31358.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure and Civil Code to allow private documents to be made and provided electronically instead of only in writing, with consent requirements and exceptions for family law, inheritance and personal or security guarantees by non-professionals. It also adjusts general terms rules and insurance policy provisions, and allows a general administrative order (AMvB) to set rules for electronic notifications under insurance law.
31358.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB power by stating that a statutory basis is required for rules in a decree on electronic notifications by policyholders and beneficiaries, making reciprocal electronic communication possible.
q: For including rules in a decree on the power of policyholders and benefit recipients, among others, to send notifications to the insurer electronically, a statutory basis is required.

Voor het in een besluit opnemen van regels inzake de bevoegdheid van onder meer verzekeringnemers en uitkeringgerechtigden om mededelingen aan de verzekeraar langs elektronische weg te doen, is een wettelijke basis vereist.
d: rules on electronic notifications between insurers and policyholders

parties: Welcomes cost reduction for citizens and businesses but asks whether savings are real and about the scope of the exceptions.
However, these members ask whether the administrative burden reduction in fact concerns only the saving of postage costs.
Wel vragen deze leden of de administratieve lastenverlichting de facto inderdaad alleen de besparing van de portokosten behelst.
Asks about the cost savings, employment effects in the postal sector, and whether receipt confirmation is needed.
Why does the government consider replacing the receipt confirmation with a notice of non-receipt?
Waarom overweegt de regering de ontvangstbevestiging te vervangen door een bericht van niet-ontvangst?
Raises risk of unlawful alteration and forgery of electronic documents and asks for safeguards protecting consumers.
The SP members ask whether there are sufficient safeguards that no unlawful changes can be made to deeds drawn up and sent electronically.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of er voldoende waarborgen zijn dat in akten die zijn opgemaakt en verzonden in elektronische vorm geen onrechtmatige veranderingen kunnen worden aangebracht.
Supports the aim but questions why stricter requirements apply to electronic insurance policies than to paper ones and asks for clarification of the receipt confirmation.
The VVD members note that stricter requirements apply to sending an electronic insurance policy than to sending a paper policy.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat aan de verzending van een elektronische verzekeringspolis zwaardere eisen worden gesteld dan aan verzending van een papieren polis.
Supports electronic deeds but insists on reliability safeguards and asks whether the qualified electronic signature should always be required to protect citizens.
Extending this, these members ask whether it would not be better to always require use of the qualified electronic signature.
Deze leden vragen in het verlengde hiervan of het niet beter is om te allen tijde te vereisen dat er gebruik wordt gemaakt van de gekwalificeerde handtekening.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill on electronic private-law documents should extend the rule on electronic sending of insurance policies and changes to all electronic private deeds, and should clarify the family and inheritance law exception and its interaction with Article 1:88 BW. The government's reply accepts the extension, explains the retained written-form exception as practical rather than substantive, adjusts Article 1:88(3) BW to allow electronic consent, and makes drafting changes.
concerns: The extension of the electronic-sending consent rule from insurance policies to all private deeds was adopted by moving the rule into Article 156a Rv.

The exception for family and inheritance law deeds was questioned as insufficiently justified; the government kept the written-form requirement but clarified the explanatory memorandum on practical grounds.
Unclear interaction between the family-law exception and Article 1:88 BW on spousal consent was addressed by amending Article 1:88(3) BW to allow electronic consent.
Editorial remarks on wording of Article 156a Rv and Article II were incorporated.

31385.s: The bill amends the Advocatenwet and the Wet op het notarisambt to allow faster disciplinary action against lawyers and notaries suspected of serious professional misconduct. It lets the dean or chamber chair impose immediate suspension or interim measures, subject to time limits and a right to request lifting, and requires deans to disclose prior disciplinary records to disciplinary judges.
31385.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by a motion of the House of Representatives and the need for effective, rapid intervention where lawyers or notaries threaten serious professional misconduct that requires immediate action.
q: The bill aims to provide broader possibilities for expedited disciplinary action against lawyers and notaries who are seriously suspected of professional misconduct or of threatening to commit it.

Het wetsvoorstel beoogt ruimere mogelijkheden te bieden tot het spoedshalve tuchtrechtelijk optreden tegen advocaten en notarissen waarvan een ernstig vermoeden bestaat dat zij beroepsmatig ontsporen of dreigen te ontsporen.
p: The dean of the bar can request immediate suspension or interim measures against a lawyer on a serious suspicion, a broader power than before, though the disciplinary board decides, a time limit applies, and the lawyer can request lifting and appeal.
Artikel II C (106 Wet op het notarisambt)
The chair of the notarial supervisory chamber may order immediate suspension of a notary on a lower threshold, with a 30-day decision deadline and a right to request lifting.

parties: Asks how 'threatening to go astray' is defined with concrete examples, whether the measure extends to other legal professions, and how it fits the forthcoming integral disciplinary reform.
They strongly endorse the importance of these instruments, but ask for further explanation of when there is in fact a case of 'threatening to go astray'.
Zij onderschrijven het belang van deze instrumenten ten zeerste, maar vragen of nader kan worden ingegaan op de vraag wanneer feitelijk sprake is van «dreigen te ontsporen»?
Asks whether the expedited procedure and interim measures also apply to first-time disciplinary cases and seeks the timetable for entry into force so bodies can prepare.
When will the parties concerned have adequately prepared for the new procedure, and when is the law expected to enter into force at the latest?
Wanneer zullen voornoemde betrokkenen de nieuwe procedure voldoende hebben voorbereid en wanneer zal naar verwachting de wet uiterlijk in werking treden?

Wants the measures adopted without waiting for the broader reform, asks how 'ambtshalve op de hoogte' is interpreted (e.g. media reports) and how imposed measures are registered and made public to protect citizens; also wants the tuchtrechter to see all relevant facts.
These members therefore want to not wait for the handling of other legislative measures, such as the reform of the Advocatenwet and the disciplinary procedure, as advised by the Council of State.
Deze leden willen dan ook de behandeling van andere wetgevende maatregelen ... niet afwachten, zoals door de Raad van State wordt geadviseerd.

Asks how long interim measures and suspensions can last, whether the six-week term can be extended during appeal, how clients will know a lawyer is under supervision, and why notaries get a 30-day term while lawyers do not; also asks whether the temporary privacy exemption will be extended.
Can the urgent measure indeed last longer than two times six weeks if an appeal procedure is ongoing?
Kan inderdaad de spoedmaatregel langer dan twee maal zes weken duren indien er een hogerberoepsprocedure loopt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill widening urgent disciplinary measures (including suspension) against lawyers and civil-law notaries, and criticises the lack of justification for an interim suspension given the pending reform of professional-group disciplinary law, plus a missing maximum deadline for complaints after an interim measure and an inconsistency between text and explanatory memorandum on the antecedents list. The government reply accepts most points: it adds reasoning distinguishing the new procedure from the article 60b procedure, sets a six-week deadline (extendable once) for filing complaints, and aligns the text with the explanatory memorandum on the antecedents list.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether an urgent suspension power is needed now, given the pending integral reform of professional-group disciplinary law and the existing article 60b procedure; the memorandum was supplemented to explain the complementary role of the new procedure.

The statute must set the maximum deadline for filing the complaint or objection after an interim measure, and any extension, given the far-reaching nature of the measure; a six-week maximum with one extension of six weeks was added.

The text and explanatory memorandum on the content of the antecedents list must be made consistent, specifically on whether dismissed complaints are listed; the text of articles 46d and 56e was amended.

Several drafting points on article I(E), article II(C) and transitional article IV were raised, including clarifying which disciplinary rules apply and ensuring immediate entry into force of the antecedents provisions.

31439.s: The bill obliges municipal executives (college van burgemeester en wethouders) to give residents access to an anti-discrimination facility that provides independent assistance with discrimination complaints and registers them. Municipalities must report annually to the minister on registered complaints, with the detailed rules left to a general administrative order and a ministerial regulation.
31439.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation on registration as administrative detail where flexibility is desirable, and the general administrative order as a way to guarantee service quality.
q: Because these are rules of an administrative nature, where flexibility is desirable, the power to set further rules is delegated to the Minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration.
Omdat het om regels van administratieve aard gaat, waarbij flexibiliteit wenselijk is, wordt de bevoegdheid om nadere regels te stellen gedelegeerd aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie.
d: organisation of anti-discrimination facility and performance of assistance task
content and format of annual municipal reports

parties: Asks for a clearer definition of low-threshold access and for quality criteria to be fixed before the act takes effect, to avoid quality differences between facilities.
These members therefore want a clearer definition of what is meant by low-threshold.
Deze leden wensen daarom een duidelijkere definitie van wat men dient te verstaan onder laagdrempelig.
Asks why monitoring, information and advice tasks are left out of the act and why quality requirements and funding guarantees are absent.
These members believe complaint handling and registration are insufficient to give insight into the nature and extent of discrimination and want the other tasks included in the bill.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat klachtenbehandeling en registratie onvoldoende zijn om inzicht in de aard en omvang van discriminatie te geven en willen de ander taak ook graag in het wetsvoorstel verwerkt zien.
Questions the 6 million euro budget, the omitted advisory and information task, and the lack of uniform arrangements, asking for reconsideration and a pooled regional structure.
The Council of State, the VNG, the CGB and Art. 1 all criticise the 6 million euro made available.
Zowel de Raad van State, de VNG, de CGB als Art. 1 hebben kritiek op het beschikbaar gestelde bedrag van € 6 miljoen.

Asks whether a statutory obligation is necessary, how the facilities relate to the Juridisch Loket and private legal aid, whether the Minister of Justice was involved, and whether advice from the VNG and other bodies was requested.
These members ask whether the government can once again explain why it is necessary to anchor the obligation of the mayor and aldermen in a formal statute.
Deze leden vragen of de regering nog eens gemotiveerd uiteen kan zetten waarom het noodzakelijk is om de verplichting aan het College van Burgemeester en Wethouders in een formele wet te verankeren.
Asks about the risk that funding cuts by provinces and uneven municipal contributions leave facilities below the advised budget, and about the open versus limitative list of anti-discrimination laws.
Asks which bottlenecks hindered professionalisation under the earlier scheme, whether the budget accounts for it, and why the minister of Social Affairs is not the lead minister.
These members ask how interdepartmental coordination on the implementation of this bill is arranged.
Deze leden vragen hoe de interdepartementale afstemming ten aanzien van de uitvoering van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel geregeld is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Wet gemeentelijke antidiscriminatievoorzieningen should be revised, raising concerns about annual reporting obligations and their legal basis, the financial compensation for municipalities, and insufficient consultation with VNG and IPO. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, moving the reporting deadline to 1 April, changing the legal basis to an algemene maatregel van bestuur, and supplementing the explanatory memorandum on costs and consultation.
concerns: The Raad questioned the justification for annual reporting by municipalities given the goal of reducing information obligations, and the 1 February deadline, which the government accepted by moving it to 1 April with added motivation.
The ministerial regulation was an insufficient legal basis for reporting rules under article 119 of the Gemeentewet, which the government accepted by changing it to an algemene maatregel van bestuur.

The Raad found the cost estimate of 6 million euro insufficiently motivated and not matched to the defined tasks, and asked for compensation of reporting obligations; the government supplemented the memorandum but the cost review was deferred to mid-2008 with VNG.
The Raad noted that VNG and IPO were not formally consulted as required by the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen; the government explained informal consultation and supplemented the memorandum.
The Raad gave editorial comments on the opening formula, the terms ingezetenen and nadere, and co-signature, which the government adopted.

31448.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands an exchange of notes amending the 2000 Dutch-New Zealand social security treaty, so the agreement can be binding on the Kingdom. The explanatory extract explains that a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on export of Toeslag Wet-based supplements under similar treaties prompted the amendment.
31448.j: The memorandum justifies the amendment by reference to the CRvB 2003 ruling that exporting the supplement was required under the treaties' wording.
q: On 12 December 2003 the Central Appeals Tribunal (CRvB), however, ruled that ending payment of the TW supplement alongside a WAO benefit conflicted with the wording of the social security treaties.

Op 12 december 2003 oordeelde de Centrale Raad van Beroep (CRvB) echter dat het beëindigen van de uitbetaling van de toeslag op grond van de TW in aanvulling op een WAO-uitkering in strijd was met de bewoordingen van de socialezekerheidsverdragen

parties: They question whether the treaty fairly divides pension costs between the Netherlands and New Zealand and ask the government to respond and act before the report is answered.
They ask when and how the government will reach agreement with Morocco to end export of allowances, whether other countries will refuse, and whether the government will consider retaliation.
The VVD members ask when and how the government will reach agreement with Morocco to end the export of allowances under the Allowances Act.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen wanneer en hoe de regering met Marokko tot overeenstemming komt om de export van toeslagen op grond van de Toeslagenwet te beëindigen?
They ask how the government will prevent allowances being paid to treaty countries and request an overview of amounts transferred per country.
The PVV members ask how the government will prevent allowances being paid out to treaty countries.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen hoe de regering gaat voorkomen dat er toeslagen worden uitbetaald naar verdragslanden?

31466.s: The bill amends the Wet gebruik burgerservicenummer in de zorg to establish a national electronic patient record (EPD) built around a landelijk schakelpunt (national switching point) with an index of care providers holding patient data, while allowing healthcare providers to share medical data without patient consent. Detailed scope, data categories, security requirements and the national switching point's operation are delegated to general administrative measures (AMvB) and ministerial regulations, with administrative fines and minister's enforcement powers added.
31466.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for a phased, detailed roll-out and technological flexibility, and cites the privacy directive's public-interest exception and a pre-consultation procedure for AMvB as safeguards.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative measure, rules are laid down on the setup and management of the national switching point.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld met betrekking tot de inrichting en het beheer van het landelijk schakelpunt
d: rules on setup and management of national switching point, security and supervision
rules on governance and supervision of the body running the switching point
patient access facilities added to the national switching point
how the identity and citizen service number of the client are verified
which care, providers, practitioners and client categories the EPD applies to and for which purposes
data content of the EPD and detailed requirements on data processing and security
how the client service desk verifies identity and citizen service number
other uses of UZI numbers and rules on their use
transitional rules for good introduction of the act, including timing of EPD access
p: Patients' medical confidentiality is overridden by legal obligation rather than consent, with the switching point and its governance set by general administrative measure.
The minister may issue binding instructions and take necessary measures against the national switching point operator after giving it a chance to comply.
The minister may impose administrative fines of up to EUR 16,750 or EUR 3,350 on healthcare providers and insurers for breaches.
Core scope of the EPD is delegated to general administrative measure, subject to necessity, proportionality and a pre-consultation procedure in parliament.

parties: Asks whether patients can refuse access, whether the LSP needs independent status and backup, and who bears liability for harm from system failures.
Surely it is for the legislator to determine who is liable, and for the courts to judge individual cases.
Het is toch aan de wetgever om vast te leggen wie aansprakelijk is en aan de rechter om in individuele casussen te oordelen.
Stresses privacy under the Wbp and asks whether the definition of authorised users is too broad and whether patients should be protected in opt-out arrangements.
For the PvdA members, the question of whether the EPD adequately respects privacy requirements under the Wbp weighs very heavily.](Note: sentence translated)
Voor de leden van de PvdA-fractie weegt de vraag of het EPD afdoende rekening houdt met de vereisten van privacy, zoals vastgelegd in de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) heel zwaar.
Asks who owns the record, who is responsible for accuracy and sanctions, and how patients under legal orders are treated.
The SP members ask who is responsible for the accuracy of the data in the EPD.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen wie verantwoordelijk is voor de juistheid van de gegevens in het EPD.
Questions why essential conditions are regulated through lower legislation rather than the statute, given far-reaching decisions on privacy and mandatory participation.
Can the government explain why it was chosen to regulate such important conditions for realising the EPD through lower legislation?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom er gekozen is om dergelijke belangrijke voorwaarden ter realisatie van het EPD via lagere wetgeving te regelen
Asks whether patients who object to electronic exchange of their medical information can opt out or limit it.
They ask whether patients who object to the electronic exchange of their medical information will have a way to opt out or limit the exchange.

Zij vragen of er voor patiënten die bezwaar hebben tegen de elektronische uitwisseling van hun medische informatie een mogelijkheid zal bestaan om zich hieraan te onttrekken of de uitwisseling te beperken.
Asks how patients will get direct access to their own medical data and whether the bill regulates this, and asks about the timetable for amvb's and the privacy and penalty regime.
Is the government willing and able to explain how citizens will get access not only to who has access to their data, but to the information itself?
Is de regering bereid en in staat om uiteen te zetten hoe burgers niet alleen inzage krijgen in wie inzage in hun gegevens heeft, maar juist tot de informatie zelf?
Critical of the LHV's refusal to cooperate with the EPD and asks what sanctions apply and what agreements exist with GPs; also raises privacy and back-up questions for the LSP.
When do sanctions for not cooperating with the EPD come into play?
Wanneer komen sancties voor het niet meewerken aan het EPD in beeld?
Supportive of the EPD but argues the law should describe processes rather than the technical system and asks the government to consult the field further before proceeding.
The VVD members are of the view that the law should not describe the system.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn van mening dat de wet niet het systeem moet beschrijven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against submitting the bill on the national electronic patient record (EPD) in its current form, citing unproven necessity, premature implementation risks, weak statutory safeguards, and doubts about patient consent and the legal basis for data processing. The government's nader rapport accepts several points (dossier safeguards, patient consent via informed consent, separate statutory basis) but rejects others, such as the claim that a statutory basis is needed for all data categories and the request to postpone implementation until the electronic ID card is available.
concerns: The Raad doubts the necessity of a nationwide EPD and asks for proof that a regional or limited alternative would not suffice; the government adds justification and a discussion of alternatives but maintains the national model.

The Raad considers the implementation date of 1 January 2009 unrealistic given pilot problems and the digitisation burden; the government says implementation will follow evaluation of pilots and a realistic timeline.

The Raad objects that essential elements such as which data are in the EPD, security rules and LSP governance are left to lower regulation; the government narrows the delegation in article 13i and adds some elements to the statute.

The Raad argues the opt-out 'no objection' system reverses the statutory rule requiring patient consent under the WGBO; the government replaces it with an informed-consent model and requires patient consent for consultation outside emergencies.

The Raad finds the legal status of Nictiz and the LSP unclear and questions whether the LSP is an administrative body; the government clarifies that its acts are factual and adds information and neglect provisions.
The Raad requires a treatment relationship check before access to EPD data beyond emergencies; the government adds authorisation steps in lower regulation but does not require a technical pre-check.

The Raad asks that patients get written information and some time to decide, and that the electronic ID card or equivalent exists before patients can inspect their data; the government adds written information and a reflection period but defers the ID card.
The Raad advises placing the EPD rules in the BW or a separate act rather than amending the Wbsn-z; the government keeps the Wbsn-z amendment because of the link with the citizen service number.
The Raad notes the financial gap between the government's budget and sector requests and asks for explanation of financial aspects; the government adds this to the explanatory memorandum.

31493.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT, excise and beverage/other products consumption tax acts to implement EU Directive 2007/74/EC on traveller allowances, inserting new articles 21a and 21b into the VAT Act that set duty-free import limits for travellers from third countries. It also extends these rules to excise via a new article 68a and to the other consumption tax via an amended article 31, effective 1 December 2008.
31493.j: The memorandum explains that the delegation basis in article 21 of the VAT Act no longer fits after the amendment of Regulation 918/83/EEC, so the traveller allowance rules are now set directly in the statute with a reference to the national VAT provisions.
q: After the amendment of Regulation 918/83/EEC, the delegation possibility of article 21, parts a and b, of the VAT Act 1968 no longer suffices for the traveller exemption.
Na de wijziging van Verordening 918/83/EEG voldoet de delegatiemogelijkheid van artikel 21, onderdelen a en b, van de Wet OB 1968 voor de reizigersvrijstelling niet meer.

parties: Asks why the timetable is so short, whether the age limit for strong drink should match the 18-year rule of the drink and hospitality act, and why no indexation is included.
Is the government willing, at a future implementation of an EU directive, to give the States General more time to deliberate on the bill?
Is de regering bereid om bij een volgende implementatie van een EU richtlijn de Staten-Generaal ruimer de tijd te geven om het wetsvoorstel te behandelen?

Supports the higher allowances and quick implementation, but asks for an overview of existing national special regimes and the basis for the chosen amounts, and questions divergent rules across member states.
Is the government willing to re-examine these old national special arrangements for their desirability and currency and reconsider them, and if not, why not?
Is de regering bereid deze «oude nationale koppen» opnieuw op hun wenselijkheid en actualiteit te toetsen en in heroverweging te nemen en zo neen, waarom niet?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on a bill transposing Directive 2007/74/EC on the traveller exemption into the Turnover Tax Act 1968, that the material rules be placed in the statute rather than in ministerial customs regulation, and that the plezier-travel exception and the lower thresholds be correctly implemented. The Secretary of State adopted the advice in full, moving the traveller exemption rules and the crew quantities into the Wet OB 1968 and adding a separate regime for pleasure aviation and sea travellers.
concerns: Material rules implementing the directive were placed in a ministerial customs regulation, which the Raad considered inappropriate; the government adopted the advice and moved them into the statute.
The bill did not fully implement the directive's exception for private pleasure aviation and sea travellers, which the government corrected by adding a separate regime.
Definitions, thresholds, quantitative limits, age limits and crew rules should be set out in the statute given their stability, and the government did so.

31538.s: The bill approves the 2007 treaty among Spain, France, Italy, the Netherlands and Portugal establishing the EUROGENDFOR European gendarmerie force. It contains only a single approval article and an entry-into-force provision, with no delegation or new executive powers.
q: The treaty concluded at Velsen on 18 October 2007 ... is approved for the Netherlands.
Het op 18 oktober 2007 te Velsen totstandgekomen Verdrag ... wordt goedgekeurd voor Nederland.

parties: Asks whether agreements with third states will be fully submitted to parliament and whether article 100 of the Constitution on parliamentary control applies to deployments of the EGF.
Is the government planning to submit such agreements to the House in full?
Is de Regering voornemens dergelijke overeenkomsten volledig aan de Kamer voor te leggen?
Asks about the capacity, cost and budget article of the Royal Marechaussee contribution and whether the Ministry of the Interior's plans for police deployments abroad are consistent with the EGF.
How much capacity is the Royal Marechaussee (KMar) expected to have to provide upon approval of this treaty?
Hoeveel capaciteit zal de Koninklijke Marechaussee (KMar) naar verwachting moeten leveren met de goedkeuring van dit verdrag?

31547.s: The bill amends the Dutch Medicines Act to align it with EU Regulation 1394/2007 on advanced therapy medicinal products, adding definitions and cross-references to Regulation 726/2004. It also adjusts rules on hospital-prepared advanced therapy products, summaries of product characteristics, labelling and package leaflets, and requires the Inspectorate to supervise equivalence of quality standards.
31547.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as purely technical adjustments required by the directly applicable EU regulation, with no new discretionary powers.
q: This bill concerns a purely technical amendment of the Medicines Act in connection with the entry into force on 10 December 2007 of Regulation (EC) No.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt tot een louter technische wijziging van de Geneesmiddelenwet in verband met de inwerkingtreding op 10 december 2007 van Verordening (EG) Nr.

31556.s: The bill allows municipal councils to impose administrative fines (up to €18,500 or €340) for violations of housing permit rules under the Huisvestingswet, with burgemeester and wethouders empowered to impose them. Criminal liability for the relevant violations lapses one year after entry into force to give municipalities time to set up enforcement.
31556.j: The memorandum justifies the fines by arguing that enforcement requires no intrusive powers, that the sanctions are simple to establish, and that appeals to courts are expected to be limited.
q: An administrative fine is appropriate if no intrusive powers are needed for imposing the sanction and it may be expected that in practice no court ruling will usually be sought on the sanction and the powers applied.

Een bestuurlijke boete komt in aanmerking indien voor de oplegging van de sanctie geen ingrijpende bevoegdheden nodig zijn en verwacht mag worden dat in de praktijk doorgaans geen rechterlijk oordeel zal worden gevraagd over de sanctie en de toegepaste bevoegdheden.
d: municipal council may by ordinance provide for administrative fines
municipal council sets amounts of administrative fines by ordinance
burgemeester en wethouders empowered to impose fines, mandate possible to officials
p: Municipal executives gain power to impose administrative fines directly on residents for housing permit violations, subject to statutory maximums and general administrative law appeal procedures.
Artikel I, A en Artikel I, B (artikel 85a, eerste lid)
Criminal prosecution of the listed violations is removed after one year, shifting enforcement to administrative fines that the Public Prosecutor will not pursue once a municipality opts for them.

parties: Asks whether the fine power and the mandate to subordinate officials should be capped, and whether municipal councils get annual information on use of the fine.
The CDA members believe the municipal council should know the extent of abuses and therefore how the administrative fine instrument is used.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn van mening dat de gemeenteraad kennis dient te hebben van de omvang van misstanden en daarom van het gebruik van het instrument bestuurlijke boete.
Supports the fine as an effective tool against unlawful occupation, while asking how far the duty to pursue legalisation extends and whether intentional evasion can justify refusing it.
Can the fact that a landlord or sublandlord deliberately evades the Huisvestingswet rules be a reason to refuse legalisation?
Kan het feit dat een verhuurder of doorverhuurder opzettelijk de regels van de Huisvestingswet ontduikt een reden zijn legalisering te weigeren?
Asks why criminal prosecution, which may be the most appropriate route against repeat offenders, is to be phased out in favour of administrative fines.
Can the government explain why it has chosen to eventually abolish the criminal law route?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten waarom wordt gekozen voor het op termijn afschaffen van de strafrechtelijke weg?
Supports the fine instrument but raises questions on differing maximum fines across municipalities, the reach of the fine for ordinary parents, and the use of GBA population data by landlords.
These members ask who carries out that comparison and on what basis this is permitted.
Deze leden vragen wie die vergelijking uitvoert en op basis waarvan dit is toegestaan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued a favourable opinion on the bill amending the Housing Act to allow administrative fines for certain violations, with only editorial remarks. The minister's nader rapport confirms that the bill raises no substantive concerns and explains why one editorial remark was not adopted.
concerns: The Afdeling made an editorial remark about article I, part A, suggesting a separate transitional provision, which the government did not adopt because the current wording is the most efficient.

31592.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act and related laws to integrate the Dutch environmental reporting duty (MJV) into the PRTR emissions report, allowing additional data to be specified by general administrative order. It also removes the separate MJV register provisions and adjusts supervision, notification and works council references accordingly.
31592.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for data serving enforcement, environmental policy and international obligations, and by limiting additional themes to a closed list.
q: Only data on the adverse environmental effects caused by the installation in the reporting year, and reasonably necessary for the listed purposes, may be designated as such data.

Als gegevens als bedoeld in de eerste volzin worden uitsluitend aangewezen gegevens omtrent de nadelige gevolgen voor het milieu die de inrichting in het verslagjaar heeft veroorzaakt, en die redelijkerwijs nodig zijn voor
d: additional data to be included in the PRTR report
optional additional reporting obligations in permits (local nuisance themes)
rules on use of data from other regulation to determine reporting duty
p: Allows general administrative order to designate further reportable data beyond the EU regulation, limited to local environmental harms needed for enforcement and policy.
Lets the competent authority impose additional reporting duties in environmental permits, with themes listed exhaustively by administrative order.

parties: Asks that delegated regulations (AMvBs) impose no reporting obligations beyond those from international and European rules, that the AMvBs be submitted to parliament, and that both registers be confirmed as publicly accessible under the Aarhus Convention.
May these members assume that no obligations other than those arising from international and European rules will be included?
Mogen deze leden ervan uitgaan dat geen andere verplichtingen dan die welke voortvloeien uit internationale en Europese regels worden opgenomen?

Asks whether optional-mandatory reporting could create large regional differences in information available to citizens on odour and noise, whether information provision remains adequately safeguarded, and how quality validation applies to the integrated PRTR report.
To what extent does the quality assessment (validation), as currently applies to the MJV, apply to the integrated PRTR report?
In hoeverre geldt de kwaliteitsbeoordeling (validatie) zoals bij het huidige MJV van toepassing is, voor het integrale PRTR-verslag?

Questions why public access must be tied to a Wob procedure rather than being published directly online, asks which substances are dropped and how supervision will be organised, and asks why energy data is excluded from reporting.
Why can this information not be made public directly via the internet?
Waarom kan deze informatie niet direct openbaar gemaakt worden via internet?

31736.s: The bill introduces a bestuursrechtelijke premium (130% of the standard premium) imposed by the College zorgverzekeringen on persistent health insurance non-payers who have not resolved their debts, with collection via wage withholding, benefit deductions, and seizure without a court order. It sets a procedure for insurers to offer payment arrangements and notify debtors, and it excludes administrative appeal against the CVZ's premium decisions in favour of civil-law remedies.
31736.j: The memorandum justifies the premium and collection powers as needed to move unwilling non-payers to pay and to prevent shifting obligations onto others, while civil-law procedures are said to give citizens adequate legal protection.
q: The aim of the bill is to move the unwilling to pay the nominal premium to their health insurer by threatening, if non-payment continues, a higher administrative premium that will also be collected directly from income.

Doel van het wetsvoorstel is de onwilligen tot het betalen van de nominale premie aan hun zorgverzekeraar te bewegen door hen indien de wanbetaling voortduurt een hogere, bestuursrechtelijke premie in het vooruitzicht te stellen, die bovendien direct op het inkomen zal worden geïnd.
d: Artikel I, E/F (artikel 18d, lid 2 en 18f, lid 4)
rules on how the CVZ collects the bestuursrechtelijke premium
period, height and manner of the bijdrage for insuring non-payers
Besluit zorgverzekering now also based on articles 19 and 21
p: The CVZ may collect the premium by wage withholding, redirect the healthcare allowance and seize bank balances and goods without a court judgment, bypassing ordinary civil enforcement safeguards.
The CVZ has no discretion to verify the insurer's notification, and administrative appeal against premium decisions is excluded in favour of civil-law remedies.
Appeal to the administrative court and the administrative objection procedure are excluded for CVZ decisions on the existence and start date of the bestuursrechtelijke premium.
For two years, objections against CVZ premium decisions must be decided within twelve weeks, a temporary shortened period that expires after three years.

parties: Asks why the problem must be regulated under administrative law, questions the 130% surcharge, and asks how the appeal procedure and the distinction between unable and unwilling defaulters will work.
They do ask the government to again address why this problem must be regulated under administrative law.
Wel vragen ze de regering nog eens in te gaan op de vraag waarom deze problematiek bestuursrechtelijk geregeld moet worden.
Asks about the CVZ's discretion and scope of review, the cost to the judiciary, the role of municipalities and the privacy burden on employers.
How does the government see the link between the open norm of 'sufficient cooperation' and the case law that has developed around forced debt arrangements?
Hoe ziet de regering de samenhang tussen de invulling van de open norm «voldoende medewerking» en de jurisprudentie die zich de afgelopen tijd gevormd heeft rond de gedwongen schuldregeling?
Calls the bill cumbersome, stresses distinguishing the unwilling from the unable, and asks about privacy and the effect on people near the social minimum.
The SP members want to stress again that a distinction must be made between people who are unwilling to pay the premium and people who are unable to pay.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen nogmaals benadrukken dat er onderscheid gemaakt dient te worden tussen mensen die onwillig zijn om de premie te betalen en mensen die onmachtig zijn.

Supports tackling defaulters but asks whether the CVZ and tax systems are ready, the costs for employers and the cost-benefit of collection, and whether the Council of State's objections are answered.
The VVD members support the government's effort to tackle defaulters so that people who do pay their premium do not bear the costs of this group.
De leden van de VVD -fractie steunen de inzet van de regering om wanbetalers aan te pakken en zo te voorkomen dat mensen, die wel hun premie betalen, opdraaien voor de kosten van deze groep.
Asks about the financial burden of defaulting and uninsured people on premium-paying citizens and whether the approach will lower the nominal premium.
What amount currently falls on premium-paying fellow citizens due to non-payment and being uninsured?
Welk bedrag komt er op dit moment door wanbetaling en onverzekerd zijn ten laste van premiebetalende medeburgers?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against proceeding in its current form, arguing the bill to impose a punitive public-law premium on premium defaulters is not shown to be necessary or effective for the unwilling and unable groups, and conflicts with the private-law character of health insurance, EU state-aid rules and Article 6 ECHR. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the criticism and amended the bill: a mandatory payment-arrangement offer, a legal basis for compensation, narrowed wage deductions and a procedural pre-stage, while rejecting the state-aid and creditor-preference objections.
concerns: The Raad doubts the bill is necessary for the unwilling and effective for the unable, since existing private-law collection tools were not shown insufficient; the government added a payment-arrangement offer and separated the groups but did not accept that the bill was unnecessary.

The Raad finds that contestation of the notice must meet Article 6 ECHR fair-trial standards, since no appeal lies against the premium decision; the government argued civil remedies suffice and added procedural steps and a pre-stage.

The Raad considers the compensation to insurers may constitute unnotified state aid and advises notification to the European Commission; the government maintained that compensation at nominal reference premium is not overcompensation and not state aid.

The Raad objects that the broad delegation to designate income sources and payers by ministerial regulation is inappropriate; the government moved the designation of payers and income into the statute itself.

The Raad advises limiting the higher premium to debts arising after entry into force, since existing defaulters could not foresee it; the government instead gave existing defaulters a pre-stage and time to comply.

The Raad objects that the statutory preferential ranking of the CVZ claim lacks adequate justification and erodes paritas creditorum; the government kept the preference, citing its social-insurance character.

The Raad points to redactional issues, including specifying the 'necessary personal data' to exclude special categories and clarifying the notice periods; these were largely adopted in the amended text.
The Raad asks for elaboration of implementation costs, Belastingdienst and UWV readiness, and the NZA's supervisory burden; the government added consultation details and cost clarifications.

31763.s: The bill allows Dutch public and private limited companies (NV and BV) to use a single board combining executive and non-executive directors (monistic model) as an alternative to the dualistic model with a separate supervisory board, and tightens rules on conflicts of interest and the duties of directors. It also makes the non-executive directors' supervisory role and the appointment rules for binding nominations and executive directors statutory.
31763.j: The memorandum justifies the division of board tasks as a way to permit a monistic board structure, leaving the choice to companies, with supervision built into the single board.
q: By or pursuant to the articles of association it may be provided that board tasks are divided among one or more non-executive directors and one or more executive directors.
Bij of krachtens de statuten kan worden bepaald dat bestuurstaken worden verdeeld over één of meer niet uitvoerende bestuurders en één of meer uitvoerende bestuurders.
d: division of board tasks and delegation of decision powers to individual directors via articles of association or by-laws

parties: Asks whether shareholders should decide on introducing the one-tier board via statutes rather than leaving it to directors, and whether the crisis and competitiveness rationale justify the change.
It is conceivable that the current shareholders' meeting would not want to leave the decision to adopt the one-tier board model to the board.
Het is denkbaar dat de actuele aandeelhoudersvergadering de beslissing om over te gaan tot het one-tier board model niet aan het bestuur willen overlaten.
Worries that combining supervision and management in one body weakens independence and the balance of power, and asks how independent oversight and information rights can be guaranteed.
How can the balance between power and counterpower be preserved if these two merge into one body?
Hoe kan het evenwicht tussen macht en tegenmacht gewaarborgd blijven, als deze twee opgaan in één orgaan?
Opposes concentrating management and supervision in one body and asks about legal certainty of task allocation and publication of conflict-of-interest arrangements.
They are not in favour of concentrating management and supervision in one body.
Zij zijn geen voorstander van de concentratie van bestuur en toezicht in één orgaan.
Supports both models and legal anchoring of responsibilities and liabilities, asking how supervision by non-executive directors differs from supervisory boards and how liability is allocated.
Moreover, codifying the responsibilities and associated liabilities of directors in the monistic system in law contributes to legal certainty.
Bovendien draagt vastlegging van verantwoordelijkheden en daarmee verbonden aansprakelijkheden van bestuurders in het monistische stelsel in de wet bij aan de rechtszekerheid.

31772.s: The bill integrates chapter 3 of the WTOS (school-cost allowance for under-18 pupils in secondary and vocational education) into the Child-Related Budget Act by raising child-budget supplements by age and income, while repealing the separate allowance and adjusting related provisions. It sets transitional rules, amends the Student Finance Act and the Secondary Education Act, and allows the child-budget amounts to be indexed by ministerial regulation and raised by general administrative order.
31772.j: The memorandum justifies the integration as reducing administrative burden for parents and simplifying implementation, and gives no specific reason for the indexation delegations.
q: Article 3, second paragraph, makes it possible for the amounts referred to in article 3, first paragraph, to be increased by general administrative order in a manner other than that resulting from indexation.

Artikel 3, tweede lid, maakt het mogelijk dat de bedragen, bedoeld in artikel 3, eerste lid, op andere wijze dan die voortvloeit uit de indexering, bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen worden verhoogd.
d: indexation of child-budget supplement amounts and income threshold
annual change of supplement amounts and income threshold via tax table correction factor
raising the supplement amounts by general administrative order

parties: Asks how parents will be informed about the new scheme and why the 6.5% phase-out rate was chosen, and how implementation between IB-Groep and Belastingdienst is organised.
However, it is important that information provided to parents about the new scheme is well organised.
Het is echter wel van belang dat de informatievoorziening naar ouders i.v.m. de nieuwe regeling goed wordt vormgegeven.
Asks which groups of parents will be disadvantaged, whether alternatives exist for about a hundred parents losing entitlement, and how pleegouders are affected.
Can the government indicate in broad outline which groups of parents will be disadvantaged by the proposed scheme and by what amounts?
Kan de regering op hoofdlijnen aangeven welke groepen ouders wel nadeel zullen ondervinden van de voorgestelde regeling en om welke bedragen het hier gaat?

Argues kinderbijslag should also be income-dependent, criticises insufficient attention to sudden income drops such as divorce, and asks about children without legal representatives and foster parents.
They are of the view that child benefit too should be income-dependent.
Zij zijn van mening dat ook de kinderbijslag inkomensafhankelijk zou moeten zijn.

Opposes using the education budget for income policy, questions budgetary effects, poverty and employment traps, and whether the scheme still serves its original purpose of not hindering school attendance.
As is known, the VVD members hold that income policy should not be pursued through the education budget.
Zoals bekend zijn de leden van de VVD -fractie van mening dat er via de onderwijsbegroting geen inkomenspolitiek mag worden bedreven.

Welcomes reduced administrative burden and fewer child schemes, but asks how parents are informed, the budgetary effect of the age-based change, and why a 30% phase-out is kept for remaining WTOS parts.
In particular they find the reduction of administrative burdens for parents and the reduction of non-use of the WTOS positive.
Met name vinden zij de vermindering van administratieve lasten voor ouders en het terugdringen van niet-gebruik van de WTOS positief.
Asks for data on how many parents leave their WTOS entitlement unused and for a comparison of the withdrawal effects before and after integration.
They ask how many parents leave their WTOS entitlement unused.
Zij vragen hoeveel ouders hun recht op WTOS ongebruikt aan zich voorbij laten gaan.

31790.s: The bill raises the statutory college fee (collegegeld) for higher education and restructures the repayment system for student loans, including new repayment phases, income-based repayment rules and a debt write-off option. It also makes various technical amendments to the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 and the Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek, including indexation of fees and loan amounts.
31790.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly on the grounds that the detailed income thresholds and payment rules must track changing wage and benefit levels and need to be adjusted flexibly.
q: Since benefit levels may change yearly and the same benefit will not always be the highest, the power to set an amount is delegated to the minister.

Aangezien de uitkeringsniveaus jaarlijks kunnen wijzigen en niet altijd dezelfde uitkering het hoogste bedrag zal kennen, wordt de bevoegdheid tot het vaststellen van een bedrag gedelegeerd aan de minister.
d: income thresholds and timing for debt write-off
procedure for debt write-off order, with parliamentary laying
revision of minimum annual repayment amount and payment rules
requirements for application by non-resident borrowers
repayment terms, income assessment rules and minimum income threshold for old-regime borrowers
annual indexation of statutory college fee via CPI
p: Eligibility and timing for debt write-off are set by general administrative order rather than in the statute, subject to parliamentary laying and a right of Parliament to demand legislation.
The minimum annual repayment amount can be revised by ministerial regulation without a statutory update.
Annual indexation of the college fee is delegated to a ministerial regulation based on a CPI formula set out in the statute.

parties: Welcomes the fee increase as a logical follow-up to earlier agreement and the more flexible repayment rules; asks about the t-2 reference year for ondernemers' income and the omitted bijverdiengrens change.
The members of this group are pleased that the original plans, as set out in the Strategic Agenda for Higher Education, have been changed.
De leden van deze fractie zijn verheugd dat de oorspronkelijke plannen, zoals die in de Strategische Agenda Hoger onderwijs waren verwoord, zijn gewijzigd.

Objects to bundling two unrelated proposals into one bill ('package deal') and asks whether they can be decoupled; questions the effects on enrolment and student work, and the treatment of wrongly granted benefits and debt-restructuring.
The members of this group propose decoupling these two topics so that both can be treated carefully; as it stands, factions are confronted with a so-called 'package deal'.

De leden van deze fractie stellen voor om deze beide onderwerpen los te koppelen, zodat beide ook zorgvuldig kunnen worden behandeld; nu worden fracties immers geconfronteerd met een zgn. «package deal».

Argues the fee rise is for the wrong reason (funding teacher measures), warns of an unfunded structural shortfall of EUR 35 million for a future cabinet, and asks for figures on loans, parental contribution and administrative burden.
The members of this group are concerned about this effectively uncovered cheque, which is being handed to a future cabinet.
De leden van deze fractie maken zich zorgen over deze feitelijk ongedekte cheque, die wordt neergelegd bij een toekomstig kabinet.

Accepts the fee increase as funding for the teacher action plan, attaching strong value to accompanying measures protecting financial accessibility; asks about the diploma-term exception for chronic illness or disability.
These members, however, attach strong value to the accompanying measures to safeguard the financial accessibility of higher education.
Deze leden hechten daarbij echter wel sterke waarde aan de flankerende maatregelen om de financiële toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs te waarborgen.

31817.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Helden, Kessel, Maasbree and Meijel and establishes the new municipality of Peel en Maas from the date of merger. It also sets transitional rules on the 2008-era election timing, assigns the new municipality for taxes, shared arrangements and utilities, and amends the judicial district, police and safety region lists.
31817.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the intensive existing cooperation among the four municipalities and the frustration caused by cooperation problems, and notes the municipalities' existing power under the Gemeentewet to change their name.
q: The merger advice of 17 June 2008 concerning the aforementioned municipalities carries a positive opinion from the provincial executive of Limburg.
Het herindelingsadvies van 17 juni 2008 betreffende de eerdergenoemde gemeenten is voorzien van een positieve zienswijze van gedeputeerde staten van Limburg.

parties: Asks about the consequences of Meijel not publishing the reorganisation draft in the usual way for possible legal proceedings, and asks for voting figures in the municipal councils.
The CDA members would therefore like to know what consequences the failure to publish the reorganisation draft in the usual way in Meijel may have for possible proceedings.

Daarom zouden de leden van de CDA-fractie graag willen weten, welke consequenties het niet op de gebruikelijke wijze ter inzage leggen van het herindelingsontwerp in de gemeente Meijel kan hebben voor mogelijke procedures.
Asks for an assessment of the risk that Meijel is ordered by the administrative court to publish the draft, and whether this affects the bill.
The PvdA members ask for an assessment of the risk that Meijel could still be ordered by the administrative court to publish the reorganisation draft.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen een inschatting van het risico dat in een eventuele zaak voor de bestuursrechter de gemeente Meijel alsnog zou worden veroordeeld tot de ter inzage legging van het herindelingsontwerp.
Argues that popular support must be properly measured, questions Meijel's reversal and the skipped public inspection procedure, and asks whether the proper consultation should be followed.
The municipality of Meijel failed to make the reorganisation draft public in the usual way.
De gemeente Meijel heeft verzuimd om het herindelingsontwerp op de gebruikelijke wijze bekend te maken.
Supports the merger but asks the government to confirm that the Meijel council's late decision, not placed for public inspection, was lawfully handled.
The VVD members would like the government to inform them whether the municipal authority's conduct ultimately operated within the law.
De leden van de VVD-fractie worden door de regering gaarne geïnformeerd of met de handelwijze van het gemeentebestuur uiteindelijk wel binnen de wet is geopereerd.
Asks whether referenda, polls or popular consultations were held in the municipalities and what the voting figures were.
The PVV members ask whether there were referendums, polls or popular consultations in the municipalities concerned and, if so, what the outcomes were.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er referenda of peilingen of volksraadsplegingen zijn geweest in de betreffende gemeenten en zo ja, wat daarvan de uitkomsten waren?

31826.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the Stabilisation and Association Agreement between the European Communities and their member states and Bosnia and Herzegovina, signed in Luxembourg on 16 June 2008. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Article 1: The Stabilisation and Association Agreement concluded in Luxembourg on 16 June 2008 between the European Communities and their member states and Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Dutch text of which is published in Tractatenblad 2008, 163, is approved for the Netherlands.

Artikel 1 De op 16 juni 2008 te Luxemburg totstandgekomen Stabilisatie- en associatieovereenkomst tussen de Europese Gemeenschappen en hun lidstaten, enerzijds, en Bosnië en Herzegovina, anderzijds, waarvan de Nederlandse tekst is geplaatst in Tractatenblad 2008, 163, wordt goedgekeurd voor Nederland.

parties: Asks the government about the Republika Srpska demand for a self-determination and secession referendum in a new constitution, and about the role of the High Representative after ratification.

These members ask the government for its view on the demand of Republika Srpska representatives that the right to self-determination and a referendum on possible independence be included in a new constitution.

Deze leden vragen de regering haar visie te geven op de eis van de vertegenwoordigers van de Republika Srpska om het recht op zelfbeschikking en het recht op de mogelijkheid voor een referendum over een eventuele onafhankelijkheid van de Republika Srpska op te nemen in een nieuwe Grondwet.
Welcomes the approval bill with approval and raises no substantive concerns.
The PvdA members have noted with approval the approval act concerning the SAO between the European Communities and Bosnia and Herzegovina.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met instemming kennis genomen van de goedkeuringswet met betrekking tot de SAO tussen de Europese Gemeenschappen en Bosnië en Herzegovina.
Asks about potential conflicts with neighbouring states, durability of police reform, and the precise legal consequences of the High Representative's mandate lapsing under the Dayton accord.
Must these members understand that with that transition the mandate under the Dayton accord will lapse?
Moeten deze leden begrijpen dat met die overgang het mandaat op basis van het Dayton akkoord komt te vervallen?
Raises serious concerns about state formation, corruption, ethnic tensions, judicial reform, human rights and the stagnation of police integration, and asks whether negotiations should be reopened.
They also ask why reopening the SAO negotiations with Bosnia and Herzegovina was not considered.
Ook vragen zij waarom niet is overwogen om de SAO-onderhandelingen met Bosnië-Herzegovina opnieuw te openen.

31835.s: The bill amends the Legal Aid Act to merge the five regional legal aid councils into a single national council run by one board, with a new advisory board providing internal supervision. It transfers existing council functions, staff, assets and records to the new body and updates references in several other statutes.
31835.j: The memorandum justifies centralisation by citing greater legal uniformity and equality, cost savings, and efficiency in governance and supervision.
q: With a central form of administration, the possibilities for deviating policy are strongly limited, which increases legal uniformity and legal equality for both legal aid seekers and legal aid providers.
Bij een centrale bestuursvorm worden de mogelijkheden tot afwijkend beleid sterk beperkt, wat de rechtseenheid en rechtsgelijkheid voor zowel rechtzoekenden als rechtsbijstandverleners vergroot.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel P (artikel 33b, eerste lid)
conditions for registration of mediators, set by the board
Artikel I, onderdeel S (artikel 42, vierde lid)
application of financial reporting rules to the council via algemene maatregel van bestuur
Artikel I, onderdeel T (artikel 42a, eerste lid, onderdeel h)
rules on size and use of equalisation reserves
Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 7, derde lid, onderdeel c)
which foreign and international courts may receive income and asset declarations
p: Replaces five regional councils with one national council whose board is appointed and steered by the minister, reducing regional autonomy in legal aid administration.
Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 5, en artikel 6)
Creates an advisory board with supervisory and information rights over the board, partly independent of the minister, although the minister appoints its chair and the Kaderwet powers remain.
Artikel I, onderdeel D en E (verwijzing naar bestuur)
Transfers decision-making powers previously held by the councils to the single board, concentrating discretion in one body.

parties: Asks whether a supervisory board would give better checks than an advisory board, and worries about accountability lines and the transparency of an independent administrative body.
The CDA members still have doubts about the choice of an advisory board rather than a supervisory board.
Vraagtekens plaatsen de leden van de CDA-fractie nog bij de keuze voor een raad van advies, in plaats van een raad van toezicht.
Asks the government to guarantee that reorganisation does not lengthen processing times and that staff voices are represented in the advisory board, protecting citizens' effective access to justice.
In the members' view, access to justice comes first and not costs.
Naar de mening van de leden staat daarbij de toegang tot het recht voorop en niet de kosten.

Asks about the consequences when board advice is not followed, the handling of confidential information, the information flow between the board and the minister, and whether the advisory board should be enlarged.
These members ask what the consequence is if the advice given is not followed and to what extent the advisory board may interfere in day-to-day operations.
Deze leden vragen wat de consequentie is als het gegeven advies niet wordt opgevolgd en in hoeverre de raad van advies zich mag bemoeien met de dagelijkse gang van zaken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill merging the five legal aid councils into one, with its own two-part recommendations: renaming the supervisory board a 'raad van advies' since it lacks decision-making powers, and adding a representation rule for multi-member boards. The government followed both points, along with a drafting correction, and sent the revised bill to parliament.
concerns: The supervisory board's tasks resemble an advisory council rather than real supervision, so it should be renamed 'raad van advies' to reflect that it lacks decision-making powers.
Under the proposed provisions the whole multi-member board would represent the council in contracts, so a rule on representation should be added.
A redactional remark on the explanatory memorandum was adopted, along with corrections to wording and an additional reference to the Kaderwet.

31844.s: The bill amends several special statutes (Natuurbeschermingswet, Gaswet, Ziektewet, Belemmeringenwet Privaatrecht, Wet milieubeheer and others) to align decision deadlines with the Wet dwangsom en beroep bij niet tijdig beslissen. It mostly shortens or extends administrative decision periods, adds possibilities for postponement with consent, and grants lower-level rule-making on application procedures.
31844.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as needed to align special statutes with the new Wet dwangsom deadlines and the Awb's decision-period system, with the delegations serving to set procedural rules and time limits.
q: The amended Article 76 provides the legal basis to set, by or pursuant to a general administrative order, the period within which a decision on an application must be given.
Het gewijzigde artikel 76 biedt de wettelijke basis om bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur de termijn vast te stellen waarbinnen een beslissing op een aanvraag moet worden gegeven.
d: rules on submission and decision-making for natural beauty requests
rules on animal protection permit applications
permit or exemption decision period under Flora- en faunawet
decision period for nadeelcompensatie under ministerial policy rule

parties: Asks why changes are split across bills and whether all necessary Dwangsom-related amendments are now covered, and whether deadline extensions are realistic.
With this bill, have all the necessary amendments related to the Dwangsom Act now been dealt with?
Zijn met dit wetsvoorstel alle benodigde wijzigingen in verband met de Wet dwangsom nu behandeld?
Worries that lengthening decision deadlines sends the wrong signal and may leave citizens waiting longer, undercutting the purpose of the Dwangsom Act.
Does extending decision deadlines not send precisely the opposite signal, the PvdA members ask themselves.
Wordt er met het verlengen van beslistermijnen niet juist een tegengesteld signaal gegeven, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie zich af.
Opposes extending deadlines where only public bodies are involved and argues administrations should remain accountable; asks why vulnerable citizens bear the cost of organisational problems at UWV.
Why does the government choose in this case to shift the organisational problems of public bodies onto vulnerable citizens?
Waarom kiest de regering er voor om in dit geval de organisatorische problemen van overheidsorganisaties af te wentelen op kwetsbare burgers?
Regrets the need to extend deadlines, asks whether extensions should be temporary as in the Wajong case, and urges improved internal organisation instead.
Would it not be better in this day and age to shorten deadlines rather than extend them?
Zou het in deze tijd niet beter zijn om termijnen te verkorten in plaats van te verlengen?

Asks whether delays by third-party advisers can be recovered from them, whether not allowing suspension reduces advice requests, and requests an evaluation period and details on financial consequences for local governments.
Can exceeding a deadline, because advice from a third party is absent or delayed, be recovered from the advising third party?
Kan overschrijding van een termijn, doordat advies van een derde uitblijft of vertraagd, verhaald kan worden op de adviserende derde?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill extending statutory decision deadlines in several special laws is broadly supported but should be revised: the temporary extension in the Wajong and Wia should be written as a transitional provision rather than the definitive text, and the deadlines for compensation claims should be set by statute instead of policy rules. The government's reply accepts the drafting suggestions and the Wajong/Wia restructuring, and defends the policy-rule approach as temporary pending a future Awb bill.
concerns: The temporary extension of decision deadlines in the Wajong and Wia should be made clear by placing the definitive text in the law and the temporary rule as a transitional provision.
Deadlines for compensation claims set in policy rules are treated as statutory deadlines, which departs from the Awb; the Council advises regulating them by statute or not regulating them at all.
The explanatory memorandum should address whether deadlines in other laws noted in the Algemene Rekenkamer report are now realistic.
Several editorial remarks in an annex are adopted in the amended bill.

31862.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Civil Code so that when a court dissolves an employment contract for a worker earning at least €75,000 a year, the compensation payable by the employer is capped at one year's salary unless that would be unacceptable under reasonableness standards. It also indexes the €75,000 threshold annually via the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and preserves the old rule for pending petitions.
31862.j: The memorandum justifies the cap as preventing unnecessarily high dismissal costs for well-positioned high earners and freeing resources for workers with weaker labour market positions, and says the indexation follows forecast contract wage growth.
q: The fourth paragraph of Article 685a provides for indexation of the amount of €75,000 mentioned in the first paragraph.
Met het vierde lid van artikel 685a wordt voorzien in indexering van het in het eerste lid genoemde bedrag van € 75 000.
d: annual indexation of the €75,000 threshold amount
p: Caps court-ordered dismissal compensation at one year's salary for high earners, narrowing judicial discretion, with an exception where the outcome would be unreasonable and unjust.

parties: Asks whether the cap is effective given contractual exceptions and whether judges will still assess reasonableness individually, and raises the unresolved case law on manifestly unreasonable dismissal.
The CDA members question the effectiveness of the proposed limitation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie plaatsen vraagtekens bij de effectiviteit van de voorgestelde beperking.
Objects to the arbitrary threshold and the financial inequality it creates, and insists that the Council of State's objections be substantively addressed rather than left to judicial reasonableness.
With this rebuttal, the Chamber and later employers and employees are effectively sent off in a faltering aircraft with a parachute handed out afterwards.
Met dit verweer worden de Kamer en later: de werkgevers en werknemers feitelijk op pad gestuurd met een haperend vliegtuig waar dan wel weer een parachute bijgeleverd wordt.
Calls the bill unjust and proposes an absolute cap of twice the Balkenende norm, also questioning the lack of appeal from kantonrechter rulings and excessive judicial discretion.
Does the government consider the scope for judges to set the dismissal compensation too large?
Is de regering van oordeel dat de ruimte voor rechters te groot is om de ontslagvergoeding vast te stellen?
Welcomes the measure as a step toward more employer freedom but doubts its marginal value and worries about juridification through judicial case-by-case assessment.
In that sense, the question arises whether the practical objections to this small measure outweigh its marginal contribution.

In die zin is de vraag aan de orde of de praktische bezwaren voor invoering van deze kleine maatregel (met de nodige haken en ogen) niet zwaarder wegen dan de marginale bijdrage aan een oplossing die ermee wordt bereikt.
Asks how judges will assess the employee's labour market position and whether existing contracts will be reopened, raising risks of arbitrariness.
How is the employee's labour market position assessed, ask the ChristenUnie members.
Hoe wordt beoordeeld wat de arbeidsmarktpositie van de werknemer is, zo vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie.
Asks the government to explain how the pending Supreme Court ruling on the unreasonable dismissal formula relates to the bill.
Can the government explain how it interprets this ruling in light of the present bill?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe ze deze uitspraak in het licht van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel interpreteert?
Doubts the fairness of a hard cutoff, asks why the legislature rather than judges should resolve differences around the threshold, and questions the expected effects on private arrangements.
Why can no solution be devised by the legislature instead of the judiciary?
Waarom is er niet een oplossing te bedenken door de wetgevende in plaats van de rechterlijke macht?

Asks for case data on judicial awards above the threshold, questions the impact study, asks for the Supreme Court advocate-general's advice to be awaited, and wants the bill withdrawn and replaced by a broader cap covering all exorbitant severance.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against the bill capping kantonrechter dismissal compensation at the annual salary for employees earning €75,000 or more, arguing the cap lacks justification, is unlikely to be effective, and creates arbitrary inequality. The government's nader rapport rejects the Raad's conclusions and declines to reconsider the bill, while adding minor drafting changes.
concerns: The Raad finds the fixed €75,000 cap insufficiently justified and not tailored to individual circumstances such as labour-market position and age, favouring a sliding scale instead.
The Raad doubts the cap will achieve flexibilisation or higher participation, since high earners with good labour-market positions are unlikely to be affected by it.
The cap may prevent a fair compensation for employees with poor labour-market positions and high salaries, withholding an equitable dismissal payment.
The Raad notes the basis of the compensation and the role of salary components are unclear, creating uncertain outcomes including for employees under €75,000.
The Raad suggests replacing 'inkomen' with 'jaarsalaris' throughout and clarifying the ambiguous wording of article 7:685a(1) and compliance with Aanwijzing 34.

31871.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act to implement EU regulations on air passenger rights, including compensation for denied boarding and cancelled or delayed flights, the EU blacklist of airlines banned from operating, and rights of disabled and reduced-mobility passengers. It extends the enforcement toolkit by allowing administrative fines and administrative enforcement, and requires the minister to publish monthly lists of final enforcement decisions.
31871.j: The memorandum justifies the new fining and enforcement powers by noting that current supervision methods such as information, warnings and summons have not always been effective, and aligns the fine amount with the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming.
q: If these means prove not to be effective, the administrative enforcement instrument under article 11.15 of the Aviation Act can be applied.
Indien deze middelen niet effectief blijken te zijn kan op grond van artikel 11.15 van de Wet luchtvaart het bestuursrechtelijk instrument van de toepassing bestuursdwang
p: Artikel 11.16 (eerste lid, onderdeel e; derde lid, onderdeel e)
The bill gives the minister power to impose administrative fines of up to 74,000 euro for violations of the listed EU regulations.
The minister must publish monthly in the Staatscourant a list of entities against which fines or administrative enforcement have become final, increasing transparency toward the public.

parties: Asks why current enforcement fails and whether the EU-level interpretation should be harmonised before imposing heavy administrative fines.
Would it not be better to wait until the desired uniform interpretation of the rules in Europe is reached before enforcing with heavy administrative fines?
Kan niet beter gewacht worden tot de gewenste uniforme interpretatie van de regels in Europa bereikt is, alvorens met zware bestuurlijke boetes te gaan handhaven?
Asks whether the EUR 74,000 fine applies per flight or per consumer and whether it has sufficient deterrent effect, and why existing enforcement tools were insufficient.
If the first is the case, how is it ensured that there is sufficient deterrent effect?
Indien het eerste het geval is, hoe wordt dan zeker gesteld dat er voldoende afschrikwekkende werking is?
Asks how the bill relates to the voluntary complaints commission, whether it can impose fines, and whether a statutory commission would be more effective.
To what extent can this complaints commission impose an administrative fine in a binding way?
In hoeverre kan deze geschillencommissie dwingend een bestuurlijke boete opleggen?
Supports expanding enforcement and publishing final decisions, while asking how the Inspectorate and the complaints commission may share information and act on complaints.
May the Inspectorate act following reports to the complaints commission, and can the commission use Inspectorate information for handling complaints submitted to it?
Mag de IVW optreden naar aanleiding van meldingen bij de geschillencommissie en kan de geschillencommissie informatie van de IVW gebruiken voor de behandeling van de bij haar ingediende klachten?

31907.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to implement EU VAT package directives, reallocating the place of supply rules for services (B2B and B2C), introducing a new VAT refund regime for businesses established in other member states, and adding a mini one-stop-shop scheme for telecom, broadcasting and electronic services. It also sets administrative obligations and procedural rules for refunds, effective from 1 January 2010 with later phases from 2011, 2013 and 2015.
31907.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the new obligations and procedures mainly by the need to implement EU directives and enable tax authorities to check compliance.
q: On the basis of that list, tax authorities can check whether VAT obligations are being properly complied with.
Aan de hand van die lijst kunnen belastingdiensten controleren of de btw-verplichtingen goed worden nagekomen.
d: requirement to attach invoice copies to refund requests above thresholds
describing business activity using harmonised codes
languages usable for refund request data
required information and additional electronic data for refund requests
rules on how non-resident businesses prove they are entrepreneurs
p: The inspector may request additional and further additional information from the applicant or other persons within set time limits, extending administrative discretion over refund claims.
Corrections to refund claims may lead the inspector to impose additional assessments, with decisions made by appealable decision.  .

parties: Asks whether the listing obligation is proportionate and compatible with EU law, and whether the Algemene Rekenkamer's fraud findings are addressed.
Can the government indicate how the administrative burden of the listing obligation relates to the amount of fraud it combats?
