Kan de regering aangeven hoe de administratieve lasten van de listingverplichting zich verhouden tot de hoeveelheid fraude die daarmee wordt bestreden?
Asks for effects on trade with third countries and a detailed response to fraud-related questions and practitioner comments.
Part of the proposals concerns combating tax fraud in intra-Community trade.
Een deel van de voorstellen heeft betrekking op de bestrijding van belastingfraude in het intracommunautaire verkeer.
Asks whether recommendations of the Algemene Rekenkamer on intra-Community fraud are incorporated and what the government concretely does with them.
What does the government concretely do with the recommendations in this law; can each recommendation be explained with what is done and the underlying reason?
Wat doet de regering concreet met de aanbevelingen in deze wet, kan per aanbeveling nader worden toegelicht wat ermee gedaan wordt en wat de achterliggende reden hiervoor is?
Not convinced by the government's rejection of the Raad van State advice on full systematic conformity of the Wet op de omzetbelasting; asks how the Rekenkamer findings are implemented.
The VVD members are not convinced by the government's argument and want to know what stands in the way of adopting the Council of State's advice.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn niet overtuigd van de argumentatie van de regering en willen weten wat zich er tegen verzet het advies van de Raad van State over te nemen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the bill implementing the EU VAT package (place-of-supply rules and VAT refunds for businesses in other member states) supports the bill's aim but raises many drafting and systematic objections, mainly that the Wet OB 1968 should follow the EU VAT directive text more closely. The government's nader rapport accepts many drafting suggestions but disagrees with the broader view that the existing structure of the Wet OB 1968 hinders correct implementation.
concerns: The Raad urges the Wet OB 1968 to be rewritten consistently with the EU directive wording and structure, which the government only partly accepts, preferring case-by-case alignment.
Unclear procedures for refund requests (portal, Algemene wet bestuursrecht, relation between articles 31 and 32f) and the scope of the term 'belasting' in the refund rules need clarification.
Various place-of-supply articles (6, 6g, 6k, 12) and the listing obligation in article 37a need to be aligned with the directive text to avoid over-broad implementation.

31916.s: The bill abolishes the municipality of Rozenburg and adds its territory to Rotterdam by a boundary change effective on the date of merger, set at 18 March 2010. It also sets transitional rules on taxes, municipal fund allocations, local elections and the transfer of regional and police area membership.
31916.j: The memorandum justifies the approach by practical considerations for municipal budget years, taxes and fund allocations, and by Rotterdam's urban challenges and election publicity, rather than by any new executive power.
q: Given the exceptional big-city challenges facing the municipality of Rotterdam, this is undesirable.
Gezien de uitzonderlijke grootstedelijke opgaven waar de gemeente Rotterdam zich voor gesteld ziet, is dit onwenselijk.

parties: Asks whether bypassing Provinciale Staten in the chosen procedure has legal consequences and questions the steering role of the Commissaris van de Koning.
The consequence is that the proposal was not dealt with in the Provincial States of South Holland.
Het gevolg hiervan is dat het voorstel niet in de Staten van Zuid-Holland is behandeld.
Asks how the government views the involvement of the population in the decision-making of the municipal council given the compressed timetable.
These members would like to hear how the government views the way the population is involved in the decision-making by the municipal council.
Graag horen deze leden hoe de regering aankijkt tegen de manier waarop de bevolking betrokken is bij de besluitvorming door de gemeenteraad.
Criticises the lack of public support and the refusal of a referendum, and questions the provincial and CdK influence on a merger that should come from below.
How does his role and interference relate to the government's starting point that a merger should come from the bottom up, from the population itself?
Hoe verhoudt zijn rol en inmenging zich tot het uitgangspunt van de regering dat een herindeling van onderop, dus vanuit de bevolking zelf dient te komen?
Asks whether the government considers the population sufficiently involved in the process, noting the referendum is not available under the Wet Arhi.
The question the VVD members have is whether the government believes the population is sufficiently involved in the process.
De vraag die de leden van de VVD-fractie hebben, is of de regering van mening is dat de bevolking voldoende bij het proces betrokken is.
Asks whether referenda on the proposal were held in all affected municipalities, probing public support.
The PVV members ask whether referenda on the proposal were held in all the municipalities concerned.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of er in alle betrokken gemeenten referenda over het voorstel zijn geweest.
Notes complaints that residents were not well informed and asks how sufficient attention to public support was shown.
The SGP members note complaints about the way residents were involved in this procedure.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren klachten over de wijze waarop de inwoners gekend zijn bij deze procedure.
Supports the merger as a voluntary decision by both municipalities, with the Rozenburg vision seen as complementary to the Rotterdam city vision.

For the ChristenUnie members, besides the argument on Rozenburg's administrative capacity, an important point is that both municipalities are in majority in favour of this merger and have voluntarily chosen it.

Voor de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie is het, naast de argumentatie ten aanzien van de bestuurskracht van Rozenburg, een belangrijk gegeven dat de beide gemeenten in meerderheid voor deze herindeling zijn en daar vrijwillig voor hebben gekozen.

31924-IIB.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (slotwet) that amends the 2008 departmental budget for the Council of State, Court of Audit, National Ombudsman, Chancery of the Netherlands Orders, and the Governors' offices of the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba. It sets the adjusted appropriations in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force of the law.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2008 to the departmental budget of the Council of State, the Court of Audit, the National Ombudsman.
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2008 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman.

32168.s: The bill amends the Code of Criminal Procedure and the DNA Act for Convicted Persons to create a legal basis for DNA kinship testing and DNA testing for visible physical traits of unidentified victims, and to let the deputy public prosecutor (hulpofficier van justitie) order DNA testing of samples from unknown suspects in high-volume crime cases. It also lets the public prosecutor or investigating judge order kinship testing of stored profiles, with prior authorisation by the investigating judge for active kinship searches, and sets limits such as the eight-year sentence threshold for active kinship testing.
32168.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by their value for solving serious crimes that cannot be solved otherwise, and by safeguards such as warrant and authorisation requirements and the eight-year threshold, while the Council of State's request to put conditions for kinship testing into statute was declined.
q: The importance of introducing the power to apply kinship testing is endorsed by the sitting and standing judiciary and the police and is seen as an important addition to the investigative tools currently available to solve crimes.

Het belang van de introductie van de bevoegdheid tot toepassing van verwantschapsonderzoek wordt door de zittende en staande magistratuur en de politie onderschreven en als een belangrijke aanvulling beschouwd op de opsporingsmiddelen die hen nu ter beschikking staan om misdrijven op te lossen.
d: list of offences for which deputy public prosecutor may order DNA testing of unknown suspect samples
designation of laboratories for DNA testing
further rules on execution of kinship DNA testing
designation of laboratories for DNA testing ordered by investigating judge
further rules on execution of kinship DNA testing in judicial pre-investigation
p: Allows deputy public prosecutors, not only the public prosecutor, to order DNA testing of samples from unknown suspects, limited to offences designated by decree.

Creates an explicit legal basis to set aside the data protection ban on processing genetic data for kinship testing, letting prosecutors and investigating judges use stored profiles of convicted and other persons to identify relatives, subject to offence threshold and, for active searches, prior investigating judge authorisation.

parties: Asks whether requiring prior authorisation by the rechter-commissaris is too heavy and whether the 'in het belang van het onderzoek' criterion should be replaced by a clearer legal standard.

These members share the criticism of the Council of State and the College of Procurators General that it is very doubtful whether a broader application is adequately secured by the broader interpretation in the explanatory memorandum.

Deze leden delen echter de kritiek van de Raad van State en het College van procureurs generaal dat het zeer de vraag is of een ruimere toepassing afdoende wordt verzekerd door de ruimere interpretatie in de memorie van toelichting.

Wants the scope of 'belang van het onderzoek' and the conditions for kinship and mass DNA searches set out in statute rather than left to a prosecution instruction, given the coercive nature of the measures.
They fear that with a vaguely defined investigation criterion, control over the use of kinship or mass investigation will not be possible.
Zij vrezen dat met een vaag omschreven onderzoekscriterium de controle op het gebruik van verwantschaps- of grootschalig onderzoek niet mogelijk is.
Worries that innocent relatives may come under suspicion through kinship matches and asks how this will be prevented; also asks whether the offence threshold is too narrow.
In this regard they think of the argument that innocent people may come into view for police and justice because their DNA profile by chance shares many DNA features with the perpetrator trace.
Daarbij denken zij aan het argument dat onschuldige mensen in beeld kunnen komen bij politie en justitie omdat hun DNA-profiel door toeval veel DNA-kenmerken gemeen heeft met dat van het daderspoor.
Asks for justification of the proportionality of a coercive measure that may affect a larger group of people's fundamental freedoms without a commensurate gain in success.
These members understand this to mean that a larger group of persons may face an intrusion on fundamental freedoms, while the chance of success does not increase proportionately.
Deze leden begrijpen dit zo dat een grotere groep betrokkenen te maken kan krijgen met een inbreuk op fundamentele vrijheden, terwijl de kans op succes niet navenant toeneemt.

Questions whether the proportionality test is met, whether the criterion shifts from a concrete suspicion to speculative involvement in other offences, and whether family members' privacy is unduly affected.
Does the proposed DNA kinship research not also lead to the private sphere of not only the suspect but increasingly also of third parties being affected?
Leidt het voorgestelde DNA-verwantschapsonderzoek er niet tevens toe dat niet alleen de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de verdachte, maar ook steeds meer die van derden wordt geraakt?
Accepts kinship searching only with strong safeguards, warns against a 'hunt for DNA' and asks what 'reasonable use of resources' and 'sufficient chance' mean in the instruction.
If it is nevertheless decided to introduce kinship research, these members believe an adequate level of protection must be offered to counter the disadvantages and risks.
Wanneer toch besloten wordt tot invoering van verwantschapsonderzoek moet er naar mening van deze leden een afdoende mate van bescherming worden geboden om de nadelen en risico's te ondervangen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Code of Criminal Procedure and the DNA Act to introduce DNA kinship (familial) searching, DNA analysis of visible characteristics of unknown victims, and related matters, raising proportionality, necessity, scope and privacy objections and recommending narrower criteria and judicial authorisation. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, accepting some recommendations (narrower offence threshold, rechter-commissaris authorisation, restructuring of vermiste personen provisions) while rejecting the call for a separate article and defending the broader 'belang van het onderzoek' interpretation and the kinship search mechanism.
concerns: Council doubts necessity and effectiveness of familial DNA searching and the broadened investigative-interest criterion given the intrusion on third parties; government defends necessity with Engelse results and Dutch practice, but narrows the offence threshold.

Council warns that familial searching affects privacy of relatives and that use of DNA of suspects/convicts for kinship without consent or purpose limitation is problematic; government keeps the bovenpersoonlijk-use argument but adds rechter-commissaris authorisation for searches of the databank.

Council notes that the investigative-interest criterion should not be reinterpreted in ministerial notes or explanatory memoranda rather than in statute; government disagrees and defends such interpretation through policy notes.

Council finds the offence threshold for kinship research too broad and asks for it to be tightened, with the conditions set out in the statute rather than in policy rules; government adopts a narrower threshold of eight years or specified serious violent and sexual offences, but keeps the policy-based conditions for passive searches.

Council argues that using DNA stored from suspects or convicts for kinship searches requires at least rechter-commissaris authorisation given the verschoningsrecht and privacy of relatives; government adds written rechter-commissaris authorisation.

Council asks for the DNA regime to be made more accessible and for the provisions on missing persons to be placed in a separate article; government restructures the articles and removes the superseded articles but refuses a separate article.

32177.s: The bill strengthens the position of the rechter-commissaris (investigating judge) in Dutch pre-trial criminal investigation by replacing the formal gerechtelijk vooronderzoek with a flexible framework in which the judge supervises the investigation and carries out investigative acts on the prosecutor's request, the suspect's request, or ex officio in limited cases. It also removes the old formal instruction procedure, redefines the end of investigation and dismissal notices, and makes conforming changes across several other statutes.
32177.j: The memorandum justifies the reform by the reduced judicial involvement in pre-trial investigation since the 1990s and the need for a balanced evidence-gathering process, with the investigating judge as judge in the pre-trial phase.
p: The investigating judge is given a clearer supervisory role over lawfulness, pace and balance of the investigation, and the suspect gains a right to request investigative acts, shifting some control from the prosecutor to the judiciary.
The investigating judge may assess the progress of the opsporingsonderzoek on request or ex officio and order its termination, a supervisory power over the prosecutor's investigation.

Abolition of the gerechtelijk vooronderzoek, its notice-of-further-prosecution steps and several suspect information rights shifts procedural control toward the prosecution and removes some formal protections of the defence.

parties: Supports the stronger supervisory role of the investigating judge but asks whether defence and prosecutorial guidance will be effective and how the prosecutor's instruction on involving the judge will work.
In particular the supervisory task is made more central, and given developments in legal practice this is crucial.
Met name de toezichthoudende taak wordt meer centraal gesteld en gelet op de ontwikkelingen in de rechtspraktijk is dat cruciaal.

Asks about the investigating judge's capacity, the budget-neutral framing, the link between the bill and the Raad van State's call for an integrated vision, and the equality of arms between defence and prosecution.
These members need a further explanation of the renewed position of the investigating judge and the vision on which this position is based.
Deze leden hebben behoefte aan een nadere uitleg over de hernieuwde positie van de rechter-commissaris en de visie waarop deze positie is gebaseerd.
Welcomes a supervising investigating judge to secure truth-finding but finds the prosecutor's guideline too voluntary and demands adequate capacity and funding for the judge.
These members point out that there must be sufficient capacity among the investigating judges, both in personnel and financially.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat er voldoende capaciteit bij de rechters-commissarissen moet zijn, zowel in menskracht als financieel.
Sees a patchwork of reforms lacking coherence, argues the prosecutor should keep a leading role in the investigation, and considers the growing number of procedural formalities undesirable.
In the view of the VVD members, the bill also fails to recognise that the public prosecutor has a leading role regarding the progress of the criminal investigation and the production of evidence.

Naar het oordeel van de leden van de VVD-fractie wordt in het wetsvoorstel ook miskend dat er een leidende rol is voor de officier van justitie met betrekking tot de voortgang van het opsporingsonderzoek en de bewijslevering.

Supports strengthening the investigating judge and the defendant's position but finds the bill lacks an overarching vision, clear boundaries with the prosecutor, and structural involvement of the judge.
These members ask how it will generally be ensured that the investigating judge also gets to carry out all these tasks assigned by the legislature.
Zij vragen hoe in het algemeen zal worden verzekerd dat de rechter-commissaris ook toekomt aan de uitvoering van al deze hem door de wetgever toebedeelde taken.
Supports reflection on the investigating judge's position, which has become unclear, and asks historical and contextual questions about why the role was weakened.
They support the idea that reflection on the position of the investigating judge in the criminal process is desirable, since his (statutory) position as investigating judge has become unclear.
Zij ondersteunen de gedachte dat bezinning op de positie van de rechter-commissaris in het strafproces gewenst is, aangezien zijn (wettelijke) positie van onderzoeksrechter onduidelijk is geworden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against proceeding with the bill strengthening the investigating judge's position, citing lack of an integrated vision on pre-trial investigation and the absence of accompanying proposals needed to assess effectiveness. The government's nader rapport rejects the claim of no integrated vision, explains the staged approach, and says the advice is largely answered in the memorie van toelichting while declining to resubmit the bill.
concerns: The Raad finds the role of the rechter-commissaris ambiguous: supervisory yet passive, and asks for a substantial addition explaining its relation to the officier van justitie.
The Raad doubts the proposal will actually strengthen the rechter-commissaris's position without the promised supplementary proposals on information provision.
The Raad questions whether the rechter-commissaris can timely obtain the relevant documents needed for his regulatory role.
The Raad advises resubmitting the bill once the announced supplementary proposals are available, which the government declines to do.

32195.s: The bill amends the Public Health Act (Wpg) and, conditionally on the Safety Regions Act, moves responsibility for preparing for and combating a large-scale infectious disease outbreak to the safety region board, aligns municipal health service and safety region boundaries, and updates the list of notifiable disease groups and municipal health policy notes. It also has the municipal health service director appointed in agreement with the safety region board and allows the executive to transfer health tasks to other bodies by general administrative order.
32195.j: The memorandum justifies the transfer of the outbreak-preparedness task to the safety region board by the need to keep public order and infectious disease control under one authority, and the expansion to newly added group A diseases by the need to act quickly.
q: The board of the safety region is responsible for preparing for combating an epidemic of an infectious disease belonging to group A.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio draagt zorg voor de voorbereiding op de bestrijding van een epidemie van een infectieziekte behorend tot groep A
d: list of infectious diseases in groups A and B1
rules for transferring health tasks to a body other than the municipal health service
p: Responsibility for preparing against group A epidemics shifts from municipal mayors and aldermen to the safety region board, which may be expanded to new diseases added quickly to group A.
Municipal council must adopt a four-yearly health policy note that takes national priorities into account, strengthening council oversight.

parties: Asks for clarity on the division of responsibilities between the minister, safety-region boards and GGD, and worries that forced regional congruence limits municipalities' freedom to organise health tasks.
Is the division of responsibilities between the boards of the safety region and the GGD sufficiently clear here, ask the CDA members.
Is de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling tussen de besturen van de veiligheidsregio en de GGD hierbij voldoende duidelijk, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.

Questions democratic legitimacy and local control when forced GGD congruence leaves border municipalities without governance over youth health care in other regions, and asks about oversight and control of municipal prevention efforts.
How can democratic legitimacy be safeguarded in the above situations in administrative decision-making on the implementation of youth health care policy?
Hoe kan de democratische legitimatie in bovengenoemde situaties worden geborgd bij bestuurlijke besluitvorming over de uitvoering van het JGZ-beleid?

Broadly supports alignment but notes the Raad van State's objections that the government did not adopt, asks for a precise delineation of responsibilities and for the financial consequences to be specified.
The VVD members would like as precise a demarcation of responsibilities as possible.
Graag zien de leden van de VVD-fractie een zo precies mogelijke afbakening tussen de verantwoordelijkheden.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill amending the Public Health Act (regionalisation of the GGD, regional planning for mass infectious disease control, municipal prenatal care) but raises concerns about municipal freedom to organise health tasks, the placement of infectious disease planning in the regional crisis plan, and costs for municipalities, and advises revision. The government's reply accepts most points: co-signature by the Minister of Interior was added, the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on costs and the VNG advice, and the explanation was clarified on municipal freedom, while the infectious disease planning was handled via a technical amendment to article 8 rather than the Wet veiligheidsregio's.
concerns: Concern that municipalities keep enough freedom to organise health tasks such as youth and elderly care within the regional GGD; the government clarified the explanation but did not change the rule requiring one regional GGD per safety region.

Doubt whether the regional crisis plan is the most suitable place for infectious disease planning, since national planning would be more logical; the government instead added a technical provision in article 8 of the Public Health Act linking the duty to the minister's steering role.
The Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations should co-sign the bill because it concerns responsibilities of that minister; co-signature was added.
The memorandum should include a calculation of the one-off reorganisation costs and efficiency gains and address the VNG advice; the explanatory text was supplemented.
Various editorial corrections to the bill and explanatory memorandum were adopted.

32276.s: The bill amends several Dutch fiscal statutes so that the tax system for the BES islands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) can take effect after the dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles, including transitional rules for legacy Antillean taxes and courts. It also delegates to a general administrative order (AMvB) a Belastingregeling voor het land Nederland to prevent double taxation, subject to a four-week pre-submission (voorhang) procedure.
32276.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to regulate detailed transitional and double-taxation matters and to handle unforeseen implementation problems.
q: By general administrative order, rules may be set to prevent double taxation in cases not otherwise provided for.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting in gevallen waarin daaromtrent niet op andere wijze is voorzien, regels worden gesteld
d: Hoofdstuk I, artikel III, onderdeel F (artikel 37 lid 2 AWR)
rules preventing double taxation between Netherlands and BES islands
further rules for applying transitional provisions
rules on transition from island taxes to new BES tax laws
rules for implementation of this act
p: Transfers all powers of former Antillean tax and customs officials, including for pending cases, to the Dutch tax administration without special safeguards.
Hoofdstuk II, artikel VIII lid 4 and artikel XVII
Allows ministerial regulations to set transitional rules and adapt terminology without parliamentary approval.
Exempts the AMvB on double taxation from the four-week voorhang procedure if published within two months before transition.

parties: Asks the government about risks of tax abuse during the transition period, the legal basis of a delegation power for the Belastingregeling, and the scope of transitional rules and the tax authority's capacity.

The CDA members ask the government to indicate to what extent it believes continuing the current tax system until 1 January 2011 could lead to interim abuse because certain avoidance opportunities are offered.

De leden van de CDA-fractie verzoeken de regering aan te geven in hoeverre zij van mening is dat het continueren van het huidige belastingstelsel tot 1 januari 2011 niet zal kunnen leiden tot tussentijds misbruik omdat er bepaalde ontgaansmogelijkheden worden geboden.
Asks a single question about the budgetary effect of possibly writing off the remaining conservatory assessment after 2016.
The SP members ask how much money is involved if the part of the conservatory assessment still outstanding on 1 January 2016 is written off.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoeveel geld hiermee is gemoeid als het op 1 januari 2016 nog openstaande deel van de conserverende aanslag wordt kwijtgescholden.

Raises concerns about whether civil servants on the islands and in the Netherlands will be ready in time, about information for citizens and firms, and about administrative burdens and transitional arrangements.
The ChristenUnie members express concern whether the civil service on the BES islands and in the Netherlands will be ready in time with all preparations to introduce the new BES tax system.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie spreken hun zorgen uit of het ambtenarenapparaat op de BES-eilanden en in Nederland op tijd gereed zal zijn met alle voorbereidingen om het nieuwe fiscale BES stelsel in te voeren.
Asks for justification of transitional rules for economic zones and the pension-hotel scheme, for an estimate of outstanding tax debts, and for the scope of exceptions to the new regime.

The VVD members ask for further justification of why transitional law must be introduced for economic zones for firms that do not wish to meet the conditions of the new regulation on trade and service warehouses.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen nader te motiveren waarom overgangsrecht geïntroduceerd moet worden ten aanzien van de economische zones voor bedrijven die niet «willen» voldoen aan de voorwaarden zoals neergelegd in de nieuwe regeling betreffende handels- en dienstenentrepots.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Invoeringswet fiscaal stelsel BES, supporting its aim but raising objections on the territorial residence fiction, the timing of transition and entry into force, and several technical points. The government's nader rapport accepts most of the advice, adopting changes to the residence fiction, the transition arrangements and the drafting, while rejecting only the proposed definition of 'buitenland' and retaining the Aruba/Curaçao/Sint Maarten permanent establishment rule.
concerns: The Raad objected that the vestigingsplaatsfictie left the consequences unregulated, including which tax inspector and court are competent, and the government added rules and clarified competence.
The Raad objected to the transition timing, which would create a legal vacuum and conflict with the general transition rules, and the government added a temporary continuation arrangement.

The Raad objected that the rules on non-sufficiently-active permanent establishments are incomplete and limited to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, creating fragility and tension with equal treatment; the government defended the limited scope as necessary and transitional.

The Raad asked to narrow the residence fiction to bodies that can be subject to Dutch dividend and corporate tax; the government adopted this for stichtingen and doelvermogens but did not define 'buitenland'.
The Raad requested clearer wording of the term 'Rijk', cross-references, and alignment of the explanatory memorandum with the BelBES bill, all of which were accommodated.

The Raad asked for transitional arrangements for the final tax settlement on hidden and fiscal reserves when rules lapse; the government added transitional rules for entities moving to the Netherlands and for the aanmerkelijkbelang regime, but the final settlement was not fully addressed.
The Raad asked that the BRN be attached as a draft and that Wet IB 2001 and related provisions be amended as suggested, and the government adjusted the bill accordingly.

32339.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2008/48/EC on consumer credit by inserting a new title 2A on consumer credit agreements into Book 7 of the Civil Code, with rules on advertising, pre-contractual information, creditworthiness assessment, withdrawal rights and early repayment, and amends the Consumer Credit Act and the Financial Supervision Act accordingly. It also extends conduct-supervision rules in the Financial Supervision Act to credit intermediaries and securities-backed credit, with enforcement via administrative law and the AFM as supervisor.
32339.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to detail information obligations and registry access in the Bgfo, consistent with the directive.
q: The exact content of the information obligations and implementing rules on the creditworthiness assessment and access to databases will be further elaborated in the Bgfo based on the Wft.

De exacte inhoud van de informatieverplichtingen en de uitvoeringsvoorschriften inzake de kredietwaardigheidstoets en de toegang tot gegevensbanken zal nader worden uitgewerkt in het, op de Wft gebaseerde, Besluit gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft
d: Wet op het financieel toezicht art. 4:33 (new)
pre-contractual credit information requirements and exemptions
Wet op het financieel toezicht art. 4:33 lid 4 (new)
designating credit types excluded from information duty
Wet op het financieel toezicht art. 4:32 lid 1
conditions for access to credit registration systems
p: Wet op het financieel toezicht art. 4:34 (creditworthiness assessment, amended)
Creditors must assess consumer financial position before credit or increases, a protection rather than an executive power shift.

parties: Worries that full harmonisation may force Dutch consumer protection downward and asks whether the directive's stronger consumer protection is in fact guaranteed.
These members believe it must be acknowledged that the choice for full harmonisation also carries risks where national regulation is relatively well arranged.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat erkend moet worden dat de keuze voor volledige harmonisatie ook risico's met zich meebrengt als de nationale regelgeving relatief goed geregeld is.
Asks how much room the Netherlands has to deviate from the directive and where Dutch consumers would lose protection, and how consumers can bring cross-border disputes to court.
On which points does implementation of the directive mean a deterioration in the protection of the Dutch consumer?
Op welke punten betekent de implementatie van de richtlijn een achteruitgang van de bescherming van de Nederlandse consument?
Asks why member states cannot adopt a higher consumer protection level than the directive and whether the directive blocks a ban on loan advertising.
Why is it not possible for individual member states to adopt in national legislation a higher level of consumer protection than the directive contains?
Waarom is het voor individuele lidstaten niet mogelijk om een hoger beschermingsniveau voor de consument in de nationale wetgeving op te nemen dan in de richtlijn is opgenomen?

Asks the government to justify and document how it used the extra policy space beyond the directive, as the Raad van State requires, and whether good practices from other member states were considered.
These members ask the government to provide a clear overview of how and where use has been made of this additional policy space
Deze leden vragen de regering een helder overzicht te verschaffen van hoe en waar gebruik is gemaakt van deze extra beleidsruimte
Asks whether implementing rules align with neighbouring countries and how the annual cost percentage is composed.
They further ask the government to indicate whether other member states, like the Netherlands, set an annual cost percentage and at what level this cost percentage lies.
Ze vragen de regering voorts aan te geven of de andere lidstaten net als Nederland een jaarlijks kostenpercentage vaststellen en op welke hoogte dit kosten percentage ligt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill implementing the EU consumer credit directive 2008/48/EC into Book 7 of the Civil Code and the Wft, supporting its aim but raising remarks on scope (effectenkrediet and mortgage-backed credit exemptions), the mandatory nature of consumer rights, out-of-court dispute settlement and unexplained gold-plating. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, amends the text and explanatory notes, and justifies its deliberate choices to go beyond the directive.
concerns: The Raad asks that the definition of securities-backed credit in article 7:57 be aligned with the directive's exemption, and the government narrowed the definition and added explanation.
The Raad finds that the mandatory-nature provision in article 7:72 allowing statutory derogation is inconsistent with the directive, and the government removed the phrase.

The Raad asks for a reasoned justification for narrowing the mortgage exemption in article 7:58, and the government added an explanation and stated it keeps the existing Wet op het consumentenkrediet rule.
The Raad asks the explanatory memorandum to explain how cross-border cooperation between dispute bodies will be ensured, and a passage on FIN-NET was added.

The Raad asks that the explanatory memorandum justify each provision going beyond the directive as national gold-plating, and the government clarified its choices as permitted policy space rather than rejecting the point.

32357.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to let an algemene maatregel van bestuur set sustainability requirements for transport fuels and rules for public procurement of clean road vehicles, and it amends the Electricity Act 1998 on renewable electricity definitions and reporting of refused grid transport. It implements EU Directives 2009/28/EG, 2009/30/EG and 2009/33/EG.
32357.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as needed to implement the EU directives' detailed technical requirements through an amvb and ministerial regulation.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules are set to promote that, when purchasing the road vehicles designated in or under that order, account is taken of energy and environmental effects.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld om te bevorderen dat bij de aankoop van de in of bij die maatregel aangewezen wegvoertuigen rekening wordt gehouden met de energie- en milieueffecten
d: sustainability requirements and data for transport fuels
energy and environmental effects in purchase of road vehicles

parties: Asks that further implementing rules follow exact EU implementation without extra national requirements and that the Chamber is involved in detailed regulation; wants an executing body to be lean and not newly created.

These members want an upfront guarantee that the government, in these implementing regulations too, chooses exact implementation and imposes no additional national requirements that would distort the level playing field at European scale.

Deze leden willen graag op voorhand de garantie dat ook bij deze uitvoeringsregelingen de regering kiest voor exacte implementatie en geen nationale aanvullende eisen stelt die leiden tot een verstoring van het gelijke speelveld op Europese schaal.

Questions how the sustainable origin of liquid biomass is guaranteed and how control and enforcement occur; asks for sustainability criteria to be fixed in the Wet milieubeheer and for enforcement capacity figures.
Is the government willing to address this by fixing the sustainability criteria through the Environmental Management Act?
Is de regering bereid dit te ondervangen door de duurzaamheidscriteria via de wet milieubeheer vast te leggen?
Welcomes the bill and the exclusion of products from rainforest clearing, but questions how certainty about responsible origin of products can be ensured.
They do wonder, however, how they can be truly certain of the responsible origin of products.
Wel vragen zij zich af hoe zij echt zeker kunnen zijn van de verantwoorde herkomst van producten.
Asks when a single European certification system for biofuels will be available.
They ask when a single European certification system for biofuels will be available.
Zij vragen wanneer er één Europees certificeringssysteem voor biobrandstoffen beschikbaar is.

32366.s: The bill gives residents who have unlawfully lived in a recreational dwelling since before 2003 a route to an environmental permit (omgevingsvergunning) for permanent residence, based on proof of residence in at least two listed documents or other evidence accepted by the municipality. It sets decision deadlines, makes the permit personal and non-transferable, and opens the application window for two years after entry into force.
32366.j: The memorandum justifies the permit route by the long-standing de facto tolerance of these residences and the need for legal certainty for residents, and it explains that the discretion in Article 4 is a deliberate departure from the Wabo.
q: For that reason, departing from the Wabo, a period of ten weeks after submission was chosen for mayor and aldermen to investigate and decide on the evidence in Article 3.

Om die reden is er in afwijking van de Wabo voor gekozen om, waar het artikel 3 betreft, burgemeester en wethouders voor het onderzoek naar en de beslissing omtrent het bewijs een termijn van tien weken na overlegging te geven.
d: permit on other or additional proof of residence to municipal satisfaction
p: Municipalities may grant permits on evidence they find satisfactory, and the statutory rule that a permit is deemed granted if no decision is taken in time is removed, leaving discretion to the municipality.
Decision deadlines are extended from the default Wabo periods, and third parties cannot submit views on permits granted under this regime.

parties: Welcomes the bill but asks what the actual situation is now and what is expected after implementation, given years of municipal non-enforcement.
They would like to know what the actual situation is at present and what the expected situation will be once the law has been implemented.
Zij vernemen graag wat op dit moment de feitelijke situatie is en wat de verwachte situatie zal zijn, nadat de wet is uitgevoerd.
Supports a central-government intervention to override municipalities that never enforced, arguing it is justified after long-standing uncertainty and stresses the temporary nature of the measure.
In the view of the PvdA members, this legitimises in this specific case the intervention to grant those decisions after all from national level.
In de ogen van de leden van de PvdA-fractie legitimeert dit in dit specifieke geval de ingreep om van rijkswege alsnog die beschikkingen te verlenen.

Worries the bill is insufficiently considered and that vague criteria, such as 'good motivation' and municipal choice of evidence data, invite interpretation differences, litigation and arbitrariness.
Leaving it to municipalities which other measurement data they wish to use, in the view of these members, fosters unclarity and arbitrariness.
Het aan gemeenten overlaten welke overige meetdata zij wensen te hanteren, werkt naar mening van deze leden onduidelijkheid en willekeur in de hand.
Asks why municipalities that only had a formal non-enforcement decision are excluded, questions the departure from earlier motions, and asks about additional evidence such as bank statements.
Why are these motions being departed from?
Waarom wordt er van deze moties afgeweken?
Expresses interest in the bill without raising a specific check-related concern in the text provided.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against proceeding with the bill on legalising unlawful residence in recreational homes, finding no necessity given municipal progress and objecting to ex lege granting of exemptions. The government's nader rapport accepts several points (dropping ex lege granting in art. 4, longer decision periods, clearer evidence rules) but maintains the bill's core and rejects the necessity objection.
concerns: The Afdeling finds no necessity for the bill since municipalities are increasingly addressing the problem and the bill intrudes on municipal autonomy.
Objection to granting exemptions by operation of law (verlening van rechtswege) as it does not meet the requirements for such a figure.
Ex lege granted permits create legal uncertainty and may be granted to persons not meeting the criteria, with possible revocation and damages consequences.
Restricting municipal autonomy is considered disproportionate given the limited scale of the problem and alternative approaches.
Evidence requirements and the burden of proof are unclear and differ inconsistently between the bill and the explanatory note.
Discretionary competence of mayor and aldermen with vague criterion 'to their satisfaction' invites disputes; no horizon clause; implementation and financial consequences insufficiently addressed.

32375.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet voorkoming verontreiniging door schepen to implement the MARPOL Convention and the Ballast Water Convention, updating definitions of harmful substances and ballast water and adding prohibitions on discharges of ballast water and sediments. It also widens the Minister's power to grant exemptions and extends the basis for appointing supervisors, including non-Inspectorate persons such as port authority staff, to check tank pre-washing.
32375.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to implement MARPOL and Ballast Water Convention exemption options and by the frequency and timing of tank pre-wash inspections requiring supervisors beyond the Inspectorate.
q: Given the frequency of pre-wash inspections (2000 per year), their duration (30 to 60 minutes) and the times they can occur (also at night and at weekends), it is desirable to also assign other persons, besides Inspectorate staff, to supervise the pre-wash procedure.

Gelet op de frequentie van de controles op de voorwasprocedure (2000 per jaar), de duur ervan (30 tot 60 minuten) en de tijdstippen waarop deze kunnen plaatsvinden (ook ’s nachts en in het weekend), is het wenselijk om naast de medewerkers van de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat (IVW) tevens andere personen te belasten met het toezicht op de voorwasprocedure.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel H (artikel 35, lid 1 and 2)
exemptions from ship discharge and equipment requirements
rules on entries in the journal kept by the Minister
rules for pleasure and fishing vessels, periodic port fees
rules on pre-washing of cargo tanks
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 14, lid 2 and 4)
designation of other persons as supervisors and rules on supervision
p: Extends supervisory powers to designated persons outside the Inspectorate, such as port authority staff, with consent of their employer where they are not under the Transport Ministry.
Widens the Minister's power to grant exemptions from ballast water and discharge rules by ministerial regulation, bounded by treaty requirements.

parties: Worries the broader definition of harmful substances creates extra burdens and competitive disadvantage for Dutch shipowners, and questions the necessity of new ministerial rules on supervision.
The VVD members are concerned about the broadening of the definition of harmful substances.
De leden van de VVD-fractie maken zich zorgen over de uitbreiding van de definitie van schadelijke stoffen
Supports the amendment and clearer rules, but asks who the 'other persons' supervising compliance will be and whether fines should be raised.
The PvdA members ask which other persons could be meant here.</mention>
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen aan welke andere personen hierbij kan worden gedacht
Supports the bill and wants the authorities competent to supervise it to be legally fixed so the rules cannot be circumvented.
They would also like the law to specify which bodies are empowered to oversee these new rules.</mention>
Daarbij zouden zij ook graag zien dat juridisch wordt vastgelegd welke instanties de bevoegdheid krijgen om op deze nieuwe regelgeving toe te zien
Asks how supervision of the pre-washing procedure has developed and what the aim is of charging third parties with supervision, and whether this brings extra costs.
They also ask what objective is pursued by charging third parties with supervising compliance with all provisions of the Wvvs.</mention>
Tevens vragen zij welke doelstelling beoogd wordt met het belasten van derden met het toezicht op de naleving van alle bepalingen uit de Wvvs.

Welcomes stricter procedures but questions the independence of port companies as supervisors, the open-ended exemption ground of 'unnecessary delay', and who holds final responsibility to avoid the Probo Koala situation repeating.

32393.s: The bill adds new instruments to the Dutch Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg, including a limit (grens) on total tariffs that providers may charge, a new availability contribution (beschikbaarheidbijdrage) and settlement amount (vereffeningbedrag) set by the Zorgautoriteit, and power for the Zorgautoriteit to reorganise declaration flows among cooperating providers. Most of these new powers can only be used after a ministerial aanwijzing that is previewed to parliament through a voorhang procedure.
32393.j: The memorandum justifies the new instruments by the need to control macro-budgetary cost growth and complete the transition from budget to performance-based funding, with parliamentary preview through the voorhang procedure as the safeguard.
q: For that reason the WMG contains an important guarantee of prior parliamentary involvement in policy decisions concerning the funding of care.
Mede om die reden bevat de WMG een belangrijke waarborg voor parlementaire betrokkenheid vooraf bij beleidsbeslissingen die de bekostiging van zorg betreffen.
d: rules on who charges tariffs and how amounts are collected, and designation of a single provider for joint services
Zorgautoriteit may declare contracts void if not adapted to its rules within a set period
Zorgautoriteit sets tariffs, price descriptions, and grids (limits) by beschikking
availability contribution for care types designated by algemene maatregel van bestuur, set by Zorgautoriteit
settlement amount between insurers and providers set by Zorgautoriteit
Zorgautoriteit policy rules on the new powers
policy rules and experiments by Zorgautoriteit only after ministerial aanwijzing
Zorgautoriteit may impose obligations on providers regarding contracts and reserved capacity
minister may fund continuity of special medical procedures at designated institutions
p: The Zorgautoriteit may designate a single provider to bill for joint services, which can shift who collects payment from patients and insurers, subject to a ministerial aanwijzing and voorhang.
The Zorgautoriteit may declare existing contracts void without judicial involvement if they are not adapted within a deadline it sets.
Important new tariff and grid powers are routed through a ministerial aanwijzing previewed to parliament, preserving some ex ante parliamentary involvement.

parties: Asks whether the cost-control model is reliable and whether the new reporting system will produce timely, accurate figures, and questions how the surplus is handled.
How reliable is the current and future registration system actually?
Hoe betrouwbaar is het huidige en toekomstige registratiesysteem eigenlijk?
Questions whether a demissionary government should introduce a system change and asks who controls the budget, arguing it should be left to the next government.
Furthermore, these members ask whether a system change is being introduced too lightly by a caretaker government.
Voorts vragen genoemde leden of hier niet te lichtzinnig een stelselwijziging ingevoerd wordt door een demissionaire regering.
Supports hospital accountability but asks about the criteria and limits of the availability contribution, the powers of the health authority and the basis for the volume instrument.
They do ask the government what the criterion means for forms of care where charging all costs of the service to tariffs would distort market relations.

Wel vragen zij de regering wat het criterium inhoudt van vormen van zorg waarbij het toerekenen naar tarieven alle met de prestatie gemoeide kosten naar voor die prestatie in rekening te brengen kosten, zou leiden tot tarieven die de marktverhoudingen verstoren.

Opposes further market liberalisation and asks whether the bill is apolitical, questions the transparency of the availability contribution and the shift of powers from the minister to the health authority.
They question the remark that no further exchange of data is needed between the minister and the health authority on assessing individual cases.

Zij plaatsen vraagtekens bij de opmerking (memorie van toelichting, blz. 42) dat geen gegevensuitwisseling meer nodig is tussen de minister en de zorgautoriteit over de beoordeling van individuele gevallen.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill introducing performance-based funding instruments into the WMG should not proceed until key preconditions (stable DOT product structure, capital-cost and medical specialist issues, temporary nature of interventions) are secured, and raised concerns on ex post risk equalisation, price regulation, and clawback mechanisms. The government's nader rapport largely rejected or reframed the Council's points, arguing the instruments are framework tools and that temporariness belongs in lower-level regulation.
concerns: Council says performance-based funding only works once a stable product structure and resolved capital-cost and specialist problems exist; government agrees these must be addressed but says the instruments are needed regardless.

Council argues ex post risk equalisation and macro-budget clawback should be limited to avoid the state taking normal business risk; government defends the clawback instrument as necessary and sees ex post compensation as adjustable in lower regulation.
Council finds clawback creates income uncertainty and perverse incentives for providers; government commits to announcing measures in advance and first targeting individual overshooters.

Council warns price regulation and the availability contribution may constitute state aid under Article 108 TFEU and need justification; government accepts notification of the availability contribution.

Council asks that temporariness of ex post equalisation be fixed in the statute (art. 34 Zvw); government refuses, saying statutory fixing is too inflexible and belongs in AMvB and ministerial regulation.
Council's redactional remarks on article 50 cross-references and wording were adopted in the revised bill.

32438.s: The bill amends the Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften to bring the Wet aansprakelijkheidsverzekering motorrijtuigen under its administrative enforcement regime and makes technical changes to fine ceilings and administrative cost rules. It also amends article 154b of the Gemeentewet to cap municipal administrative fines per violation at the first-category criminal fine for individuals and 2,250 euros for legal persons.
q: The proposal for this general administrative order is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
De voordracht van deze algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
d: rules on the administrative sanction and fee amounts under the Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften

parties: Questions whether the bill's aim is effective enforcement and asks for justification of the projected savings and deterrence.
The VVD members have taken note of the above bill with reservations.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met reserve kennisgenomen van bovengenoemd wetsvoorstel.
Questions whether the bill actually improves enforcement or only eases fine collection, and asks about recidivists and insurer reporting.
They do not really understand, however, how enforcement of the motor vehicle insurance obligation is improved.
Zij begrijpen echter niet goed hoe de handhaving van de verzekeringsplicht motorrijtuigen verbeterd wordt.
Worries that without a driving ban the deterrent effect will be insufficient and recidivism will rise, and asks when criminal enforcement will replace administrative fines.
These members fear that without the possibility of a driving disqualification the new bill will have insufficient deterrent effect and recidivism will increase.

Bij voornoemde leden heerst de vrees dat er bij onmogelijkheid van ontzegging van de bevoegdheid tot het besturen van een motorrijtuig een onvoldoende afschrikwekkende werking van het nieuwe wetsvoorstel uit zal gaan.
Supports administrative enforcement for efficiency but asks how sufficient deterrence can be achieved given the limited sanction options compared with criminal law.
Under the Wahv only one fine can be imposed.
Op grond van de Wahv kan slechts één boete worden opgelegd.
Supports stronger enforcement but argues recidivists should face higher criminal penalties and asks what capacity shortfalls justify the shift.
These members think it is very good that the chance of being caught rises sharply, but they do think a higher penalty should be imposed in case of recidivism.
Deze leden vinden het heel goed dat de kans dat iemand tegen de lamp loopt fors toeneemt, maar vinden wel dat in geval van recidive een hogere straf moet worden opgelegd.

Questions the choice of administrative enforcement, the inconsistency of the sanction system, and the use of a general administrative order to add the offence to the Wahv annex, which bypasses legislative scrutiny.
They point out that article 2(5) Wahv is a textbook example of the kind of regulation that the Jurgens motion adopted by the Senate on 21 March 2006 strongly disapproves of.

Zij wijzen erop dat artikel 2, vijfde lid, Wahv een schoolvoorbeeld is van de wijze van regelgeving, die in de op 21 maart 2006 in de Eerste Kamer aangenomen motie-Jurgens ten zeerste wordt afgekeurd.
Asks how choosing administrative enforcement fits the government's own sanction-system principles, given that all citizens may be affected and there is no special supervisory relationship.
Asks for clarity on the size and composition of the uninsured group and how 100 percent enforcement would be achieved.
Can a clear schedule be provided showing which groups are now insured and which are not?
Kan in een duidelijk schema aangegeven worden welke groepen intussen nu wel en niet verzekerd zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against using administrative rather than criminal enforcement for the compulsory motor vehicle liability insurance requirement, finding the practical justification unconvincing and advising a return to criminal enforcement unless a sound motivation is given. The government's reply argues that the current enforcement gap of over two hundred thousand uninsured vehicles requires the faster, more efficient Wahv route, notes that a bestuurlijke strafbeschikking is not available before 2012, and points to the sanction of 380 euro and the retained option to request driving disqualification in court.
concerns: The Afdeling found the practical reason of limited OM capacity insufficient to depart from the cabinet's own principle that criminal enforcement is preferred in an open context.

The Afdeling regarded the choice for administrative enforcement as inconsistent given the plan to later bring the Wahv back under the criminal-beschikking system, and asked for this to be addressed in the explanatory memorandum, which was done.

The Afdeling considered that the administrative route unjustifiably blocks escalating criminal sanctions such as higher fines and driving disqualification for repeat offenders; the government replies the 380 euro fine is sufficiently deterrent and court sanctions remain available.

The Afdeling asked for justification of a fixed amount for legal persons in Article II while natuurlijke personen are referred to fine categories; the government followed this and amended the memorandum.

32456.s: This omnibus repair bill corrects technical defects and minor inconsistencies across several Dutch laws under the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, including the Awb, Gemeentewet, Kieswet, Provinciewet, Wet gemeenschappelijke regelingen and Wet op de lijkbezorging. It makes mostly editorial changes, and some articles adjust existing discretionary or hardship clauses, with no major new executive powers.
32456.j: The memorandum explains that the changes are technical, corrects unintended consequences, and frames the hardship clauses as discretionary decision powers rather than delegated rule-making.
d: Artikel IV (Garantiewet burgerlijk overheidspersoneel Indonesië, art. 7 lid 3)
minister may waive or deviate from guarantee rule in cases of overriding unfairness
Artikel V (Garantiewet militairen K.N.I.L., art. 6 lid 4)
minister may waive or deviate from guarantee rule in cases of overriding unfairness
minister may waive or deviate from non-activity pay rule in cases of overriding unfairness
Artikel XIV (Wet op de lijkbezorging, art. 32)
rules on burial method, grave layout, spacing, clearing and removal of monuments
Artikel XII (Wet gemeenschappelijke regelingen, art. 25 lid 3)
general board may transfer powers to a committee, except as excluded
p: Ministers receive discretion to waive statutory guarantee and pay rules where application would cause overriding unfairness, though the memorandum says this is a decision power, not a rule-making delegation.
Artikel XII onderdeel A (WGR art. 25 lid 3)
The general board of a joint regulation may transfer its and the executive board's powers to a committee unless the nature of the power prevents it.
Security screening of persons in military service is exempted from the general consent rule, with prior notice to the person concerned required.

32465.s: The bill abolishes the limited accrual of statutory minimum leave during sickness, allows leave to be taken during sickness, and introduces a six-month forfeiture period for minimum vacation days in Book 7 of the Civil Code. It is driven by EU case law and applies to entitlements accrued after entry into force.
32465.j: The memorandum justifies the forfeiture period by EU case law and the need to protect workers' health and safety by encouraging timely recuperation, and it notes that agreements may still deviate in the worker's favour.
q: To promote that all (healthy and re-integrating) employees, in the interest of their safety and health, actually recuperate regularly and in time by taking leave, a forfeiture period for the minimum leave days is proposed.

Om te bevorderen dat alle (gezonde en re-integrerende) werknemers in het belang van hun veiligheid en gezondheid daadwerkelijk met regelmaat en tijdig recupereren door vakantie op te nemen, wordt een vervaltermijn voorgesteld voor de minimum vakantiedagen.
d: date of entry into force set by royal decree

parties: Worries the bill places a one-sided burden on employers and asks for clarification of employer-employee agreements and the forfeiture rules.
The VVD members regret, however, that the financial and administrative consequences of the bill fall on employers.
De leden van de VVD-fractie betreuren het echter dat de financiële en administratieve gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel bij de werkgevers komen te liggen.
Supports removing the restricted accrual during sickness but opposes the very short forfeiture period and asks about sanctions on employers and the scope of exceptions.
The PvdA members do not support the proposal to introduce a very short forfeiture period for minimum vacation days.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie ondersteunen het voorstel om een zeer korte vervaltermijn in te voeren voor de minimumvakantiedagen niet.
Argues the forfeiture period ignores workers who cannot take leave for reasons such as illness or overtime, and that the 'reasonably unable' exception is open to interpretation.
The bill entirely ignores the fact that employees are not always able to take their full number of vacation days in a year.
Het voorliggende wetsvoorstel gaat geheel voorbij aan het feit dat werknemers niet altijd in staat zijn om het volledige aantal vakantiedagen in een jaar op te nemen.
Asks for justification of the shorter forfeiture period and estimates of cost and accrued leave volumes.
The SP members ask the government why the 2001 arguments for extending the forfeiture period to five years no longer apply.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering waarom de argumenten uit 2001 voor de verlenging van de vervaltermijn naar vijf jaar niet meer gelden.
Asks about consequences for reintegration of sick employees and the distribution of costs, including for small firms.
Is there a risk that certain employers will get into trouble due to high costs?
Bestaat de kans dat bepaalde werkgevers in de problemen komen door hoge kosten?
Asks for justification of the balance struck by the measures, the effect on taking leave during sickness, and the cost estimate.
They do ask for further explanation of why the government considers the proposed measures to strike a balanced equilibrium.
Wel vragen zij om een nadere toelichting waarom de regering van mening is dat de voorgestelde maatregelen tot een evenwichtige balans leiden.

32474.s: The bill makes water boards (waterschappen) responsible for controlling muskrats and beavers and requires them to contribute to the cost of improving primary flood defences via an annual formula-based payment to the Minister. It also sets the calculation formula, data-reporting duties, and collection by writ of execution, and repeals the 1985 muskrat-catcher law.
32474.j: The explanatory memorandum is missing from the text, so no justification is given.
q: The Minister sets, by 1 October of the year following the reference year, the amount of the contribution due under article 7.24 for that year and the three following years.

Onze Minister stelt voor 1 oktober van het kalenderjaar dat volgt op het kalenderjaar waarin de peildatum valt de hoogte van de ingevolge artikel 7.24 verschuldigde bijdrage over het desbetreffende kalenderjaar en de drie daarop volgende kalenderjaren vast.
d: water board data supply to the Minister
Minister sets contribution amount for four-year periods
p: The Minister fixes the amount of each water board's contribution and can collect it by writ of execution, using a formula set in the statute.

parties: Asks why only part of the water boards' proposal is adopted, why savings start in 2011, and what regulatory action the government will take.
They note that the government adopts only part of the proposal and ask why that choice was made.
Zij constateren dat de regering slechts een deel van het voorstel overneemt en vragen waarom daarvoor is gekozen.
Supports shifting muskrat control to water boards but asks why other parts of the Storm advice are not regulated and how efficiency and citizen costs will be safeguarded.
The PvdA members finally ask how the government will prevent that, by implementing only part of the UvW package, the intended efficiency gains are not achieved and burdens on citizens rise.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen ten slotte hoe de regering zal voorkomen dat, door maar een deel van het maatregelenpakket uit het advies van de UvW uit te voeren, de beoogde efficiencywinsten niet gehaald worden en de lasten voor burgers zullen stijgen.
Demands written guarantees that the bill will not raise charges for citizens and asks what the 'limited increase' in administrative burden for the state amounts to.
They request the government to lay down in this bill that the proposed changes will under no circumstances lead to a rise in charges for citizens.
Zij verzoeken de regering om in dit wetsvoorstel vast te leggen dat de voorgestelde wijzigingen onder geen beding zullen leiden tot een lastenverhoging voor de burger.
Welcomes the constructive role of the UvW and asks how the government views the criticism that only some measures are legislated.
These members consider it a positive signal that the Unie van Waterschappen constructively helps find savings that do not come at the expense of quality.
Deze leden vinden het een positief signaal dat de Unie van Waterschappen (UvW) constructief meedenkt met het vinden van besparingen die niet ten koste gaan van de kwaliteit.
Sceptical of selective adoption of the UvW package; asks for a legal basis for the main proposals, a government response per proposal, and a clear account of cost shifts per water board.
These members note that the government cherry-picks from the coherent package of cost-saving proposals to improve the capacity and efficiency of the water chain.
Deze leden constateren dat de regering selectief winkelt in het samenhangende pakket van voorstellen voor kostenbesparing door verbetering van de slagkracht en efficiency in de waterketen.
Asks for an overview and justification of unadopted measures, a second opinion on whether charges rise, and how the bill relates to the Delta programme and Delta fund.
They ask whether the government can back its answer with a second opinion, precisely because several parts of the Storm action plan are not part of the bill.

Zij vragen of de regering haar antwoord op voorgaande vraag kan onderbouwen met een second opinion, juist omdat een aantal onderdelen van het actieplan «Storm» geen onderdeel uitmaakt van het wetsvoorstel.

32519.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act to implement EU Directive 2009/12/EC on airport charges, extending tariff rules to other civil airports, allowing the minister to designate airport networks and approve joint tariff systems, and adding NMa review of tariffs and service-on-demand decisions. It also introduces differentiated charges for public interest and environmental protection, freight coverage, and transitional rules.
32519.j: The memorandum justifies the uniform model as needed to meet the directive's requirements for all possible future scenarios, including networks and traffic distribution between airports.
d: designation of airport networks and approval of joint tariff systems
information users must provide before tariff proposals (via general administrative order)
regulations under the thirteenth paragraph on airport charges
p: The minister may designate airport networks and approve joint tariff systems across airports serving the same city or agglomeration.

parties: The VVD supports the bill but asks questions about the consequences for the competition authority NMA's board after its expanded supervision.
The VVD members ask, given the expansion of supervision by the Netherlands Competition Authority (NMA), what the consequences of this bill are for the NMA's Board of Management.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen, gelet op de uitbreiding van het toezicht door de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit (hierna NMA), wat de consequenties zijn van dit voorstel van wet voor de Raad van Bestuur van de NMA.
The PvdA asks factual questions about tariffs, differentiation, security costs and the airport network without taking a position on checks.
The PvdA members ask the government what concrete consequences the bill has for Schiphol's tariffs.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering welke concrete consequenties het voorliggende voorstel van wet heeft voor de tarieven van Schiphol.

The PVV fears the bill raises passenger costs and undermines a level playing field, and asks for article 1B to be deleted because it lets Schiphol set tariffs under environmental or mainport pretexts despite government direction; it also argues NMA review should be available before tariff changes take effect.
The PVV members therefore ask the government to delete article 1B of the bill.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering dan ook artikel 1B van het voorstel van wet te schrappen.
The CDA asks whether designating an airport network hinders tailored solutions and how small airports such as Lelystad's general aviation users are heard in consultation.
Finally, the CDA members ask how it is ensured that the input of General Aviation at Lelystad airport weighs as heavily in consultation as the input of the large airlines at Schiphol.

Tot slot vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie op welke wijze wordt geborgd dat de inspraak van de «General Aviation» van de luchthaven Lelystad net zo zwaar weegt in de consultatie als de inspraak van de grote luchtvaartmaatschappijen op de luchthaven Schiphol?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill implementing EU Directive 2009/12/EC on airport charges but advises the explanatory memorandum to justify why the Schiphol mainport interest counts as public or general interest, and to fix the criteria for premium services in advance. The minister adds the justification to the memorandum and adopts the advice on advance criteria, while retaining the possibility of supplementary case-specific criteria and adding administrative sanctions.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should justify why the Schiphol mainport interest can be regarded as a public or general interest, since EU law normally means non-economic interests.

Criteria for premium services or reserved terminal parts should be set in advance so that they can be objective and transparent, but the government keeps room to add criteria in specific circumstances.
Administrative sanctions for acting contrary to the new article 8.25ea were added to article 11.24.

32528.s: The bill amends the Aliens Act 2000 to let border and aliens-supervision officials search dwellings and business premises without the occupant's consent for the temporary seizure of travel or identity documents when a person whose identity cannot immediately be established is held. It also allows searches of detained persons' clothing, body and belongings in custody to obtain identity and nationality information.
32528.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the difficulty of identifying undocumented migrants and the ineffectiveness of existing measures when documents are kept at home, citing police experience and figures.
q: The proposed Article 53a(1) of the Aliens Act 2000 allows border and aliens-supervision officials, under certain conditions, to search a dwelling without the occupant's consent for documents for identity investigation and preparation of departure.

Het voorgestelde artikel 53a, eerste lid, van de Vw 2000 maakt het mogelijk dat ambtenaren belast met de grensbewaking dan wel het toezicht op vreemdelingen onder bepaalde voorwaarden zonder toestemming van de bewoner de woning doorzoeken naar documenten ten behoeve van het identiteitsonderzoek en voorbereiding van vertrek.
p: Officials may search homes and business premises without the occupant's consent for identity documents, subject to a prior request for voluntary surrender and a reasonable-necessity test.
Searches require a written authorisation (which may be given by phone in urgent cases) by a designated official, and the search must be recorded with its grounds.
Officials may search the body, clothing and belongings of detained persons where necessary to obtain identity, nationality and residence-status information.

parties: Asks for fuller justification of why further extending entry without consent is not considered, and for clarification of proportionality and subsidiarity principles.
They would like a more extensive argument for why a further extension of the power to enter without the occupant's consent is not being considered.
Zij vernemen graag een uitgebreidere argumentatie waarom een verdere uitbreiding van de bevoegdheid tot binnentreden zonder toestemming van de bewoner niet wordt overwogen.
Stresses maximum care when expanding supervisory powers and asks about safeguards against unlimited use of home searches and the risk of searching the wrong homes.
These members also want to know what guarantees there are that the possibility of searching a home will not be used without limit.
Ook willen deze leden weten welke garanties er zijn dat niet onbeperkt gebruik gemaakt zal worden van de mogelijkheid tot het doorzoeken van een woning.
Urges the government to extend entry powers further now, given illegal stay and identity fraud, without raising check concerns.
These members ask the government to seize the opportunity of the present amendment to actually carry out the further extension mentioned above.
Deze leden vragen de regering om juist de gelegenheid van de onderhavige wetswijziging te baat te nemen om de bovengenoemde verdere uitbreiding wel door te voeren.
Asks why searches are limited to 'limited' scope and what prevents going further, while also asking whether the proportionality of examinations of persons in detention could be disproportionate.
The members asking here wonder where any disproportionality might lie.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen waarin eventuele disproportionaliteit zou kunnen liggen.

Argues that searches of homes and businesses should require authorisation by an investigating judge rather than a hulpofficier van justitie, given the intrusiveness, and questions the necessity of the measures if illegal stay is criminalised.
The aforementioned members endorse the Council of State's view that the power to authorise a search should not rest with the hulpofficier van justitie but with the investigating judge.

Voornoemde leden onderschrijven de mening van de Raad van State dat de bevoegdheid tot machtiging voor doorzoeking niet dient te berusten bij de hulpofficier van Justitie maar bij de rechter-commissaris.

Questions the necessity and justification of expanding search powers into homes and businesses, asks for clearer statutory conditions, and insists on separating immigration searches from criminal investigation.
These members emphasise that such an intrusion must be justified by weighty reasons.
Deze leden benadrukken dat een dergelijke inbreuk met zwaarwegende redenen omkleed dient te zijn.
Supports the ability to establish identity and sees no reason for further comments.
These members currently see no reason to make further comments on this bill.
Deze leden zien op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het maken van nadere opmerkingen over dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Council of State advised, in its opinion of 4 August 2010, that the bill expanding immigration supervision powers (home search without consent for identity checks, and body/property search of detained aliens) is broadly supported but needs changes on necessity, proportionality, remedies, authorisation by a hulpofficier van justitie, and the scope of the home-search power. The government's reply accepted some points (clarifying the legal framework and remedies) and rejected others (purpose limitation, authorisation level, telephone consent, residential-use clause), arguing the existing safeguards suffice.
concerns: The Council wanted the explanatory memorandum to show why the existing article 50 Vw2000 identity procedures are insufficient, which the government only partly addressed by pointing to cost savings.
The Council asked that the purpose limitation on preparing departure be reflected in articles 53a and 59, but the government said it was not a purpose limitation.
The Council required effective legal remedies for aliens and third parties against home searches and body searches, which the government added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Council advised that only a rechter or a higher prosecutor, not a hulpofficier van justitie, should authorise home searches, a point the government did not accept.
The Council advised narrowing the home-search power to cases of reasonable suspicion of residential use, which the government rejected as unnecessary given existing conditions.
The Council suggested allowing verifiable electronic telephone authorisation; the government acknowledged the point but did not change the text.
The Council proposed replacing 'werkend is aangetroffen' with 'werkzaam is' in article 53a(2); the government declined.
