32555.s: The bill amends Book 3 of the Civil Code and the Code of Civil Procedure to implement EU Directive 2008/52/EC on mediation in civil and commercial matters. It allows mediation to interrupt limitation periods, lets courts propose mediation at any stage, and gives mediators a limited testimonial privilege for confidential mediations.
32555.j: The memorandum justifies the new court powers and privilege as required by the directive and as support for the use of mediation, and reports that the advisory committee's recommendations were not followed.
q: The possibility for the judge to refer to mediation (Article 5 of the directive) and the possibility to record the result of a mediation in a form that can be enforced (Article 6 of the directive) can support the use of mediation.

De mogelijkheid voor de rechter om te verwijzen naar mediation (artikel 5 van de richtlijn) en de mogelijkheid tot het vastleggen van het resultaat van een mediation in een vorm waarin dit resultaat ten uitvoer gelegd kan worden (artikel 6 van de richtlijn) kunnen het gebruik van mediation ondersteunen.
p: Introduces a limited testimonial privilege for mediators in confidential mediations, with exceptions for public-order reasons such as protecting children.

parties: Regret that the government did not regulate mediation more fully and worry about vague definitions of mediator and mediation, creating legal uncertainty.
They are concerned about this overly vague definition, which could lead to problems both in the field and in the courtroom.
De aan het woord zijnde leden maken zich zorgen over deze te vage definitie die tot problemen kan leiden, zowel in het veld als in de rechtszaal.
Asks why mediator quality is not secured by statute and whether unqualified mediators can invoke the testimonial privilege.
Asks whether clients of non-certified mediators can claim legal aid and raises the Supreme Court's objections to a privilege for all mediators.
The PVV members ask whether a client of a non-certified mediator can claim legal aid from the Legal Aid Board.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of een cliënt van een niet gecertificeerde mediator aanspraak kan maken op rechtsbijstand van de Raad voor rechtsbijstand.
Asks about quality requirements for mediators, the scope of the privilege, and possible misuse of the new limitation period.
How does the government view the fact that, under Articles 2 and 7 of the Directive, a broad group of mediators is granted the privilege of non-disclosure.
Hoe kijkt de regering aan tegen het feit dat op grond van de artikelen 2 en 7 van de Richtlijn aan een ruime groep mediators het verschoningsrecht toekomt.
Asks for confirmation that mediation is not compulsory, that judges cannot pressure parties, and that refusal will not lead to higher fees or loss of legal aid.
These members ask the government to rule out now that refusing mediation will lead to higher court fees, denial of subsidised legal aid, or a higher contribution.

Deze leden vragen de regering nu reeds uit te sluiten dat het weigeren van mediation zal leiden tot hogere griffierechten, het niet toekennen van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand of een hogere eigen bijdrage.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing the EU mediation directive but objects to the broad mediator privilege (verschoningsrecht) extending beyond cross-border cases, the unexplained three-year limitation period, and the transitional rule. The government's reply narrows the privilege to mediations where confidentiality is expressly agreed, justifies the three-year period by reference to the comparable binding-advice regime, and explains the transitional provision in relation to the directive.
concerns: The extension of the mediator's privilege to all mediations, not only cross-border ones, is insufficiently justified and was narrowed by the government to cases of expressly agreed confidentiality.
The meaning of 'informatie' in the proposed article 165(3) Rv should be clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
The choice of a three-year limitation period after interruption by mediation must be motivated, and the government added a justification by reference to the binding advice regime.
The transitional arrangement for mediations started before entry into force needs a fuller explanation of its relation to the directive, which the government provided in the memorandum.
A redactional remark on describing 'no implementation required' in the transposition table is made in the annex.

32618.s: The bill creates a differentiated statutory tuition fee in higher education, under which students who have been enrolled longer than the allowed duration pay a higher (verhoogd) rate, with fee amounts and related rules set by general administrative order and institutional boards. It also amends the Higher Education Act, Study Finance Act, Experiments Act and income tax act to align references and deductions.
32618.j: The memorandum justifies the differentiated fee by rising higher-education enrolment and the aim to discourage excessively long study, and relies on general administrative orders for amounts and categories to allow adjustment.
q: The amount of the full statutory tuition fee is set by general administrative order.
Het bedrag van het volledige wettelijke collegegeld wordt bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vastgesteld.
d: basic and increased rate of full statutory tuition fee
minimum and maximum partial tuition fee amounts
institutional board sets partial tuition fee within bounds
extension of categories of students liable for statutory tuition
reference date and counting rules for years enrolled; extension of exempt student categories
Open University sets collegegeld OU and rules
institutional board sets institutional tuition fee and rules
indexation of fee amounts by general administrative order
minister grants permission for selective admission and higher fee up to five times basic rate
p: Institutions and executive bodies gain discretion to set partial and institutional tuition fees and to fix higher rates for long-enrolled students, with bounds set by general administrative order.
Minister may approve selective admission and fees up to five times the basic rate, conditioned on small-scale intensive education and no harm to quality or accessibility.

parties: Supports the bill as a shift of responsibility to students and institutions, asks about coherence with other measures and about the OU and refunds.
This means that choices must now be made on financial matters, so that over the next few years investment can be made in the quality of higher education.
Dat betekent dat nu keuzes gemaakt moeten worden op financieel gebied, zodat over enkele jaren kan worden geïnvesteerd in de kwaliteit van het hoger onderwijs.
Argues the bill violates legal certainty and equality because there is no transitional rule, and that financial motives cannot override general principles of good governance.
General principles of good governance may indeed be set aside for other considerations, but in the view of the PvdA members not for a financial target.

Immers, algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur kunnen weliswaar vanwege andere overwegingen opzij worden gezet, maar naar de mening van de leden van de PvdA-fractie niet vanwege een financiële taakstelling.
Supports the goals but asks for justification of the absence of a transitional rule and for clarity on the legal basis after the Harmonisatiewet ruling.
In particular they look forward to further explanation of the choice not to include a transitional arrangement.
Met name over de keuze voor het niet opnemen van een overgangsregeling zien de leden van de fractie graag een nadere toelichting tegemoet.
Calls the bill a disguised budget cut and says the lack of a transitional rule violates legal certainty for students already enrolled.
The bill chases students for costs and also amounts to a flat budget cut on the institutions.
Het wetsvoorstel jaagt studenten op kosten en komt tevens neer op een platte bezuiniging op de instellingen.
Questions the bill's durability, its effectiveness and its legal soundness given the legal certainty principle and immediate entry into force.
The measure must take effect even before the 2011–2012 academic year.
De maatregel moet al vóór het studiejaar 2011–2012 in werking treden.
Argues the bill is a budget cut unrelated to quality, asks for the basis of the fine and for evidence that it is effective, and questions the lack of transitional law.
The government sets aside care and legal certainty for students.
De regering schuift zorgvuldigheid en rechtszekerheid voor studenten aan de kant.
Asks for justification of the measure, its fit with the Veerman advice, and whether the legal advice from the landsadvocaat will be made public.
Has the government asked the State Advocate for advice on the legal soundness of the proposed measure, they ask.
Heeft de regering over de juridische houdbaarheid van de voorgestelde maatregel advies gevraagd aan de landsadvocaat, zo informeren zij.
Asks why no transitional arrangement was made despite the weight given to legal certainty, and how the government assessed the risk the rule fails in court.
They ask how the government has assured itself of the chance that the proposed scheme will stand up before the court.
Zij vragen hoe de regering zich heeft vergewist van de kans dat de voor gestelde regeling voor de rechter stand zal houden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises revising the bill raising tuition for long-term students, questioning its goals, effectiveness, lack of transitional law and several technical points. The government's reply largely accepts the drafting and transitional-law concerns, reworks the institutional budget cut, but rejects a cohort-based phase-in and keeps immediate effect.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the bill's goal is clear and that the proposed fee increase will effectively raise study efficiency, asking for evidence and a clearer distinction between budget and study-success aims.
The Afdeling finds the institutional budget cut and the lack of instruments for institutions to counter long study duration disproportionate, suggesting alternatives.
The Afdeling advises transitional law or a cohort-based phase-in because students already delayed cannot avoid the higher fee, which raises legal certainty concerns.
The Afdeling notes the uitloopjaar may not help students with few instroommomenten and that part-time students may be disadvantaged, asking for adjustment.
The Afdeling raises technical points on the collegegeldkrediet maximum, the delegation of tariff rules and the fiscal aftrek, asking for clarification and adjustments.

32717.s: The bill implements EU framework decision 2008/978/JBZ on the European Evidence Warrant by adding a new section to the Code of Criminal Procedure on recognition and execution of incoming warrants and issuing outgoing warrants. It gives the public prosecutor and investigating judge powers to execute or issue warrants for seizure and transfer of evidence, with specified refusal grounds, remedies via complaint to the court, and a ministerial regulation power on data collection.
32717.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary to implement the principle of mutual recognition and the framework decision's obligations, and it explains the role of the investigating judge and complaint remedies as safeguards.
q: The present framework decision implements the principle of mutual recognition.
Het onderhavige kaderbesluit geeft uitvoering aan het beginsel van wederzijdse erkenning.
d: rules on collecting and providing data on execution of the warrant provisions
p: Allows coercive powers normally limited to certain offences to be used for listed serious offences abroad even where a comparable Dutch case would not permit them, with formal requirements left in place.

Removes the separate judicial authorisation (verlof) for transferring seized items abroad, relying on the complaint procedure instead, and bars the executing court from reviewing the grounds of the issuing state's warrant.}],

parties: Asks whether the warrant could require evidence gathering on conduct not criminal in the Netherlands, such as abortion or euthanasia, and whether the court approval procedure should be dropped.
They would object to judicial efforts and costs being spent investigating acts that are not punishable in the Netherlands.
Zij zouden er namelijk moeite mee hebben als gerechtelijke inspanningen en kosten zouden moeten worden gemaakt voor onderzoek naar handelingen die in Nederland niet strafbaar zijn.
Questions the removal of the court approval procedure in artikel 552p Sv and whether suspects and third parties are informed of requests.
They ask the government to convince them of the benefit of not applying artikel 552p Sv to the European evidence warrant.
Zij vragen de regering hen te overtuigen van het nut om artikel 552p Sv niet van toepassing te laten zijn op het Europees bewijsverkrijgingsbevel.
Questions how many mutual legal assistance requests have been refused and the outcome of negotiations on data retention, and expresses that the EU should focus on economic cooperation.
These members ask whether the government expects an increase in these requests.
Deze leden vragen of de regering een toename van deze verzoeken verwacht.
Supports the bill as improving European judicial cooperation and asks how the warrant will be implemented and resourced.
This bill will contribute to better cooperation between European judicial partners.
Dit wetsvoorstel zal bijdragen aan een betere samenwerking tussen de Europese justitiële partners.
Criticises the limited grounds for refusal, mutual recognition as blind trust, investigative powers unavailable under Dutch law, and weak legal protection for citizens.
Notes Netherlands is late in implementing the framework decision, asks about privacy protection of third parties and data protection levels, and wants a judicial check retained.
These members ask the government to ensure this bill does not enter into force before the bill implementing framework decision 2008/977/JBZ, so that privacy is guaranteed.

Deze leden vragen de regering er zorg voor te dragen dat onderhavig wetsvoorstel niet eerder in werking treedt dan het wetsvoorstel ter implementatie van kaderbesluit 2008/977/JBZ, zodat de privacy gewaarborgd is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing the EU framework decision on the European Evidence Warrant but advises revising the conditions for issuing and executing the warrant, notably replacing 'rechtmatig' with 'rechtstreeks' and restructuring article 552ww. The minister's reply rejects the terminology change but adopts alternative wording, clarifies the memorandum, restructures the article, and accepts most drafting remarks.
concerns: The Council advised replacing 'rechtmatig toegankelijk' with 'rechtstreeks toegankelijk' to match the framework decision's wording; the minister declined the term change but replaced it with 'naar Nederlands recht toegankelijk' and clarified the explanatory memorandum with examples.
The Council advised restructuring article 552ww, first paragraph, into separate parts to improve clarity and readability, which the minister adopted.
Redactional remarks on the preamble, the term 'vorderen', article 552yy grounds for refusal, and article 552bbb cross-references were partly adopted or declined with reasons.

32780-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the States General (IIA) by adjusting spending and commitments for the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer, with a net increase of about 2.5 million euros in expenditure. It takes effect from 1 June 2011 and is linked to the Voorjaarsnota.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the budget of the States General (IIA) for the year 2011
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2011

32825.s: The bill approves the Aanpassingsregeling BES-wetten BZK, a ministerial regulation adapting Dutch Antillean legislation for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, as required by the Invoeringswet. It also makes several technical amendments to education, media, aviation and criminal-procedure provisions and sets entry-into-force rules.
32825.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation by the Invoeringswet's provision allowing amendment of Antillean-origin laws where necessary for application or to prevent unacceptable consequences, and requires submission to parliament for approval.
q: Article 21(1) of the Invoeringswet provides that as soon as possible after the ministerial regulation is adopted, a bill approving it is submitted to the States General.

Artikel 21, eerste lid, van de Invoeringswet bepaalt dat zo spoedig mogelijk na vaststelling van de ministeriële regeling, zoals hierboven genoemd, een voorstel van wet tot goedkeuring van deze regeling bij de Staten-Generaal wordt ingediend.
d: adaptation regulation for BES legislation (approved by law)
Artikel II, III, IV, V, VI
entry into force of provisions by royal decree
p: Ministerial regulation adapting statutes is made by the executive but must be approved by parliament through this law, which limits the shift.

32834.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing act for the European Order for Payment procedure so that all applications are filed with the Hague district court, which may then refer cases to other courts after a statement of defence. It also sets out the procedure after a defence is filed, including judicial designation, time limits, and that no appeal lies against the designation decisions, and adjusts court fees for small claims.
32834.j: The memorandum justifies the concentration of filings and the procedural rules by the simplification for foreign claimants and the need for efficient handling, developed with the judiciary and advisory committee.

parties: Asks whether debtors have sufficient safeguards against a dubious or procedurally flawed enforceable title obtained abroad, and asks for concrete figures on court designation accuracy.

Are there sufficient safeguards for the (Dutch) debtor so that they are not unexpectedly confronted with a possibly dubious, or contrary to e.g. principles of procedural law, enforceable title obtained in another EU member state?

Zijn er wel voldoende waarborgen voor de (Nederlandse) schuldenaar, zodat deze niet onverhoopt wordt geconfronteerd met een mogelijk dubieus, of in strijd met bijvoorbeeld de beginselen van procesrecht, verkregen executoriale titel in een andere EU-lidstaat?
Supports trade and lower costs but fears lower thresholds could allow malicious foreign claims to be served in the Netherlands, asking whether this risk increases.
Can the government address whether, with the proposed bill, the risk that malicious claims can be served in the Netherlands increases?
Kan de regering ingaan op de vraag of met het voorliggend wetsvoorstel het risico dat malafide vorderingen in Nederland kunnen worden betekend groter wordt?
Asks why the proposed designation system was chosen over alternatives suggested by the Dutch judiciary and whether the Commission has been notified, questioning the procedure's safeguards.
The aforementioned members ask why the proposed system was chosen.
Voornoemde leden vragen waarom er voor het voorgestelde systeem is gekozen.
Welcomes the simplification and considers the designation procedure to offer adequate guarantees that the correct judge handles the continued proceedings.

These members share the government's view that the procedure proposed in the bill, in which the claimant and defendant have a say if desired, offers good guarantees that the correct judge handles the continued procedure.

Deze leden delen de mening van de regering dat de procedure die wordt voorgesteld in het wetsvoorstel, waarbij de eiser en de verweerder indien gewenst inspraak hebben, goede waarborgen biedt dat de juiste rechter de voortgezette procedure behandelt.
Asks whether the legal protection of the paying defendant changes for better or worse, and whether earlier consumer-protection jurisdiction rules still apply under the new design.
These members ask whether the reasons for the choice made at the time no longer apply now.
Deze leden vragen of de redenen waarom hier destijds voor is gekozen nu niet meer gelden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill concentrating European payment order applications at the The Hague district court but raises objections on the compatibility with Brussels I and the EBB Regulation and on the continuation of proceedings after a contest, advising adaptation. The government's reply rejects the main suggestion (binding determination of jurisdiction) while adding clarification to the explanatory memorandum and accepting the drafting correction.
concerns: The Council asks that the explanation of why the court in The Hague would designate itself in most cases be clarified, and that the procedure avoid jurisdictional challenges and referral by requesting further information and binding the relative jurisdiction.

The Council asks clarification of why the arguments against concentration in 2008 no longer hold, given that Brussels I and Article 6 of the EBB Regulation also designate the relatively competent court; the government added clarification to the explanatory memorandum.
Editorial remark on Article 6, fifth paragraph, correcting a cross-reference from 'vierde' to 'derde'.

32843.s: The bill amends the Dutch Foreigners Employment Act to implement EU Directive 2009/52/EC against employers of illegally staying third-country nationals. It requires employers to notify authorities of foreign workers at least two working days in advance, and introduces wage claims against employers and higher-level employers in the chain, heard by the cantonal judge.
32843.j: The memorandum justifies the notification duty and the delegated rules on forms and exemptions as needed to implement the directive by the transposition deadline of 20 July 2011.
q: An employer who has a foreigner perform work in the Netherlands, to which the prohibition in article 2 does not apply, may under the proposed article 2a(1) be obliged to notify in writing, at least two working days before the work starts, a body designated by ministerial regulation.

Een werkgever die een vreemdeling arbeid in Nederland laat verrichten, ten aanzien waarvan het verbod, bedoeld in artikel 2 Wav niet geldt, kan volgens het voorgestelde artikel 2a, eerste lid Wav, verplicht worden minimaal twee werkdagen voordat die vreemdeling arbeid gaat verrichten daarvan schriftelijk melding te doen aan een bij ministeriële regeling aan te wijzen instantie
d: designation of body to receive employer notifications
cases where notification duty is already met under other provisions
model of declaration and supporting documents
p: Employers must report foreign workers to a body designated by ministerial regulation, with the designation and forms left to delegated rules.

parties: Asks why the notification duty is needed when authorities already know of such employment, and warns of extra administrative burden and duplication.
Moreover, an additional notification may create extra administrative burdens.
Bovendien kan een extra melding extra administratieve lasten opleveren.
Supports tightening the Wav and asks how the government will enforce it and whether the labour inspectorate gets more capacity.
Does the government make more capacity available to the labour inspectorate to enforce this tightening effectively?
Stelt de regering meer capaciteit van de arbeidsinspectie beschikbaar om deze aanscherping effectief te kunnen handhaven?

Asks why separate legislation was not chosen for legal and illegal third-country nationals, questions the notification deadline and the discretionary recovery of deportation costs, and asks about financial effects.
The PVV members ask why separate legislation was not chosen for legally and illegally residing third-country nationals, as their position on the labour market is totally different.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waarom niet is gekozen voor aparte wetgeving met betrekking tot legale en illegaal verblijvende onderdanen van derde landen, aangezien hun positie op de arbeidsmarkt totaal verschillend is.

Supports the anti-illegal-employment aim but asks whether the bill goes beyond the directive regarding legal residents, volunteer work, joint liability and the proportionality of sanctions for employers who complied with their duties.
Employers who have fulfilled their obligations (such as checking identity papers and the notification duty) should in the view of these members not be held liable.

Werkgevers die hebben voldaan aan hun verplichtingen (zoals een controle van de identiteitspapieren en de meldingsplicht) zouden naar de mening van deze leden niet aansprakelijk gesteld moeten worden.

Asks how the notification duty will be shaped, which authority will handle registration, control and enforcement, and whether the government will work in the EU to amend the posting directive on equal treatment and chain liability.
The SP members ask whether the government is willing to work within the European Union to amend the posting directive in order to shape equal treatment and chain liability.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering bereid is om zich binnen de Europese Unie in te zetten om de detacheringsrichtlijn aan te passen teneinde gelijke behandeling en ketenaansprakelijkheid vorm te geven.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing Directive 2009/52/EC on sanctions against employers of illegally staying third-country nationals, but raises remarks on incomplete implementation, the employer reporting obligation, the wage definition and financial sanctions, and advises adapting the bill. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts most advice, including the reporting duty with a two-working-day deadline and the wage definition, while explaining its choice for broader scope in several areas.
concerns: The advisory division found the delegation basis for the employer reporting duty did not meet the directive; the government converted it into a direct statutory obligation.

The advisory division asked for a statutory deadline for the reporting duty and consistency between text and explanatory memorandum; the government set a deadline of two working days before work starts.
The advisory division asked that the wage terminology in the Wav match the directive or the Civil Code; the government adopted the directive's definition in article 23.

The advisory division flagged that stricter national rules than the directive (scope, definition of employment, subcontractor liability) may harm competitiveness and need justification; the government gave reasons but kept several stricter rules.
The advisory division found the directive's exemption for employers who did due diligence was not properly implemented via the Awb and the sanctions policy rules; the government agreed to address it.

The advisory division asked for clarification of how terugkeerkosten (return costs) are implemented in fines and cost recovery; the government explained the implementation through article 6.4 Vreemdelingenbesluit and the fine calculation.
Several minor redactional comments on the bill text and transposition table were adopted, except one relating to a provision outside this bill that was deferred.

33059.s: The bill adds a special transfer regime (overdrachtsregeling) to the Wet op het financieel toezicht, letting DNB prepare and have a court approve forced transfer of deposits, assets, liabilities or shares of a failing bank or insurer, and adds a new Part 6 letting the Minister of Finance take immediate measures or expropriate a financial institution to protect financial stability. It also amends the Faillissementswet and restricts counterparties' trigger-event rights after such measures.
33059.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for effective resolution of failing financial institutions and protection of financial stability, arguing that existing instruments are insufficient once an institution is in trouble.
q: These concern two special powers for the Minister of Finance: the power to intervene in the internal powers of a financial institution and the power, as ultima ratio, to expropriate a financial institution where necessary.

Het gaat daarbij om twee bijzondere bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën: de bevoegdheid om in te grijpen in de interne bevoegdheden van een financiële onderneming en de bevoegdheid om, als ultimum remedium, zo nodig zelfs tot onteigening van een financiële onderneming over te gaan.
d: rules on overbruggingsinstelling (bridge institution) by AMvB
further rules on transfer plan and its preparation
financing and allocation of costs of deposit transfer
transfer plan may deviate from statutory or articles provisions on shares
Minister may take immediate measures departing from statutory or articles provisions
Minister may expropriate assets or securities of a financial institution, departing from statute
p: Minister of Finance may expropriate assets or securities of a financial institution, departing from statute, when financial stability is at immediate risk, subject to consultation with DNB and expedited Raad van State review.
Minister may take immediate measures in deviation from statutory and articles provisions for a financial institution, with a time limit set in the measure and consultation of DNB.
After DNB notifies a bank it is preparing a transfer plan, DNB may compel information disclosure and site access; decisions taken then are not subject to administrative objection or appeal.
Court approves transfer plans on a summary basis, with shareholders not heard in advance and limited to later objection.
Counterparties may not invoke trigger-event rights against banks or insurers after transfer measures, without DNB consent.

parties: Asks how a balance is guaranteed between the supervisor's flexibility and speed and advance clarity for affected parties before far-reaching instruments are used, and how the minister's powers are tied to criteria.
The VVD members ask how the bill guarantees a balance between flexibility and speed for the supervisor to intervene in time and advance clarity for those concerned.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe in het wetsvoorstel een evenwicht wordt gewaarborgd tussen flexibiliteit en slagkracht voor de toezichthouder om tijdig in te grijpen en voorafgaande duidelijkheid voor betrokkenen

Questions the pricing and financing of deposit transfers, who decides, whether the minister's expropriation powers are reviewable, and whether shareholders' liability should bear losses; raises state aid and too-big-to-fail concerns.
Is it the case that the acquiring party must always pay a price for taking over deposits that exceeds the part DNB finances?
Is het zo dat de overnemende partij altijd een prijs moet betalen voor het overnemen van de deposito's die groter is dan het gedeelte dat DNB financiert?

Warns of legal uncertainty and weak legal protection, asks why shareholders holding 5% or less are not heard, asks for alignment of appeal regimes and for explicit statutory derogations rather than open-ended ones.
The CDA members therefore wish to stress that it is extremely important that this bill does not bring legal uncertainty and deficient legal protection.
De leden van de CDA-fractie willen dan ook benadrukken dat het van buitengewoon van belang is dat dit wetsvoorstel geen rechtsonzekerheid en gebrekkige rechtsbescherming met zich meebrengt.

Asks how the reasonableness of prices and transfers is assessed by the court, whether capacity exists for that review, how workers' rights are protected, and whether parliament has any say over bridge institutions.
The SP members ask how the reasonable price for a deposit transfer is determined.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe de redelijke prijs voor een deposito-overdracht wordt vastgesteld.

Asks how the existence of an emergency threat is judged, who has the final word between the minister and DNB, whether a cost-benefit analysis is made, and how moral hazard and shareholder contributions are addressed.
The PVV members likewise ask how it is assessed whether there is a serious and imminent danger to the stability of the financial sector.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen eveneens hoe wordt ingeschat of sprake is van een ernstig en onmiddellijk gevaar voor de stabiliteit voor de financiële sector.

Asks whether a voluntary reorganisation pre-phase and living wills should precede intervention, the scope of intervention across activities, and how the minister's role relates to supervisors and parliament's information.
The ChristenUnie members ask whether attention has been paid to the phase preceding intervention by the supervisors.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen of er aandacht is besteed aan de fase voorafgaand aan ingrijpen door de toezichthouders

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet bijzondere maatregelen financiële ondernemingen, proposing a transfer regime, emergency regime and expropriation powers for DNB, and raised major objections on the scope (insurers), the broad trigger criterion, judicial review and shareholder hearing rights. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, narrowing the scope to banks and insurers, tightening the criterion, changing the court test and adding compensation and appeal mechanisms.
concerns: The Afdeling said the scope including insurers and risk-acceptance entities was insufficiently justified; the government removed risk-acceptance entities and kept insurers with added motivation.
The trigger criterion was too broad; the government removed the conduct-based reference and changed the wording but kept the core continuity element.

Shareholder hearing rule was reversed and judicial review of the transfer regime needed adequate legal protection and compensation; the government adopted a compensation procedure via the Ondernemingskamer.
The judge's review of DNB's transfer plan should not be merely marginal; the government changed the test to summary-showing wording like the Faillissementswet.
Powers to deviate from statutory provisions were too open-ended and needed precision; the government limited the deviation power.
Differing appeal regimes for transfer and emergency regimes were unexplained; the government aligned appeal rules for the emergency regime.
Redactional comments on the bill and explanatory memorandum were adopted.

33086.s: The bill abolishes the municipal duty to provide and fund integration (inburgering) courses, shifting cost and organisation to the integration obligor and centralising the remaining powers, fines and loan rules with the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations, with a three-year deadline and a higher fine. It also amends the Aliens Act, Education Act, Childcare Act and Participation Budget Act to align them with the new regime and moves appeals from the Central Appeals Tribunal to the Council of State.
33086.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the central powers by a smaller target group, a need for a leaner central infrastructure, and the closer link to residence law, which makes central Minister-level administration more efficient.
q: The power to impose fines under the Integration Act will be assigned, through delegation of authority by the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations, to a central implementing body.
De bevoegdheid tot het opleggen van boetes op grond van de Wet inburgering zal door middel van mandaatverlening door de Minister van BZK belegd bij een centrale uitvoeringsinstantie.
d: I, B, 1 (art. 1 Wet inburgering, sub f)
designation of persons subject to integration obligation by reference to art. 7(2)(a)
extension of deadline, exam administration, exam content and form, exam fees, identification, examination committee, diploma
conditions for taking courses at course institutions attached to social loans
designation of bodies (instanties) entitled to data and tasks under the integration law
transitional deadlines for exam for existing persons
p: Fining power is moved from municipalities to the Minister, who imposes recurring fines every two years until integration obligations are met, with a higher maximum fine of EUR 1250.
Exemption decisions move to the Minister, who assesses whether it is reasonably impossible for the obligor to comply, with exemption still possible after demonstrated effort.
I, Y, 2-4 and V, 1 (art. 47 Wet inburgering; data provisions)
Data sharing with the Minister, Migration minister and tax authority is expanded for enforcement of integration requirements in naturalisation, residence and childcare allowance decisions.
Municipal roles in intake, provision of courses, enforcement and fining are removed and centralised with the national Minister.
Appeals in integration cases move from the Central Appeals Tribunal to the Council of State's administrative jurisdiction division.

parties: Supports shifting responsibility for integration to the individual and asks about the scope of the bill and enforcement of alternatives.
These members stress that if someone wishes to settle permanently in the Netherlands, they also have their own responsibility to participate in society.
Deze leden benadrukken dat als iemand zich duurzaam in Nederland wil vestigen deze ook een eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft om te participeren in de samenleving.
Objects to making refugees finance their own integration and asks whether the government will revise this part of the bill for humane refugee policy.
The PvdA members have difficulty with the government's position of extending financial self-responsibility to refugees as well.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben moeite met het standpunt van de regering om de financiële eigen verantwoordelijkheid ook voor vluchtelingen te laten gelden.
Asks technical questions on the social loan, exemptions, maximum amount and the phasing out of subsidies for self-study.
Which exemptions are being referred to?

Supports the simplification and the stronger personal responsibility, but asks how society and volunteers can support newcomers and how Turkish nationals and the associated EU-Turkey rules are treated.
Together with the government, these members share the view that strengthening foreigners' own responsibility for integration goes hand in hand with the need to scale back the current system.

Met de regering delen deze leden het standpunt dat de versterking van de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van vreemdelingen voor de inburgering gepaard gaat met de noodzaak tot versobering van het huidige stelsel.
Questions the legal basis, notably the conflict with the Refugee Convention and EU directive, and asks why the government does not await a proper evaluation.
What does the government think of the Council of State's criticism that the bill insufficiently does justice to the government's responsibility for the societal interest served by integration?

Wat vindt de regering van de kritiek van de Raad van State dat het wetsvoorstel onvoldoende recht doet aan de verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid bij de behartiging van het maatschappelijk belang dat met de inburgering is gediend?
Rejects the bill as overshooting its aim, notes lack of evidence-based policy analysis and the Council of State's critique, and asks for a sunset or review clause.
Like the Council of State's advisory division, these members believe that 'usable policy analyses on which conclusions about the design of the integration system can be drawn' are lacking.

Net als de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, menen deze leden dat «bruikbare beleidsanalyses op basis waarvan conclusies kunnen worden getrokken over de inrichting van het inburgeringstelsel en een afweging kan worden gemaakt van mogelijk alternatieven» ontbreken.
Notes the shift of primary responsibility to the migrant and asks about it.
These members note that the bill seeks to shift primary responsibility for integration onto the person required to integrate.
Deze leden constateren dat het wetsvoorstel de primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor de inburgering wil verleggen naar de inburgeringsplichtige.
Supports emphasis on personal responsibility provided people are able to meet the obligation, and asks about support for asylum seekers with short residence.
These members support the emphasis on the integration obligee's own responsibility, provided the person is able to meet the integration obligation.
Deze leden ondersteunen de nadruk op eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de inburgeringsplichtige, mits deze in staat is aan de inburgeringsplicht te voldoen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft amendment to the Wet inburgering (civic integration act) strengthening the individual responsibility of integration obligees, raising major concerns about the proposed loss of residence rights as sanction, the Associatie EG-Turkije standstill clauses, the position of asylum beneficiaries, and the municipal role. The minister's nader rapport accepts several points (raising the social loan cap, clarifying the transition and privacy aspects) but rejects others, such as dropping the residence-loss sanction and compensating municipalities after 2014.
concerns: The Afdeling considers loss of residence as sanction for failing the integration obligation disproportionate and advises dropping it; the government keeps the sanction in principle but limits its application in individual cases where ECHR art. 8 or the family reunification directive applies.
Loss of residence risks conflict with ECHR article 8 and family reunification directive 2003/86/EG, which the government addresses by excluding such cases from the sanction.

The proposed sanctions and higher fines are incompatible with the standstill clauses of Associatiebesluit 1/80 art. 13 and Aanvullend Protocol art. 41 for Turkish nationals; the advice to exclude Turkish nationals from the sanctions was not followed in substance.
Frequent successive amendments of the integration act create uncertainty for those subject to it; the government explains the transition rules and informs stakeholders.
The Afdeling asks for justification of the timing and the choice to limit the integration obligation to newcomers, which the government addresses only partly.
The Afdeling asks that municipalities be compensated for integration trajectories started before 2014; the government refuses, citing the reserve arrangement in the participatiebudget.

The government raises the maximum social loan to 10,000 euro and extends it to alphabetisation courses for asylum beneficiaries; the privacy and register points are addressed by limiting data exchange to DUO and the ministries.

33090-X.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence for fiscal year 2011, adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2011
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2011

33095.s: The bill amends the Archiefwet 1995 and the Wet op het specifiek cultuurbeleid so that provincial executives keep custody of provincial archives after transfer to an archive repository, the Raad voor cultuur no longer advises on draft selection lists, and the algemene rijksarchivaris advises on openness of decentralised state archives. It also replaces the provincial inspector with a provincial archivist appointed and dismissed by gedeputeerde staten, and makes parallel changes to the Archiefwet BES.
33095.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the decentralisation agreement with the provinces (Bestuursakkoord 2008–2011) and the Regeerakkoord 2010, and by alignment with municipal and water board rules and the revitalisation of generic supervision.
q: it is desirable that the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten) take over care of the provincial archive records even after transfer to an archive repository
het wenselijk is dat gedeputeerde staten de zorg krijgen over de provinciale archiefbescheiden ook na overbrenging naar een archiefbewaarplaats
d: provincial archivist oversight rules via provincial ordinance
p: Removes the requirement that the minister hear the Raad voor cultuur before draft selection lists are adopted, reducing advisory input into archive selection.
Artikel I, onderdeel H en I (artikelen 28 and 29 Archiefwet 1995)

Replaces the provincial inspector's statutory supervisory role with a provincial archivist appointed by gedeputeerde staten, who is subject to provincial ordinance on supervision, reducing statutory specification of the supervisory function.
Extends the minister's custodial role over provincial archives and allows discretionary subsidies in special cases, with Awb title 4.2 applying to them.

parties: Asks for clarification of how responsibility for archives is divided between government levels, including archives of former provincial and departmental bodies still under the Rijk.
The members request further explanation of this division of responsibilities and also of the content, scope and function of these archives.
De leden vragen om een nadere toelichting van deze verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden en ook een toelichting betreffende de inhoud, omvang en functie van deze archieven.
Argues that cost considerations are overriding quality and risk assessments in shifting archive tasks and costs to provinces, risking lower archiving quality.
In doing so, substantive interests and risk assessments seem subordinate to cost considerations.
Daarbij lijken inhoudelijke belangen en risicoafwegingen ondergeschikt te zijn aan de kostenoverweging.
Supports the need to modernise the Archiefwet and sees no reason to ask questions.
The members endorse the need to modernise the Archiefwet.
De leden onderschrijven de noodzaak tot modernisering van de Archiefwet.

Raises uniformity of archiving across provinces, concentration of advisory function on openness restrictions with the Algemene Rijksarchivaris and its independence, and whether the Archiefvisie addresses the Raad voor Cultuur's objection.
How is independence guaranteed in this?
Hoe wordt de onafhankelijkheid hierin gewaarborgd?
Objects to the loss of the Raad voor Cultuur's advisory role, the weakening of interbestuurlijk toezicht into voluntary supervision, and the lack of quality safeguards in appraisal and selection.
The members ask that the advisory role of the Raad voor Cultuur be maintained, especially while the new selection method is still in its early phase.
De leden vragen de adviesrol van de Raad voor Cultuur in stand te houden, zeker zolang de nieuwe selectiemethode nog in de beginfase verkeert.

33176.s: The bill amends the Code of Criminal Procedure to extend the right of victims and next-of-kin to make statements at trial, including to minors aged twelve and over and to up to three blood relatives. It also lets the presiding judge decide who speaks, restrict or refuse statements in the interest of a minor victim, and admit minors aged twelve to eighteen as spectators.
33176.j: The memorandum justifies the expansion by evaluation findings that victims and next-of-kin value the statement right and by the need to inform the judge and confront the suspect, with a cap of three relatives for manageability.
q: I assume that the statement right of blood relatives will in principle be limited to three next-of-kin, and that they reach mutual agreement on who will speak at the hearing.
Ik ga ervan uit dat het spreekrecht van bloedverwanten in beginsel tot drie nabestaanden wordt beperkt en dat zij onderling overeenstemming bereiken over wie het woord ter terechtzitting zal voeren.
p: Expands statement rights of victims and next-of-kin, a protection for citizens against the state's criminal process, with judge-controlled limits in the minor's interest.
Gives the presiding judge the power to recognise statement-holders and choose among next-of-kin, a case-management power vested in the judiciary itself.

parties: Wants a fuller, consistent victim speaking right including on sentencing, and asks how this affects order and courtroom capacity and whether the prosecution must trace eligible relatives.
The proposal of these members is to give victims a full speaking right.
Het voorstel van deze leden is om slachtoffers een volwaardig spreekrecht te geven.

Asks the government to answer the NOvA's substantive objections about shifting the balance toward victims and delays, and how speaking rights interact with the presumption of innocence before guilt is established.
The answer the government gives in the explanatory memorandum is not based on substantive arguments but only on a felt social conviction.
Het antwoord dat de regering in de toelichting geeft, is niet gebaseerd op inhoudelijk argumenten maar slechts op maatschappelijke gevoelde overtuiging.
Asks about priority rules when more than three relatives want to speak, the age limits for parental speaking rights, and whether parents who are themselves suspects should be excluded.
These members ask whether a particular priority rule applies that the judge must follow.
Deze leden vragen of hiervoor een bepaalde voorrangsregeling geldt welke de rechter dient aan te houden.

Supports wider victim speaking, but wants the bill to be monitored in practice, suggests two-phase trials so guilt is established before victim statements, and asks for more room than the current limit to the consequences of the offence.
These members therefore ask the government to reconsider whether it would not be advisable to handle serious criminal cases in two phases.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering daarom opnieuw te bezien of het niet raadzaam zou zijn zware strafzaken in twee fasen te behandelen.
Welcomes the extension, notes the earlier unimplemented motion, and asks about the status of splitting the trial into two phases and of victim-offender mediation.
An extension of the speaking right is more justified once it is established that the person who must listen to the (sometimes emotional) victim statements is actually the perpetrator.
Een uitbreiding van het spreekrecht is eerder gelegitimeerd als vast staat dat degene die naar de (soms emotionele) slachtofferverklaringen moet luisteren ook daadwerkelijk de dader is.
Supports strengthening victims but wants the circle of eligible speakers not too wide, workload and court capacity protected, and asks how the judge may deviate from the three-relative limit.
Nevertheless they also consider it important that the circle does not become too wide and that the direct involvement of those entitled to speak in the harm suffered does not dilute.
Niettemin vinden zij het tevens van belang dat de kring niet te ruim wordt en de directe betrokkenheid van de spreekgerechtigden bij het berokkende leed verwatert.

Endorses the aim but wants fuller justification for extending to fourth-degree relatives and the three-person limit, clarity on who chooses speakers, and rights protection where a victim cannot decide who speaks.

Although these members endorse this aim, they believe a fuller justification is desirable for the choice to extend the circle of relatives to all lineal relatives and to fourth degree collateral relatives.

Hoewel deze leden dit doel onderschrijven, menen zij dat een uitgebreidere onderbouwing gewenst is ten aanzien van de keuze om de kring van nabestaanden uit te breiden tot alle nabestaanden in de rechte lijn en tot in de vierde graad in de zijlijn.

Asks for the rationale of the fourth-degree relatives criterion, how the choice of up to three speakers is made, and why parental speaking against the minor's interest is discretionary rather than prohibited.
Why was an obligation not chosen to refrain from the speaking right in such a case?
Waarom is hier niet voor een verplichting gekozen om in een dergelijk geval van het spreekrecht af te zien?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill extending victims' and relatives' speaking rights in criminal proceedings but asks for adjustments to the parents' own speaking right, namely clearer definition of parents, limiting it in line with the explanatory memorandum, and allowing the chair to restrict it where contrary to the minor's interest. The government's reply accepts the advice on defining parents and on the chair's power to restrict, and accepts the drafting remarks, though it extends the parents' right to all offences listed in article 51(1) Sv rather than only serious violent and sexual offences.
concerns: Parents' own speaking right must cover parents with a close personal relationship and caregivers in the family, not only legal or biological parents.
The bill text limits the parents' speaking right to serious violent and sexual offences while the explanatory memorandum says so, a mismatch to be resolved or motivated.
The chair should be able to restrict the parents' own speaking right where it conflicts with the minor's interest, as in article 51a(6).
Several redactional remarks on wording, including singular and plural forms, the number of persons allowed to speak, and terminology for representatives.

33185.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code and the Caribbean Netherlands Criminal Code to criminalise conduct endangering air traffic, raises maximum penalties for illegal employment and human trafficking-related offences, and expands bribery and extraterritorial provisions. It also widens the confidentiality duty in the Aviation Act to persons holding security-sensitive positions in civil aviation.
33185.j: The memorandum justifies raising the penalty maximum by citing investigators' reported difficulty in using existing investigative powers against illegal employment, and the need to meet positive obligations under Article 4 ECHR against trafficking.
q: The proposed increase of the maximum penalty from three to four years widens the possibilities for applying criminal procedure measures.
De voorgestelde verhoging van het strafmaximum van drie naar vier jaar maakt dat de mogelijkheden tot toepassing van strafvorderlijke maatregelen worden verruimd.
p: Artikel I C and Artikel III

Extends investigative powers available to prosecutors by raising the maximum penalty for illegal employment, enabling wiretapping and data seizure, though this is framed as a targeted tool for a specific offence.

parties: Welcomes higher penalties for human trafficking and asks the government to respond to NRM findings on low conviction rates and limited trafficking case experience at some courts.
Asks whether enforcement capacity is sufficient to use the broadened investigative powers for illegal employment and whether extra police capacity will be deployed.
These members ask whether there is sufficient investigative capacity to effectively use these broader legal possibilities.
Deze leden vragen of er voldoende opsporingscapaciteit is om effectief van deze ruimere wettelijke mogelijkheden gebruik te kunnen maken.
Questions whether enforcement capacity is adequate for the broader investigative powers and whether the penalty levels are high enough, and asks about the added value of the new provisions.
Is there also sufficient capacity to check this, supervise companies and deploy these broader investigative powers?
Is hier ook voldoende capaciteit voor om dit te controleren, toezicht te houden op bedrijven en deze ruimere opsporingsbevoegdheden in te zetten?

Asks whether raising the penalty for illegal employment is motivated by the ends of prosecutorial powers rather than by the seriousness of the offence, which would conflict with the principle that punishment tracks gravity.
They ask whether raising the length of the prison sentence does not serve predominantly a prosecutorial interest rather than the principle that punishment should match the seriousness of the offence.
Zij vragen of met de verhoging van de duur van de gevangenisstraf niet een overwegend strafvorderlijk belang wordt nagestreefd dan het beginsel dat ten grondslag ligt aan het straffen
Agrees with the higher maximum penalties for trafficking but asks how the eighteen-year maximum relates to the fifteen-year cap in article 10 Sr.
They do ask whether the eighteen-year maximum penalty and article 10 of the Criminal Code can be addressed.
Wel vragen zij of kan worden ingegaan op het strafmaximum van achttien jaar en artikel 10 Sr
Supports the higher penalties for trafficking and illegal employment, arguing the seriousness of trafficking is not yet adequately reflected in current maxima.
They regard human trafficking as an extremely serious offence that gravely violates human dignity and integrity.
Zij zien mensenhandel als een uitermate zwaar misdrijf dat een zeer ernstige inbreuk maakt op de menselijke waardigheid en integriteit

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill mixing criminal law changes (aviation laser endangerment, higher maxima for human trafficking, and ISD measures for illegal aliens) fails the omnibus criteria and that the ISD changes for illegal aliens be split off and that they conflict with the Return Directive; the government split off the ISD part, adjusted the laser provisions and added reasoning for the higher trafficking maxima. The government reply is included.
concerns: The bill is an omnibus that does not meet the criteria for omnibus legislation, so the ISD changes for illegal aliens should be split off into a separate bill, which the government did.
The fixed two-year ISD measure for illegal aliens conflicts with Return Directive Article 15 safeguards on detention, which the government reply does not address on the substance.
The ISD measure for illegal aliens may serve an improper purpose of facilitating deportation, to be reconsidered or subjected to the Return Directive safeguards.
The aviation endangerment provisions do not clearly cover lasers aimed at control towers, so the articles should be amended, which the government did.
The explanatory memorandum insufficiently justifies why existing maxima for human trafficking are inadequate, so the reasons should be stated, which the government addressed by adding reasoning.

33240-III.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statutes for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Office of the Queen, the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services, and the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency, changing appropriations in thousands of euros. It is a budgetary supplement with no new delegations or shifts of power to the executive.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2011 to the budget statutes of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Office of the Queen, the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2011 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet der Koningin, de Commissie van toezicht betreffende de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en de baten-lastendienst Dienst Publiek en Communicatie.

33284.s: The bill abolishes the 62-plus premium discount for employers (the werkbonus) and aligns the premium discounts for older and disabled employees in the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen, setting both at 7,000 euro per year with pro-rata reduction for part-time work. It adds a ministerial power to set rules on records employers must keep to prove eligibility.
33284.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power by saying the Belastingdienst must be able to verify eligibility where the UWV data are not available, mirroring an existing provision for the older-worker discount.
q: Ministerial regulations may set rules for the records the employer keeps in payroll administration showing that the employee, referred to in the first paragraph, meets the first paragraph before employment begins.

Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen regels worden gesteld voor de gegevens, die de werkgever bij de loonadministratie bewaart waaruit blijkt dat de werknemer, bedoeld in het eerste lid, voorafgaande aan de datum van aanvang van de dienstbetrekking voldoet aan het eerste lid.
d: records employers must keep proving employee eligibility for disabled-worker discount

parties: Asks whether the government will evaluate and monitor the measures, how a premium discount could be abused by repeated one-year contracts, and whether institutional barriers were considered.
Can the government explain to the VVD members whether there is a problem of employers not being able to cash in the discount among certain (smaller) employers?
Kan de regering aan de leden van de VVD-fractie toelichten of sprake is van verzilveringsproblematiek bij bepaalde (kleinere) werkgevers?

Worries that dropping the werkbonus together with the AOW change severely affects low and middle incomes and heavy-labour workers, and questions the adequacy of the budget and the basis for its conclusion.
The PvdA members are of the view that scrapping the werkbonus together with the bill amending the General Old Age Pensions Act (AOW) has far-reaching consequences for low and middle incomes.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn van mening dat het schrappen van de werkbonus in samenhang met het ingediende wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Algemene ouderdomswet (AOW) ( 33 290 ), vergaande gevolgen heeft voor de lage en middeninkomens.

Asks whether the measures will increase older benefit recipients and whether budget overruns would be addressed, and presses for measures aimed at removing institutional barriers as the Council of State advised.
The PVV members ask whether these measures will instead lead to a considerable increase in the number of older benefit recipients, making this bill more a stopgap than a solution.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen daarbij of deze maatregelen er niet eerder toe leiden dat het aantal oudere uitkeringsgerechtigden flink zal toenemen en het onderhavige wetsvoorstel veeleer een doekje voor het bloeden hiervoor zal zijn.

Supports shifting policy toward hiring older and disabled workers and the higher premium discount, stressing that financial incentives alone do not suffice and a change in employer mentality is needed.
In this context they support the proposal to raise the premium discount for employers hiring older and disabled workers.
Zij steunen in dit verband het voorstel om de premiekorting voor werkgevers bij het aannemen van oudere en arbeidsgehandicapte werknemers te verhogen.
Asks for data on long-term unemployment among older age groups and for an overview of the total package of measures and its budgetary cost.
The D66 members ask the government for an overview of the intended overall package of measures to promote the labour market for older workers.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering om een overzicht van het beoogde totaalpakket aan maatregeling ter bevordering van de arbeidsmarkt voor ouderen.
Asks whether the government will evaluate the effects, how the Chamber will be informed, the basis for expected beneficiary numbers, and what the government will do if the budget is exceeded.
The ChristenUnie members want to know whether the government will evaluate the effects of the proposed measures.
De leden van de VVD- en ChristenUnie-fracties willen weten of de regering de effecten van de voorgestelde maatregelen gaat evalueren.
Questions why a premium discount rather than a true bonus is used, given that its widened basis increases inequality between firms, and whether an extra bonus for permanent hires was considered.
These members ask why, in that light, the government chooses the premium discount system rather than an actual bonus.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering in dat licht kiest voor het systeem van de premiekorting in plaats van een daadwerkelijke bonus.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised, on a bill amending the Wfsv premium discounts for older workers, that the government should further analyse the causes of low mobility of older workers and prefer removing institutional barriers over generic premium discounts, and questioned the effectiveness of the proposed discounts. The government's reply accepts the conclusion, drops the proposed mobility bonus, targets remaining funds at those furthest from the labour market, and adjusts the bill and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Council doubts the effectiveness of the premium discount for hiring older unemployed people because it addresses symptoms, such as high wage costs, rather than causes, and recommends targeting the root causes.

The Council questions the generic design and effectiveness of the mobility bonus for workers over 55 and recommends dropping it or targeting it at specific bottlenecks; the government drops the mobility bonus.
The Council asks the government to explain the calibration of the proposed reduction of the premium discount for older workers and whether further reduction is warranted.
The Council suggests editorial changes to headings and the closing form to reflect that articles 47 and 48 Wfsv cover more than a mobility bonus.

33293.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to allow the Minister to grant asylum residence permits for a fixed term ex officio and to simplify admission for family members following a holder of an asylum permit, and makes consequential changes to the Huisvestingswet and transitional rules. It also allows the Minister to set leges for replacement residence documents by ministerial regulation.
33293.j: The memorandum justifies the ex officio power as a simplification of the admission procedure for family members of asylum permit holders.
q: The power to grant the asylum residence permit for a fixed term ex officio will be used to simplify the admission procedure for family members following a holder of an asylum residence permit for a fixed term.

De bevoegdheid om ambtshalve de verblijfsvergunning asiel voor bepaalde tijd te verlenen zal worden aangewend om een vereenvoudiging aan te brengen in de toelatingsprocedure voor nareizende gezinsleden
d: I-D (art. 37, lid 3 Vw), amount of fee
amount of fee for replacement documents
p: Gives the Minister power to grant asylum residence permits ex officio, reducing reliance on individual applications.

parties: Asks whether psychological problems fall under the medical exception in Article 64 and how fraud and misuse of permits will be tackled, reflecting concern about checks on abuse.
The VVD members note that Article 64 of the Aliens Act 2000 allows deportation to be set aside, including in a medical emergency.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat artikel 64, Vw 2000, de mogelijkheid biedt uitzetting achterwege te laten, waarbij onder andere sprake is van een medische noodsituatie.
Supports harmonisation with EU standards but insists no tightening occurs and asks for a justification, citing the critique of the Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken.
They believe the reordering should not amount to tightening and that existing Dutch admission grounds should be placed in the new asylum or regular grounds as far as possible.

Zij zijn wel van mening dat de herschikking geen aanscherping zou moeten inhouden en dat de bestaande Nederlandse toelatingsgronden zoveel mogelijk in de nieuwe asielgronden of reguliere toelatingsgronden moeten worden ondergebracht.
Accepts the reordering but asks that individual assessment of asylum and residence applications remain the rule, seeking reassurance on safeguards.
These members assume that after the reordering of asylum grounds, the principle of careful individual assessment of residence applications will remain in force.

Zij gaan ervan uit dat ook in de nieuwe situatie, na de herschikking van de asielgronden, het uitgangspunt van zorgvuldige individuele toetsing van verblijfsaanvragen recht overeind zal blijven staan.
Supports abolishing the asylum grounds but is alarmed by European influence on national admission policy and insists the Netherlands must keep the final word.
These members would like the government's response to the view that this is an extremely undesirable development and that the Netherlands must always have the final say on admitting foreigners.

Graag vernemen deze leden de reactie van de regering op het standpunt dat het hier een buitengewoon onwenselijke ontwikkeling betreft en dat Nederland te allen tijde zelf het laatste woord dient te hebben inzake toelating van vreemdelingen tot ons land.
Raises many questions about protection for refugees who may lose protection, the discretionary power, the absence of complaint routes for lawyers and IND staff, and the unclear monitoring.
How will the government prevent refugees from wrongly losing protection they would receive under current policy because of the narrowing of asylum grounds?
Hoe gaat de regering voorkomen dat vluchtelingen door het beperken van de asielgronden onterecht bescherming mislopen die ze onder het huidige beleid wel moeten krijgen?
Concerned about the abolition of national grounds and the individualisation requirement for members of specific groups, and echoes Raad van State criticism of the moratoria alternative.
These members ask the government to clarify the degree of individualisation required of members of specific groups under the new policy to qualify for necessary protection.

Zij verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten welke mate van individualisering voor leden van specifieke groepen onder het nieuwe beleid vereist wordt om in aanmerking te komen voor de noodzakelijke bescherming.
Supports aligning with international grounds and asks mainly explanatory questions about relatively high grant rates and family policy.
They support the aim of aligning Dutch asylum policy as closely as possible with international protection grounds and keeping exceptions to a minimum.
Zij steunen de inzet om in het Nederlandse asielbeleid zoveel mogelijk aan te sluiten bij internationale beschermingsgronden en zo min mogelijk uitzonderingen daarop te laten voortbestaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill to restructure asylum grounds (abolishing the humanitarian c-ground and categorical protection policy, and making derivative asylum for family reunification automatic) but raises objections on the trauma policy, specific groups, categorical protection, and family reunification conditions, advising adjustments. The government's nader rapport accepts or clarifies most points, keeping the trauma policy abolition with a limited tightening, retaining the nationality requirement for family reunification and the categorical protection abolition, while adding clarifications to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that abolishing the trauma policy lacks adequate justification and that article 64 Vw 2000 does not cover the same situation; the government clarifies the memorandum but does not treat article 64 as a substitute ground, accepting a limited tightening.

The Afdeling notes that for specific groups (Iranian LGBT, Afghan women) individual grounds may be insufficient and that generalised violence situations need clarification; the government clarifies that the individualisation requirement will not apply where general violence reaches the EHRM threshold.

The Afdeling highlights a deterioration in legal position for westernised Afghan schoolgirls moved to regular policy, including residence revocation and family conditions; the government adds that they will not face greater revocation risk than under asylum status.

The Afdeling is not convinced that decision and departure moratoria can replace categorical protection, as they are time-limited and grant only temporary lawful stay; the government rejects the need for a safety net and does not adopt criteria for when moratoria apply, instead clarifying the memorandum.

The Afdeling questions whether testing regular aspects within asylum procedures will speed things up and asks for the claimed benefits to be explained; the government defers detail to a forthcoming amendment of the Vreemdelingenbesluit.

The Afdeling advises removing the nationality requirement for family reunification of refugees and subsidiary protection holders, arguing the directives do not contain it; the government retains it, citing article 23(2) of the qualification directive and Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak case law.

The Afdeling asks the memorandum to clarify the conditions for ambtshalve derivative asylum after a granted mvv application; the government adds that the same conditions as now apply to family members of asylum holders.
The Afdeling asks whether the asylum holder acting as referent can face administrative fines; the government excludes this category from the boetebeleid.
The Afdeling asks the memorandum to explain the option of an independent asylum application and whether an asylum annotation applies to ambtshalve grants; the government adds both points.

33329.s: The bill amends the Neighbouring Rights Act to implement EU Directive 2011/77/EU by extending the protection term for performers' rights in sound recordings from 50 to 70 years. It adds a contract-termination right for performers after 50 years of non-exploitation, a supplementary annual remuneration of 20 percent for performers, and a penalty provision for producers who fail to report revenue to the designated collecting body.
33329.j: The memorandum justifies the measures by the income gap faced by performers late in life and the need to implement the directive, not by new executive powers.
q: Payment of the supplementary remuneration is made to a legal person to be designated by the Minister of Security and Justice, in agreement with the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, which alone is charged with collection and distribution.

De betaling van de in artikel 9b, eerste lid bedoelde vergoeding geschiedt aan een door Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen aan te wijzen rechtspersoon.
d: designation of collecting legal person for supplementary remuneration

parties: Asks why 20% was chosen without justification, questions the terminology (fonogram vs. opname) and the feasibility of tracing session musicians 50 years after buy-out, raising administrative burden concerns.
However, no justification is given for why exactly 20% was chosen rather than another percentage.
Er wordt echter geen verantwoording gegeven waarom is gekozen voor precies 20% en niet een ander percentage.
Asks clarifying questions on the scope of the 70-year term, eligibility for the fund, terminology differences with the Rome Convention, and how platforms can identify rightful session musicians.
How can a record company know who is entitled?
Hoe kan een platenmaatschappij weten wie gerechtigde is?

Opposes EU-level copyright regulation as a transfer of Dutch sovereignty, asks the government to explain objections to the directive, and questions the scope of the term distinction and the fund's beneficiaries.
Furthermore, this directive brings the Netherlands another step closer to transferring Dutch sovereignty to the European Union.
Daarnaast brengt deze richtlijn Nederland weer een stap dichterbij de overdracht van de Nederlandse soevereiniteit naar de Europese Unie.
Supports the term extension and the session musician fund and the reversion of rights to performers, asking only why the extension is limited to audio phonograms and not films or other works.
These members ask why the extension of the protection term only concerns related rights in music works fixed on a phonogram.
Deze leden vragen waarom de verlenging van de beschermingstermijn zich alleen op de naburige rechten op muziekwerken die zijn vastgelegd op een fonogram richt.

Asks whether the term distinction is correctly understood, whether SENA may assume the fund covers only commercially released phonograms, and whether record companies must retain session musician data for 50 years, raising burden concerns.
If record companies must in future keep records for 50 years of which session musicians took part in each phonogram, does this not lead to an undesirable increase in burden?

Als platenmaatschappijen in het vervolg voor de periode van 50 jaar van ieder fonogram moeten bijhouden welke sessiemuzikanten daaraan hebben meegewerkt, leidt dit dan niet tot een onwenselijke lastenverzwaring?

Acknowledges little policy room, focuses on the negotiating process and the Dutch position, and asks how the terms opname, vastlegging and fonogram, and remastering, are interpreted, which affects fund payments.
The interpretation of the terms opname, vastlegging and fonogram is not entirely clear at this moment.
Niet geheel helder op dit moment is de interpretatie van de begrippen opname, vastlegging en fonogram.
Asks on what basis the 20% remuneration in article 9b is founded.
The ChristenUnie members ask what the 20% remuneration percentage in article 9b is based on.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen waar het percentage van 20% vergoeding in artikel 9b op gebaseerd is.

33347.s: The bill removes the status of budget fund from the BTW-compensation fund and folds it into the departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance, with the fund now recorded as an article in that budget. It also strips several subsections from the fund law, leaving the Minister of Finance able to set further rules on how contributions and advances are paid out.
33347.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the merger of the budgets, with the Algemene Rekenkamer agreeing to the integration on condition that audit tolerances are not changed.
q: The lapse of the second subsection of article 2 of the BTW-compensation fund law means that the designation of the fund as a budget fund under article 9 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 lapses.

Het vervallen van het tweede lid van artikel 2 van de Wet op het BTW-compensatiefonds betekent, dat de aanduiding van het fonds als een begrotingsfonds als bedoeld in artikel 9 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001, vervalt.
d: rules on payment of fund contributions and advances
p: Artikel I, onderdelen 2 en 4 (vervallen leden artikel 2)

Removing the fund's status as a separate budget fund takes it out of the separate budget treatment under the Comptabiliteitswet, reducing parliament's separate view of the fund, though the memorandum says the underlying fund structure continues and the Algemene Rekenkamer's tolerance condition is retained.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill to remove the BTW-compensatiefonds' status as a budget fund, but advises that the fund-specific management and reporting rules in article 2 be deleted and that the law no longer refer to a fund. The State Secretary's reply declines that advice, stating that a earmarked budget remains materially a fund and will keep the name for continuity of policy.
