concerns: The Afdeling advises amending article 2 and the law's title and articles so that no reference to a fund remains, since the fund's separate management rules are no longer needed; the government rejects this and keeps the fund name.

The Afdeling considers that the separate management, budgeting and reporting rules for the fund are unnecessary once it becomes part of the ministry's budget, and the government followed this by deleting those provisions.

33419.s: The bill amends the Dutch Notaries Act so that nationals of other EU, EEA or Swiss states can be appointed as civil-law notaries, replacing the Dutch-nationality requirement. It also adds a requirement of sufficient command of the Dutch language and repeals a 2012 act and a transitional article.
33419.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the 2011 Court of Justice ruling on freedom of establishment and by the aim of reciprocity within the EU, EEA and Switzerland, and it states that the language requirement is objective, necessary and proportionate.
q: A person is eligible for appointment as a notary only if he holds Dutch nationality or the nationality of another EU member state, another EEA state or Switzerland.

Tot notaris is slechts benoembaar hij die de Nederlandse nationaliteit bezit of de nationaliteit van een andere lidstaat van de Europese Unie, van een overige staat die partij is bij de Overeenkomst betreffende de Europese Economische Ruimte of van de Zwitserse Bondsstaat.

parties: Questions the precise language requirement and whether it constitutes an obstacle to free movement, and asks whether the government's limitation of notary appointments via Royal Decree violates EU law.
What exactly is the required language level and how is it verified whether the person in question sufficiently masters it?
Wat is precies het vereiste taalniveau en hoe wordt getoetst of de persoon in kwestie dat niveau voldoende beheerst?
Asks what requirements foreign notaries must meet to establish in the Netherlands and whether these provide sufficient guarantees of quality, entrepreneurship and integrity.
Do these requirements provide sufficient guarantees of quality, entrepreneurship and integrity?
Bieden deze eisen voldoende waarborgen voor kwaliteit, ondernemerschap en integriteit?
Asks how a candidate's command of Dutch is assessed and which Member States have a Latin notariat or the same nationality requirement.
Must the three-year training (and internship) that a candidate notary must complete be followed in the Netherlands?
Dient de driejarige opleiding (en stage) die een kandidaat-notaris moet doorlopen in Nederland te zijn gevolgd?

33428.s: The bill repeals the NOx emission rights trading system from the Environmental Management Act and the Economic Offences Act, effective 1 January 2014. Transitional provisions keep certain reporting, inspection and register-keeping obligations in force until 2025, and the bill withdraws the 2005 law that created the system.
33428.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the NOx trading system not functioning as intended and by a Council of State ruling that trading does not justify looser emission limits, and it states that the state aid approval lapses with the system.
q: With the lapse of the system and the related obligations, the NEa is no longer responsible for enforcing NOx emissions under title 16.3 of the Environmental Management Act.
Met het vervallen van het systeem en de bijbehorende verplichtingen, is de NEa niet langer verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de NO x -emissies op grond van titel 16.3 Wm.
d: transitional rules for NOx emissions and rights accrued before 2014
p: Artikel I H, I, J, K

Removes the NEa's enforcement powers to impose penalty payments, administrative fines and licence withdrawal for breaches of the NOx trading rules, while keeping transitional enforcement for emissions before 2014.

parties: Supports abolishing an ineffective system and welcomes the reduced burden on companies, but asks for clarity on the transition period and the level playing field in Europe.
It is still not entirely clear to the VVD members what the transition period looks like.
Het is voor de leden van de VVD-fractie nog steeds niet helemaal helder hoe de overgangsperiode er nu uitziet.
Asks whether the premise that the system does not work because Dutch and EU standards are already strict is correct, and whether the change affects air quality targets.
The PvdA members ask the government whether it can be ruled out that adjusting the NOx emissions trading system affects air quality and the attainment of targets.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering of kan worden uitgesloten dat de aanpassing aan het NOx-emissiehandelssysteem gevolgen heeft voor de luchtkwaliteit en het halen van de doelstellingen.
Accepts stopping an ineffective system but insists that environmental protection, guarantees, and oversight be carefully weighed, and asks why the system was chosen and then abandoned.
However, the named members find that this must in any case not come at the expense of environment and nature, and that the guarantees, agreements and supervision must therefore be carefully weighed.
De genoemde leden vinden echter dat dit in ieder geval niet ten koste mag gaan van milieu en natuur en dat de waarborgen, de afspraken en het toezicht daarom zorgvuldig moeten worden afgewogen.

33455.s: This housekeeping bill (Veegwet aanpassing bestuursprocesrecht) corrects technical errors in the General Administrative Law Act and several sector statutes following the Wab reform, including indexation of amounts, appeal routes for Vreemdelingenwet decisions, and transitional annex references. It also excludes incidental appeal in detention cases under the Vreemdelingenwet 2000.
33455.j: The memorandum justifies the indexation delegation as a technical means to keep statutory amounts aligned with the consumer price index, with rounding amounts excluded from indexation.
q: The amount of the compensation referred to in Article 4:113(1) [...] is adjusted annually as of 1 January by ministerial regulation of the Minister of Security and Justice to the consumer price index.

Het bedrag van de vergoeding, bedoeld in artikel 4:113, eerste lid, [...] worden jaarlijks met ingang van 1 januari bij regeling van Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie aangepast aan de ontwikkeling van de consumentenprijsindex.
d: annual indexation of statutory amounts to consumer price index
Artikel I B (Artikel 11:2 Awb, second paragraph)
discretionary adjustment of other statutory amounts
annual indexation of higher education appeal filing fee

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the Veegwet aanpassing bestuursprocesrecht but raises remarks on entry bans (separate inreisverboden) lacking clear statutory language allowing direct appeal, and on mismatched griffiegelden tariffs in asylum-related toeslag cases. The government reply adopts the first remark by amending the text and explanatory memorandum, declines the tariff alignment as unsuitable for this technical bill, and adds technical corrections.
concerns: The bill's wording on entry bans does not make clear that direct appeal is open against separate entry bans, so the text should be adjusted.
Griffiegelden tariffs for toeslag cases are not aligned between the Wab annex (huurtoeslag) and care and childcare allowance cases, which the Afdeling suggests addressing.

33482.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Alphen aan den Rijn, Boskoop and Rijnwoude into a new municipality named Alphen aan den Rijn, effective the day after publication in the Staatsblad. It also sets transitional rules for a by-election, the handling of municipal taxes, joint arrangements and utilities, and removes Boskoop and Rijnwoude from the judicial district and safety region annexes.
33482.j: The memorandum justifies immediate entry into force by the wish of the municipalities to merge per 1 January 2014, which would otherwise cause disproportionate disadvantages.
q: This deviation is permissible, since postponement – given the municipalities' wish to merge per 1 January 2014 – would lead to disproportionate disadvantages for the municipalities.
Deze afwijking is geoorloofd, nu uitstel – gelet op de wens van de gemeenten tot herindeling per 1 januari 2014 – zou leiden tot buitensporige nadelen voor de gemeenten.

parties: Has no further questions and considers the bill ready for plenary debate.
It gives them no reason for further questions.
Het geeft hen geen aanleiding tot verdere vragen.
Welcomes the stronger municipality but asks about village participation, the effects on regional partnerships, provincial control of financial commitments, and the name and election date.
These members are positive about municipalities' own choices that increase their administrative capacity.
Deze leden staan positief ten opzichte van keuzes van gemeenten, waardoor zij hun bestuurskracht vergroten.
Finds the necessity of the merger insufficiently justified and argues that no referendum or representative survey of public support was held.
They do not consider the usefulness and necessity of the merger sufficiently substantiated.
Zij vinden nut en noodzaak van de samenvoeging niet voldoende onderbouwd.
Asks whether the bottom-up principle and public support were genuinely met without representative research, and why the Benthuizen referendum result is not reflected in the bill.
How does the government know what lives among residents without representative research?
Hoe weet de regering wat er leeft onder de inwoners zonder representatief onderzoek?
Asks which criteria the government uses for representative research and for adequately involving residents, businesses and institutions.
Which criteria does the government use for a "representative survey" and for "adequately involving residents, businesses and institutions", the CDA members ask.

Welke criteria hanteert de regering voor een «representatief onderzoek» respectievelijk het «goed betrekken van inwoners, bedrijven en maatschappelijke instellingen», zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Questions whether the merger was truly voluntary and free of pressure, whether the scale will raise costs and distance citizens from government, and whether the larger scale is justified.
To what extent is there a reorganization that was actually achieved without any pressure?
In hoeverre is er sprake van een herindeling die daadwerkelijk zonder enige druk tot stand is gekomen?

33509.s: The bill amends the Wet cliëntenrechten zorg and the Wet gebruik burgerservicenummer in de zorg to give patients rights over electronic health record sharing, including opt-in consent, exclusion of providers, access and copies, and bans insurers from accessing electronic exchange systems. It also amends the Zorgverzekeringswet, the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg (adding enforcement and fines by the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit) and several health laws, with details to be set by a general administrative order.
33509.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order as allowing technical standards to be updated faster than legislation, since technology changes.
q: This was chosen because the state of technology is subject to change and lower regulations allow faster response to new technical developments.
Hier is voor gekozen omdat de stand van de techniek aan verandering onderhevig is en door middel van lagere regelgeving sneller ingespeeld kan worden op nieuwe technische ontwikkelingen.
d: technical, functional and organisational requirements for electronic data exchange (under Wbp art. 26)
rules on manner and content of publication and notification of fines
p: Gives the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit power to impose administrative fines on insurers and publish decisions, strengthening oversight of insurers' data access.

parties: Asks whether the government will use a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure for the delegated general administrative measure setting electronic exchange requirements.

A general administrative order (amvb) under article 26 of the Personal Data Protection Act will specify requirements for electronic data exchange. Does the government intend to use a pre-consultation procedure for this amvb?

Een algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) op basis van artikel 26 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) zal uitwerking geven aan specifieke eisen op het punt van de elektronische gegevensuitwisseling. Is de regering voornemens bij deze amvb een voorhangprocedure te volgen?
Stresses patient control over data and asks for the delegated amvb to be sent to parliament, arguing a proper assessment is impossible without it, and supports a voorhang procedure.
These members also attach great importance to a pre-consultation procedure for this amvb. Can the government also send the amvb to the Chamber with its answers?
Deze leden hechten ook groot belang aan een voorhangprocedure voor deze amvb. Kan de regering bij de beantwoording van dit verslag de Kamer ook de amvb doen toekomen?
Argues the bill does not give patients real control over medical data and undermines medical confidentiality; proposes an authorisation card allowing patients to grant or refuse access.
Nor does it give the patient control over their own medical data, and medical professional confidentiality is undermined without well-founded arguments.
Evenmin geeft het de patiënt de zeggenschap over de eigen medische gegevens en wordt het medisch beroepsgeheim zonder goed onderbouwde argumenten aangetast.

Says the bill's reliance on the delegated amvb prevents proper assessment, demands the amvb be sent with a stronger voorhang procedure, and questions whether the bill prepares a mandatory national hub (LSP).
Is the government willing to remove this distrust by ensuring the amvb is subject to a strengthened pre-consultation procedure, making it part of democratic control by both Chambers?

Is de regering bereid om dit wantrouwen weg te nemen door er voor te zorgen dat de amvb wordt voorzien van een verzwaarde voorhangprocedure, en dit onderdeel te maken van de democratische controle van zowel de Tweede als Eerste Kamer?
Finds the consequences hard to assess without the underlying amvb and asks for a draft to be sent and why no voorhang procedure is used; also raises Council of State advice on consent and oversight.
They request the government send a draft amvb with the memorandum in reply to this report, so it can be part of the legislative history and give more insight into the bill's practical consequences.

Zij verzoeken de regering om een concept-amvb met de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag naar de Kamer toe te sturen, zodat deze amvb ook bij de wetsgeschiedenis betrokken kan worden en meer inzicht in de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel voor de praktijk geeft.
Asks for an outline of the amvb, whether hack-testing will be required, when the amvb will be sent, and whether it will go through a voorhang procedure.
Will the amvb be submitted to the Chamber through a pre-consultation procedure?
Wordt de amvb door middel van een voorhangprocedure aan de Kamer voorgelegd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill on client rights in electronic health data exchange but raises concerns on care quality responsibility, scope and data protection, advising adaptation. The government's nader rapport responds point by point, largely accepting the advice on scope, consent, and security while rejecting one sanction point on Solvency II grounds.
concerns: The Afdeling questions how the minister will fulfil ultimate responsibility for data-exchange quality when private parties fall short, and asks for clarification of intervention options.
The Afdeling asks for clarity on the scope of the consent requirement across institutions and the moment consent is needed for data-exchange systems.
The Afdeling advises the explanatory memorandum to explain why explicit opt-in consent is required and to extend the consent provision to article 24(1) Wcz.

The Afdeling finds the motion's point 3, allowing all policyholders to cancel after a second breach, disproportionate and in tension with EU insurance directives; the government did not adopt it but strengthened other sanctions.
The Afdeling asks for an outline of the forthcoming general administrative order under article 26 Wbp and for answers to practitioners' questions on system functioning.
The Afdeling offers redactional comments on the bill text, which the government incorporated.

33527.s: The bill establishes a basic registry of large-scale topography (BGT), a nationwide digital map at scales 1:500 to 1:5,000, maintained by the Kadaster and fed by designated source holders who must supply and update authentic geographic data. It also sets duties for public bodies to use the registry, a reporting duty for doubtful data, entry rights for surveyors onto private land, and ministerial supervision with a power of substitution over source holders.
33527.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations on grounds of the detailed, technical nature of the rules and the wish for flexibility to adapt them to experience.
q: Because of the detailed character and for the sake of the desired flexibility in technical rules, the exact nature and form of the data to be recorded and the technical standards to be used are elaborated in a catalogue to be established by ministerial regulation.

Vanwege het gedetailleerde karakter en omwille van de gewenste flexibiliteit in technische voorschriften, worden de exacte aard en vorm van de te registreren gegevens en de daarbij te gebruiken technische standaarden uitgewerkt in een catalogus die bij ministeriële regeling zal worden vastgesteld.
d: catalogue defining the information model and data quality rules
adding other authentic data to the registry
rules and tariffs for inspection and disclosure of data
elements and manner of the periodic control
elements and manner of source holders' self-audit
p: The minister may issue binding directions to source holders on object allocation and boundaries after consultation, with no appeal available.
The minister may act in place of a water board or rail infrastructure manager that neglects its duties, with parliament informed afterwards.
Surveyors may enter land and use force against refusal, with compensation claims decided by a kantonrechter whose ruling is not appealable.
Public bodies are not required to report doubtful data where a statute or criminal investigation prevents it, limiting transparency toward citizens and courts.

parties: Asks about data holders' readiness, tariff exemptions, the choice of scenario, and the potential for a European basic register; no check-related concern raised.
The VVD members are strong supporters of simplifying procedures, especially where it improves service to citizens and businesses and cooperation between governments.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn een groot voorstander van het vereenvoudigen van procedures, helemaal waar het de dienstverlening richting burgers en bedrijven en de samenwerking tussen overheden verbetert.
Asks for more detail on the Kadaster's management tasks, the third dimension, the choice of scenario, and the allocation of transition costs; no check-related concern raised.
The PvdA members have noted the bill with approval and have a number of questions they ask the government to address.
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben nog een aantal vragen waarop ze de regering verzoeken in te gaan.

Questions the absence of a supervisory role for the Kadaster over data holders, the unlimited 'in onderzoek' status, the MKBA not being sent to the House, and whether a hard budget ceiling and evaluation were implemented.
The SP members note that the Kadaster is responsible for receiving and processing the data but has no supervisory task vis-a-vis the data holders.

De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat het Kadaster verantwoordelijkheid draagt voor de ontvangst en verwerking van de gegevens, maar geen toezichthoudende taak heeft ten opzichte van bronhouders.
Welcomes removal of the power to enter homes without the occupant's consent on Raad van State advice, and asks what differs from existing entry powers in the Kadasterwet.
The CDA members are pleased that, on Raad van State advice, the power to enter homes without the occupant's consent, which was not considered necessary, has been removed from the bill.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn verheugd dat op advies van de Raad van State de bevoegdheid tot het binnentreden van woningen zonder toestemming van de bewoner, welke niet noodzakelijk werd geacht, uit het wetsvoorstel is geschrapt.
Asks for effective control and enforcement, the criteria for self-control, and whether the basic registers have been evaluated.
The D66 members are of the view that good and effective control and enforcement must take place.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat er goede en effectieve controle en handhaving moet plaatsvinden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft Wet basisregistratie grootschalige topografie be revised, mainly because the power to enter homes without consent was not justified, the power of substitution for ministers was disproportionate, and the annual self-check was not clearly necessary. The government's nader rapport accepted the removal of home entry and the ministerial substitution power for ministers and defended the annual self-check, adding clarifications and redactional changes.
concerns: The power to enter dwellings without the occupant's consent infringes the right to privacy of the home and was not shown to be necessary; the government removed home entry from the power.

The power of substitution (indeplaatsstelling) should not apply to ministers who have no supervisory relationship with one another; the government deleted it for the ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence.

The necessity of the annual self-check by data holders was questioned; the government defended it as needed for data reliability and expanded the explanatory memorandum without changing the frequency.
Redactional comments on article references and wording were adopted by the government.

33554.s: The bill brings four independent administrative bodies (the Cbp data protection authority, the CvTA copyright collective-management supervisor, the LBIO maintenance-payment bureau, and the donor-data foundation) under the general Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, while removing their supervisory boards and exempting some functions from ministerial directive and annulment powers to protect independence. It also abolishes the minister's power to issue policy rules to the Cbp and related ministerial oversight tools in the separate statutes.
33554.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by aligning with the Kaderwet and European Court of Justice requirements of full independence for the data protection authority, and by removing duplicative supervisory layers.
q: Given the binding requirement of strict independence arising from Article 28(1) of the directive, Articles 21 and 22 of the Kaderwet are declared not applicable to the Cbp.

Gelet op de uit artikel 28, eerste lid, van genoemde richtlijn voortvloeiende dwingende eis van strikte onafhankelijkheid van deze taakuitoefening worden de artikelen 21 ... en 22 ... van de Kaderwet niet van toepassing verklaard op het Cbp.
d: legal position of Cbp chair and members
legal position of LBIO directors by ministerial regulation
minister exercises Kaderwet powers jointly with other ministers
p: Repeals the minister's power to issue policy rules on the Cbp's administrative fining, protecting regulator independence from the executive.

Removes or restricts the minister's directive and annulment powers over the Cbp and CvTA while keeping the minister's appointment and reporting tools under the Kaderwet.; the LBIO supervisory board is abolished, leaving direct ministerial control.;
Abolishes the LBIO raad van toezicht, removing an independent board that handled complaints and public accountability.;

parties: Asks why zbo's were not brought under the Framework Act earlier, how many remain outside it, and how the minister's policy-setting power over the CBP can be kept given independence requirements.
Why were the zbo's in question not brought under the Framework Act earlier?
Waarom zijn de desbetreffende zbo's niet eerder onder werking van de Kaderwet gebracht?

Wants minimal deviation from the Framework Act to keep democratic control over zbo's as large as possible, and questions limits on the minister's annulment power and the removal of supervisory boards.
They believe deviations from the Framework Act should be kept to a minimum to keep democratic control over zbo's as large as possible.
Zij zijn van oordeel dat zo min mogelijk moet worden afgeweken van de Kaderwet om de democratische controle op zbo's zo groot mogelijk te houden.

Asks how the remaining tasks of abolished supervisory boards will be covered, and whether pay and side-job limits will be reassessed; also stresses the CBP must remain independent and the minister's information powers should be limited to management aspects.
Can the government guarantee that the CBP's criticism has no influence at all on the government's funding of the CBP and how it spends that money?
Kan de regering garanderen dat de kritiek van het CBP geen enkele invloed heeft op de overheidsbijdrage aan het CBP en de wijze waarop het met dit geld omgaat?

Accepts the approach for zbo's under the ministry, but insists oversight of zbo's is not a dead letter and is periodically evaluated, and asks the government to address the CBP's request to limit the minister's information powers to management aspects.
Given the problems with the COA's director and supervisory board, these members attach great importance to oversight of zbo's not remaining a dead letter.

Gezien de problemen die er zijn geweest in verband met het disfunctioneren van de algemeen directeur en de raad van toezicht van het COA hechten deze leden er zeer aan dat het toezicht op het functioneren van zbo's geen dode letter blijft.

Supports keeping the CBP fully independent as EU law requires, welcomes exempting it from parts of the Framework Act, but urges safeguards and asks why the minister's information powers under Article 20 are not limited to management aspects.
They note that the Dutch privacy watchdog must be able to carry out its tasks independently.
Zij stellen vast dat de Nederlandse privacy waakhond onafhankelijk uitvoering moet kunnen geven aan haar taken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supported a bill bringing four Ministry of Security and Justice agencies under the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, but advised a cross-reference (samenloop) clause because the amendments depended on two other bills, and advised basing the amendments in article IV on the current text of the Landelijk Bureau Inning Onderhoudsbijdragen Act. The government's reply accepted the samenloop point, adapted article IV to the current law, adopted the redactional remarks, and removed the supervisory board of the LBIO on its own initiative.
concerns: The Afdeling advised a samenloop clause making the amendment to article 25a of the collective-management supervision act conditional on two other bills entering into force, which the government did not adopt in the bill text, instead stating it would add one if needed.
The Afdeling advised basing the article IV amendments on the current text of the LBIO Act, since a separate bill's article IV was not going to enter into force.

Redactional remarks on wording, including replacing 'heeft geen betrekking' and the reglement terminology, were largely adopted, though one suggested formulation was rejected as grammatically incorrect.

33572.s: The bill replaces the Dutch Criminal Code's extraterritorial jurisdiction rules (articles 4-8) with a streamlined set, moving the scope of treaty-based jurisdiction into a general administrative order (AMvB) under the new article 6. It also adds a passive personality and residence-based jurisdiction basis and a consequential amendment to the extradition and surrender laws.
33572.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB by saying it makes the rules more manageable and avoids amending the statute each time a new instrument is adopted, while the treaty itself fixes the scope.
q: This is possible by providing that the scope of Dutch jurisdiction over the acts falling under an international instrument is further defined by general administrative order.

Dit is mogelijk door te bepalen dat de reikwijdte van de Nederlandse rechtsmacht over de feiten die onder de werking van een internationaal instrument vallen, nader wordt omschreven bij algemene maatregel van bestuur
d: scope of jurisdiction over offences under international treaties and decisions of international organisations
p: The concrete scope of Dutch criminal jurisdiction under international instruments is set by general administrative order rather than by statute, though the memorandum says it cannot alter what treaties already require.

The bill widens extraterritorial jurisdiction over offences against Dutch nationals and residents, and the prosecution discretion (opportuniteitsbeginsel) is left to the public prosecutor with limited judicial correction.

parties: Asks about the number of cases, costs of prosecution and detention, and why the eight-year threshold was chosen.
Without further legal justification, this term seems to these members relatively arbitrary.
Zonder nadere juridische onderbouwing komt deze termijn deze leden betrekkelijk willekeurig over.
Supports clearer article structure but questions whether extraterritorial jurisdiction will overlap with other states' jurisdiction and whether prosecution in EU member states is adequate.

These members understand that for offences such as human trafficking, child pornography or rape, such acts should still be prosecutable in the Netherlands even where they are not punishable in the country where they were committed.

Deze leden begrijpen dat bijvoorbeeld in het geval van mensenhandel, kinderpornografie of verkrachting dergelijke feiten ook in het geval dat die in het land waar het gepleegd wordt niet strafbaar zijn, toch in Nederland moeten kunnen worden vervolgd.
Questions whether the general administrative order power in article 6 is a substantive change that bypasses the legislature, and asks why the eight-year threshold was chosen.
Is no substantive change or extension intended with this general administrative order?
Is met deze amvb geen inhoudelijke wijziging of uitbreiding beoogd?
Supports the bill's aims but questions its practical effect without more investigative capacity, the lack of a remedy for 1F suspects, and the meaning of the five-year residence requirement.
The Public Prosecution Service and the Dutch Association for the Judiciary rightly point out that this bill offers no solution to the 1F problem.
Het OM en de Nederlandse vereniging voor Rechtspraak (NVvR) wijzen er terecht op dat dit wetsvoorstel geen oplossing biedt voor de 1F-problematiek.
Asks about workload, costs, cooperation with foreign states and the reasoning behind the eight-year threshold.
The CDA members ask whether an indication can be given of the expected extent of the additional workload and financial resources accompanying the proposed changes.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of een indicatie kan worden gegeven van de verwachte omvang van de (extra) werklast en financiële middelen die met de voorgestelde aanpassingen gepaard zullen gaan.
Questions the justification for differing jurisdictional thresholds for offenders and victims, and whether the discretionary nature of jurisdiction should be relied on.
Can the government explain how it also more fundamentally justifies the difference?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe zij het verschil ook meer principieel rechtvaardigt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a government bill revising Dutch extraterritorial criminal jurisdiction, finding it more transparent but raising objections on effectiveness, jurisdiction over foreigners (the five-year residence requirement), passive personality, dual criminality, nationality principle and retroactivity. The minister's nader rapport accepted or partly accepted most points, rejecting the suggestion to extend article 8c to non-extradition obstacles and adding a transitional safeguard against retroactivity.
concerns: The Afdeling wanted the government to assess enforcement capacity and expected case numbers for the expanded jurisdiction; the minister said such a realistic estimate was impracticable but added explanation on limited consequences.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the five-year uninterrupted lawful residence requirement for foreigners, which narrows the existing rules; the minister added justification and clarified the timing of the residence test.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of why the passive personality principle should apply to foreigners prosecuted for offences against nationals of the locus state; the memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The Afdeling asked that article 8c cover other obstacles to prosecution abroad beyond extradition refusals; the minister declined, relying on the extradition relationship as the starting point.

The Afdeling advised that retroactive jurisdiction be limited to conduct criminal at the time under the locus law or general principles of law, citing article 7 ECHR; the transitional provision was amended to reflect this.
The Afdeling asked the bill to justify dual criminality as a general condition for article 5 and reconcile it with the protective purpose; the memorandum was supplemented.

The Afdeling recommended extending the nationality-principle rule allowing prosecution if the suspect later acquires Dutch nationality to the new regime; this was already addressed in the proposed article 7(3).

33581.s: The bill amends the Aliens Act 2000 to implement EU Directive 2011/51/EU, extending the EU long-term resident status to beneficiaries of international protection. It creates a new section on EU long-term resident permits, with conditions, grounds for refusal and withdrawal, and procedural rules, and transitional provisions for existing permits.
33581.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as a faithful implementation of the directive and a one-to-one transposition of its conditions, keeping existing rules where possible.
q: For these reasons, in line with the advice of the Council of State's Advisory Division, it was chosen to include the EU long-term resident status in a new section of the Aliens Act 2000.
Om deze redenen is, in lijn met het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, ervoor gekozen de EU-status voor langdurig ingezetenen op te nemen in een nieuwe afdeling in de Vw 2000.
d: rules on grounds for refusal of EU long-term resident permit
further rules on EU long-term resident status annotation
p: I, E (art. 20) / I, H (art. 22) / I, K (art. 33)
The Minister gains discretion to grant, withdraw or change permits ex officio, including withdrawing EU long-term resident status and granting indefinite-stay permits in transfer cases.
The Minister may refuse or withdraw EU long-term resident permits on broad grounds such as national security, public order, and fraud, with appeal remaining available.

parties: Asks how many people will obtain status, whether residence permits can be revised after EU status is granted, and what conditions for study or economic activity elsewhere in the EU are checked and by whom.
Who bears responsibility for checking these conditions?
Wie draagt de verantwoordelijkheid om deze voorwaarden te controleren?

Questions whether the new EU permit complicates the Dutch permit system, whether it undermines a common European asylum policy, and whether non-refoulement can be guaranteed when protection is not taken over.
Can the government guarantee that no refugees will be sent back in breach of non-refoulement in this way, for example if another member state does not take over protection from the Netherlands?

Kan de regering garanderen dat er geen vluchtelingen op deze wijze, bijvoorbeeld als een andere lidstaat de bescherming van Nederland niet overneemt, in strijd met non-refoule ment wordt teruggestuurd?

Objects that asylum status should be temporary, that asylum history is disregarded when assessing eligibility, and that persons whose protection was withdrawn can still receive a permit, calling this excessive European influence.
Does the government share the view that this bill again shows very far-reaching European influence over the national Dutch admission policy?
Deelt de regering de mening dat uit het onderhavige wetsvoorstel wederom blijkt dat sprake is van een zeer verregaande Europese beïnvloeding van het nationale Nederlandse toelatingsbeleid?

Asks about naturalisation consequences, the passport requirement, and whether the strict withdrawal scale on public order grounds meets the directive's requirement of an actual and sufficiently serious threat.
Withdrawal on grounds of danger to public order and national security may only occur where there is an actual and sufficiently serious threat to that public order and public security.
Intrekking wegens gevaar voor de openbare orde en nationale veiligheid mag alleen wanneer sprake is van een actuele en voldoende ernstige bedreiging voor deze openbare orde en openbare veiligheid.
Asks whether the government expects a pull effect for the Netherlands and why the Netherlands would take over international protection from another member state.

These members ask for what reasons the Netherlands or a member state would want to take over responsibility for international protection of persons who already enjoy international protection in another member state.

Deze leden vragen om welke redenen Nederland c.q. een lidstaat de verantwoordelijkheid zou willen overnemen voor de internationale bescherming van personen die in een andere lidstaat reeds internationale bescherming genieten.

Asks how the Commission's criticism of Dutch practice (fees, withdrawal on assistance grounds, permanence, public order expulsion protection, education access) has been handled, and when transfer of protection will be decided; also asks about timely implementation and rights in the interim.
In what way will the rights of persons enjoying international protection, derived from the directive, be ensured for the period in which implementation is not yet complete?
Op welke wijze zullen voor de periode dat de implementatie nog niet is voltooid de rechten worden verzekerd van personen die internationale bescherming genieten aan de richtlijn ontlenen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing Directive 2011/51/EU on long-term residents should not issue refugees and subsidiary protection holders a separate asylum permit with an EU long-term resident annotation, arguing this conflicts with the directive and is needlessly complicated, and recommended creating the EU long-term resident permit as a separate section of the Vw 2000. The government replied that it followed the advice by placing the EU long-term resident permit in a new Afdeling 5 of Chapter 3 of the Vw 2000, with consequential restructuring and transitional provisions.
concerns: Issuing an asylum permit with an EU long-term resident annotation to beneficiaries of international protection is at odds with the directive, which requires an EU long-term resident permit.
The chosen implementation through several different permits across scenarios is unnecessarily complicated, and a single EU long-term resident permit in a separate section would be clearer.

33590.s: The bill amends the Tobacco Act to raise the minimum age for selling tobacco products from 16 to 18 years, by replacing the age references in article 8 and in the annex under Category B. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
33590.j: The memorandum justifies the age increase by noting that smoking addiction usually starts in secondary school and that earlier smoking makes addiction more likely; it does not justify any new executive power.
q: The earlier a child starts smoking, the more likely it is that he or she becomes addicted.
Hoe eerder een kind begint met roken hoe waarschijnlijker het is dat hij of zij verslaafd raakt.
d: entry into force date set by royal decree

parties: Asks whether the government will deploy enough enforcement capacity and considers shifting enforcement of the tobacco age to municipalities as the alcohol law did.
Can the government guarantee that this additional capacity is sufficient to achieve adequate enforcement and compliance with this law?
Kan de regering garanderen dat deze extra capaciteit voldoende is om te komen tot een adequate handhaving en naleving van deze wet?
Supports the higher age but insists enforcement must be strengthened and asks what role municipalities will have in enforcement.
The PvdA members believe that, in line with the Council of State's remarks, enforcement must be pursued even more firmly.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden dat in lijn met de opmerkingen van de Raad van State nog steviger ingezet moet worden op de handhaving.
Supports the change but argues that high success rates of youth purchase attempts show weak controls and asks whether NVWA capacity will be expanded.
They themselves find that the cause lies in inadequate controls, so that sales outlets feel no pressure to comply with the age limit.
Zelf constateren zij dat de oorzaak te vinden is in tekortschietende controles waardoor verkooppunten geen enkele druk voelen om zich te houden aan de leeftijdsgrens.
Supports the higher age but asks how the Council of State's concern about worse compliance will be addressed and about NVWA control targets and officer safety.
These members would welcome further explanation on this point.
Graag zouden deze leden een nadere toelichting op dit punt willen hebben.
Doubts the effectiveness of the measure and the risk of backfire, while stressing individual freedom of choice and asking about controls and which body should enforce.
These members endorse the importance of a smoke-free youth but question the effectiveness of raising the minimum age.
Deze leden onderschrijven het belang van een rookvrije jeugd maar stellen vragen bij de effectiviteit van de verhoging van de minimumleeftijd.
Supports the increase for long-term health gains and asks about communication consistency between alcohol and tobacco.
They endorse the need for the increase.
Zij onderschrijven de noodzaak van de verhoging.
Supports the higher age but asks whether NVWA has sufficient enforcement capacity and whether municipalities should enforce, and whether incentives and sanctions for retailers were considered.
Does the NVWA have sufficient capacity, even with the additional deployment of the current alcohol age-limit team, for enforcement?
Heeft de NVWA voldoende capaciteit – zelfs met de extra inzet van het huidige leeftijdsgrenzenteam alcohol – voor de handhaving?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill raising the minimum age for tobacco sales from 16 to 18, but asks the explanatory memorandum to address enforcement, noting that the cited monitor shows shopkeepers rarely comply with the current age limit. The government's reply states the memorandum was supplemented with passages on enforcement and compliance, noting that youth refrain from trying while sellers rarely refuse.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum's claim that the new age limit has no consequences for enforcement is not supported by the monitor, which shows very low seller compliance with the current limit, so enforcement must be explained further.

33653.s: The bill introduces a temporary one-off levy called the resolutieheffing 2014 on banks covered by the deposit guarantee scheme on 1 February 2013, to help finance the nationalisation of SNS REAAL. It sets the base as deposits eligible for compensation, the rate at 0.075%, payment dates, and a related amendment to the corporate tax act.
33653.j: The memorandum justifies the expiry-date delegation by saying the timing of full collection and any objection or appeal procedures cannot be known in advance, so it avoids transitional law in the general tax acts.
q: By having the articles of this act expire at a time set by royal decree rather than on 1 January 2015, transitional provisions in the General Tax Act and the 1990 Income Tax Act are avoided.

Door de artikelen van deze wet op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip te laten vervallen in plaats van per 1 januari 2015, wordt vermeden dat in de AWR en de IW 1990 overgangsrecht dient te worden opgenomen
d: entry into force and expiry dates of articles

parties: Asks about the levy's shock effects on bank results, the tariff basis, what happens if revenue falls short or exceeds target, and the basis for the credit-supply estimates.
Can the government further substantiate this percentage in relation to the intended revenue?
Kan de regering dit percentage nader onderbouwen in relatie tot de beoogde opbrengst?
Questions the justification of the EUR 1 billion ceiling and DNB's two extreme scenarios, and asks for an independent analysis and a mixed scenario, citing the Nijboer-Harbers motion.

Questions inconsistencies between the bank tax and the resolution levy regarding scope, exemptions and the terminology of tax versus levy, and asks how passing the burden to taxpayers will be prevented.
Is the government wavering here (as with the difference between tax and levy) as well?
Zwalkt de regering (net als bij het verschil belasting/heffing) hier niet?
Asks how the EUR 1 billion revenue is substantiated, the chance the target is missed, the form of any additional measures, and whether surpluses are refunded to banks.
If the government cannot state that, how can it be substantiated that a rate of 0.075% will raise EUR 1 billion?
Mocht de regering dat niet kunnen aangeven, hoe kan dan worden onderbouwd dat met een tarief van 0,075%, € 1 miljard wordt opgehaald?
Understands the rationale for banks paying toward the SNS Reaal nationalisation but worries about cumulative levies reducing credit supply and asks for a full overview of effects.
These members have understanding for the government's consideration of having banks contribute to the nationalisation of SNS Reaal.
Deze leden hebben begrip voor de overweging van de regering om banken te willen laten meebetalen aan het nationaliseren van SNS Reaal.
Questions the tension of deferring the deposit guarantee fund contributions, the budget effect via state holdings, and how burden shifting to taxpayers via customers will be prevented.
In what way does the government want to prevent this?
Op welke wijze wil de regering dit voorkomen?
Considers it fair that banks contribute, but asks about credit-supply consequences of the second DNB scenario, alternative spreading of payments, and the exact net revenue to the treasury.
They consider it fair that banks make a contribution through the one-off resolution levy to the costs of rescuing SNS Reaal.
Zij achten het billijk dat banken via de eenmalige resolutieheffing een bijdrage leveren aan de kosten van de redding van SNS Reaal.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the Tijdelijke wet resolutieheffing 2014 supports the bill's aim but raises concerns about the effect of the one-off levy on banks' capital buffer build-up and about unclear drafting on the timing of the levy and of tax liability. The minister's reply adds clarifying text on buffers, the three-instalment structure and the liability date, rejects the request to rename the levy as a tax, and adopts a 0.075% rate.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address how the levy affects banks' capital buffer rebuilding, which the government did by adding text citing DNB, though it kept the two-year postponement of the ex ante deposit guarantee scheme.

The Afdeling found that articles 7 and 8 were confusing about whether the 2014 levy is owed three times, and the government clarified the commentary but kept the three-instalment design at the banks' request.

The Afdeling flagged that article 3 is unclear about the date on which a bank must fall under the deposit guarantee scheme to be liable, and the government clarified the explanatory memorandum while accepting that some banks may fall outside liability at certain dates.
The Afdeling suggested renaming the levy as a 'belasting' in line with its status as a national tax, which the government declined on the ground that the wording in the statute suffices.

The Afdeling suggested the bill expressly provide for its lapse and reverse the related amendment to the corporate tax act, consistent with drafting guidelines, and the other drafting comments were adopted.

33671.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2012 agreement with France on reprocessing Dutch irradiated nuclear fuel elements in France. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Netherlands undertakes to take the necessary measures within its competence to enable implementation of the agreement.
Nederland verplicht zich daarbij om de nodige onder haar bevoegdheid vallende maatregelen te treffen om de uitvoering van de overeenkomst mogelijk te maken.

parties: Asks how the traceability of nuclear materials sent to France will be guaranteed and who is responsible for harm while the materials are abroad.
How will that traceability be guaranteed in the coming years?
Hoe wordt die traceerbaarheid in de komende jaren gewaarborgd?
Asks how waste covered by the old treaty will be returned by 2034 and how the newer treaty's stronger provisions apply, and raises Belgian local opposition to rail transport of nuclear waste.
How does the government view the opposition in Belgium among various municipalities to rail transport of nuclear waste through densely populated areas?
Hoe beziet de regering het verzet in België onder verschillende gemeenten tegen treinvervoer van kernafval door dichtbevolkte gebieden?

33680.s: The bill introduces a social loan system for master-phase students in the Wet studiefinanciering 2000, replacing grants with loans for that phase and extending the standard repayment period from 15 to 20 years. It also abolishes the partner allowance, the allowance for unresponsive or untraceable parents, and related hardship and appeal routes, while adding ministerial and general-administrative-order delegation for designating shortage-sector programmes eligible for partial debt forgiveness.
33680.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and removals mainly by administrative simplification, lower DUO workload, transparency and avoiding case-by-case judgements on parent-child relations.
q: This means DUO no longer needs to assess the relationship between the student and one or both parents, and so no longer has to interfere in the relationship between parent and child.
Dit betekent dat DUO de relatie tussen de studerende en één of beide ouders niet meer hoeft te beoordelen en zich dus niet langer hoeft te mengen in de relatie tussen ouder en kind.
d: designation of education programmes eligible for partial debt forgiveness
further rules on application of debt forgiveness
further rules for proper implementation of repayment-period choice
minister determines duration and form of funding for education abroad
loan amount per month set by reference date
p: Abolishes the arrangement for students of refusing or untraceable parents and the partner allowance, removing the statutory entitlement and the administrative appeal route over parent-child relations, with no replacement hardship safeguard beyond a ban on relying on the hardship clause.
Excludes the hardship clause from being used on grounds of a disrupted parent-child relationship or parent untraceability, removing a route to individual review.

parties: Supports a more even distribution of study costs and asks about flexibility in loan terms and the interest-rate system.
The members of the VVD faction read the bill with approval.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben het wetsvoorstel met instemming gelezen.
Supports the reform's aim of investing in quality but asks how access will be monitored and how freed funds will be spent effectively.
For the members of this faction it is important that every motivated student can study, so that every talent comes into its own.
Voor de leden van deze fractie is het van belang dat iedere gemotiveerde student kan studeren, zodat ieder talent tot zijn recht komt.
Argues the abolition rests on theoretical assumptions and risks saddling a generation of students with debt, and asks for analyses of student costs.
The members of the SP faction have noted this bill with disapproval.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met afkeuring kennisgenomen van voorliggend wetsvoorstel.
Rejects the social loan system for master's students and fears reduced financial access for first-generation students.
The members mentioned reject the introduction of a social loan system, not only for the bachelor's but also for the master's phase.
De genoemde leden wijzen de invoering van een sociaal leenstelsel af, niet alleen voor de bachelor-, maar ook voor de masterfase.
Sees the loan system only as a means to free funds, questions the phasing and asks for detailed financial data and timelines for information to Parliament.
They stress that the social loan system is not a stand-alone improvement of higher education but a means to free up money.
Zij benadrukken dat het sociaal leenstelsel geen opzichzelfstaande verbetering van het hoger onderwijs is, maar een middel om geld vrij te maken.
Opposes abolition of the basic grant, expecting higher student debt and a higher threshold to enter higher education.
The members oppose abolition of the basic grant, because a loan system will lead to a sharp increase in debt among graduates and raise the threshold to higher education.
De leden zijn tegen afschaffing van de basisbeurs, omdat een leenstelsel zal leiden tot een forse toename van schulden onder afgestudeerden en de drempel tot hoger onderwijs zal verhogen.
Wants the reform viewed alongside the wider government plans and asks that freed funds be guaranteed for higher education quality.
They attach importance to the introduction of a loan system being accompanied by extra investment in accessibility.
Zij hechten eraan de invoering van een leenstelsel gepaard te laten gaan met extra investeringen in de toegankelijkheid.
Stresses accessibility and student responsibility, and asks whether a fundamentally new step is being taken and why the bill is phased rather than integral.
They ask whether the government recognises that this bill does take a fundamentally new step.
Zij vragen of de regering onderkent dat met dit wetsvoorstel wel een fundamenteel nieuwe stap wordt gezet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division reviewed the Wet sociaal leenstelsel bill abolishing the master basic grant and extending repayment to 20 years, raising concerns about debt burden, the unexplained scope of the extension, fiscal leakage, controllability of retroactive claims, and statute readability. The minister's nader rapport responds to each point, largely accepting the drafting and retroactivity remarks and explaining the rationale for the broader repayment extension and the fiscal leakage measure.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanation to justify why the 20-year repayment extension applies to all students and to quantify its budgetary effects; the government explained the uniform rule for DUO and clarified the budget figures.
The Afdeling noted that longer repayment can burden students with debt up to 27 years, limiting other credit options, which the government did not directly rebut.
The Afdeling asked for an indication of which quality improvements and sectors the freed-up funds would serve; the government added clarification that allocation is reserved to the legislature.

The Afdeling flagged that retroactive claims could increase misuse risks and asked how residence status would be verified; the government said DUO will assess mitigation and adjusted the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked clarification on transitional law for students claiming retroactive support for 2014/15; the explanatory memorandum was adjusted accordingly.

The Afdeling found article 5.2 hard to read and advised splitting it and considering integral revision; the government explained clarification in the commentary but deferred integral revision to a separate track.
The Afdeling listed redactional corrections to the text, which were incorporated in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

33716.s: The bill reforms and simplifies child benefit schemes by abolishing age-differentiated child benefit rates, cutting benefit levels, removing the single-parent supplements in minimum-income and social assistance schemes, and raising the child-related budget for certain age groups. It also amends the Kindgebonden budget, tax, student finance and enforcement rules to align with these changes.
33716.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical detail needed to implement the reform and notes that the Raad van State advised on the bill and that implementing bodies found it feasible.
q: The Minister of Social Affairs and Employment may, by ministerial regulation, replace once the amount mentioned in the first paragraph with another amount equal to 70% of that amount.

Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid kan bij ministeriële regeling het bedrag, genoemd in het eerste lid, eenmalig vervangen door een ander bedrag overeenkomend met 70% van het in het eerste lid genoemde bedrag.
d: Artikel I A, art. 7 lid 4 AKW
further rules on school attendance and graduation conditions for 16-17 year olds
Artikel I A, art. 7 lid 5 AKW
income threshold amount and rules on child income for 16-17 year olds
Artikel I A, art. 7 lid 6 AKW
contribution amount triggering doubled child benefit
Artikel I A, art. 7 lid 7 AKW
further rules on care-dependent children and contribution rule
intensive care need determination for doubled benefit for disabled children
Artikel I D, art. 12 lid 5 AKW
one-time replacement of basic child benefit amount
Artikel I G, art. 14 lid 2 AKW
p: Artikel I D, art. 12 lid 5 AKW
Allows the Minister of Social Affairs to set the child benefit amount by ministerial regulation, which may replace the statutory amount once.
Artikel II A-E Anw; Artikel III Aow
Removes the single-parent and ex-spouse survivor protections; the memorandum says the Centrale Raad van Beroep considered the transition term compatible with ECHR Protocol 1, art. 1.

parties: Welcomes simplification and the reduction of the poverty trap, but asks about fraud risks from the single-parent supplement and Belastingdienst warnings, and about the GBA registration system.
The Tax Administration has indicated that the level of the single-parent supplement may encourage fraud and improper use of this scheme.
De Belastingdienst heeft aangegeven dat de hoogte van de alleenstaande-ouderkop fraude en oneigenlijk gebruik van deze regeling in de hand kan werken.
Asks why the poverty trap is resolved more favourably for single parents with older children and how the changes will be communicated to parents.
What is the reason for this difference? Does the government believe that resolving the poverty trap is currently happening in a balanced way?
Was is de reden voor dit verschil? Is de regering van mening dat het oplossen van de armoedeval momenteel op een evenwichtige wijze gebeurt?
Strongly opposes the savings that worsen income positions of families, questions the distributive effects, and asks what measures will prevent and detect fraud.
The SP members have studied the bill and have great difficulty with this saving of more than half a billion euros on household incomes of families.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben het wetsvoorstel bestudeerd en hebben grote moeite met deze bezuiniging van meer dan een half miljard euro op de inkomens van gezinnen.
Has serious objections to the large cuts on child arrangements, questions the government's view of the family's role, and asks about effects on combination allowance and childcare allowance.
These members support the aim of simplifying the child arrangements but have major objections to the substantial cut that accompanies this simplification.
Deze leden onderschrijven het streven om te komen tot een vereenvoudiging van de kindregelingen, maar hebben grote bezwaren tegen de forse bezuiniging waarmee deze vereenvoudiging gepaard gaat.

Supports a simpler, more effective system focused on labour participation but asks why four schemes were kept, about integrating remaining income-support schemes, and about the planned household allowance.
The current system with 11 different schemes aimed at families with children is complex and in some cases internally inconsistent.
Het huidige systeem met 11 verschillende regelingen gericht op gezinnen met kinderen is complex en in sommige gevallen intern inconsistent.
Welcomes that families are spared after the budget agreement and asks about combining work and care, part-time work for single parents, and the position of fathers after a mother's death.
These members note with satisfaction that, as a result of the budget agreement, families are being spared.
Deze leden stellen met tevredenheid vast dat als gevolg van de afspraken in het begrotingsakkoord gezinnen ontzien worden.

Welcomes the amendment as creating a balanced bill that corrects strong negative effects for middle incomes and for families with three or more children, and questions the effectiveness of childcare subsidy.
To their delight they note that the amendment makes the bill a balanced whole.
Tot hun vreugde constateren zij dat de nota van wijziging het wetsvoorstel tot een evenwichtig geheel maakt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aims of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen but raises concerns about income effects on specific groups and about the income and asset tests for the kindgebonden budget, advising adaptation. The government's nader rapport defends proportionality through compensation for lower-income households, explains the asset and income test design, and makes only technical and explanatory changes to the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a fuller explanation of whether the cuts create excessive burdens for specific groups, especially given school-cost support; the government adds explanation and states compensation keeps the measures proportionate.

The Afdeling flags European Convention obligations, particularly regarding education costs, and the government responds that financial barriers to education are removed via compensation, with text added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks for justification of the asset and income thresholds in relation to parental financial capacity, and the government explains the design choice without changing the thresholds.

33743.s: The bill establishes a new advisory council on science, technology and innovation to advise the government and both chambers, and amends the Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur law to add energy infrastructure. It also repeals the Algemene Energieraad 1997 law and the Adviesraad voor het wetenschaps- en technologiebeleid 1997 law.
33743.j: The memorandum justifies the new council by reference to globalisation and the shift to a knowledge economy, without discussing delegation or new executive powers.
q: it is desirable to establish a permanent advisory body in the field of science, technology and innovation
het wenselijk is een vast college voor advies in te stellen op het terrein van wetenschap, technologie en innovatie

parties: Asks why the bill is submitted before the financial consequences are known and whether the new council can view energy policy broadly enough.
They are therefore surprised that the government writes that no direct financial consequences follow from this bill.
Zij zijn dan ook verbaasd dat de regering schrijft dat uit dit wetsvoorstel «geen rechtstreekse financiële gevolgen voortvloeien».
Questions whether merging the existing councils leads to less effective research given the very broad remit, and misses a account of consultations and the views of the councils themselves.
They ask whether this merger of existing councils and tasks does not in fact lead to less effective research, given the very broad spectrum within which the council must advise.
Zij stellen de vraag of deze samenvoeging van bestaande raden en taken niet juist leidt tot minder effectief onderzoek, gezien het erg brede spectrum waarbinnen de raad in advies dient te voorzien.
Aligns with the Raad van State's criticism that the justification for merging the AWT and AER lacks a problem analysis, and asks how an integrated view on energy can be preserved.
The CDA members would like to endorse the critical remarks of the Raad van State on the justification for merging the AWT and AER.
De leden van de CDA-fractie willen zich graag aansluiten bij de kritische kanttekeningen van de Raad van State over de onderbouwing van het samenvoegen van AWT en AER.
Sees no reason at this stage to ask questions.
At this moment they see no reason to ask questions.
Zij zien op dit moment geen aanleiding voor het stellen van vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised in 2012 that the bill establishing the Raad voor wetenschap en innovatie (merging AWT and AER into a new advisory body) insufficiently explained its necessity, basis in studies, the shift of energy advice to the RLI, and the size/composition of the council (max ten members), and recommended a redactional change. The minister's 2013 nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on necessity and sources, energy advice was clarified, composition was adjusted, and the name and title were amended.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a clearer explanation of why the merger and new council are necessary and what added value they bring, which the government addressed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to state whether the proposal rests on prior advice, reports or evaluations; the government added references to the underlying studies.
The Afdeling objected that energy advice shifted to the RLI with a narrower, more technical perspective, risking loss of an integrated approach; the government clarified the energy advice framing.
The Afdeling doubted that a council of at most ten members can cover all needed expertise and asked for justification or adjustment; the government adjusted the memorandum on scope and composition.
The Afdeling made a redactional remark to add a heading in the preamble of the bill, which was implemented.

33752.s: The bill amends the Income Tax Act 2001, Wage Tax Act 1964, Inheritance Tax Act and several other tax laws for 2014 onward, including abolishing the wage-tax reduction for education, changing the treatment of non-resident taxpayers, introducing an electricity tax reduction for energy cooperatives, and raising the motor vehicle tax for older cars. It also delegates detailed rules on cooperative eligibility, qualifying non-resident taxpayers, and residence presumptions to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders.
33752.j: The memorandum justifies delegations mainly on technical and efficiency grounds, such as allowing swift response to EU case law and implementing detailed eligibility rules.
q: This provides that general administrative orders may set requirements for the declaration.
Deze voorziet erin dat bij algemene maatregel van bestuur eisen kunnen worden gesteld aan de verklaring.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel I (art. 2.10 / 2.10a context); Artikel II, onderdeel A (art. 1.2 Wet IB 2001, art. 7.8 lid 6)
designation of additional qualifying non-resident taxpayers
requirements for income declaration of non-resident taxpayers and exemptions from declaration
Artikel XIX (MRB art. 84a lid 11 and related)
further rules for transitional regime for older motor vehicles
designation and withdrawal of energy cooperatives and exceptions for entrepreneur members
conditions and restrictions for the reduced electricity rate for cooperatives
implementation of income-dependent benefit calculation and related rules
p: Artikel XIX, onderdeel A (MRB art. 7 leden 3-4)
Presumes residence in the Netherlands for motor vehicle tax purposes based on population register entry, shifting the burden of proof to vehicle holders.
Artikel XIX, onderdeel B (MRB art. 13 lid 2)
Allows the tax authority to start the tax period from the date a person should have registered, extending assessment reach.
Conditions eligibility for the qualifying non-resident regime on an income declaration issued by the foreign tax authority, with exemptions set by general administrative order.
Artikel XXV (AWR art. 30i, 89) and Artikel XXVI (Invorderingswet art. 44b)
Removes certain references to stock-based pension arrangements from collection and withholding provisions, narrowing taxpayer exceptions.

parties: Asks for quantification of administrative-burden reduction and the rise in implementation costs, and how the increase is financed.
What concrete amount does this reduction in administrative burden and implementation costs yield?
Welk bedrag levert deze terugdringing van administratieve lasten en uitvoeringskosten concreet op?
Welcomes fair burden-sharing and anti-fraud measures but flags a practical risk in the wage-administration timing of the income-tax credit and asks for clarity on subsidy scheme timing.
The PvdA members receive signals from payroll administration that a problem is threatening because of the difference in calculation moments between wage tax and income tax.

De leden van de fractie van de PvdA krijgen signalen vanuit de praktijk van de loonadministratie dat een probleem dreigt te ontstaan door het verschil in berekeningsmomenten tussen de loonbelasting en inkomstenbelasting.
Questions whether the income-tax credit changes and energy-tax incentives fit the ability-to-pay principle and whether fiscal instruments are justified over subsidies.
How does this idea relate to the ability-to-pay principle?
Hoe verhoudt deze idee zich met het draagkrachtbeginsel?
Questions the design of the income-tax credit cuts, the sufficiency of the local energy incentive budget, and possible subsidy misuse in the education scheme.
Can the government respond to the remark that there is a danger that employers with immature plans will already apply for subsidy, ask the SP members?
Kan de regering ingaan op de opmerking dat het gevaar bestaat dat ook werkgevers die nog onvoldragen plannen hebben, alvast subsidie aanvragen, vragen de leden van de fractie van de SP?
Calls the tax increases unbalanced without government spending cuts, questions effects on work incentives and trust, and objects to taxing before income is received.
They invite the government to explain why the government must increase burdens so much while citizens' purchasing power has been falling for years.
Zij nodigen de regering uit aan te geven waarom de overheid de lasten zodanig moet verzwaren, terwijl de koopkracht van burgers al jarenlang daalt.
Raises substantial objections on labour-cost, progressivity and simplification grounds, citing Raad van State and CPB findings and asking for responses to advisory-body letters.
The D66 members note that according to the Council of State the government succeeds only to a very limited extent in simplifying legislation.
De leden van de fractie van D66 merken op dat de regering er volgens de Raad van State er maar in zeer beperkte mate in slaagt om wetgeving te vereenvoudiging.
Objects that the measures further disadvantage single-earner households relative to dual-earner households and asks for cumulative income-effect calculations.
The ChristenUnie members fear that the proposed measures will lead to a further deterioration of the income position of single earners compared with dual earners.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vrezen dat de voorgestelde maatregelen leiden tot een verdere verslechtering van de inkomenspositie van alleenverdieners ten opzichte van tweeverdieners.
Doubts the package will boost the economy and consumer confidence, calls for lower tariffs and broader bases, and questions the complexity of tax law.
The course of burden increases and levelling will have to be abandoned to truly offer opportunities for economic growth.
De koers van lastenverzwaringen en nivellering zal moeten worden verlaten, om economische groei weer écht kansen te bieden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division issued a 9 September 2013 opinion on the Belastingplan 2014 bill, raising concerns on tax base broadening, enforceability, delegation, the stamrecht exemption, LNG excise refund, and foreign-registered vehicle taxation. The government's nader rapport of 13 September 2013 responds point by point, accepting several changes while defending most measures.
concerns: The Council warns against broad delegation of regulatory power in tax law, particularly the foreign taxpayer and local renewable energy provisions; the government narrowed three of four cases.

The Council questions whether the stamrecht exemption abolition and the 80% tax-rate incentive are proportionate and effective, and whether the local renewable energy tax reduction is cost-effective; the government largely defends these measures.
The Council raises whether the motor vehicle tax residence presumption for foreign-registered vehicles could impede free movement of services under EU law; the government disagrees.

The Council flags enforceability and administrative complexity of mortgage interest deduction, local renewable energy rules, and oldtimer enforcement; the government added explanatory text but kept the design.

The Council questions whether the oldtimer exemption and local renewable energy measures achieve their stated goals, and asks for a horizon clause; the government added evaluation commitments but declined a sunset clause.
The Council made redactional comments on the bill and explanatory memorandum, which the government adopted.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on the second amendment note to the Belastingplan 2014, raising general concerns about the lack of structural base-broadening and the reversal of measures, and specific objections on the care-cost deduction, the box 2 rate cut, the leidingwater cap and the werkbonus savings figures. The government's reply explains that the measures stem from the Begrotingsafspraken 2014, adds motivation and clarifies the figures in the text.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that reversing measures such as the care-cost deduction abolition undermines base-broadening and trust in consistent fiscal policy; the government answers that the package is needed for budget support and that some measures do serve structure.

The Afdeling asks for a substantive motivation of the reversal of the abolition of the specific care-cost deduction and its consequences for the decentralisation agenda; the government adds the motivation to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to substantiate the expected revenue of over EUR 1 billion from the temporary box 2 rate cut; the government added this basis to the text.

The Afdeling asks for motivation and attention to the effects on large users of removing the maximum consumption cap in the leidingwaterbelasting; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling notes inconsistent structural savings figures for the abolition of the werkbonus (EUR 210 million versus EUR 163 million); the government corrects the budget table.

33805-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets, adjusting expenditure and receipts for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, National Ombudsman and governor offices. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published on or after 1 June.
33805-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by fewer asylum cases than expected and a periodic review of funding for the Vreemdelingenkamer Raad van State.
q: Fewer asylum cases have been handled this year than estimated in the spring.
Er zijn dit jaar minder asielzaken behandeld dan in het voorjaar geraamd.

33815.s: The bill approves the 2012 Washington treaty between the Netherlands and the United States on scientific and technological cooperation in national and civil security. It designates the Minister of Security and Justice as the executive agent and sets rules for handling classified and controlled unclassified information.
33815.j: The memorandum justifies the executive agent and security authority roles as necessary for day-to-day supervision and implementation of the treaty.
q: In Article 4, an 'executive agent' is designated on both the Dutch and the American side.
In artikel 4 wordt zowel aan Nederlandse zijde als aan Amerikaanse zijde een «uitvoerende agent» aangewezen.
d: designation of executive agent and conclusion of project agreements
designation of security authority and handling rules for classified information

parties: Doubts whether information exchanged with US security services will be used only for the agreed cooperation, and asks how fundamental rights and privacy are safeguarded in research plans.

Therefore these members ask whether the government trusts that information exchanged under this cooperation treaty will actually be used only for the intended cooperation and is available only to authorised parties.

Daarom vragen deze leden of de regering vertrouwen heeft dat informatie die in het kader van dit samenwerkingsverdrag uitgewisseld wordt daadwerkelijk alleen voor de beoogde samenwerking gebruikt wordt en alleen beschikbaar is voor bevoegde partijen.

Questions how the treaty's protection of fundamental rights fits with revealed NSA surveillance, asks how compliance with data-security agreements is monitored, and questions provisional application that bypasses parliament.
How is it ensured that the agreements are actually complied with, and how is intervention carried out if they are not?
Hoe wordt toegezien dat de afspraken daadwerkelijk nagekomen worden en hoe wordt ingegrepen indien dit niet het geval is?
Asks for examples of other possible counter-terrorism and national security activities under article 2(g).
Which other activities are envisaged and can the government give examples?
Aan welke andere activiteiten wordt dan gedacht en kan de regering hier voorbeelden van geven?
Asks about the role of the security officer and the College bescherming persoonsgegevens in supervising compliance, and questions the provisional application that the Council of State criticised.
These members further ask whether the College bescherming persoonsgegevens has a role in supervising correct compliance with the treaty provisions on exchanging personal data.

Voorts vragen deze leden of er bij het toezicht op de juiste naleving van de verdragsbepalingen inzake het uitwisselen van persoonsgegevens een rol is weggelegd voor het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Asks about the criteria for refraining from exchanging personal data where processing by the Dutch side is in question.
