These members ask whether it is correct that questions also covers the situation in which it is (almost) established that exchanged data are being processed unlawfully.
Deze leden vragen of het klopt dat onder vragen ook de situatie wordt verstaan waarin (bijna) vaststaat dat uitgewisselde gegevens onrechtmatig verwerkt worden.
Asks for clarity on the scope of research covered and whether the treaty is separate from criminal investigations and US anti-terrorism law, and how oversight is arranged.
How is oversight arranged for the joint research that this bill makes possible?
Hoe is het toezicht geregeld bij de gezamenlijke onderzoeken die dit wetsvoorstel mogelijk maakt?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the US-Netherlands treaty on scientific and technological cooperation in domestic and civil security, asking for a fuller justification of provisional application and for explicit parliamentary approval rather than tacit approval. The minister's reply accepts both points, expanding the explanatory note on provisional application and submitting the treaty for explicit approval.
concerns: Provisional application from 29 November 2012 requires a more detailed justification of its necessity than the summary explanatory note gave.
The treaty should be submitted for explicit parliamentary approval rather than tacit approval because parliament is likely to want consultation on its consequences.
The explanatory note should drop a reference to a withdrawn information security regulation and cite its 2013 successor.

33851.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 650/2012 on succession in the Netherlands, setting up court procedures for enforcement and recognition of foreign decisions, designating notaries as issuing authorities for the European Certificate of Succession, and amending Book 4 and Book 10 of the Civil Code, the Notaries Act and the Cadastre Act. It gives the voorzieningenrechter and the kantonrechter defined roles in exequatur and review of certificate decisions, with the notary as the designated issuing authority.
33851.j: The memorandum justifies the designation of notaries and courts as the implementing authorities by the EU regulation's requirements and by practical efficiency and legal certainty for heirs.
q: The voorzieningenrechter is eminently suited to decide on the request for recognition or leave for enforcement.
De voorzieningenrechter is bij uitstek geschikt om een beslissing op het verzoek om erkenning of verlof tot tenuitvoerlegging te geven.
d: designation of notary as issuing authority for European Certificate of Succession
p: Creates an accessible kantonrechter procedure for interested parties to challenge notarial decisions on issuing, correcting or withdrawing the certificate, with no appeal against the judge's decision.

parties: Questions whether the authenticity of European certificates of succession can be verified and whether the district court's review powers over notarial certificates are adequate.
These members have some questions about the possibilities to check the reliability of these certificates.
Deze leden hebben enige vragen over de mogelijkheden om de betrouwbaarheid van deze verklaringen te controleren.
Asks why the kantonrechter may only refer an incorrect certificate back to the notary rather than correct it, and whether concentrating such cases in one court is preferable.
The PvdA members ask why a cantonal judge can assess that a certificate is incorrect but cannot itself provide a correct certificate.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom een kantonrechter wel kan beoordelen dat een erfrechtverklaring onjuist is, maar daarin niet zelf kan voorzien door een juiste verklaring op te stellen.
Asks how heirs can be protected against unwanted liability for estate debts where the applicable law offers no limitation mechanism, and about the exequatur procedure without substantive review.
These members attach importance to heirs not being unintentionally and unknowingly confronted with debts of the estate.
Deze leden hechten eraan dat erfgenamen niet ongewild en onbewust geconfronteerd kunnen worden met schulden van de nalatenschap.
Asks about the scope of notarial training programmes and the status of a possible European register of certificates, focusing on implementation rather than checks on power.
These members ask the government to indicate what the scope and content of this programme is, considered per Member State.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven hoe de uitwerking en het bereik van dit programma is, bezien naar de afzonderlijke lidstaten.
Asks why Ireland, the United Kingdom and Denmark are exempt and why Dutch law previously distinguished connecting rules for succession and settlement.
These members ask what the reason for this is.
Deze leden vragen wat hiervoor de reden is.

33923.s: This bill makes technical and editorial corrections to the Mediawet 2008, including amendments to public broadcasting funding, administration duties, and transitional rules for broadcasters. It also repeals a provision of a 2012 amending act and sets entry-into-force dates for its articles.
33923.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as correcting omissions and technical gaps, such as the missing clawback power for regional broadcasters, rather than as new discretionary powers.
q: This article did not inadvertently provide that funds used by the NPO or regional public broadcasters in violation of the Mediawet can be reclaimed by the Commissariat.

In dit artikel is abusievelijk niet geregeld dat gelden die door de NPO of de regionale publieke omroepen in strijd met het bepaalde bij of krachtens de Mediawet zijn gebruikt ... door het Commissariaat kunnen worden teruggevorderd.
d: Commissariat determines amount to be repaid by regional public broadcaster
p: The Commissariat is empowered to set the amount a regional public broadcaster must repay after it ends its public mandate, based on a final accounting the broadcaster must prepare.
The Commissariat gains explicit power to reclaim funds that the NPO or regional broadcasters used in violation of the Mediawet.

33932.s: The bill adds a legal basis to the Work and Assistance Act (WWB) for a one-off 2014 purchasing-power allowance of 70 to 100 euro for low-income recipients of assistance and benefits. Municipalities may also grant it to households up to 110% of the social minimum, and the executive may set rules by general administrative order (AMvB) on allocation and implementation, including possible SVB involvement.
33932.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for detailed, uniform implementation rules and by the wish to use existing WWB machinery and municipal policy space.
d: Artikel I C, art. 36a lid 2 and lid 3
rules on allocation and implementation of the purchasing-power allowance
municipal discretion to grant allowance to households up to 110% of social minimum
assigning SVB the task of granting the allowance
p: Several WWB protections, such as parts of the due process and appeal framework, are declared inapplicable to the allowance.
Municipalities gain discretion to extend the allowance to a wider group, subject to transparent public disclosure of criteria.

parties: Asks why the one-off allowance is placed in the WWB rather than lower regulation, given its one-time nature.
ask why the government chose to include the provision of the purchasing-power allowance in the Wet werk en bijstand (WWB), since it concerns a one-off arrangement.
vragen waarom de regering er voor gekozen heeft om het verstrekken van de koopkrachttegemoetkoming op te nemen in de Wet werk en bijstand (WWB), aangezien het een eenmalige regeling betreft.

Questions why municipalities cannot pay the allowance ex officio to all known low-income people, the discretion given to municipalities, and the disproportionate fine for breaching the information duty.
However, there are also 419,000 households with an income up to 110% of the social minimum without a benefit, in addition to this group.
Echter, er zijn daarnaast nog 419.000 huishoudens met een inkomen tot 110% van het sociaal minimum zonder bijstandsuitkering.

Asks about the effects of cabinet measures on low incomes, why the 110% threshold was chosen, how implementation via municipalities and SVB is monitored, and what happens if municipalities do not pay out.
How is it being monitored that the purchasing-power allowance actually reaches households without a benefit?
Hoe wordt er gemonitord dat de koopkrachttegemoetkoming ook daadwerkelijk bij de huishoudens zonder bijstandsuitkering terecht gaat komen?
Questions why support targets benefit recipients rather than middle incomes and how the measure fits the 'work must pay' principle; questions the high administrative costs of the scheme.

In light of these disproportionately high implementation costs, the CDA members ask the government to indicate whether an alternative design was possible in which less money is lost to implementation costs.

Mede in het licht van deze in verhouding haast onevenredig hoge uitvoeringskosten, vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering aan te geven of er geen alternatieve vormgeving mogelijk was waarbij niet zoveel geld verloren gaat aan uitvoeringskosten.

Objects to unequal treatment of benefit recipients (automatic payment) versus workers and AOW recipients who must apply and depend on municipal policy; asks for alternatives such as a mandatory entitlement for the whole group.
The D66 members believe that work should pay more than a benefit.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn van mening dat werken moet lonen boven een uitkering.

Asks whether the government excludes future use of WWB for allowances and why it does not address skewed purchasing-power effects structurally; asks about the timing and content of the AMvB and SVB comments.

Argues pensioners with AOW only should be automatically included rather than depending on municipal policy, and asks why a national rule was not chosen to avoid unequal outcomes between persons in the same situation.
A general regulation prevents persons in the same income situation from receiving a different or even no income allowance at all.
Een algemene regeling voorkomt immers dat personen in dezelfde inkomenssituatie, een afwijkende of zelfs helemaal geen inkomenstegemoetkoming krijgen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet koopkrachttegemoetkoming lage inkomens, a one-off 2014 purchasing-power allowance for low incomes, raising concerns about the targeting to incomes up to 110% of the social minimum, the one-off character, and high implementation costs (about 16% of the budget). The government's nader rapport defends the target group and the one-off design, accepts the need to limit administrative costs, and adds a citation title.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether targeting low incomes up to 110% of the social minimum is adequately justified given the relative purchasing-power trends of minima versus middle incomes.
The Afdeling warns that the one-off allowance could create pressure to repeat it, making it effectively structural.
The Afdeling considers the implementation costs of about 10 million euro, over 16% of the budget, very high and asks for justification or adjustment.
The Afdeling suggests adding a citation title, which the government has done.

33940-IIB.s: This first supplementary budget for 2014 amends the expenditure statement of the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets, raising commitments and spending for the Raad van State and the Algemene Rekenkamer and adding a small amount for the ombudsman and the governors' cabinets. It is a technical budget adjustment that takes effect from 1 June 2014.
q: The budget statement for the other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets for 2014 is amended.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en de Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd.

33950.s: The bill makes a set of mainly technical amendments to several Dutch tax laws, including the income tax, wage tax, motor vehicle taxes, VAT, excise and energy tax, and the Invorderingswet, mostly aligning terminology with the modernised vehicle registration system and correcting earlier omissions. It sets 1 January 2015 as the general entry-into-force date, with several provisions applying retroactively.
33950.j: The memorandum justifies the amended delegation provision in artikel 59a Wbm as a correction of an earlier omission so that a change, not only a revocation, of a cooperative designation can be made by delegated rules.
q: This article is supplemented so that the delegation provision it contains applies not only to the revocation of a designation of a cooperative, but also to a change of such a designation.

Dit artikel wordt zodanig aangevuld dat de daarin opgenomen delegatiebepaling niet alleen geldt voor de intrekking van een aanwijzing van een coöperatie, maar ook voor een wijziging van zo'n aanwijzing.
d: revocation or amendment of designation of cooperative for green electricity reduced rate

parties: Asks whether the Register Belastingadviseurs' concerns about longer decision periods for benefits are valid and how the government responds.

Can the government respond to the Register Belastingadviseurs' comment that under this bill the decision periods for allowances may become considerably longer for the specified group of beneficiaries, ask the VVD members?

Kan de regering ingaan op het commentaar van het Register Belastingadviseurs dat op basis van dit wetsvoorstel de beslistermijnen voor toeslagen bij de genoemde specifieke groep belanghebbenden fors langer kunnen worden, vragen de leden van de fractie van de VVD?
Worries that benefit decision periods could lengthen for some claimants, leaving them in greater uncertainty about their final allowance.
Can the government explain how it will be prevented that allowance recipients face greater uncertainty about the final amount of the allowance?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe wordt voorkomen dat toeslaggerechtigden in grotere onzekerheid zullen verkeren over de definitieve hoogte van de toeslag?
Asks how citizens can check where they stand in the mortgage repayment process given the complexity of the owner-occupied home rules.
To what extent are taxpayers able to check where they stand in the repayment process, ask the SP members?
In hoeverre zijn belastingplichtigen in staat om te controleren waar zij staan in het aflossingsproces, vragen de leden van de SP-fractie?
Questions who bears the burden of proof for mortgage interest deduction after 30 years and calls for simplification of the owner-occupied home scheme.
Can the government indicate on whom the burden of proof rests in this case and how that burden can be discharged?
Kan de regering aangeven op wie de bewijslast rust in dit geval en op welke wijze deze bewijslast kan worden ingevuld?
Asks whether taxpayers without a legal record-keeping duty can comply with the repayment requirement over the full period.
Is it correct that this scheme can in the coming years only be correctly complied with if taxpayers hold records covering the entire period in which they had a owner-occupied mortgage debt?

Klopt het dat deze regeling de komende jaren alleen correct kan worden nageleefd indien belastingplichtigen beschikken over een administratie van de gehele periode waarin zij een eigenwoningschuld hebben gehad?
Has questions and comments on the bill without a specific check-related point recorded in the excerpt.
The members mentioned have a number of further questions and/or comments.','
Genoemde leden hebben nog een aantal vragen, aan- en/of opmerkingen.

34049.s: The bill amends the Wft (Dutch financial supervision act) to implement EU Regulation 1024/2013, which gives the European Central Bank direct and indirect prudential supervision over banks in the eurozone. It shifts licensing and qualifying-holding decisions for banks to the ECB, with DNB preparing draft decisions and the AFM and other authorities cooperating on fit-and-proper assessments.
34049.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the EU regulation, which requires the ECB to take over exclusive decisions on bank licensing and qualifying holdings.
q: The regulation requires that the Wet op het financieel toezicht be brought into line with it.
De verordening vergt dat de Wet op het financieel toezicht daarmee in lijn wordt gebracht.
d: designation of persons to assist ECB inspections and investigations
p: Licensing decisions for banks are shifted from DNB to the ECB, with DNB only preparing draft decisions, reducing national control over bank authorisation.

parties: Asks how the ECB and DNB divide supervision and whether an ECB decision can be checked, and raises the costs and proportionality of ECB supervision.
Supports European supervision but asks whether the Netherlands can set higher buffers and whether DNB keeps enough powers to block undesirable takeovers.
Does DNB retain adequate possibilities to prevent undesirable takeovers in the banking sector, ask the PvdA members?
Behoudt DNB afdoende mogelijkheden om ongewenste overnames in bankenland te voorkomen, vragen de leden van de fractie van de PvdA?
Asks whether the ECB can override DNB, whether national authorities can block ECB measures, and whether national supervisors may impose stricter requirements.
Can the ECB call DNB to account if it considers that DNB is supervising more than it wants?
Kan de ECB DNB op het matje roepen als zij meent dat DNB meer toezicht houdt dan zij wil?
Worries about an ECB that expands without a control mechanism to correct bad decisions and asks who supervises the ECB and whether Dutch parliament has real instruments.
These members are concerned about an uncontrolled expanding ECB with no control mechanism that can act against a bad ECB decision.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen over een ongecontroleerd uitdijende ECB waarbij er geen controlemechanisme is dat op kan treden tegen een slecht besluit van de ECB.
Requests complete overviews of ECB and DNB powers, supervised banks, administrative burdens and costs of the SSM.
The PVV members request a complete (schematic) overview of all powers and related tasks that the ECB receives and DNB retains
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen om een compleet (schematisch) overzicht van alle bevoegdheden en de bijbehorende taken die de ECB krijgt en DNB behoudt
Asks how the ECB's bonus supervision fits Dutch bonus rules and how efficient cooperation between ECB, DNB and AFM will be ensured.
These members ask the government how this relates to the variable bonus scheme of 20% it previously proposed for financial institutions?
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe zich dit verhoudt tot de eerder door haar voorgestelde variabele bonusregeling binnen financiële instellingen van 20%?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Uitvoeringswet verordening bankentoezicht, which adapts the Wft to ECB direct supervision of significant banks, recommending clarification of supervisory division, the basis for AFM-ECB cooperation, and correction of the branch-establishment procedure. The government's nader rapport accepted these points, supplementing the explanatory memorandum and replacing the DNB consent requirement with a non-objection rule.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify the difference in scope of prudential supervision between the EU banking regulation and the Wft, and whether a national designated authority exists in the Netherlands.

The legal basis for cooperation between the AFM and the ECB is unclear, and the explanatory memorandum should address it; the government supplemented the memorandum and clarified the purpose as giving the AFM guidance rather than creating a statutory duty.

The requirement that DNB consent to a branch establishment by a less significant bank in another Member State conflicts with the framework regulation, which allows establishment unless the home authority decides otherwise; the government replaced the consent requirement with a non-objection rule.
Redactional comments, including wording changes in article I and a transposition table, were incorporated.

34058.s: The bill creates a licensing and site-allocation regime for offshore wind farms in the Dutch territorial sea and exclusive economic zone, replacing water permits with ministerial site decisions (kavelbesluiten) and licences awarded by the Minister of Economic Affairs. It delegates detailed rules, minimum criteria, fees and exemptions from species protection to ministerial orders and the site decisions, and streamlines procedures with single-instance appeal before the Council of State.
34058.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary site and exemption powers by the need for a planned, integrated approach and shorter procedures to reduce offshore wind costs and lengthy appeal delays.
q: There are as few decision points as possible to prevent stacking of objections and appeals, and the associated long lead times.
Er zijn zo min mogelijk beslismomenten om stapeling van bezwaar en beroep, en daarmee samenhangende lange doorlooptijden, te voorkomen.
d: adopting site allocation decisions (kavelbesluit) for wind farm locations
rules and conditions attached to site decisions, including deviation from water works rules
exemption from protected species prohibitions in site decision
types of recoverable costs from permit holders
permit terms, conditions and exemptions from permit timing
application procedure, data requirements and application fees
weighting of ranking criteria for competing applications
designation of officials responsible for supervision
application of other Dutch legal provisions to installations at sea by general administrative order
p: Ministers decide discretionarily where and when offshore sites are allocated and set site rules that may depart from water works rules, with only public comment and single-instance review before the Council of State.
The Minister grants exemptions from species protection prohibitions within the site decision rather than by general administrative order, shifting the decision out of the usual regulatory procedure.
Applies the accelerated procedures of the Crisis and Recovery Act to site decisions, restricting and speeding up administrative court procedures.
Allows a preparatory decision banning works on a location, with no objection or appeal open against it, and lapsing only if no draft site decision is published within a year.
Minister may refuse permits for areas outside designated sites, limiting applicant options.
Minister may amend, withdraw or revoke site decisions and permits on broad grounds, with a prior warning requirement before revocation for non-compliance.
Replaces the usual two-tier appeal with single-instance appeal to the Council of State for site decisions and changes to them, with a six-month decision target.
Disapplies Flora and Fauna Act prohibitions on unintentional killing and disturbance of listed species for wind farm activities.
Excludes offshore wind farms from water permit requirements and from the Environment and Planning Act in areas outside municipal or provincial jurisdiction.

parties: Asks how the Chamber can verify the reduction of the SDE+ budget and whether combining permit and subsidy removes the ability to correct course later.

That means in the view of the VVD members that there is a risk that after granting the permit, it can no longer be corrected through granting or not granting the subsidy, because that has already been granted.

Dat betekent naar mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie dat er een risico ontstaat dat na verlening van de vergunning er niet meer kan worden bijgestuurd via het al dan niet verlenen van de subsidie, want die is dan immers ook al verleend.
Objects to limiting procedural remedies and to the permit regime overriding protection of species and economic activities; asks about the Flora- en faunawet exemption.
Furthermore these members note that the number of procedural options is being restricted.
Verder constateren deze leden dat het aantal proceduremogelijkheden wordt ingeperkt.
Opposes the application of the Crisis- en herstelwet that removes the right to pro-forma appeal and supplement grounds, and fears weakening of nature protection.
Chapter 1, section 2 of the Crisis- and Recovery Act deprives everyone of the right to lodge a pro-forma appeal and supplement their grounds of appeal.
Hoofdstuk 1, afdeling 2 van de Crisis- en herstelwet ontneemt eenieder het recht om pro-forma beroep in te dienen en zijn beroepsgronden aan te vullen.
Criticises withdrawal of existing permits and asks the government to submit article 34 to the Raad van State, which was not advised on.
The SGP members note that article 34 on the lapse of existing permits was only added to the bill after the Afdeling's advice came in and was therefore not submitted to the Afdeling.

De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat artikel 34 betreffende het vervallen van bestaande vergunningen pas na binnenkomst van het advies van de Afdeling in het wetsvoorstel is opgenomen en derhalve niet aan de Afdeling is voorgelegd.
Welcomes faster permitting but is concerned about transitional rules that wrong existing permit holders and asks why no compensation is provided.
They mainly still have questions about the transitional arrangements, which in these members' view do an injustice to the parties that have already committed to making offshore wind possible.
Zij hebben vooral nog vragen over het overgangsrecht, dat in de ogen van deze leden de partijen die zich al hebben ingezet voor het mogelijk maken van wind op zee, tekortdoet.
Supports offshore wind but asks the government to settle existing permits in consultation with holders to avoid raised expectations.
They do note, however, that expectations have been raised several times in the past among permit holders.
Zij merken echter wel op dat bij de vergunninghouders in het verleden verschillende malen verwachtingen zijn gewekt.
Asks how the Afdeling's recommendation to integrate the environmental permit into the kavelbesluit will be followed up.
These members would like to know whether and how the government will do this, and what statutory amendment is needed for it.
Deze leden willen graag weten of en hoe de regering dit gaat doen, en welke wijziging in de wet hiervoor nodig is.
Asks whether coastal municipalities and provinces have a say in designating zones within and outside territorial waters.
These members also ask whether coastal municipalities and provinces have a say in the procedure for designating offshore wind areas within and outside the territorial waters.
Deze leden vragen eveneens of kustgemeenten en provincies inspraak hebben in de procedure bij de aanwijzing van wind-op-zeegebieden binnen de territoriale wateren en buiten de territoriale wateren.
Asks about compensation for damage from revocation of permits and about the chilling effect of article 17 on investors.
How will the government ensure adequate compensation in this bill for damage resulting from the revocation of permits?
Hoe gaat de regering om met het borgen van een adequate vergoeding in dit wetsvoorstel voor schade als gevolg van het intrekken van vergunningen?
Asks how nature interests will be weighed carefully and whether nature organisations will be involved to limit legal challenges.
How does the government intend to ensure that nature interests are carefully weighed against the importance of timely realisation of wind farms?
Hoe wil de regering waarborgen dat natuurbelangen zorgvuldig worden afgewogen tegen het belang van tijdige realisatie van windparken?
The VVD says its questions have been sufficiently answered and does not ask further questions.
They consider their questions sufficiently answered for now and therefore refrain from asking additional questions.
Zij achten hun vragen voor dit moment voldoende beantwoord en zien daarom af van het stellen van aanvullende vragen.
The CDA asks about the size of the area needed for a 700 MW tender, cross-border cable cooperation, and fishing rights within wind parks.
Would a shared cable from land to sea with a foreign partner not mean one fewer cable from land to sea?
Zou een gemeenschappelijke kabel vanuit land naar zee gezamenlijk met een buitenlandse partner niet een kabel minder vanuit land naar zee betekenen?
The PVV says the government acted outside its powers by having TenneT prepare the offshore grid before parliament has decided, and questions the legitimacy of those costs.
These members note that the House has not yet made this assessment, since this bill has not yet been debated, and that the government has therefore acted beyond its powers.
Deze leden constateren dat de Kamer deze afweging nog niet heeft gemaakt, aangezien dit wetsvoorstel nog niet behandeld is en dat de regering daarmee buiten zijn bevoegdheden om heeft gehandeld.

D66 questions whether the allocation of tariff-setting powers between the legislature and the independent ACM is consistent with national and European law, and asks whether the Council of State or the Commission should review it.
These members note that this may conflict with the independence of the ACM regarding the setting of tariffs.
Deze leden merken op dat dit op gespannen voet kan staan met de onafhankelijkheid van de ACM met betrekking tot het vaststellen van de tarieven.

GroenLinks says revoking existing permits by statute undermines legal certainty and was not submitted to the Council of State, and asks whether appeal to the administrative courts is open for the revocation.
The GroenLinks members believe that revoking the existing permits by law (article 34(2)) is an action that undermines legal certainty and moreover was not submitted to the Council of State as such.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn van mening dat het per wet intrekken van de bestaande vergunningen (artikel 34 lid 2) een actie is die de rechtszekerheid aantast en bovendien niet als zodanig is voorgelegd aan de Raad van State.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division supports the Wind Energy at Sea bill but raises objections on competing national interests, an outdated appropriate assessment, the withdrawal and amendment of site decisions and permits, and integration in the territorial sea, advising adaptation. The Minister's reply accepts most points, adding a balancing provision, clarifying the appropriate assessment, extending appeal routes, and adjusting the Wabo and transitional provisions.
concerns: Competing national interests (e.g., mining licence holders) require an explicit legal balancing; the government added a provision requiring third-party interests to be considered and clarified the balancing in the explanatory memorandum.
An outdated appropriate assessment could undermine the permit; the explanatory memorandum now clarifies that the site decision must be readopted on an updated assessment.
Legal protection is missing against amendment and withdrawal of site decisions and permits; the government extended appeal routes to the ABRS and CBb in Annex 2 of the Awb.
Unclear consequences of amending or withdrawing a site decision for already granted permits; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on this point.

Territorial sea integration is incomplete because the Wabo environmental permit is not integrated; a paragraph was added excluding the Wabo for offshore wind parks outside municipal or provincial areas.
Redactional and structural comments on chapters, sections and article wording were incorporated.

34067.s: The bill introduces a fixed-rate contribution to the costs of criminal prosecution and victim support, payable by convicted offenders whose case ends with a sentence or measure, with exemptions for juveniles and for cases ending in a penal order or objection. It sets collection by the Minister of Justice and Security under a general administrative measure, with a debt-settlement exception and a bankruptcy-law carve-out.
34067.j: The memorandum justifies the fixed-rate, administratively set contribution by the high costs of prosecution and the aim of making offenders bear part of those costs, and it explains that amounts are set by general administrative measure to avoid complex individual assessments.
q: Whereas it is desirable, to combat the high costs of investigation, prosecution and adjudication of criminal offences and the care for victims, to have perpetrators contribute to the costs of criminal prosecution and victim support.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is, ter bestrijding van de hoge kosten van opsporing, vervolging en berechting van strafbare feiten en de zorg voor slachtoffers van die strafbare feiten, de plegers van strafbare feiten te laten bijdragen aan de kosten van de strafvordering en de slachtofferzorg
d: share of contribution revenue used for victim support
designation of organisation to collect the contribution on behalf of the Minister
amount of the contribution, differentiation, and collection procedure
further rules on the minister's power to cooperate in debt settlements
p: The Minister may, on request, waive or partly abandon collection of the contribution through participation in a debt settlement, under conditions set by the bill and further regulation.

The Minister may take recourse against the goods, income and assets of a convicted person who fails to pay within the deadline, applying enforcement provisions with the Minister in place of the prosecutor."},{

parties: Supports the principle that offenders pay, but asks how fixed amounts apply to complex and simple cases alike and how individual payment arrangements work.
These members find it more than reasonable that someone pays a share when his offences saddle the government and thus taxpayers with high costs.

Deze leden vinden het meer dan redelijk dat iemand meebetaalt wanneer hij de overheid en daarmee de belastingbetaler, met hoge kosten opzadelt die voortvloeien uit zijn eigen en meestal weloverwogen gemaakte keuze strafbare feiten te plegen.
Worries that debts will harm resocialisation and recidivism; asks why judges cannot moderate the contribution and whether means-testing should be introduced.
These members share the concern that imposing own contributions will lead to higher debt burdens for ex-prisoners and thereby harm resocialisation.
Deze leden delen de zorg die daar leeft dat het opleggen van eigen bijdragen zal leiden tot hogere schuldenlasten bij ex-gedetineerden en dat daardoor de resocialisatie geschaad wordt.
Opposes the bill; argues debt increases recidivism, questions the legal basis and the Minister's discretion, and warns the rechter may indirectly account for the contribution in sentencing.
These members at least share the concerns of various organisations that increasing debts does not contribute positively to resocialisation and recidivism reduction.
Deze leden delen in ieder geval de zorgen van verschillende organisaties dat het verhogen van schulden niet op een positieve manier bijdraagt aan resocialisatie en recidivebestrijding.

Understands the principle but is worried about recidivism; asks why no impact analysis on reasonable contribution was done, how the Raad van State and judiciary advice was weighed, and about revenue and cost estimates.
These members also have concerns about the possible unwanted effects on the recidivism chances of convicted persons.
Voornoemde leden hebben voorts hun zorgen over de mogelijk ongewen ste effecten op de recidivekansen van veroordeelden.
Asks why fixed amounts are set by lower regulation rather than in the statute, so that parliament can control the amounts, and why juveniles are exempt and parents not charged.
These members would like these amounts to be regulated by statute so that the House is involved in their level.
Deze leden zouden graag zien dat deze bedragen wettelijk geregeld worden zodat de Kamer betrokken is bij de hoogte van de bedragen.
Questions feasibility and the contradiction with earlier cabinet positions, asks why a contribution is now introduced, and raises the extra appeal burden on administrative courts.
Although the idea that whoever causes costs also pays seems sympathetic, the proposal raises many questions among these members about feasibility and financial viability.
Alhoewel het idee sympathiek lijkt dat degene die kosten veroorzaakt, deze ook betaalt roept het voorstel bij deze leden veel vragen op over de uitvoerbaarheid en financiële haalbaarheid.
Asks why the government introduces the contribution despite recidivism risk from debt, how debt-related harms are prevented, and how the Raad van State's doubts on revenue are answered.
They ask for further explanation of why the government chooses to introduce a contribution from convicted persons, while debts arising from this can lead to a greater chance of recidivism.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen een nadere toelichting waarom de regering kiest voor het invoeren van een eigen bijdrage van veroordeelden aan de kosten van de strafvordering, terwijl schulden die hierdoor ontstaan kunnen leiden tot een grotere kans op recidive.

Agrees in principle that offenders able to pay should contribute, but questions the legal basis for fixed amounts in an amvb, the risk to sentencing objectivity, data powers, and the many debtors who cannot pay.
Insofar as prisoners are able to, it is good that a contribution to the costs of the criminal process is asked of them.
Voor zover gedetineerden ertoe in staat zijn, is het goed dat er van hen een eigen bijdrage in de kosten van het strafproces wordt gevraagd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the proposed cost contributions for criminal procedure, detention stay and victim care, citing debt burden, recidivism risk, uncertain revenues and unaddressed benefit/welfare costs, and raised points on delegation, retroactivity, debt timing, parental contributions, ECHR Article 6 and the OM-strafbeschikking objection. The government's nader rapport largely rejected the core objections, defended the financial estimates and payment arrangements, but accepted several technical changes (debt timing, objection exemption, ECHR reasoning, clarifying parental contribution).
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the benefits outweigh the social and financial costs, including higher recidivism and unrealised revenues, and advises abandoning the contributions; the government disagrees, citing adequate financial underpinning and payment arrangements.

Essential elements such as the amount and maximum duration of the contribution are delegated to an AMvB without sufficient justification; the government keeps the core in the Act but delegates amounts and collection rules.
Retroactive (immediate) effect is insufficiently justified; the government clarified that the contribution is administrative and not a sentencing factor, and the memorie was adjusted.
The timing of invoices during detention makes payment within six weeks unrealistic; the proposal is to send the invoice after detention ends.
The parental contribution of about EUR 480 per month is much higher than the youth-care parental contribution without justification; the government clarified the relation to juvenile law.
The contribution for criminal procedure may be a criminal charge under ECHR Article 6 given its severity; the memorie was supplemented with reasoning on the amount.
The proposal creates a disincentive to contest a strafbeschikking; the government amended the bill so no contribution is owed where verzet leads to a judgment.
Cumulation of detention and welfare exclusion (no benefits for detainees) is not motivated; the government did not address this specifically in the reply.

34085-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations across the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint parliamentary articles. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The budget statement for the Staten-Generaal for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34148.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure so that a seizure of a real estate sale price placed after the sale has been registered in the public registers rests on the part of the price held by the notary for the seller, and so that payment to the notary in spite of such a seizure can be invoked against the seizing creditor. It also adds a corresponding entry requirement to the seizure notice and makes related cross-references.
34148.j: The memorandum justifies the change by pointing to the practical deadlock caused by seizures of sale proceeds after the Vormerkung and to cost savings for creditors, without any new executive delegation.
q: A seizure on the purchase price has the effect that the transfer is frustrated.
Een beslag op de koopsom heeft tot gevolg dat de levering wordt gefrustreerd.

parties: Asks whether the bill points to the need for a broader reform of attachment and enforcement law and whether the current regime is still future-proof.
These members ask whether the need for this bill does not also expose the need for a more general and structural reassessment and possible revision of attachment and enforcement law.

Deze leden vragen of de noodzaak voor voorliggend wetsvoorstel niet tevens de noodzaak blootlegt om te komen tot een meer algemene en structurele herwaardering en eventuele herziening van het beslag- en executierecht.
Supports the core of the bill and asks clarifying questions about how common registration of purchase agreements is and how often buyers face attachments without protection.
They understand that this bill is a repair of the law regulating the Vormerkung, namely the Real Estate Purchase Act, which in practice turned out less favourable to the buyer than intended.

Zij begrijpen dat dit wetvoorstel een herstel betreft van de wet dat de «Vormerkung» regelt, namelijk de Wet koop onroerende zaken, die in de praktijk ongunstiger voor de koper uitpakte dan was beoogd.
Asks technical questions about when the conversion of the attachment takes place and whether registration of the buyer's purchase agreement is needed to enforce protection.
Does attachment on the surplus take place only after delivery and thus before the amount is transferred to the seller's account?
Vindt beslaglegging op het surplus pas plaats na levering en dus voor overboeking van het bedrag op de rekening van de verkoper?
Objects that the bill breaks the principle of equal treatment of creditors (paritas creditorum) and asks whether the Vormerkung as a whole should be evaluated, given the burden placed on notaries.
The aforementioned members note that in an attempt to improve the Vormerkung, a significant breach is made of a basic principle of law.
Voornoemde leden merken op dat in een poging de «Vormerkung» te verbeteren, een belangrijke inbreuk wordt gemaakt op een basisprincipe in het recht.
Supports the bill's aim of securing the buyer's right to performance and asks follow-up questions about transitional law and the notary's handling of surpluses.
The PVV members have taken note of the above bill and endorse its aim of giving the buyer the protection intended by the Vormerkung.
De leden van de PVV-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van bovengenoemd wetsvoorstel en onderschrijven het doel van het wetsvoorstel om de koper de met de «Vormerkung» beoogde bescherming te kunnen bieden.
Welcomes restoring the Vormerkung and asks for clarification, including a worked example of how the posterior creditor's position is affected under current law and the bill.
It is good to restore the operation of the Vormerkung, the possibility to register a purchase agreement in the public registers (the Kadaster) and to derive protection from it.
Het is goed om de werking van «Vormerkung», de mogelijkheid om een koopovereenkomst in te schrijven in de openbare registers (het Kadaster) en daaraan bescherming te ontlenen, weer te herstellen.

34184.s: The bill replaces the existing sectors and departments in pre-vocational secondary education (vmbo) with ten broader profiles per learning pathway, each combining a profile subject with optional vocational elective subjects set by schools. It also amends the WVO, WEB, WEC, WVO BES and related laws, adds transitional rules, and repeals two older acts.
34184.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for adjustable, technical rules that can be revised quickly as experience builds, and notes that the voorhang procedure gives both Chambers input.
q: This bill concerns the introduction of profiles in all four pathways of pre-vocational secondary education.
Dit wetsvoorstel betreft de invoering van profielen in alle vier de leerwegen van het voorbereidend middelbaar beroepsonderwijs
d: profile subjects, rules on elective vocational subjects and exemptions for basic and mixed vocational pathways
minimum number of subjects in which final exams may be taken in the third year
profile subjects, elective vocational subject rules and exemptions for the mixed pathway
10b, zesde en zevende lid, en 10b, achtste lid (WVO)
school board decides which elective languages and vocational electives are offered and which extra subjects are compulsory
designates additional subjects students may take in place of standard subjects
Minister may designate schools whose plans may depart from statutory requirements for certain profiles
recognition for funding of new profiles based on projected pupil numbers
designation of profiles schools may offer in the transition from departments to profiles
p: 10b, zesde tot en met achtste lid (WVO)
School boards gain discretion to decide which elective subjects are offered and which extra subjects are mandatory, reducing statutory specification of the curriculum.
Consolidates conditional and controlled delegation provisions, with a voorhang or Parliament-triggered approval procedure that keeps Parliament able to require statutory regulation of a subject.

parties: Asks how the proportionality of profile subjects, the procedure for setting module content and the role of education and industry in drafting it are safeguarded.
What is the procedure for drawing up the content of the modules?
Wat is de procedure van de totstandkoming van deze inhoud van de modules?
Asks how the bill ensures flexibility of final attainment targets so vocational education does not become teaching to the test, and how the MBO Raad's position is reflected.
In what ways does the bill provide for this flexibility?
Op welke wijzen voorziet het wetsvoorstel in deze flexibiliteit?
Says the bill does not tackle key vmbo problems and asks how quality of school-chosen elective subjects is guaranteed, with quality criteria set by AMvB and enforcement unclear.
How does the government ensure that the quality of the elective subjects is guaranteed?
Hoe zorgt de regering ervoor dat de kwaliteit van de keuzevakken gewaarborgd is?
Broadly agrees with the bill but asks what concrete problems it solves and what it means for green education and intersectoral choices.
These members can broadly agree, but still have some questions.
Deze leden kunnen zich in hoofdlijnen vinden, maar hebben nog wel enige vragen.
Asks how quickly schools can add or remove elective subjects, what accreditation and approval rules apply, and what quality criteria govern them.
To what extent must such elective subjects be accredited and approved, and what rules and criteria apply, these members ask.
In hoeverre moeten die keuzevakken bijvoorbeeld worden geaccrediteerd en goedgekeurd, en welke regels en criteria gelden daarvoor, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks how regional labour-market links are kept, why RPO (regional education consultation) permission is needed, and whether all profiles remain available in regions with few pupils.
Is it possible in all regions in the Netherlands to offer all profiles?
Is het in alle regio's in Nederland mogelijk om alle profielen aan te bieden?

Asks why the structure is fixed in law rather than made flexible, how control of elective subject conditions works, and why basic requirements such as works council consent are not anchored in the bill.

Why are basic requirements mentioned in the explanatory notes on elective subjects, such as works council consent, not anchored in the bill and only the detailed quality criteria left to lower regulation?

De leden vragen voorts waarom basale vereisten, die in de toelichting ten aanzien van keuzevakken genoemd worden, zoals instemming van de medezeggenschap, niet in het voorstel verankerd zijn en enkel de nadere uitwerking van kwaliteitscriteria aan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill on the introduction of profiles in vmbo, but asked for better justification of the 2016 start date, clearer and uniform conditional delegation provisions in the WVO, and fuller reporting on consultation of Caribbean Netherlands authorities. The government's reply accepts the delegation and redaction points, explains the staggered introduction with a one-year option, and clarifies the Caribbean consultation.
concerns: The Council asked for justification of the 1 August 2016 introduction date and the option for schools to switch a year later; the government explained the staggered approach based on mixed signals and experience with the tweede fase, without quantifying schools' readiness.

The Council criticised inconsistent conditional delegation provisions in the WVO with differing procedural requirements; the government consolidated all such provisions into a single article 121 applying uniform procedures.

The Council asked for more detail on consultation of the Caribbean Netherlands bestuurscolleges; the government reframed the point as coordination under article 209 and described consultation of schools and the content of the explanatory memorandum.
The Council's editorial comments in the annex, including revised transitional provisions for articles VIII, IX and XI, were adopted and transitional rules moved into the WVO and WVO BES.

34238.s: The bill gives the Dutch youth care inspectorate (inspectie jeugdzorg) a statutory basis to supervise and enforce quality requirements for youth care, family guardianship and guardianship councils in the Caribbean Netherlands, including incident reporting, access to files and binding instructions or orders. It also empowers the responsible ministers to issue orders and, if needed, impose enforcement measures, and allows general administrative orders on youth care in the public bodies.
34238.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for a statutory basis for effective inspection and quality improvement in youth care in the Caribbean Netherlands, and the need to access confidential files and personal data to perform supervision.
q: It is proposed that supervision of youth care, providers of youth care, family guardianship, the family guardianship institution and the guardianship council in the Caribbean Netherlands be carried out by officials of the youth care inspectorate.

Voorgesteld wordt om het toezicht op de jeugdzorg, de aanbieders van jeugdzorg, de (gezins)voogdij, de (gezins)voogdij-instelling en de voogdijraad in Caribisch Nederland te laten uitoefenen door de ambtenaren van de inspectie jeugdzorg.
d: rules on youth care in public bodies (access, supply, quality, funding, cost contribution)
inspectors must follow instructions of the ministers
p: Ministers may issue binding orders to providers and guardianship institutions, and inspectors may issue immediate written orders valid seven days, with reasons and deadlines required but no prior judicial authorisation.
Ministers may impose an order under administrative coercion (bestuursdwang) to enforce orders, subject to ordinary objection and appeal.
Inspectors may access dossiers despite the general professional confidentiality exception in the Awb, with a duty of secrecy imposed on them instead and data processing limited to necessity.
Providers must report calamities and violence and hand over personal and health data needed for investigation.

parties: Asks whether the Inspectie's assessment framework should be tailored to the islands and whether data sharing and confidentiality exceptions need restrictions and prior review by the CBP.
Nevertheless, sharing personal data is essential for the functioning of the Inspectie Jeugdzorg and the youth care system in general.
Desalniettemin is het delen van persoonsgegevens essentieel voor het functioneren van de Inspectie Jeugdzorg (IJZ) en van het jeugdzorgstelsel in het algemeen.
Asks whether inspection visits will become more frequent given reported shortcomings, and about the proportionality of added administrative burdens for local care workers.
These members ask whether and to what extent this leads to a higher frequency of visits to the islands for quality supervision.
Deze leden vragen of en in welke mate dit leidt tot een hogere frequentie van het aantal bezoeken aan de eilanden in het kader van toezicht op de kwaliteit.
Welcomes the bill but questions the justification for collecting ethnicity and cultural background data and asks how the government guarantees quality of care to children.
What reason does the government see to identify ethnicity or cultural background as a quality-threatening factor?
Welke aanleiding ziet de regering om etniciteit of culturele achtergrond als een kwaliteitsbedreigende factor aan te wijzen?
Asks for justification of why no administrative fine is available for non-compliance with orders on the islands, unlike in Europe, and for an estimate of administrative burdens.
The CDA members ask for justification of the claim that this should not be necessary for the Caribbean Netherlands, and where the difference with the European Netherlands lies.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen een onderbouwing van de stelling dat dit voor Caribisch Nederland niet nodig zou moeten zijn, en waarin hierbij het verschil zit met Europees Nederland.
Asks why Antillean legislation is largely retained instead of the Jeugdwet, how the ministry can account for it, and how privacy of minors is safeguarded.
They further ask how the ministry can provide adequate accountability when it concerns different legislation.
Zij vragen voorts op welke manier het ministerie adequate verantwoording kan dragen, als het andere wetgeving betreft.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending youth care quality standards and Inspectie jeugdzorg supervision to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, asking for better justification of personal data processing under article 8 ECHR and the Wbp BES, and a confidentiality duty for inspectorate officials. The government reply accepted these points, amended the bill and memorandum, and adopted the drafting remarks.
concerns: Processing of personal and special personal data interferes with privacy under article 8 ECHR and article 10 Constitution and must be better motivated in light of the Wbp BES.
The explanatory memorandum must be self-standing and not rely on cross-references to other provisions or parliamentary papers to justify the data processing.
A statutory confidentiality duty for Inspectie jeugdzorg officials handling notifications containing professional-secret data should be added, analogous to article 25 of the Wkkgz bill.

Several technical drafting changes were recommended, including consistent terminology, clearer definitions of jeugdige and jeugdzorg, and removing a reference to administrative fines not provided for in the bill.

34256.s: The bill creates a separate legal regime for parent-participation crèches (ouderparticipatiecrèches), which are excluded from the kindercentrum category and no longer eligible for childcare allowance, and adapts quality, registration, inspection and sanction rules to them. It lets the Minister and municipal authorities set quality rules by general measure of administration or ministerial regulation, including an alternative quality framework developed with the crèches, and provides a transitional procedure for existing crèches to be re-registered by the inspectorate.
34256.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the crèches' parent-run character requires their own quality framework, while the state keeps responsibility for safety supervision and a ministerial fallback ensures no gap in standards.
q: At the same time, the government, from its responsibility for a sound childcare system, continues to supervise compliance with the safety requirements set in the Wko.
Tegelijkertijd blijft de overheid, vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid voor een goed stelsel van kinderopvang, toezicht houden op de naleving van de in de Wko gestelde veiligheidseisen.
d: I, A (art. 1.1 Wko, lid 2 in the bill's new text; art. 1.49 lid 4 and art. 1.57 lid 2 also delegate)
quality rules for parent-participation childcare (safety, health, training, group size, premises)
information that parent-participation crèche holders must make available to parents
detailed quality rules for ouderparticipatieopvang, incl. training, staff ratios and premises
p: I, A and Q (art. 1.1, art. 1.57) together with the alternative quality framework

Quality standards for parent-participation crèches are left largely to be filled in by an alternative framework agreed with the crèches and then set by executive regulation, with the Minister acting as fallback if no agreement is reached.
The inspectorate and, failing that, the Minister may re-register existing crèches as parent-participation crèches without a request from the holder, within set deadlines.

parties: Asks the government to clarify safety rules (four-eyes principle), staff stability, inspection findings, and the timing and content of the forthcoming AMvB that Parliament will receive.
Can the government also clarify whether inspection reports have revealed safety violations at OPCs?
Kan de regering ook nader toelichten of uit inspectierapporten/inspecties overtredingen ten aanzien van de veiligheid naar voren zijn gekomen bij OPC's?
Objects that removing childcare allowance punishes parents for good behaviour and reduces citizen initiative, and questions whether fraud concerns justify the measure.
What is the reason the government wants to punish good behaviour of parents who have their children cared for in a parent-participation daycare?
Wat is de reden dat de regering goed gedrag van ouders die hun kinderen laten opvangen in een ouderparticipatiecrèche te bestraffen?
Worries that dropping the allowance threatens the survival and affordability of OPCs and doubts the government's claim that they will remain viable.
At the same time, in the view of the CDA members, OPCs are threatened in their survival by this bill, because the childcare allowance is proposed to be dropped.
Tegelijkertijd worden naar het oordeel van de leden van de CDA-fractie de OPC's met dit wetsvoorstel in hun voortbestaan bedreigd, omdat voorgesteld wordt de kinderopvangtoeslag te laten vervallen.
Questions the proportionality of removing the allowance entirely, citing the Raad van State's finding that the decision lacks a supporting justification, and asks for a cost breakdown.
These members also point to the advice of the Raad van State, which states that the choice to grant no childcare allowance at all lacks a supporting justification.
Deze leden wijzen hierbij ook op het advies van de Raad van State, waarin wordt aangegeven dat de keuze om helemaal geen kinderopvangtoeslag meer toe te kennen, een dragende motivering ontbeert.
Argues government should encourage rather than discourage civic initiative, and notes the Raad van State's view that the justification for removing the allowance is missing.
They note that the Raad van State states that a supporting justification for removing the allowance is lacking.
Zij constateren dat de Raad van State stelt dat een dragende motivering voor het schrappen van de toeslag ontbreekt.

Asks for clarity on the meaning of 'exploiteren' in the Wko for peuterspeelzalen, whether non-commercial providers need permits, and why the delegation basis for quality rules is not narrowed given no government funding.
These members ask why there is no reason to deviate from the existing delegation bases and choose an exhaustive enumeration, given that no government funding is involved here.
Deze leden vragen waarom er geen reden is juist af te wijken van de bestaande grondslagen en een limitatieve opsomming te kiezen, gezien het feit dat hier geen overheidsbekostiging aan de orde is.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Childcare and Preschool Quality Act to give parent-participation crèches a separate legal status, with alternative quality rules and abolition of childcare allowance. The advice asked for justification of the abolition of the allowance and clarification of fit with participation policy; the government's reply accepted the need for clarification, expanded the explanatory memorandum, and kept the allowance abolished while referring to cost analysis and limited delegation scope changes.
concerns: The Council asked for a reasoned justification for abolishing childcare allowance entirely for parent-participation crèches, given the costs parents still bear, and asked whether a partial allowance was possible; the government added a cost breakdown but rejected a partial allowance on fraud and design grounds.

The Council questioned why the statutory qualification framework for professional childcare should be the norm for parent-run crèches and asked for clarification of the fit with participation policy; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum but kept the existing minimum requirements as the baseline.

The Council advised making the list of topics in article 1.57(2) on which quality rules may be set by general administrative order exhaustive; the government adopted the advice in the revised bill text.
The Council advised renumbering article 3.8l to 3.8k; the government declined because another pending bill already introduces a new article 3.8k.

34265.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2013/53/EU on recreational craft and personal watercraft, replacing the Wet pleziervaartuigen with essential safety requirements, CE-marking rules, duties for market actors, conformity assessment bodies and market surveillance by the ILT. It adds administrative fines and enforcement powers while delegating detailed rules on notified bodies and transitional matters to ministerial regulation.
34265.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by the need for effective, uniform market surveillance and the technical nature of the rules implementing the EU directive.
d: languages of declarations for partly completed craft
procedure and criteria for designating conformity assessment bodies and their fees
supervision of notified bodies and fees
entry into force of amendments to directive annexes by ministerial decision
p: The market surveillance authority may directly impose measures on market actors, including withdrawal, recall or suspension of products, and provisional bans where risks exist, with measures required to be proportionate to the risk.
The market surveillance authority may impose measures, including bans or recalls, when administrative requirements are not met and the operator fails to correct them.
The Minister may impose administrative fines of significant amounts on market actors, with appeal available under the Awb.
The Minister may apply administrative enforcement (bestuursdwang) to enforce obligations under the Act.
The Minister may suspend, restrict or withdraw designation of conformity assessment bodies when criteria are no longer met.

parties: Asks whether parliament can express a view on future changes made through the dynamic reference in Article 6, and how parliamentary input is ensured.
Is the observation of these members correct that the Chamber has no opportunity to express a view on these changes in this case?
Klopt de constatering van deze leden dat de Kamer in dit geval geen mogelijkheid heeft om zich over deze wijzigingen uit te spreken?
Asks why the ILT was chosen as market supervisor over other candidate organisations and why new obligations for importers and distributors are needed.
Was the ILT the only organisation eligible for this? If not, why was the other organisation not chosen?
Was de ILT de enige organisatie die hiervoor in aanmerking kwam? Zo nee, waarom is niet voor de andere organisatie gekozen?

34292.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2014/17/EU on mortgage credit agreements for consumers by amending the Wet op het financieel toezicht to add mortgage intermediaries to licensing, conduct and liability rules, and by adding a new title 7.2B to the Burgerlijk Wetboek with consumer protections such as advertising standards, pre-contract information, early repayment and foreign-currency loan rules. Most of the new rules are minimum harmonisation and the AFM is designated as the supervisory authority.
34292.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical implementation of the directive's requirements on consumer protection and intermediary supervision, without giving detailed reasons for each delegation.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, rules may be set regarding professional liability insurance and comparable provisions.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de beroepsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering en de daarmee vergelijkbare voorziening.
d: ARTIKEL I, M (artikel 4:9, tweede lid Wft)
professional competence rules for non-natural persons implementing EU acts
ARTIKEL I, Q (artikel 4:74b, tweede lid Wft)
rules on professional liability insurance for mortgage intermediaries
ARTIKEL I, Q (artikel 4:74b, derde lid Wft)
minimum coverage amount of professional liability insurance

parties: Asks where the directive differs from Dutch rules, whether member states apply the same discretion, and about administrative burden and compliance costs for consumers and firms.
The VVD members ask where the proposals implementing the directive substantially differ from how Dutch laws and regulations previously regulated the matter.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waar de nu voorliggende voorstellen ter implementatie van de richtlijn wezenlijk verschillen van hoe het tot nu toe in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving was geregeld.
Asks about financial education initiatives and about whether conduct rules on forced sale and early repayment are set through self-regulation, questioning the independence of appraisers.
The PvdA members ask for further explanation of why the choice was made to lay down standards in self-regulation.
De leden van deze fractie vragen om nader toe te lichten waarom wordt gekozen voor normen neergelegd in zelfregulering.
Asks how supervision of the tying-sales ban by the AFM relates to ACM competition supervision and how advisers' conduct will be ensured beyond knowledge requirements.
These members would like to hear from the government how supervision of the tying-sales ban is currently arranged and how the proposed legislation will change that.
Deze leden zouden graag van de regering horen hoe het toezicht op het verbod van koppelverkoop in de huidige situatie geregeld is en hoe dat door de voorgestelde wetgeving zal veranderen.
Doubts the need for the new legislation given Dutch rules are already advanced, demanding proof of added value and a list of measures that would be adopted without the EU directive.
These members note that the regulation of providing and informing about mortgage credit in the Netherlands is already very far developed, and therefore they view new legislation with suspicion.
Deze leden merken op dat de regelgeving voor het verstrekken en informeren over hypothecair krediet in Nederland al zeer ver ontwikkeld is, dat zij nieuwe wetgeving daarom met argusogen bekijken.
Asks why minimum harmonisation was chosen, requests overviews of national rules for excluded credit agreements, and asks for estimates of compliance costs and administrative burdens.
Furthermore, these members note that the directive lists several credit agreements to which the directive does not apply.
Voorts stellen deze leden vast dat in de richtlijn enkele kredietovereenkomsten opgesomd worden waarop de richtlijn niet van toepassing is.
Welcomes harmonisation as increasing competition and lowering mortgage prices, while asking about tying-sale discounts that may hinder switching banks and about the ESIS adjustments.
They welcome the harmonisation of the regulations on mortgages.
Zij juichen de harmonisatie van de regelgeving rond hypotheken toe.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised the government to proceed with the bill implementing EU Directive 2014/17/EU on mortgage credit, but to amend several points, including supervision of cross-border mortgage intermediaries, the AFM's powers in exceptional cases, the scope of competence requirements, the creditworthiness definition, supervision of the tie-in sales ban, and the precontractual information obligation. The minister's reply largely accepted the advice, adopting most amendments while not adopting the creditworthiness definition change in full, and explaining the reasoning behind the implementation choice.
concerns: Cross-border supervision of mortgage intermediaries from other member states is wrongly left with the AFM in the case of cross-border services; the bill should be aligned with the Directive.
The Directive's power for the AFM to prevent intermediaries from other member states from carrying out transactions in exceptional cases has not been implemented and should be added.
Competence requirements should also apply to managing directors and persons involved in product development for mortgage credit, not only to staff directly serving consumers.
The exemption from competence requirements for branch staff should cover branches of all financial undertakings, in line with the Directive, not only credit providers with a specific licence.

The definition of creditworthiness assessment should refer to the ability to pay interest, not only debt repayment; the government agrees substantively but kept the Directive's wording, adding clarification in the explanatory memorandum.
The AFM needs a statutory basis to supervise the prohibition on tie-in sales, which is only in the Civil Code.
The obligation to supply additional precontractual information together with the standard form should be a discretionary power rather than a legal obligation.
Several redactional and legal-technical corrections were made to cross-references and the explanatory memorandum.

34319.s: The bill extends by two years the conditions under which health insurers may dispose of their former sickness-fund reserves, including a claim for the state treasury against funds that have not declared a non-profit purpose. It also amends the Invoerings- en aanpassingswet Zorgverzekeringswet and sets commencement by royal decree, with a possible advisory referendum under the Wet raadgevend referendum.
34319.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the measure by the financial health of the health insurance sector and the need for a proportionate interference with property rights, citing the Raad van State advice.
q: At the same time, the financial health of the health insurance sector as a whole was and is clearly an important condition for the long-term accessibility of healthcare.

Tegelijkertijd was en is de financiële gezondheid van de zorgverzekeringssector als geheel vanzelfsprekend een belangrijke voorwaarde voor de toegankelijkheid van de gezondheidszorg op langere termijn.
d: fixing commencement date of the law by royal decree
fixing commencement date of articles by royal decree
p: Gives the Zorginstituut an immediately enforceable claim for the state treasury against former sickness funds that do not meet the non-profit condition within the set period.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the bill extending the no-profit condition on former sickness-fund reserves to 2018 to the Tweede Kamer, but found the justification insufficient, particularly under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and legal certainty. The government's reply supplements the explanatory memorandum, stressing that the extension is limited to two years and is one-off, and clarifies the bill's title.
concerns: The extension of the no-profit prohibition interferes with property rights under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and needs a substantive, proportionate justification, which the government supplemented in the memorandum.

The explanatory memorandum does not adequately demonstrate necessity, since insurer population recognisability, Solvency II requirements and the level playing field arguments are not convincingly substantiated.

Insurers must be able to rely on the extension being one-off, so the justification must make clear that no further extension will follow; the government stressed the extension is limited to two years and one-off.
The title of the bill is to be clarified, which the government did.

34350-X.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Defence by changing appropriations and receipts across policy and non-policy articles, effective from 1 December 2015. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and is a budget adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34355.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act to remove legal obstacles to international cooperation between higher education institutions, allowing joint programmes, joint degrees, mandatory enrolment and tuition waivers for joint programmes, and PhD recognition. It also makes technical changes such as studiekeuze rules for foreign-educated students and capacity-based admission limits.
34355.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers mainly by reducing administrative burden and enabling international cooperation, with the institutional accountant able to check tuition waivers under the agreement.
q: The agreement is required because it gives the student more clarity and because the institutional accountant must be able to verify whether setting a tuition fee below the statutory fee is lawful.

De overeenkomst is vereist omdat de student zo meer duidelijkheid wordt geboden en omdat de instellingsaccountant moet kunnen toetsen of de vaststelling van een collegegeld lager dan het wettelijk collegegeld (zie hierna onder g) rechtmatig is.
d: rules on selection application date and number of selection procedures
p: Institutional boards may set tuition for joint programmes with foreign institutions at zero or below the statutory amount, a discretion previously not available.
Institutions may oblige students in joint programmes with foreign institutions to remain enrolled throughout the programme, an obligation imposed on students by the institution.
The doctorate college may appoint as promotor any staff member deemed sufficiently competent, widening discretion over supervisors.

parties: Asks what problem the extension of ius promovendi solves, whether the broader pool of promotors is sufficiently qualified, and why a minimum requirement such as universitair hoofddocent was not proposed.

Why has the government not proposed that, in addition to a positive judgment by the college voor promoties, the promotor must at minimum be a universitair hoofddocent who also has experience with doctorates?

Waarom heeft de regering niet voorgesteld om, naast een positief oordeel van het college voor promoties, bijvoorbeeld te stellen dat het minimaal om een universitaire hoofddocent moet gaan die ook al ervaring heeft met promoties
Questions the financial risks and motives of foreign campus investments and asks how the government can guarantee that Dutch institutions bear no risk.
They also ask how the government can guarantee that Dutch institutions do not run any risk.
Daarnaast vragen zij hoe de regering kan garanderen dat de Nederlandse instellingen geen risico lopen.
Asks why joint programme measures must be anchored in statute rather than policy rules, and whether the profiling fund is the right instrument for study-abroad scholarships.
Why is it not sufficient to lay this down in policy rules?
Waarom is het niet afdoende om dit in beleidsregels neer te leggen?
Asks whether the Dutch exclusive role of the professor as promotor has qualitative value and why statutory minimum requirements for non-professor promotors were not included.
They ask why the government did not choose to include minimum statutory requirements for staff other than professors who may act as promotor.
Zij vragen waarom de regering er niet voor gekozen heeft in de wet minimumvoorwaarden op te nemen met betrekking tot ander personeel dan hoogleraren dat als promotor kan optreden
Asks how separation of funds and quality assurance will work in practice and how education abroad will not harm quality in the Netherlands.
How in practice is it ensured that education abroad does not come at the expense of quality here in the Netherlands, they ask.
Hoe wordt in praktijk geborgd dat het onderwijs in het buitenland niet ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit hier in Nederland, zo vragen zij.
Asks about risks, minister's supervision, works council rights, academic freedom and labour rights at the Yantai branch.
How is supervision by the Minister of Education, Culture and Science arranged, and does it also apply to the Yantai branch?
Hoe is het toezicht van de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap geregeld en geldt deze ook voor de vestiging in Yantai?
Views the bill as ad hoc legislation and questions human rights, censorship, public funding, tuition fees and student protection in case of failure.
How does she guarantee that this university will not face censorship in any way?
Hoe garandeert zij dat deze universiteit op geen enkele manier wordt geconfronteerd met censuur?
Worries about effects on Dutch education quality, staff drain, transfer of publicly funded expertise, accreditation conditions and inadequate supervision abroad.
The requirement alone that institutions providing education of sufficient quality may qualify for transnational education is too thin, these members think.
Alleen de vereiste dat instellingen die onderwijs van voldoende kwaliteit leveren in aanmerking mogen komen voor het verzorgen van transnationaal onderwijs is daarbij te mager, zo vinden deze leden.
Has serious doubts about transnational education and asks about financial risks, quality, academic freedom, internet censorship and co-determination in China.
The members have serious question marks about parts of the bill, particularly regarding offering transnational education.
De leden hebben grote vraagtekens bij onderdelen van het wetsvoorstel, met name over het aanbieden van transnationaal onderwijs.
