Objects that essential safeguards are regulated by AMvB rather than in the bill, and asks how academic freedom and public money use are guaranteed abroad.
Why is this, or a clear framework, not included in the bill, these members ask.
Waarom is dit, of een duidelijk kader, niet in het wetsvoorstel opgenomen, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a nota van wijziging to the WHW enabling a permission requirement for fully foreign-delivered higher education, raising questions on refusal grounds, accreditation, withdrawal of permission and supervision. The Minister's nader rapport accepted most points, adding refusal grounds in an AMvB, unconditional accreditation requirements, a withdrawal basis, supervision conditions, and a clarified scope for unfunded institutions.
concerns: The Council asked for clarity on the situations the permission requirement targets and for aligning refusal grounds; the government clarified these and will regulate them in an AMvB.

The Council asked for a statutory basis to withdraw permission and for withdrawal to lead to withdrawal of accreditation; the government made the requirement facultative with withdrawal grounds in the AMvB, while accreditation remains valid.

The Council raised doubts about supervision and enforcement abroad where the Inspectie and NVAO lack formal competence; the government relies on conditions in the permission and treaties, but rejected the Council's request for a statutory cost-recovery basis.
The Council questioned whether the accreditation rules suit transnational education; the government will require unconditional accreditation and no repair trajectory in the AMvB.
The Council noted the statute gave the impression unfunded institutions were unregulated; the nota van wijziging was amended to clarify the legal regime applies to both.
The Council noted the delegation of funding use was unclear in relation to the permission requirement; the provisions were restructured and clarified.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised sending the bill to parliament but asked for revision of the extension of ius promovendi to non-professors, finding its necessity and fit with professors' statutory responsibility insufficiently justified. The government's nader rapport rejects the responsibility objection, adds justification and comparative material to the explanatory memorandum, and largely follows the remaining drafting and technical points.
concerns: The Afdeling found the need for extending ius promovendi insufficiently justified, lacking comparison of international systems and reasons why it improves recruitment and career prospects; the government added a comparison of nine European countries and reasoning on tenure policy.

The Afdeling considered the extension incompatible with the statutory responsibility of professors for their research and teaching; the government disagreed, arguing professors remain responsible and the promotion regulations safeguard the role.
Text and explanatory memorandum of article 7.3f on tuition fees were aligned, and the redactional remarks were adopted.
A technical error in article 7.53 on numerus fixus (propedeutic phase and deadlines) was corrected, and the co-signature by the Minister of Economic Affairs was dropped.

34373.s: The bill amends Book 7 of the Civil Code and related housing laws to speed up turnover in the rental market, including allowing five-year fixed-term leases for youth, students, PhD candidates and large families, and changing the income-based rent increase rules. It also adjusts the Leegstandwet, the rent price act, the Housing Act and the Woningwet, and requires a report to parliament within five years.
34373.j: The memorandum justifies the new tenancy grounds and delegations as practical, citing the Amsterdam youth-contract experiment and the 2015 housing accord, and states the aim of increasing housing turnover.
q: These are situations where it is clearly unreasonable to invoke rent protection.
Het gaat hier om situaties waarin overduidelijk is dat een beroep op huurbescherming niet redelijk zou zijn.
d: rules on compensation and governance of the guarantee fund
Artikel IV, onderdeel B (Uitvoeringswet art. 10 lid 2)
Artikel I, onderdeel C (BW art. 252a lid 4)
detailed rules for household declarations by the tax authority
Artikel I, onderdeel C (BW art. 252a lid 6)
vacancy permit duration and extensions by municipality
percentage cap on average rent increase for housing associations
p: Artikel I, onderdeel G (BW art. 274 lid 2, 4)
Landlords gain broader grounds to terminate tenancies for own use and courts may no longer count state housing allowances when judging reasonable alternative housing, weakening tenant protection.
New categories of own-use termination for youth, students, PhD candidates and large families, with specified conditions, reduce tenants' protection against eviction.
Fixed-term leases up to one year for dwellings and five years for non-independent units become terminable only by notice, weakening tenant security.
Tenants' disputes over proposed rent increases route through the tax authority's household declaration rather than independent review, shifting information flow toward landlords and state agencies.
Municipalities may extend vacancy-permit durations and grant permits for sale-designated rental housing, adding discretion for local authorities.

parties: Supports more market-conform rents and temporary leases for flexibility, asking about lease length and grounds for termination.
The VVD members support the principle of giving landlords more options to make rents more market-conform where possible and allowing more temporary leases.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen het uitgangspunt om verhuurders meer mogelijkheden te geven om de huren marktconformer te maken waar mogelijk en meer tijdelijke huurcontracten mogelijk te maken.
Welcomes the rent-sum approach but worries tenants lose security under temporary leases and that protection of tenants under private landlords is weakened; asks for monitoring.
These members fear that protection for tenants with incomes below the allocation limit will decrease if they rent from a private landlord.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn bang dat de bescherming voor huurders met een inkomen onder de toewijzingsgrens hierdoor afneemt, in het geval ze huren van een particuliere verhuurder.
Critical that the bill does not address housing of status holders and asks why the abolition of their priority status was left out.
Why was the abolition of priority status for status holders not included in this bill?
Waarom is het afschaffen van voorrangstatus van statushouders niet in dit voorliggende wetsvoorstel verwerkt?
Critical of expanded temporary leases weakening tenant protection, the income-linked rent increases, and asks about monitoring, control of the rent-sum calculation and consequences of errors.
The SP members ask the government why it does not choose to keep the income-dependent component out of the rent-sum approach and cap it.
De leden van SP-fractie vragen de regering waarom zij er niet voor kiest om de inkomensafhankelijke component niet te laten vallen binnen de huursombenadering en deze te maximeren.
Asks questions on applicability to private landlords and worries that too much flexibility in terminating leases creates insecurity for tenants, asking where the limit lies.
How does the government intend to set a limit to that insecurity, especially now that safe housing is a fundamental right, and where is the line?

Op welke wijze wil de regering een grens stellen aan die onzekerheid, zeker nu veilig wonen een grondrecht is en waar ligt de grens of, met andere woorden, tot hoe ver wil de regering de flexibiliteit oprekken ten koste van de huurder en ten faveure van de verhuurder?
Doubts about combining temporary leases and the rent-sum approach in one bill, and questions the design, timing and effects of the income test on tenants.
The D66 members are surprised that temporary leases and the rent-sum approach are submitted in the same bill.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn verbaasd over het feit dat tijdelijke huren en de huursombenadering in hetzelfde wetsvoorstel zijn voorgelegd.

Strong objections to the temporary lease for large families, arguing it can force moves with serious social consequences and lacks proportionality; asks for reconsideration and clarification of tenant remedies.
These members have serious objections to this proposal.
Deze leden hebben grote bezwaren tegen dit voorstel.
Asks for justification of thresholds, the consequences for housing corporations that violate the rent-sum rule, and why the legal system is not modernised for clarity.
The SGP members ask what consequences housing associations face if they do not comply with the statutory rent-sum rule.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen met welke consequenties toegelaten instellingen geconfronteerd worden indien zij de wettelijke bepaling inzake de huursom niet naleven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the Housing Market Flow Act 2015 but requested justification or revision on three points: the rent-sum approach's effect on liberalisation, the extension of the 'dringend eigen gebruik' termination ground to municipally designated groups, and the exclusion of pensioners from the income check. The government's reply accepted the advice on liberalisation justification, the removal of the municipal ground, and the pensioner justification, rejected the extension of registration duration to students and PhD candidates, and dropped the referendum-related provision.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that allowing municipalities to extend limitative termination grounds via housing ordinances hollows out the statutory system protecting tenants, so the provision was dropped.

The Afdeling asked for justification of how the rent-sum approach discourages liberalisation of social rental housing, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented while the bill text was left unchanged.
The Afdeling asked for a reasoned basis for excluding pensioners from the income check, and the memorandum was supplemented without changing the bill.
The Afdeling asked that registration duration also be preserved for students and PhD candidates, which the government declined, citing their greater housing prospects.
The Afdeling questioned the urgency justifying application of the referendum-related entry-into-force provision, and the government removed it.
The Afdeling made several drafting corrections, which were largely adopted, while the remark on the data provisions was not adopted.

34391.s: The bill amends the Income Tax Act 2001, the Wage Tax Act 1964, the Motor Vehicle Tax Act 1992 and the Provinces Act to reduce car-related tax rates and adjust CO2-linked benefits and vehicle tax (BPM/MRB) schedules through 2021. It also sets sunset and horizon provisions and transitional rules, with most tariff indexation and adjustments done by ministerial regulation.
34391.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to ministerial regulation as the means to set mileage registration rules and tariff adjustments, with a horizon provision and evaluation in 2018 to review the tax incentives.
q: Rules may be set by ministerial regulation on the mileage registration a log must meet.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen regels worden gesteld waaraan een rittenregistratie moet voldoen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 3.20 lid 8 Wet IB 2001)
rules for mileage registration and proof of under 500 km private use
Artikel VII, onderdeel B (art. 9 Wet BPM 1992, tariff tables and inflation adjustments)
reduction of BPM amounts by percentage at start of calendar year
Artikel IX, XII, XVII, XIX, XX, XXIII (Wet BPM 1992 tariff reductions)
lowering BPM tariff amounts by set percentages
Artikel XXV, onderdeel E (art. 24aa Wet MRB 1994)
conditions for electric van weight reduction
Artikel XXVII, onderdeel A (art. 23 lid 6 Wet MRB 1994)
further rules on fine-particle emission determination for diesel cars
Artikel XXVII, onderdeel C (art. 24 lid 4 Wet MRB 1994)
further rules on fine-particle emission determination for vans
Artikel XXVII, onderdeel E (art. 24a Wet MRB 1994)
conditions and restrictions for van tax on request for disabled transport
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 3.20 Wet IB 2001) and Artikel IV (art. 13bis Wet LB 1964)
Tax benefit rules for company cars are rewritten with rules on private-use evidence delegated to ministerial regulation.

parties: Supports the MRB reduction and first step toward abolishing BPM; asks whether diesel surcharge may double-burden vehicles already hit by municipal low-emission zones.
The VVD fractie fully supports the reduction of the motor vehicle tax and the first step toward abolishing the BPM.
De leden van de VVD-fractie steunen voluit de verlaging van de motorrijtuigenbelasting en de eerste stap naar afschaffing van de belasting van personenauto’s en motorrijwielen (BPM).
Broadly agrees with the bill but questions the delayed diesel surcharge, consumer price pass-through, and LPG treatment.
The PvdA fractie nonetheless has some questions and remarks on the bill, on the view that further improvements still seem possible.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben niettemin nog enige vragen en opmerkingen bij het wetsvoorstel vanuit de gedachte dat verdere verbeteringen nog mogelijk lijken.
Asks why its earlier proposals were not adopted and why the diesel surcharge starts only in 2019.
Can the government explain in detail, for each SP proposal, why it was not adopted?
Kan de regering per voorstel van de SP-fractie uitgebreid uiteenzetten waarom deze niet worden overgenomen.
Warns of overstimulation of fully electric company cars and questions reliance on CO2 test data open to manipulation, citing the Raad van State.
The Raad van State also points out in its advice that an inefficient instrument, namely the bijtelling discount for hybrid company cars, must be fully and quickly phased out.
Ook de Raad van State wijst er in haar advies op dat een inefficiënt instrument, namelijk de bijtellingskorting voor hybride auto’s van de zaak, volledig en snel moet worden afgebouwd.
Asks for a clear decision framework, quantified budget effects per measure, and whether the package is genuinely sober.
Which criteria does the government use to trade off these two main goals? Does it have an explicit or implicit weighing framework, ask the PVV fractie.
Welke criteria gebruikt de regering om een trade-off tussen die twee hoofddoelen te maken? Heeft daar een expliciet of een impliciet afwegingskader voor, zo vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie.
Concerned the bill yields fewer electric cars and relies on uncertain EU norms; wants linkage to charging infrastructure decisions and evaluation of PHEV exports earlier.
The D66 fractie finds it worrying that this bill leads to 100,000 fewer electric cars than previously planned.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vinden het zorgwekkend dat dit wetsvoorstel leidt tot 100.000 minder elektrische auto’s dan eerder voorgenomen.
Asks about the long-term vision, kilometre pricing, the Parijs climate obligations, and the basis for the budget-neutral design.
The ChristenUnie fractie asks for the government's view of the car tax system in the longer term.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen naar de visie van de regering op het stelsel van autobelastingen op de langere termijn.

Doubts the bill's effectiveness on climate and air quality, citing the Raad van State, and calls for earlier diesel surcharges and tougher EU source policy; criticises the selective Tesla cap as inconsistent with technology neutrality.
With the Raad van State, the GroenLinks fractie has great doubts whether this proposal will prove effective in achieving the government's stated goals.
Met de Raad van State hebben de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie grote twijfels of dit voorstel effectief zal blijken te zijn als het gaat om het bereiken van de door de regering gestelde opgaven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises sending the Autobrief II bill to parliament but requests adjustment, arguing the government has not shown the bill's effectiveness on environmental impact, revenue robustness and simplification, and that faster full phase-out of car incentives may be preferable. The government's reply (nader rapport) rejects the main objections on effectiveness and fraud, accepts several points (full phase-out ambition, clarifying the bijtelling criteria, RDW data for diesel rule, referendum-related effective date), and explains the gradual approach chosen.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the effectiveness of the proposal on environmental goals, revenue robustness and simplification not demonstrated, and suggests a faster, full phase-out of fiscal incentives unless effectiveness is reasoned out.
Concerns that test-cycle (NEDC) gaps and software fraud undermine the robustness of emission-based tax bases, questioning whether taxation should rely on manipulable emission data.

Simplification claims are doubted because transitional rules and the split bijtelling rules increase complexity in the short term, and the Belastingdienst conditions on fine-dust data for the MRB are unclear.
The justification for lowering the bijtelling percentage from 25% to 22% needs clearer criteria and explanation of how factors were weighed.
The BPM import fraud-resistance statement conflicts with the explanatory memorandum and should be explained.
The entry-into-force provision must take into account the Wet raadgevend referendum eight-week period or justify use of the urgency procedure.
Redactional and technical corrections to the bill and explanatory memorandum are made.

34409.s: The bill amends numerous Dutch laws (customs, excise, VAT, tax collection, environmental taxes, and others) to align them with the EU Union Customs Code and its implementing and delegated regulations. It also adds transitional rules and allows the minister to set further detailed rules by ministerial regulation.
34409.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to align national law with the Union Customs Code and its delegated and implementing regulations by the 1 May 2016 date.
q: This does not concern an extension of the regulatory domain of the European Union.
Het betreft hier geen uitbreiding van het regelgevende terrein van de Europese Unie.
d: ARTIKEL IV, onderdeel F (artikel 1:10 Algemene douanewet)
ARTIKEL IV, onderdeel E (artikel 1:9 Algemene douanewet)
repeal of requirements for customs representatives, with detailed criteria left to discretion
ARTIKEL VII? / ARTIKEL XV, tweede lid
further rules for transition to full application of the Union Customs Code
further transitional provisions related to entry into force
deviating allocation of payments to collection demands where EU law requires
p: ARTIKEL IV, onderdeel J (artikel 1:18 Algemene douanewet)
Excludes certain general administrative law provisions (motivation, hearing, objection procedures) for customs decisions taken under the Union Code, relying on EU-law rules instead.
ARTIKEL IV, onderdeel D (artikel 1:6 Algemene douanewet)
Removes the first paragraph of article 1:6, reducing the statutory scope of applicable provisions.
ARTIKEL X, onderdeel K (artikel 28, derde lid, Invorderingswet 1990)
Deletes the reference to payment deferral under the old Community Customs Code, a technical removal of a protective term.

parties: Asks the government what the concrete consequences of the amendments are for Dutch businesses involved in imports and exports.
Can the government indicate what the actual consequences are for Dutch companies and entrepreneurs involved in imports and exports?
Kan de regering aangeven wat precies de daadwerkelijke gevolgen zijn voor Nederlandse bedrijven en ondernemers die met de in- en uitvoer te maken hebben?
Asks on which points member states, and the Netherlands in particular, have room to shape the implementation of the EU regulation.
The PvdA members wonder on which points there is room for member states, and the Netherlands in particular, to give their own interpretation to the implementation.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen zich af op welke punten er ruimte voor lidstaten, en in het bijzonder Nederland, bestaat om eigen invulling te geven aan de implementatie.
Asks which changes are not merely technical and questions the basis for new interest concepts and interest charging rules.
Can the government briefly and with references indicate which changes are not of a technical nature?
Kan de regering kort en met verwijzingen aangeven welke wijzigingen niet van technische aard zijn?
Asks about the effects of the bill on customs valuation, including royalties, the last-sale transaction, and the binding status of tariff information for applicants.
The CDA members ask the government to indicate what the consequences of this bill are for determining the customs value.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven wat de gevolgen van onderhavige wet zijn voor het vaststellen van de douanewaarde.

34436.s: The bill amends the Waterwet to set new safety standards for primary flood defences, aiming for at least a 1-in-100,000 per year death risk from flooding, and introduces new dike-section categories, annexes with norms and coordinates, and a ministerial regulation framework for hydraulic load and strength. It also removes the provincial approval requirement for water-board levy regulations, extends deadlines for assessment reports, and adds subsidy flexibility.
34436.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to a ministerial regulation by saying technical requirements need to be specified at a lower level, and the removal of approval by citing reduction of administrative burden agreed with the provinces.
q: The technical requirements will be elaborated in a ministerial regulation, which will replace the existing statutory assessment instrument.
De technische eisen zullen worden uitgewerkt in een ministeriële regeling, die het bestaande wettelijke toetsinstrumentarium zal vervangen.
d: definition and delineation of dike sections and primary defences
rules for determining hydraulic load and strength of dike sections
safety norms for other than primary defences designated by AMvB
I, J (Art. 7.23) and I, K (Art. 7.24, vijfde lid, onder c)
subsidy programmes and designation of defences via general administrative order
p: Technical rules for hydraulic load and strength move from the statute into a ministerial regulation valid for up to twelve years, with reporting on assessments required.
I, K (Art. 7.24, vijfde lid, onder b)
Subsidy funds for water-board defence works may be spent on alternative measures and on national expenditure, with deviation from standard subsidy rules allowed.
Removal of the provincial approval requirement for water-board levy allocation regulations reduces interbestuurlijk toezicht.

parties: Asks about the relation to the Deltaprogramma, the division of responsibilities between water boards and Rijkswaterstaat, and why boundaries are set in the Act rather than lower regulation.
The VVD members want to know whether this bill changes the division of responsibility for dike sections between water boards and Rijkswaterstaat.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen weten of met dit wetsvoorstel de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling inzake de zorg voor dijktrajecten tussen waterschappen en Rijkswaterstaat wordt gewijzigd.
Questions the need for and risks of retroactive entry into force and asks about legal obligations and enforceability of the standards.
To what extent could entry into force with retroactive effect offer a solution for this?
In hoeverre zou inwerkingtreding met terugwerkende kracht hiervoor een oplossing kunnen bieden?
Opposes retroactive entry into force, notes the assessment instrument is missing, and asks for alternatives and for the Chamber to be informed of supporting reports and of ILT capacity.
The SP members oppose the proposal that the Act enter into force with retroactive effect.
De leden van de SP-fractie staan afwijzend tegenover het feit dat voorgesteld wordt om de wet met terugwerkende kracht in werking te laten treden.
Asks the government to clarify the legal meaning of the lower bound, following the Raad van State's criticism, and asks about the readiness of the assessment instrument.
The CDA members ask the government to clarify what legal significance the lower bound, or failure to meet it, has.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om te verduidelijken welke juridische betekenis de ondergrens of het niet voldoen daaraan heeft.
Asks whether the liability of public managers for defects amounts to a risk liability far exceeding ordinary fault liability and what alternatives exist.
Does the government agree that such risk liability goes much further than ordinary fault-based liability for unlawful acts?
Deelt de regering de mening dat zo’n risicoaansprakelijkheid veel verder gaat dan de gewone schuldaansprakelijkheid uit onrechtmatige daad?
Questions whether placing risk liability for failures of unknown cause on water boards is appropriate and how their financial capacity will be protected.
These members ask whether it is appropriate to place this burden entirely on the shoulders of water boards.
Deze leden vragen of het gepast is om deze last (geheel) op de schouders van waterschappen te leggen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft amendment of the Waterwet setting new safety standards for primary flood defences, recommending the lower bounds per dike section be written into law and that the minister's power to deviate be justified and safeguard the basic protection level; it advised not to submit the bill until these points were addressed. The minister's reply states the advice was followed: lower bounds are now in annex III, the deviation power was deleted, the implementation timeline and retroactivity were justified, and the definition of overstromingskans was aligned.
concerns: Lower bounds per dike section should be legally anchored in an annex to the Act rather than derived via a calculation factor, to avoid confusion and protect safety.
The calculation factor linking signalling standards to lower bounds may yield weaker protection than the actual calculated values and is not clearly justified.
The ministerial power to deviate from lower bounds must be justified and the basic protection level must be guaranteed in the statutory text itself.
The justification for the deviation power and the concrete circumstances warranting it need clearer explanation.
The feasibility of the 2017 start date for the new norms and assessment instruments needs further explanation.
Retroactive effect requires justification and consideration of less intrusive alternatives such as postponing the reporting obligation.

The explanatory memorandum should clarify the calculation steps for signalling standards and the legal consequences of falling below lower bounds, and align the definition of overstromingskans with the bill text.

34445.s: The bill amends the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg to clarify that the Minister of VWS, not the NZa, sets the regulatory frameworks by ministerial regulation, removes the Minister's directive power over the NZa, and moves sector-specific market supervision (dominance and merger control) from the NZa to the Autoriteit Consument en Markt. It also makes healthcare performance descriptions and tariffs free by default, subject to ministerial regulation designating regulated sectors, and lets the ACM impose extra conditions on healthcare mergers.
34445.j: The memorandum justifies the shift by arguing that combining regulation and supervision in the NZa undermines its independence, and that deregulation with a 'free unless regulated' model and stronger market supervision by the ACM will benefit patients and insurers while keeping parliamentary involvement through voorhang.
q: To break this undesirable situation, from now on not the NZa but the Minister of VWS will set the regulatory frameworks.
Om deze ongewenste situatie te doorbreken, zal voortaan niet de NZa maar de Minister van VWS de reguleringskaders vaststellen.
d: designation of cruciale zorg and availability contribution eligibility
designation of care forms subject to prestatie and tariff regulation
rules for experiments allowing deviation from tariffs and prestatiebeschrijvingen
designation of single billing provider for joint care delivery
rules on availability contribution amount and grounds for ambtshalve application
p: The Minister's power to issue individual-case instructions to the NZa is limited and the Minister's directive power over the NZa is removed, shifting regulatory design from the independent regulator to the ministry.

Prestatiebeschrijvingen become free by default, with the ministry deciding by regulation which care is regulated, reducing statutory protection of patients and insurers while expanding ministerial discretion.
Market-power supervision and merger review move from the sector regulator NZa to the ACM, changing the institutional venue of oversight.
The NZa must report to the Minister with an accountant's statement on compliance with its decisions, a new accountability channel to the executive rather than to parliament.

parties: Wants effective supervision and enforcement of public conditions remaining when services are deregulated, e.g. against fraud and irregularities.
These members state that sufficient safeguards must remain to effectively supervise public conditions and to act effectively where necessary, for example in cases of fraud and irregularities.

Deze leden stellen vast dat er voldoende waarborgen moeten blijven om effectief toezicht te houden op publieke randvoorwaarden en om effectief op te treden indien dat noodzakelijk blijkt, bijvoorbeeld in het geval van fraude en onrechtmatigheden.
Worries about regulatory capture of the NZa, doubts about benefits of free tariffs given dental sector experience, and asks how parliament can keep its controlling role.
How is it ensured that the House can sufficiently perform its controlling task?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat de Kamer haar controlerende taak voldoende kan uitvoeren?
Opposes transfer of supervision to the ACM as a step toward market forces, and questions whether ministerial regulations rather than AMvB let parliament and the Council of State fulfil their roles.
Why for such essential matters is an AMvB not chosen, whereby both the Council of State and parliament can better fulfil their role?
Waarom wordt bij zulke wezenlijke zaken niet gekozen voor een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB), waarbij zowel de Raad van State als het parlement hun rol beter kunnen vervullen?

Asks how the NZa keeps sufficient distance from the field and its independence when the ministry sets frameworks, and why ministerial regulations rather than AMvB are used; also asks about enforcement, macro-cost control and the consumer's protection.
Can the government provide the House with an overview of this?
Kan de regering de Kamer hiervan een overzicht doen toekomen?
Supports clear task division but wants close parliamentary involvement through pre-consultation procedures and ministerial changes at a measured pace.
They therefore attach importance to close involvement of parliament through pre-consultation procedures and ministerial amendments.
Zij hechten dan ook aan een nauwe betrokkenheid van het parlement via voorhangprocedures en ministeriële wijzigingen.
Worries that free performance agreements will not formally strengthen the patient's position and that transparency and comparability for patients may suffer.
However, the PvdA members also see that within the power triangle of patient-provider-insurer, the patient's position is not formally strengthened by the proposed amendment.

Echter zien de leden van de fractie van de PvdA ook dat binnen de machtsdriehoek van patiënt-zorgaanbieder-zorgverzekeraar, de positie van de patiënt door de voorgenomen wijziging niet formeel wordt versterkt.

Opposes further free tariffs and performance; argues they reduce transparency, empower insurers over duty of care, and that the NZa should be more independent of the ministry, questioning the ministry's pre-publication review of NZa reports.
The SP members have no need for further free tariffs and performance because they see that this actually reduces transparency.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben geen behoefte aan verdere vrije tarieven en prestaties omdat zij zien dat hiermee juist transparantie afneemt.

Questions whether the move to free tariffs truly increases market competition, objects to shifting AMvB regulation to ministerial regulations that limit parliamentary involvement, and questions the weak evidence base and the shifting of NZa roles.
Does the government agree that by converting an AMvB into a ministerial regulation, the involvement of the House of Representatives is limited?
Deelt de regering de mening dat door deze omzetting van een AMvB naar ministeriele regeling de betrokkenheid van de Tweede Kamer wordt beperkt?
Asks whether abolishing the performance requirement is necessary, its effect on risk equalisation, administrative burden and comparability of quality measurement.
Can it be substantiated again why abolishing the performance requirement is necessary and can lead to more innovation?
Kan nogmaals worden onderbouwd waarom het afschaffen van de prestatievereiste noodzakelijk is en tot meer innovatie kan leiden?

Objects that the Minister is both budget-driven and market-shaping, that the shift from 'regulated unless' to 'free unless' is adopted before feasibility of public safeguards is tested, and that NZa lacks enforcement tools.
Does the government agree that it is important to test the feasibility of regulatory criteria before creating the possibility of deregulation?
Is de regering het met de GroenLinks-fractie eens dat het belangrijk is om de uitvoerbaarheid van reguleringscriteria te toetsen voordat de mogelijkheid tot deregulering wordt gecreëerd?

Worries that deregulation without clear results, with macro-cost recovery from the whole sector, and unclear NZa supervision will harm patients, weaken rechtmatigheid checks and enable arbitrary contracting; asks for independent evidence and fusion scrutiny.
Does the government share the SP's view that the results of this bill need to be clear before it can be properly assessed whether the bill is desirable?
Deelt de regering de mening van de SP-fractie dat het nodig is om de resultaten van dit wetsvoorstel helder te hebben, alvorens goed ingeschat kan worden of dit wetsvoorstel wenselijk is of niet?

Asks how the division between ministerial policy and NZa execution will work, whether the NZa's independent position is preserved, and whether the new arrangement creates confusion for insurers and providers.
Can the government explain what it regards as policy and what as execution in this light?
Kan de regering toelichten wat zij in dit licht ziet als beleid en wat als uitvoering?

Welcomes reversing the prohibition-to-obligation shift and innovation room, but asks for clarity on the difference between the experiment article and the free performance and whether the five-year term and lack of evaluation requirement are adequate.
That this amendment note reverses the shift from a prohibition system to an obligation system pleases the CDA members.
Dat deze nota van wijziging de overgang van een verbodsstelsel naar een gebodsstelsel ongedaan maakt, stemt de leden van de CDA-fractie positief.

Questions the necessity of reversing the shift and asks how the NZa will assess and decide whether to include a voluntary free performance in regular regulation, and whether an evaluation should be added.
At the same time, the D66 members favour removing unnecessary barriers to healthcare innovation and tailored care where possible.
Tegelijkertijd zijn de leden van de D66-fractie er voorstander van om onnodige drempels voor zorginnovaties en maatwerk waar mogelijk weg te nemen.

Worries that the minister would set tariffs under budget pressure, asks whether an independent body can still verify tariffs, and questions whether the new instrument adds anything beyond existing options.
Is it not undesirable for the Minister to have to decide on the level of tariffs when budgetary frameworks are under pressure?
Is het niet onwenselijk dat de Minister een beslissing moet nemen over de hoogte van de tarieven, als de budgettaire kaders knellen?

Argues the voluntary free performance undermines the claimed prohibition system because it allows unregulated performances without prior NZa review, and asks how a ministerial regulation can carry these safeguards and whether time-limited effects can be extended indefinitely.

These members ask in what sense there is a prohibition system if the third amendment note also introduces a voluntary free performance instrument that in principle offers the same possibilities to use free performances not described in advance by the NZa.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen op welke wijze er sprake is van een verbodsstelsel, als de derde nota van wijziging ook een instrument van voorlopig vrije prestatie introduceert waarmee in principe dezelfde mogelijkheden bestaan om vrije prestaties te hanteren die niet vooraf door de NZa zijn beschreven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill reshaping the Dutch healthcare market regulator (NZa), moving market-regulation tasks to the Minister of VWS and market supervision to the ACM, and questioned whether market-making functions and ACM powers are adequately safeguarded. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice on deleting the ministerial-regulation clause in Article 48(4) Wmg and clarifies the other points, with changes made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Transfer of regulatory tasks from the independent NZa to the Minister raises whether market-making function is adequately guaranteed, which the government addressed by clarifying the separation between framework-setting and individual decisions.
The ministerial regulation power in Article 48(4) Wmg to set rules on determining significant market power was unnecessary and was deleted, as the ACM already has such powers under other legislation.
Overlap between Article 2(3)-(4) Wmg and Article 56b Wmg on designation of care forms and institutions was to be resolved by moving designation to an AMvB and removing duplicate delegations.

Explanatory memorandum on availability contributions as state aid under the EU SGEI Decision needed clearer overcompensation control; government adjusted the general part but disagreed on the degree of verification required.
Clarification that the macro-containment levy may not be differentiated among provider categories was added to the bill text, while other drafting remarks were adopted except one on recovery powers.

34454.s: The bill removes refugee permit holders (vergunninghouders) as a mandatory priority category in the Housing Act 2014 and adds a duty for municipalities to record in their housing ordinance how they meet the statutory housing quota for permit holders. It also adds temporary shelter residents and informal carers to the urgent-priority groups in article 12.
34454.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by saying municipalities must keep meeting the quota and that other forms of housing for this group will spare regular applicants on the social housing market.
q: That is why it is proposed to add a fourth paragraph to article 12, which ensures that municipalities, now that permit holders are no longer a mandatory priority group, record how they give effect to the quota.

Daarom wordt voorgesteld om aan artikel 12 een vierde lid toe te voegen, waarmee wordt geborgd dat gemeenten, nu vergunninghouders geen verplichte voorrangsgroep meer zijn, vastleggen hoe aan de taakstelling invulling wordt gegeven.
d: how the municipality meets the housing quota for permit holders, recorded in the housing ordinance
p: Removing permit holders as a mandatory priority group leaves municipalities more discretion over housing allocation, though the new fourth paragraph requires them to record their approach in the housing ordinance.

parties: Supports leaving the housing priority decision to municipalities so local circumstances are respected, and asks how municipalities will be informed so they can decide on their own ordinance.
The discussion on how this is shaped belongs in municipal politics, so that local circumstances are respected.
De discussie over de vormgeving daarvan hoort thuis bij de gemeentelijke politiek, zodat recht wordt gedaan aan de lokale omstandigheden.
Worried that removing the statutory urgency arrangement without concrete commitments to expand affordable housing leaves municipalities with an unresolved obligation; asks how they see the task.

The PvdA members ask the government how it sees the task of municipalities if measures are taken to adjust the statutory urgency designation but not to bring the still-necessary expansion of housing supply closer.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering hoe zij de opgaaf van gemeenten voor zich ziet als er wel maatregelen worden genomen om de wettelijke urgentieaanwijzing aan te passen maar niet om de nog steeds noodzakelijke uitbreiding van het woningaanbod dichterbij te brengen.
Says the bill does not solve the housing shortage and asks the government to withdraw it; raises questions about the effects on the waiting lists and the rights of people in shelters.
Removing the priority does not help house permit holders, does not help increase the affordable stock of social rental homes, and does not help regular applicants find an affordable rental home.

Het schrappen van de voorrang helpt niet bij het huisvesten van vergunninghouders, helpt niet bij het vergroten van de betaalbare voorraad sociale huurwoningen en helpt niet om reguliere woningzoekenden een betaalbare huurwoning te helpen vinden.
Asks how the government will deal with municipalities that do not give priority to permit holders and how it supports municipalities in carrying out the housing task.

The CDA members would like to know how the government intends to deal with municipalities that do not wish to give priority to allocating rental homes to permit holders and therefore cannot meet the target.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vernemen graag hoe de regering denkt om te gaan met gemeenten die geen prioriteit aan de toewijzing van huurwoningen aan vergunninghouders wensen te geven en daardoor de taakstelling niet kunnen realiseren.
Asks whether the government will act against municipalities that intend to continue giving priority to permit holders despite the change, and questions the cost and land-policy effects.

The PVV members want to know whether the government disapproves of the intention of many municipalities to continue the priority housing policy for permit holders and whether the government will tackle this practice.

De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten of de regering het voornemen van veel gemeenten om toch door te gaan met het voorrangsbeleid van huisvesting voor vergunninghouders afkeurt en of de regering deze praktijk aan gaat pakken.
Considers removing the urgency status unwise, shifts the problem onto municipalities, and worries about segregation and the later flow of permit holders into regular social housing.
The D66 members are concerned that the bill shifts the national government's problems onto the municipalities.
De leden van de D66-fractie maken zich zorgen, dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel problemen van het Rijk neerlegt bij de gemeenten.
Asks what instruments the minister keeps if a municipal council says it has done enough but cannot meet the target, and whether the new accountability duty is as effective as the priority rule.
But what instruments does the Minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs have under this new provision if the municipal council believes it has done enough and cannot fulfil the target?
Maar welke instrumenten heeft de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst met deze nieuwe bepaling als de gemeenteraad van mening is dat zij voldoende heeft gedaan en de taakstelling niet kan vervullen?
Asks the government to respond to the Council of State's criticism that the bill creates a distinction between permit holders and regular applicants contrary to the equality principle.
With this bill, as the Council of State rightly notes, a distinction is made between housing for permit holders and housing for regular applicants.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt, zoals de Raad van State terecht constateert, een onderscheid gemaakt tussen de huisvesting voor vergunninghouders en de huisvesting voor reguliere woningzoekenden.
Asks why the duty to record municipal policy for permit holders is not tied specifically to the decision to give them priority, and why the wording is not simplified to 'voorzien in woonruimte'.
These members ask why the government does not specifically link the obligation to record policy on permit holders to the municipality's decision to grant permit holders a priority position.

Deze leden vragen waarom de regering de verplichting om beleid inzake vergunninghouders vast te leggen niet specifieke koppelt aan de beslissing van de gemeente om vergunninghouders een voorrangspositie toe te kennen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill abolishing the statutory priority for asylum residence-permit holders (vergunninghouders) in social housing allocation, but asked for better justification of the unequal treatment compared with regular housing seekers, including transition routes from alternative housing. The minister's nader rapport accepted the need for further justification, clarified that the new housing facilities serve both groups, and added a provision requiring municipal councils to specify how the housing obligation is met.
concerns: The Afdeling found the justification of the differential treatment of vergunninghouders under the equal treatment principle insufficient and asked for a fuller motivation, which the government addressed by arguing no direct distinction arises since the facilities serve both groups.
The Afdeling asked for attention to the temporary nature of alternative housing and transition options to regular housing, which the explanatory memorandum was supplemented to address.

The Afdeling noted the removal of the priority may make it harder for municipalities to meet their housing obligation, and the bill was amended to require councils to set out how the obligation is met.

34472.s: The bill amends the Dutch Public Health Act to set up a government-offered national vaccination programme and a population screening programme (including neonatal heel-prick screening) coordinated by the RIVM, with municipalities sharing implementation. It also transfers responsibility for controlling invasive exotic mosquito vectors from municipalities to the Minister, with new powers to inspect, order measures and destroy vectors, plus minor consequential amendments.
34472.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial powers by the need for rapid, expert action against exotic vectors because municipalities lack knowledge and experience and delay could harm public health.
q: Because municipalities have no knowledge or experience in carrying out control, this could delay action, which is undesirable in the public health interest.

Omdat er bij de gemeenten geen kennis en ervaring is met de uitvoering van de bestrijding kan dit leiden tot een vertraging in het handelen terwijl dit in het belang van de volksgezondheid ongewenst is.
d: designation of invasive exotic vectors and prevention measures
temporary designation of vectors in urgent cases
national vaccination programme and eligible groups
quality and programme requirements for municipal implementation
rules on carrying out population screening
p: The Minister, excluding the mayor, may inspect premises and goods on a plausible risk basis, take samples, order hygiene measures and destroy vectors, shifting powers away from municipalities.
Inspectors may enter any place, using force if necessary, to enforce the vector measures, subject to identification and necessity.
A ministerial regulation can designate vectors without an amvb in urgent cases, lapsing after six months.
The Minister may recover costs of vector measures from the natural or legal person concerned if that person was not voluntarily cooperative.

parties: Asks about the lengthy retention of screening data by RIVM, consent for research use, and the NVWA's enforcement powers and staffing.
The RIVM records personal data and screening results in a registration system.
Het RIVM registreert persoonsgegevens en de resultaten van de screeningsuitslagen in een registratiesysteem.
Welcomes the codification but asks how informed consent is verified, how low language proficiency is handled, and who has access to the Praeventis system.
How is it established whether parents have been sufficiently informed and have made a well-informed choice?
Hoe wordt vastgesteld of ouders voldoende zijn geïnformeerd en een goed geïnformeerde keuze hebben gemaakt?
Questions the balance between public health and privacy, the anonymity of data passed on without consent, and the scope of administrative enforcement orders against non-cooperation.
Which interests weigh more heavily under which circumstances?
Welke belangen wegen zwaarder onder welke omstandigheden?

Asks whether municipal policy freedom will create variation in quality, how compliance with quality requirements is measured and enforced, and which municipality bears responsibility for children in institutions.
These members ask whether this arrangement creates municipal policy discretion in implementation.
Deze leden vragen of met deze regeling gemeentelijke beleidsvrijheid ontstaat in de uitvoering.
Asks why the bill forecloses extending the vaccination programme to adults over 18 and how this affects financing of shingles and pneumococcal vaccines.
The 50PLUS member asks whether this means the national vaccination programme will no longer be extended to vaccinations for people over 18.
Het lid van de 50PLUS-fractie vraagt of dit betekent dat het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma niet meer zal worden uitgebreid met vaccinaties voor mensen ouder dan 18 jaar.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised the minister to proceed with the bill amending the Wet publieke gezondheid (vaccination programme, population screening, invasive exotic vectors), but asked for more substantive content in the bill on the Rijksvaccinatieprogramma and the municipal tasks, that population screening be set by general administrative order, and that the newborn heel-prick data exception to consent be specified more precisely. The minister's nader rapport accepts these points, moving the screening rules to an AMvB, amending article 12a, and making minor redactional changes.
concerns: Ministerial regulations were considered inappropriate for setting the content of the vaccination programme and municipal tasks, which should be regulated in the bill itself.
Defining population screening through a ministerial regulation was judged to require a policy choice at the level of a general administrative order.
Processing newborn heel-prick data without parental consent was held to require precise delimitation in the bill of who may receive data and when it must be deleted.
Redactional suggestions on the heading of paragraph 5, article 47a and article 65, and on the relation to the EU animal health regulation, were largely adopted or explained.

34490.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2014/104 on private enforcement of competition law into Dutch civil law, adding Book 6 rules on liability, presumption of harm, joint liability, limitation periods and passing-on defences, and amending the Code of Civil Procedure on access to evidence from competition authorities. It also gives the Authoriteit Consument en Markt a role in assisting courts on damages and makes its final infringement decisions binding proof in damages claims.
34490.j: The memorandum justifies the provisions as required transposition of the EU directive, noting that much already exists under Dutch civil procedure law.
q: The proposed Article 850 makes clear that safeguarding the effectiveness of public enforcement of competition law can be a compelling reason that, under the directive's proportionality test, may outweigh the interest served by disclosure.

Artikel 850 maakt duidelijk dat de waarborging van de doeltreffendheid van de publiekrechtelijke handhaving van het mededingingsrecht zo’n dwingende reden kan opleveren die in het kader van de door de richtlijn voorgeschreven evenredigheidstoets zwaarder kan wegen dan het belang dat wordt gediend met de disclosure .
p: The competition authority may assist courts at their request in determining damages, a discretionary advisory role for an oversight body.
Access to competition authority case files is restricted and made subject to judicial balancing against the authority's enforcement effectiveness, with the court deciding case by case.

parties: Asks whether the broad undertaking concept could widen parent-company liability beyond Dutch civil law, and about limitation periods and collective claims.
How does the government view the fear that applying this undertaking concept will lead to a broader interpretation of the attribution doctrine in Dutch civil law than is currently the case?
Hoe beschouwt de regering de angst dat het hanteren van dit ondernemersbegrip zal leiden tot een ruimere interpretatie van de toerekeningsleer onder het Nederlandse civiele recht dan nu het geval is?
Asks for a fuller list of the grounds on which access to documents in damages claims may be refused and whether privacy and competition interests should be written into law.
Does the government share the analysis, including in the Houthoff Buruma advice, that privacy interests and protection of competition cannot be regarded as weighty reasons?
Deelt de regering de analyse in onder meer het advies van Houthoff Buruma dat het privacybelang en de bescherming van de concurrentie niet als gewichtige redenen kunnen worden aangemerkt?
Asks why the government intends to extend the rules to purely national infringements in a separate bill and about the effect of the two exceptions on recovery of damages.
Nevertheless, these members already ask why this choice has been made.
Toch vragen voornoemde leden nu al waarom hiervoor wordt gekozen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Implementatiewet richtlijn privaatrechtelijke handhaving mededingingsrecht, which implements EU Directive 2014/104 on private antitrust damages claims, raising points on access to evidence, limitation periods, damages assistance by the ACM, and the suspensive effect of out-of-court dispute resolution. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, amending the bill on limitation (extension rather than interruption) and on ACM assistance, while retaining an extension mechanism it argues achieves the same result as suspension.
concerns: Access to evidence must implement the directive's requirement to weigh whether public enforcement effectiveness should be safeguarded, not mandate safeguarding it always.

Limitation period extension does not fully replicate the directive's suspension rule ending at least one year after the infringement procedure; government kept extension but added a one-year addition.
Out-of-court dispute resolution should suspend rather than interrupt limitation periods; government adopted extension mechanism matching suspension in result.
Directive article 5(5) on the interest of undertakings in preventing damages claims is not addressed; explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
ACM assistance on damages quantification at the court's request was not implemented; a new third paragraph in article 44a Rv was added.
Minimum five-year limitation period under directive article 10(3) needed clarification; explanatory memorandum and bill were adjusted.
Redactional remarks on article 193m(4), article 193t(2) wording and article 847 were noted for correction.

34508.s: The bill amends the Gemeentewet, Provinciewet and Waterschapswet so that municipalities, provinces and water boards can no longer levy precariobelasting on networks and works of general utility such as water, electricity, gas and heat infrastructure. It adds transitional rules allowing bodies that levied this tax in 2015 to keep doing so at no more than their 10 February 2016 rate until 1 January 2027, with recalculation rules for boundary changes.
34508.j: The memorandum justifies the abolition as easier to arrange within a broader reorientation of local taxation and cites rising use of the tax and pressure from parliament, and it frames the transitional rate cap as preventing revenue increases during the transition.
q: This bill aims to restrict the power to levy precariobelasting so that no precariobelasting can be levied on networks.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe de heffingsbevoegdheid voor de precariobelasting zodanig te beperken dat geen precariobelasting meer kan worden geheven ter zake van netwerken.
p: Removes the power of municipalities, provinces and water boards to levy precariobelasting on listed utility networks, narrowing subnational fiscal discretion rather than expanding executive power.
Transitional rules let bodies that levied the tax in 2015 continue at capped rates until 1 January 2027, with a defined recalculation formula after boundary changes.

parties: Asks how many municipalities use the alternative private-law and permit routes and whether the costs would still be passed on to all customers in the supply area.
To what extent do these two options have the same effect as precario levies, in that the costs are passed on in the utilities' tariffs so that all customers in the supply area pay?

In hoeverre is er bij deze twee mogelijkheden sprake van eenzelfde effect als bij de precariobelasting, in die zin dat de kosten worden doorberekend in de tarieven van de nutsbedrijven, waardoor alle klanten in het verzorgingsgebied meebetalen?

Supports abolition because the levy is opaque and shifts costs onto residents of municipalities that do not levy it, but questions whether utilities will actually lower tariffs and whether municipalities can recoup lost revenue through other charges.
This leads the members speaking to the conviction that the part of the precario levy covered by this bill should indeed be abolished.
Dit brengt de aan het woord zijnde leden tot de overtuiging dat het deel van de precariobelasting waar het voorliggend wetsvoorstel op ziet, inderdaad afgeschaft dient te worden.
Opposes municipal precario levies in principle but is concerned about lost municipal budgets and asks why there is no compensation and what extra burden the alternative recovery routes impose.
These members ask why this was chosen and what options the government sees to still compensate municipalities.
Zij vragen zich af waarom hiervoor is gekozen en welke mogelijkheden de regering ziet om gemeenten alsnog te compenseren.

Endorses the principle that residents without democratic voting rights should not be indirectly taxed by another body, but asks how the transition rule and its wording were communicated and why it refers to levies 'in' rather than 'over' the year.

These members endorse the starting point of this bill, that it is undesirable for citizens to be indirectly drawn via a neighbouring municipality's precario levy into a levy by a body in which they have no democratic vote.

Deze leden onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel, dat het onwenselijk is dat burgers via de heffing van precariobelasting door een naburige gemeente indirect worden betrokken in een heffing van een bestuurslichaam ten aanzien waarvan zij geen democratisch stemrecht hebben.

Asks what consultation took place with municipalities and utilities, whether hardship exemptions are relevant, why 2027 was chosen, and wants data on the share of revenue from utility networks to assess the bill's necessity.
With this, however, these members cannot verify whether the utility sector's claim that it faces increasingly strong precario levies is correct, and if so, to what extent.

Daarmee kunnen deze leden echter niet staven of de bewering van de nutssector dat zij in sterk toenemende mate geconfronteerd worden met de heffing van precariobelasting klopt, en zo ja, in welke mate.

Questions whether national restriction fits the decentralisation agenda and argues that municipal councils should judge and control such levies, and objects that the transition rule excludes municipalities not yet levying precario.
Can the government explain how this statutory restriction on precario levies fits with the decentralisation movement this cabinet has launched?
Kan de regering uitleggen hoe deze wettelijke beperking van de heffing van precariobelasting zich verhoudt tot de beweging van decentralisatie die dit kabinet heeft ingezet?

Favours expanding local tax powers and questions why the first change narrows them; argues the real problem is cost pass-through and asks why a cap on pass-through is not chosen over a ban, and whether transition terms match the minister's letters.
The real problem, in the view of the SGP members, is that utility companies pass the precario levy on to all customers.
Het eigenlijke probleem is naar de mening van de leden van de SGP-fractie dat de nutsbedrijven de precariobelasting doorberekenen aan alle afnemers.

Asks whether the bill will open budget gaps for municipalities, whether it works as a hidden savings measure, and whether the government will compensate municipalities, for example via the municipal fund.
Is the government willing to compensate municipalities in future for the income they lose, for example by appropriately raising the municipal fund?
Is de regering bereid om gemeenten in de toekomst te compenseren voor de door hen misgelopen inkomsten, bijvoorbeeld door het gemeentefonds passend te verhogen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in 2012 that the bill limiting municipal, provincial and water board precario levies on utility networks (gas, electricity, water) was not shown to be necessary and risked a mere shift of burdens, and urged reconsideration of financial relations, the telecom-sector alternative, state aid and transitional law. The government's 2016 reply accepted the redrafting on state aid, terminology and drafting, but rejected the telecom-model alternative and the referent date for transition, justifying the bill as necessary to curb rising, poorly visible levies.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of the bill not demonstrated and doubted it would reduce burdens rather than shift them to other levies.
The Afdeling argued the democratic-legitimacy objection to precario levies applies to many taxes, so it lacks force; the government maintained the objection is specific to utility networks.

The Afdeling advised the bill be considered in light of Financiële-verhoudingswet articles 2 and 8, including possible adjustment of the municipal fund distribution key; the government argued Article 2 creates no automatic compensation duty and rejected changing the fund distribution.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address possible cross-border state aid; the government added a state aid section.
The Afdeling advised replacing the term vrijstelling with beperking van de heffingsbevoegdheid and making redactional corrections, which were adopted.
The Afdeling advised using the bill's entry into force as the reference date for the transitional period; the government deviated to avoid announcement effects.

The Afdeling proposed aligning the bill with the telecom-sector model of a statutory tolerance duty with compensation; the government rejected this as far-reaching and conflict-prone for utility networks with natural monopolies.

34517.s: The bill proposes adding a constitutional right to a fair trial before an independent and impartial judge within a reasonable time to Article 17 of the Dutch Constitution. It also seeks to anchor the associated right of access to a court in the Constitution, implementing a parliamentary motion and the State Commission's advice.
34517.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need to give individual legal protection constitutional status, following the State Commission and a parliamentary motion, and notes existing statutory and case-law guarantees.

parties: Asks how the new fair-trial right relates to the general constitutional provision and the nature of the right, and how it affects legal aid, and whether combining judgeship with a parliamentary seat is acceptable.
The VVD members would welcome a response from the government.
Gaarne krijgen de leden van de VVD-fractie een reactie van de regering.
Asks whether the fair and public hearing principle should move to chapter 1 and extend to the Council of State's administrative court, and why the Seventh Protocol is not ratified.
It seems to these members that the provision of article 121 is mainly fundamental-rights in character.
Het komt deze leden voor dat de bepaling van artikel 121 voornamelijk grondrechtelijk van karakter is.

Argues the right would carry more weight if laws could be fully tested against it, questions compulsory mediation and cuts to legal aid that may keep people from court, and asks about proportionality review.
Can the government at least indicate to what extent it shares the view that the proposed right gains merely symbolic value if Dutch laws cannot be tested against this fundamental right?

Kan de regering niet op z’n minst aangeven in hoeverre het de mening deelt dat het voorgestelde recht op een eerlijk proces een meer symbolische waarde krijgt als Nederlandse wetten niet aan dit grondrecht kunnen worden getoetst?

Supports the right but asks whether it covers all areas of law including administrative fines and public prosecution settlements, whether the test ban should be lifted, and whether the right to access a court is a positive duty on the legislator.

Welcomes the anchoring but questions whether the right is absolute, how it relates to European treaty rights, the effect of legal aid and court fee cuts on reasonable time, and the mediation bill that conditions access to court.
These members do have questions about the current proposal to amend article 17 of the Constitution.
Deze leden hebben wel vragen over het huidige voorstel tot verandering van artikel 17 van de Grondwet.
Supports anchoring the fair-trial principle in the constitution and asks whether the right is undermined by procedural hurdles and whether limitation grounds should be named specifically.

Would specifically naming the grounds on which limitation is possible not strengthen the fair process, so that it is clear to everyone that restriction of access to court is only possible for very well-founded reasons?

Zou juist het specifiek benoemen van de gronden op basis waarvan beperking mogelijk is niet het eerlijke proces kunnen versterken, zodat voor iedereen duidelijk is dat slechts om zeer gegronde redenen een inperking van het recht op toegang tot de rechter mogelijk is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises sending the bill to parliament to enshrine a fundamental right to a fair trial in the Constitution, but asks for clarification on its practical effect, its relation to the constitutional limitation system, the rights of the defence, the right to an effective remedy, and its application during states of emergency. The government's reply largely adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, defends its choice of wording over the Staatscommissie majority, and declines some suggestions such as adding an effective-remedy clause or a limitation clause.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to clarify whether the provision only fixes a minimum protection level or requires changes to existing legislation and case law; the government clarifies it fixes the ECHR Article 6 minimum and current law complies.

The Afdeling asks how the right relates to the constitutional limitation system and whether a limitation clause should be added; the government holds that not every constitutional right has one and declines to add it, while clarifying the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling doubts that specific fair-trial rights of the defence in criminal proceedings (ECHR Art. 6(2) and (3)) can simply be read into the general provision; the government maintains they are implicit in the concept of a fair trial and clarifies the memorandum accordingly.
The Afdeling advises explicitly including the right to an effective remedy; the government considers it unnecessary given the broad scope of the provision, though it supplemented the memorandum.

The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum address whether the right may be derogated from under Article 103 of the Constitution during a state of emergency, given Article 113; the government adds a separate paragraph explaining that rights to a judge remain in force.

The Afdeling asks for justification of the chosen wording and its differences from the Staatscommissie majority proposal; the government explains its preference for the ECHR-based terminology and supplements the memorandum.

34544.s: The bill amends the Aliens Act 2000 to lengthen the period within which family members of an asylum permit holder can be reunited (from three to six months) and to allow a decision on a provisional residence permit application for such family members within nine months, in deviation from the general decision period. It also contains two technical renumbering provisions linked to a separate pending bill on refusal of entry.
34544.j: The memorandum justifies the longer deadlines by pointing to the need for timely family reunification decisions and reduced risk of penalty payments, not by invoking new executive discretion.
q: It is proposed to add a paragraph to Article 2u of the Aliens Act 2000 providing that an application for a provisional residence authorisation for stay as a family member is decided within nine months.
Voorgesteld wordt aan artikel 2u van de Vw 2000 een lid toe te voegen waarin wordt geregeld dat op een aanvraag om verlening van een machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf voor verblijf als gezinslid

parties: Asks why the extension is needed given falling inflow and why three months is insufficient, and questions whether the extension should be temporary rather than standard.
Can the government explain why this amendment is needed, given the dramatically fallen asylum inflow and the forecasts in the Ministry of Security and Justice budget?

Kan de regering toelichten waarom onderhavige wetswijziging nodig is, gezien de spectaculair gedaalde asielinstroom en de prognoses zoals opgenomen in de begroting van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie?
Welcomes the longer window for refugees but asks about the decision-period safeguards, maatwerk and whether late applications get priority.
Can the government explain how, in the assessment process, it is ensured that there is room for tailored judgement?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe in het proces van de beoordeling, wordt gewaarborgd dat er ruimte is voor maatwerk?
Asks whether a hardship (verschoonbaarheid) test is still possible under the bill and wants to know how late or incorrect applications were handled.
Moreover, there will always be people who for individual reasons did not submit their application on time, but under the current bill no hardship assessment seems possible anymore.

Daarnaast zullen er altijd mensen blijven die om individuele redenen hun aanvraag niet op tijd hebben ingediend maar met het huidige wetsvoorstel lijkt er geen verschoonbaarheidstoets meer mogelijk te zijn.
Asks for the statutory basis for exceptional late requests after six months and whether the government will critically check that decision periods are not maximised.
They ask the government for the statutory basis in Dutch law if there is a wish to submit a request after the six-month period has expired.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering naar de wettelijke grondslag in de Nederlandse wetgeving indien de wens bestaat na het verstrijken van de termijn van zes maanden een verzoek in te dienen.

Views the nine-month decision period with astonishment, notes the government dismissed IND staff while citing capacity limits, and asks for the statutory hardship exception the Raad van State recommended.
These members ask the government to set out the statutory basis for this.
Deze leden vragen de regering de wettelijke grondslag hiervoor vast te leggen.
Views the bill as a loosening of family reunification policy and will vote against it, asking for the policy to be abolished rather than relaxed.
They will therefore vote against the bill.
Zij zullen daarom tegen het wetsvoorstel stemmen.
Asks why no statutory basis for exceptions was created as the Raad van State advised, and what conditions allow challenging IND decisions under article 8 ECHR.
Can the government indicate which conditions must be met in order to challenge an IND decision under article 8 ECHR?
Kan de regering aangeven aan welke voorwaarden voldaan moet worden teneinde een beslissing van de IND ex artikel 8 van het EVRM aan te vechten?
Asks why the government departs from the ACVZ view that the three-month term serves urgency, and raises the risk of a pull effect from a generic extension.
They ask why, with this bill, the government departs from its earlier substantive judgement and why a deviation could be justified solely on workload grounds.
Zij vragen waarom de regering met dit wetsvoorstel afwijkt van haar eerdere inhoudelijke oordeel en waarom een afwijking enkel op grond van werkdruk te rechtvaardigen zou zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the bill extending the nareis application deadline from three to six months, but recommended a statutory basis to deviate from the deadline in exceptional cases and clarification of how information and communication will be improved. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the revised bill and the redactional and transitional remarks, with the advice on the statutory exception and communication addressed in the amended explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling advised creating a statutory basis to deviate from the application deadline in exceptional cases, since without it verschoonbaarheid would no longer be assessed.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain how information and communication will be improved, as the stated main cause of late applications is inadequate information.
The Afdeling asked for an explanation of why phased entry into force under article II is needed, per aanwijzing 178.

34550-V.s: This bill fixes the 2017 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs at EUR 8,879.5 million in expenditure, in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2017. The attached tables set out spending and revenue by policy article, and the explanatory memorandum extract covers migration, consular service, EU coordination and related commitments.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2017 attached to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34553.s: The bill makes a range of technical and substantive amendments to Dutch tax laws for fiscal year 2017, including changes to the eigenwoningregeling, business succession relief, excise duties, and enforcement powers of the tax authority. It mostly adjusts statutory rules directly, with few delegations to lower-level rule-making.
34553.j: The memorandum justifies the discretion over advance payments as needed for uniform application and notes that information sharing will be proportionate and targeted.
q: To enable uniform application of both measures, the cabinet chooses to also give the measure in the Awir the form of a discretionary power.
Om uniforme toepassing van beide maatregelen te kunnen bewerkstelligen, kiest het kabinet ervoor om de maatregel in de Awir ook vorm te geven als een bevoegdheid.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel K / ARTIKEL XII, onderdeel I (Wet IB 2001 art. 7.2 etc.; Douane- en Accijnswet BES) — see ARTIKEL IX C
conditions and restrictions for biofuel/renewable fuel excise refund
ARTIKEL IX C (Wet op de accijns art. 71h, lid 7 and lid 6)
further rules for implementing excise refund on renewable fuels
p: ARTIKEL XIII, onderdeel B (Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen art. 16 lid 5)
The tax authority's power to revise advance payments is limited after five years, but the power to revise upward remains.[1]
ARTIKEL XV (Wet aanpak fraude toeslagen en fiscaliteit, art. III C, Awir art. 16 lid 8)
The tax authority may refuse advance payments to applicants whose household members committed offences, with information sharing with other bodies under convenants, subject to proportionality.[2]

parties: Asks whether the reparation of the BOR goes further than needed and whether the government will reconsider the 5% exclusion, questioning the rule of law and legal certainty of retroactive changes.
Why does the reparation legislation go much further than necessary?
Waarom gaat de reparatiewetgeving veel verder dan nodig is?
Asks for advance access to the implementing decree on information sharing and for a broader reconsideration of the BOR.
They would therefore like to see the implementing decree on the General Act on income-dependent schemes in advance.
Zij zouden daarom graag van tevoren inzage krijgen in het Uitvoeringsbesluit Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Questions the broad sharing of citizens' data with unnamed public bodies and the omission of those bodies from the statute, which would bypass parliamentary debate.
These members fear that, without debate in the House, names of arbitrary administrative bodies will be included in the AMvB.
Deze leden vrezen dat straks, zonder een discussie in de Kamer, allemaal namen van willekeurige bestuursorganen in de AMVB worden opgenomen.
Criticises the retroactive BOR reparation as overreaching and inconsistent with tax practice, and questions the unfair transitional rules for gift exemptions.
Asks about legal certainty for taxpayers in choosing between light and heavy procedures and about the consequences of the five-year assessment term.
What do these differences mean for the legal certainty of the taxpayer?
Wat betekenen deze verschillen voor de rechtszekerheid van de belastingplichtige?
Asks about the effectiveness and annual cost of the BOR facility and whether new avoidance constructions may arise.
What is the effectiveness of the BOR, ask the members of the PVV faction.
Wat is de effectiviteit van de BOR, vragen de leden van de fractie van de PVV.
Considers the BOR reparation far too rigorous and asks for substantiation of the claimed revenue loss.
The members of the SGP faction are concerned that the proposed reparation legislation on the business succession scheme (BOR) is far too rigorous.
De leden van de SGP-fractie maken zich zorgen dat de voorgestelde reparatiewetgeving omtrent de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) veel te rigoureus is.
