v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the Overige fiscale maatregelen 2017 bill to parliament, but flags the unbalanced treatment of business succession (BOR) versus private assets in inheritance and gift tax and asks the government to reconsider the BOR in principle. The government replies that the bill only repairs the consequences of a Hoge Raad ruling, that a broader revision is for later, and it adopts the drafting suggestions on the wording 'belang' versus 'indirect belang' and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the BOR unbalanced compared with private inheritances and asks that the scheme be reconsidered in principle, which the government declines to do now.
The Afdeling asks that the term 'indirect belang' be used in article 35c(6) to avoid ambiguity, and the government clarifies the provision and explanatory memorandum accordingly.

34571.s: The bill amends the General Old Age Pensions Act (AOW) so that the single-person norm income support and related benefits can be paid to resistance participants and war victims living in non-treaty countries, and sets transitional rules so income support continues when a social security treaty is terminated or provisionally applied treaty ends. It is retroactive to 1 January 2016 and is largely a codification of benefit administration already applied by the SVB.
34571.j: The memorandum justifies the exception to export restrictions as a continuation of benefits already administered by the SVB since 1 January 2016, with the bill described as feasible and clearly defined.
q: The SVB has been implementing the proposed amendments since 1 January 2016 and has, on request, addressed their implementation.
De SVB voert de voorgestelde wijzigingen al sinds 1 januari 2016 uit en is op verzoek ingegaan op de uitvoering hiervan.
d: Artikel I.B (art. 33a, eerste lid, sub d.4°)
countries with a social security treaty or decision of an international organisation

parties: Welcomes the bill as fulfilling a wish supported across the House to make an exception for war victims to the AOW export restriction.
this fulfils a wish supported across the House to make an exception for war victims to the AOW export restriction.
hiermee wordt een kamerbrede wens ingewilligd om voor oorlogsgetroffenen een uitzondering te maken voor de exportbeperking AOW.
Asks whether net payments are unequal and how entitlement to the single-person AOW is checked in non-treaty countries, including whether the embassy monitors this.
How is it checked whether entitlement to the single-person AOW is still met in the non-treaty countries?
Hoe wordt gecontroleerd of nog steeds wordt voldaan aan het recht op alleenstaanden-AOW in de niet-verdragslanden?
Asks how the AOW will be applied in 2017 to four case types in Israeli-occupied territory, following press reports about implementation of the BEU law.
the members of the D66 faction ask how the AOW will be applied in 2017 to the following cases
hebben de leden van de D66-fractie de vraag hoe de AOW in 2017 wordt toegepast op de volgende casussen

34607.s: The bill makes numerous technical amendments across Dutch education laws (primary, secondary, vocational, higher education, and their BES equivalents) to align terminology and procedures with the General Administrative Law Act (Awb), such as replacing 'verzoek' with 'aanvraag' and removing deviations from Awb rules. It also removes several appeal routes against general binding regulations and an administrative appeal to provincial executives, and corrects minor technical errors.
34607.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical alignment with the Awb to ensure consistent terminology and procedures, with no substantive or implementation consequences.
q: These are various changes of a technical nature to better align the relevant provisions with the General Administrative Law Act (Awb).
Het betreft verschillende wijzigingen van technische aard om de desbetreffende bepalingen beter te laten aansluiten bij de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb).
p: Artikel I, onderdeel R (artikel 96g, vijfde lid, WVO); Artikel II, onderdeel X (artikel 140, vijfde lid, WPO); Artikel III, onderdeel W (artikel 134, vijfde lid, WEC); Artikel VII, onderdeel I (artikel 160, vijfde lid, WVO BES)

Removes the explicit right to appeal against municipal general binding regulations on equal treatment of public and private schools, relying instead on incidental review of individual decisions via the Awb.
Artikel I, onderdeel S (artikel 96k, derde lid, WVO)
Removes administrative appeal to provincial executive against decisions on excess-enrolment grants, replacing it with the standard objection and appeal route.
Artikel I, onderdeel F, onder 2 (artikel 27, vierde lid, WVO); Artikel I, onderdeel T (artikel 106, vierde lid, WVO)
Sets a shorter four-week decision period for school objections on admission or removal of pupils and removes some deviation provisions, with pupils and parents still heard before decision.

parties: CDA asks the government to explain why it does not share the researchers' view that administrative fines should be merely a supplement to existing instruments, and what the qualitative weighing of norms means.
These members ask whether the government can further explain why it does not share the researchers' view that the administrative fine would mainly be a supplement to the existing instruments.
Deze leden vragen of de regering nader kan toelichten waarom zij de mening van de onderzoekers niet deelt dat de bestuurlijke boete vooral een aanvulling op het bestaande instrumentarium zou zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with a bill that makes technical amendments to Dutch education laws to align them with the General Administrative Law Act (Awb), but criticises the choice to limit changes to technical adjustments and urges fuller alignment on subsidy rules, administrative fines and legal protection. The minister's reply accepts the redactional remarks and explains that the broader points on fines, subsidies and legal protection are not part of this technical bill, with the definition change on school governing bodies withdrawn.
concerns: The Afdeling's redactional remarks on the bill and explanatory memorandum were incorporated by the government.

The Afdeling asks for fuller alignment with the Awb on subsidy rules, administrative fines and legal protection rather than only technical changes; the government addresses these in the general part of the explanatory memorandum but does not change the bill's scope.

34620-X.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, raising total expenditure commitments and spending by roughly EUR 134.7 million and 82.3 million respectively through supplementary budget mutations across defence artikelen. It does not delegate rule-making power, create new executive discretion or alter oversight, and only sets budget amounts in thousands of euros with retroactive effect from 1 December 2016.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34634.s: This bill (Herstelwet financiële markten 2017) corrects gaps and omissions in earlier Dutch implementations of EU financial market rules, amending the Wft, Faillissementswet, Burgerlijk Wetboek, and accountancy laws. It makes technical changes such as redefining terms, adjusting supervisory and resolution powers of DNB, and clarifying cross-border supervision and resolution procedures.
34634.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical repairs of implementation gaps required to meet EU law and the European Commission's prior formal notice, with no added burdens.
q: The importance of prompt repair of defects and omissions in implementation is emphasised by the European Commission.
Het belang van een spoedig herstel van gebreken en omissies bij implementatie wordt benadrukt door de Europese Commissie.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel EE (Wft art. 3:279, derde lid)
rules on transfer or takeover of prudential supervision with other member states
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel X (Wft art. 3:261, derde lid)
term within which deposit guarantee compensation must be made available
p: Aligns DNB's power to impose prudential measures on banks and investment firms with EU criteria, including a probable breach within twelve months and results of the SREP evaluation.
Gives DNB explicit national power to impose measures to remove impediments to resolvability, on instruction of the Single Resolution Board where applicable.
Allows DNB to transfer or take over prudential supervision of banks through bilateral agreements with foreign supervisors, subject to conditions set by ministerial regulation.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel QQ and RR (Wft art. 3A:24, 3A:25, 3A:25a)

Lets DNB permanently write down capital instruments to zero without compensation, with a limited exception for claims challenging the lawfulness of the write-down and a power to later increase the reduced principal.

parties: Asks whether earlier legislation was sloppy, how repeats will be prevented, and what the Commission infringement procedure and information request concern, and whether lower regulation is consulted with the sector.
The VVD members have the impression that this involves a considerable number of errors and that earlier legislation was therefore sloppy.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben de indruk dat het hier gaat om een behoorlijke hoeveelheid fouten en dat de eerdere wetgeving dus slordig is geweest.
Asks why the Banking Recovery and Resolution Directive was implemented late and what was discussed with the European Commission about the capital requirements implementation.
They ask why there was such a delay.
Zij vragen waarom hier sprake van was.
Questions whether an omnibus repair act covering many implementing laws harms legislative clarity and asks about the pending Wft revision and how to prevent such volumes of amendments in future.
The CDA members ask the government about the desirability of a repair act covering so many implementing laws that the clarity of legislation is compromised.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering naar de wenselijkheid van een herstelwet die strekt over zoveel implementatiewetten dat de overzichtelijkheid van wetgeving in het gedrang komt.
Notes the explanatory memorandum is very brief, asks for policy changes and affected parties, and asks why no public consultation was held and why only DNB and AFM were consulted.
Why was it chosen not to consult other parties?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen om geen andere partijen te consulteren?

34652.s: The bill imposes an annual landlord contribution on owners of more than 50 rental dwellings to fund the Huurcommissie, and modernises it by letting it hear tenant complaints about landlord products and services and changing appointment procedures. It also requires the tax authority to share landlord data with the commission's board and requires an evaluation report within five years.
34652.j: The memorandum justifies the contribution by the need to fund the commission and by the larger number of landlord-related complaints, and justifies data sharing by proportionality and privacy safeguards.
q: These concern disputes arising from tenant complaints about the landlord's acts or omissions regarding products and services supplied by the landlord to the tenant.

Het betreft hier geschillen die voortvloeien uit klachten van de huurder over het handelen of nalaten van de verhuurder in het kader van de door de verhuurder geleverde producten en verrichte diensten aan de huurder.
d: calculation and levying of landlord contribution
p: Tax authority must transfer landlord identity, address and dwelling data to the Huurcommissie board for levying the contribution, with use limited to that purpose and data retained until the contribution is final.
Huurcommissie gains jurisdiction over tenant complaints about landlord conduct, while disputes reserved to the courts remain excluded and court review stays available.

The minister appoints commission members on the board's nomination after consultation with interest organisations, with a six-week decision deadline, and the minister's own veto on members is retained.

parties: Asks whether energy performance matters fall under the new tasks and how landlords in student cities are protected against no-cure-no-pay advisory firms.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill amending the Rent Price Act to further modernise the Rent Tribunal and introduce a landlord contribution.

De leden van VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel Wijziging van de Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte in verband met een verdere modernisering van de Huurcommissie en met de introductie van een verhuurderbijdrage.
Questions whether a landlord-funded model threatens the tribunal's independence and stable funding, and whether the polluter-pays logic holds given the cost distribution.
These members ask about the possibilities and risks that landlords could gain influence over the tribunal's performance via the Advisory Council or otherwise.
Daarom vragen deze leden naar de mogelijkheden en risico’s dat de verhuurders via de Raad van Advies of anderszins invloed krijgen op de taakuitoefening door de Huurcommissie.

Objects to cutting Huurcommissie funding, higher fees for tenants and landlords, the exclusion of liberalised-sector tenants, and asks how independence will be guaranteed when landlords finance the body.
The SP members ask how the government will guarantee the independence of the Huurcommissie.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen hoe de regering de onafhankelijkheid van de Huurcommissie zal waarborgen.

Supports mediation and the Council of State's advice on statutory delimitation, but questions the use of hardship clauses on fees and asks for a response to the Ronnes motion on reasonableness review.
The CDA members do ask, however, how conflicts over mediation are handled if, for example, the Huurcommissie considers mediation promising but one party does not.
Wel vragen deze leden zich af hoe omgegaan wordt met conflicten over de bemiddeling, als bijvoorbeeld de Huurcommissie de bemiddeling kansrijk acht, maar één van de partijen niet.
Asks why delimitation of the tribunal's competence is done by ministerial regulation, as flagged by the Council of State, and questions the basis of the fee levels and the pilot results.
Can the government explain why it chose to delimit the competences via a ministerial regulation?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom gekozen is voor het afbakenen via een ministeriële regeling?
Accepts modernisation but worries that landlord-borne costs undermine the tribunal's independent appearance and that woningcorporaties would effectively fund other landlords' disputes.
This landlord contribution detracts from the independent image of the Huurcommissie, so its rulings will be experienced as less reliable.
Deze verhuurderbijdrage doet afbreuk aan de onafhankelijke uitstraling van de Huurcommissie, waardoor de uitspraken als minder betrouwbaar zullen worden ervaren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill modernising the Huurcommissie (rent committee), introducing a landlord levy and mediation, and advised waiting for pilot evaluations, narrowing delegation, reconsidering the tiered fee criterion and justifying supervision powers. The minister's nader rapport largely accepted the advice on mediation rationale, delegation, consultation and supervision, but rejected reconsidering the fee criterion.
concerns: Scope of the Huurcommissie's competence should be set in the statute itself rather than delegated to a ministerial regulation, with only minor points delegated to an AMvB; the minister adopted this.
Mediation should be evaluated from the pilots before becoming a structural task, and legal obstacles to mediation addressed; the minister added evaluation support and argued no legal obstacles exist.

The arbitrary criterion for the higher fee for repeat losing landlords should be reconsidered; the minister declined, arguing the number of dwellings is not a discriminating criterion and a hardship clause exists.
Supervisory powers over landlords must be shown necessary and proportionate; the minister removed the supervision provision.
Consultation of umbrella organisations on the draft budget should be reconsidered as duplicative of the Raad van Advies; the minister removed the extra consultation.
Data protection (doelbinding) concerns about Tax Administration data reuse should be addressed in the explanatory memorandum; the minister added justification.
Redactional remarks including consistent terminology, article restructuring and deleting redundant provisions were adopted.

34730-V.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros as part of the Spring Memorandum. It sets the entry into force of the amendment as 1 June 2017 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We, with joint consultation of the States General, have seen fit and resolved
Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

34805.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Groningen, Haren and Ten Boer into a new municipality of Groningen, abolishing the three former municipalities and setting the boundaries per an attached map. It also sets transitional rules on tax collection, joint arrangements, utilities and safety-region membership, with entry into force by royal decree.
34805.j: The memorandum justifies the regular merger by the importance of broad support for the reorganisation and by following established procedures and criteria as closely as possible.
q: Also in view of the importance of the broadest possible support for the reorganisation, the government considers it appropriate to follow the established procedures and assessment criteria as precisely as possible.
Mede gelet op het belang van een zo breed mogelijk draagvlak voor de herindeling acht de regering het aangewezen de vastgestelde procedures en toetsingscriteria zo nauwkeurig mogelijk te volgen.
d: fixing the date the law enters into force

parties: The VVD asks whether other options were examined and whether Haren itself requested the reorganisation, given that the Haren council voted against it.
First, they note that this concerns a reorganisation initiated by the province, and not coming from the municipalities themselves.
Allereerst merken zij op dat het hier gaat om een herindeling die door de provincie is geïnitieerd, en niet vanuit de gemeenten zelf komt.
The CDA asks why the reorganisation advice and response note were not attached to the explanatory memorandum and were only published online rather than submitted to the House.
These members ask the government to still send the reorganisation advice and the accompanying response note to the House.
Deze leden vragen de regering het herindelingsadvies en de bijbehorende reactienota alsnog aan de Kamer toe te zenden.
D66 supports reorganisation in principle but questions limited local support in Haren and whether the procedure was careful, proper and lawful.
On the one hand there are concerns about the procedure followed. Has the government met the requirements of care, propriety and lawfulness?
Er zijn aan de ene kant zorgen over de gevolgde procedure. Is volgens de regering aan de vereisten van zorgvuldigheid, behoorlijkheid, en rechtmatigheid voldaan?
GroenLinks asks how residents and organisations were involved in the proposal and how residents of small villages will be informed and able to participate.
The SP notes that 74.5% of Haren voters opposed the reorganisation and argues reorganisations should happen only bottom-up with popular support.
According to these members, reorganisations should only take place from the bottom up, if the population supports them.
Herindelingen zouden volgens deze leden alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderaf, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
The ChristenUnie accepts the merger in principle but asks for clarification of how the Haren council reached its decision and what risks follow if the merger does not proceed.
Can the government further explain what risks are attached if this reorganisation does not go ahead?
Kan de regering nader toelichten welke risico's er aan verbonden zijn als deze herindeling geen doorgang zou vinden.

The SGP doubts that the reorganisation is truly voluntary and bottom-up, questions the provincial approach and the scope of the study, and asks whether Haren was given a real chance under its own policy.
For the SGP members, the starting point for reorganisations is that they take place voluntarily and from the bottom up.
Uitgangspunt bij herindelingen is voor de leden van de SGP-fractie dat deze vrijwillig en van onderop plaatsvinden.
50Plus asks how the advice and its preparation were procedurally tested, given claims that the province's conduct may not have been careful, proper or lawful.
there are well-founded reasons to doubt the care, propriety and lawfulness of the reorganisation procedure followed by the Provincial Executive.
er gegronde redenen zijn voor twijfel over de zorgvuldigheid, behoorlijkheid en rechtmatigheid van de door Gedeputeerde Staten gevolgde herindelingsprocedure.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against sending the bill merging Groningen, Haren and Ten Boer to parliament in its light-merger form, since Haren's refusal to consent would effectively give it a veto, and recommended a regular merger instead. The minister's reply accepts the advice, opts for a regular merger, and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly, so Groningen is also abolished.
concerns: The Afdeling found the reasoning that Haren would obtain a veto over the merger inconsistent with the consent criterion, and the government accepted that a regular merger should be chosen.
The Afdeling stressed that established procedures and assessment criteria must be applied precisely to give municipalities certainty about how the merger will be judged.

34814.s: The bill makes several purely technical, non-substantive amendments to the Dutch Animal Experiments Act (Wet op de dierproeven) to align its wording with EU Directive 2010/63/EU, such as adding 'wetenschappelijke' to the definition of animal experiment and correcting a primate-species reference. It also clarifies a project-licence compliance reference and replaces 'indien opportuun' with 'indien die geschikter is' in article 14.
34814.j: The memorandum justifies the wording changes as necessary to match the EU directive and remove ambiguity, and the immediate entry into force as implementing a binding EU legal act.
q: The changes to be made are all technical (not substantive) in nature.
De door te voeren wijzigingen zijn alle technisch (niet inhoudelijk) van aard.

34832.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Noordwijk and Noordwijkerhout into a new municipality named Noordwijk, effective on a date set by royal decree. It abolishes the two old municipalities, designates the new one as successor for several statutory transitional matters, and removes Noordwijkerhout from annexes of housing, judicial and safety-region laws.
q: This act enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: entry into force date set by royal decree

parties: The VVD has no comments or questions on the bill, which it views as a voluntary merger to strengthen administrative capacity.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
The CDA objects that the herindelingsadvies and the province's zienswijze were not attached to the explanatory memorandum sent to the House and asks for them to be transmitted.
These members are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Deze leden zijn van mening, dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
D66 notes the merger arose from the bottom up with majority votes in both municipalities and has no further questions at this stage.
They read that this reorganisation took place from the bottom up and the reorganisation advice was adopted by a majority of votes in both municipalities.
Zij lezen dat deze herindeling van onderop heeft plaatsgevonden en het herindelingsadvies in beide gemeenten met een meerderheid van stemmen is vastgesteld.
GroenLinks asks how residents, civil society and local politics were involved in the proposal and how accessibility of services will be guaranteed after the merger.

These members ask the government to explain again how residents, civil society organisations and local politics in the municipalities concerned were involved in the making of the municipal merger proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken is geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
The SP questions whether a majority of residents supports the merger, why no citizen consultation was held, and doubts whether the merger is truly voluntary given pressures on small municipalities.
According to these members, reorganisations should only take place from the bottom up, if there is support from the population.
Herindelingen zouden volgens deze leden alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderop, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
The ChristenUnie supports the proposed merger and has no further questions at this stage.
These members endorse the planned merger of these municipalities.
Deze leden onderschrijven de voorgenomen samenvoeging van deze gemeenten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised sending the bill merging Noordwijk and Noordwijkerhout to parliament, but asked for a clearer justification of the durability criterion, noting that a more durable single Duin- en Bollenstreek municipality was seen as not achievable in the near term. The minister responded by adding a supplementary passage in section 3.5 of the explanatory memorandum on the medium-term durability of the merger.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain more clearly how the merger meets the durability criterion in the medium term, given earlier statements that a more durable regional solution was not expected soon.

34940.s: The bill removes the maximum income limits in the Wet op de huurtoeslag so that housing allowance phases out over a longer income range, and ties the tenant's own contribution indexation to the lower of net social assistance and rent development. It also amends the Woningwet to refer to a government decree (AMvB) for the household income used in allocating housing.
34940.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB reference by saying it keeps the group eligible for appropriate allocation constant after removing the income limits, with the BTIV 2015 referring to the limits of article 14.
q: who qualify for a housing allowance within the meaning of that act and have a household income to be determined by that general administrative order
die in aanmerking komen voor een huurtoeslag in de zin van die wet en een bij die algemene maatregel van bestuur te bepalen huishoudinkomen hebben
d: household income criterion for allocating housing

parties: Supports the longer phase-out of the allowance and reduced poverty trap; asks for data on spending and beneficiary numbers without raising a check concern.
The VVD members endorse the purpose of the bill before us.
De leden van de VVD-fractie onderschrijven de strekking van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes removal of income limits and judges net effects on tenants to be limited; asks about the gap between estimated costs and the memorandum figures and about timing of simplification.

In particular the removal of the maximum income limits will, according to these members, prevent many tenants from suddenly losing the full allowance with a small income rise and falling into a poverty trap.

Met name het onderdeel van het vervallen van de maximale inkomensgrenzen zal volgens deze leden voor een flink aantal huurders voorkomen dat men bij een beperkte stijging van het inkomen ineens de volledige huurtoeslag ziet wegvallen en men in een armoedeval terecht komt.
Welcomes the gradual phase-out and reduced marginal pressure; requests scenario calculations including a rent agreement scenario.
Under this proposal the allowance is no longer abruptly cut at the maximum income limit but phased out gradually.
Door dit voorstel wordt immers de huurtoeslag niet meer zoals nu hard afgebouwd bij de maximale inkomensgrens, maar geleidelijk.
Doubts the stated simplification purpose, suspects the real aim is a cut that hits the poorest, and asks whether alternatives were considered and how the bill relates to the Comptabiliteitswet.
The GroenLinks members, however, question from the documents before us what the precise purpose of the bill is.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen zich, op basis van de voorliggende stukken, echter af wat het precieze doel van het wetsvoorstel is.
Worries that tenants on low incomes are pushed further into hardship; asks for data on rent burdens, the reasons for scrapping the KAN-clause, and alternatives considered.
The SP members are very worried that parts of this law will push low-income tenants further into a tight spot.
De leden van de SP-fractie maken zich grote zorgen dat met onderdelen van deze wet huurders met een laag inkomen verder in het nauw worden gebracht.
Can only partly accept the bill and asks for it to be split; questions the necessity and justification of the KAN-clause abolition and the impact on people on benefits.
The PvdA members can only partly agree with the bill and request that it be split into two bills.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie kunnen zich maar ten dele in het wetsvoorstel vinden.
Welcomes removal of income limits but asks how vulnerable groups, such as people moving from shelter or care into independent housing and people with disabilities, will be monitored and protected.
The ChristenUnie members ask about the effect of the bill on vulnerable groups, such as clients who move from shelter, sheltered housing and mental health institutions into their own homes.

De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen naar het effect van het wetsvoorstel op kwetsbare groepen, zoals cliënten die vanuit opvang, beschermd wonen en GGZ-instellingen weer verhuizen naar een eigen woning.

35000-IV.s: The bill fixes the 2019 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds in one law, setting expenditure, receipts and commitments for Caribbean Netherlands, rule-of-law support, and reconstruction of the Windward Islands. It contains no new delegations of rule-making power; the explanatory memorandum describes budget lines, loans, guarantees and ministerial information commitments.
q: The budget statement of Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) for the year 2019 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35075.s: The bill replaces the Waarborgwet 1986 (precious metals hallmarking act) with a modernised version that requires accreditation of hallmarking institutions, expands permitted marking techniques, introduces a responsibility mark, and gives supervisors power to impose administrative penalties (last onder dwangsom). It also sets out delegations to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations for thresholds, exemptions, hallmark standards and tariffs.
35075.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the rules must keep pace with technical developments and market conditions, allowing flexible adjustment of hallmark levels and exemptions.
q: higher fineness levels guaranteed by a hallmark are, unlike under the Waarborgwet 1986, set by ministerial regulation, giving flexibility to respond to market needs
De hogere gehalten die door een gehaltemerk worden gewaarborgd worden, anders dan onder de Waarborgwet 1986 het geval is, bij ministeriële regeling vastgesteld.
d: mass thresholds below which items need not be hallmarked
categories of items exempt from hallmarking obligation
higher hallmark fineness levels and hallmark designs
rules on subcontractors and subsidiaries performing hallmarking tasks
conditions for separate hallmarking of composite items
conditions for hallmarking items combining precious and other materials
automatic adoption of Permanent Commission decisions amending treaty annexes
p: The Minister may designate, suspend or withdraw hallmarking institutions and approve their statutes, with appeal rights in administrative law.
Supervisors may impose an administrative penalty (last onder dwangsom) on businesses for violations, adding an administrative enforcement tool alongside criminal law.
Designated officials may enter a dwelling without the occupant's consent, bring equipment, and use force, and may cut open items to inspect them.

parties: Asks why maximum tariffs were dropped, whether competition among hallmarking institutions is affected, and whether the bill could be simpler by aligning with the international convention.
These members ask whether the law could be simpler by simply aligning with the requirements of the said Convention.
Deze leden vragen of de wet niet nog eenvoudiger zou kunnen door simpelweg aan te sluiten bij de eisen in het genoemde Verdrag.
Questions outsourcing of hallmarking tasks to foreign firms, whether sampling gives sufficient certainty, and the level playing field with neighbouring countries.
These members question whether this is wise.
Deze leden zetten hier vraagtekens bij of dit verstandig is.
Warns that large online platforms could escape the Waarborgwet and asks how supervision of foreign-based parties and algorithms is arranged, and wants the Autoriteit Consument en Markt involved.
These members would like this issue also to be put to the Authority for Consumers and Markets.
Deze leden zouden graag zien dat dit vraagstuk ook wordt voorgelegd aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Asks whether the burden of hallmarking jewellery is disproportionate, as claimed by the goldsmiths' association, and whether the bill should be adjusted and how far sector consultation went.
They are also curious to what extent consultation with the sector took place when drafting the bill.
Zij zijn tevens benieuwd in hoeverre overleg met de sector heeft plaatsgevonden bij het opstellen van het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised against sending the Waarborgwet bill to parliament until the ongoing evaluation of the precious-metals hallmarking system is complete, since the bill pre-empts choices about market ordering, supervision abroad and Algemene Rekenkamer oversight. The government's reply accepts the advice to await the evaluation, drops the maximum-tariff proposal to preserve Rekenkamer competence, and maintains that cross-border subcontracting was already possible under the 1986 Act.
concerns: The bill should await the outcome of the evaluation of the market-ordering of the hallmarking system before being sent to parliament, since the evaluation may change the positioning of waarborginstellingen.

Supervision of accredited institutions operating or subcontracting abroad is not regulated and its design depends on the evaluation outcome; the government argues subcontracting abroad already existed and adds accountability and accreditation requirements.
Switching from fixed to maximum tariffs would remove the Algemene Rekenkamer's competence to examine waarborginstellingen, so the maximum-tariff proposal was withdrawn.
Most redactional remarks were incorporated, but the remarks on deleting 'duizendsten' in definitions, rewording 'is verplicht' and a phased repeal of the 1986 Act were not followed.

35084.s: This Brexit omnibus bill makes targeted changes to several Dutch statutes to prepare for the UK's withdrawal from the EU, covering company registration, driving licences, cross-border energy networks, semiconductor topography protection, social security and health care reimbursement. It also creates temporary delegation powers (articles VII and X) allowing transitional rules by general administrative order or ministerial regulation, with ex-post parliamentary approval.
35084.j: The memorandum justifies the broad powers by the unpredictability of Brexit and the need to act quickly on unforeseen cliff-edge consequences, with parliament approving afterwards.
q: Given the unpredictability of the process and the government's limited ability to steer it, the government considers it advisable to also provide a basis to act quickly where necessary.

Gelet op de onvoorspelbaarheid van het proces en de geringe mogelijkheden van de regering om daarin te sturen, acht de regering het echter raadzaam tevens te voorzien in een grondslag om waar nodig snel te kunnen handelen
d: rules on cross-border grid with third country and its operator
rules on cross-border gas grid with third country and its operator
treat UK as EU member for social security laws and set transitional law
CAK reimbursement of care costs for persons in UK after withdrawal
transitional arrangements and deviation from statute for withdrawal, up to one year
urgent transitional arrangements deviating from statute
p: Allows the government to deviate from existing statutes by decree or ministerial regulation for up to a year, with later parliamentary approval required only for structural deviations.
Permits a general administrative order to modify social security statutes temporarily, with ex-post parliamentary approval as the only safeguard.

parties: Asks why Article X allows ministerial regulations deviating from law, why no after-the-fact procedure applies to non-structural deviations, and what happens if the bill is not adopted.
Why is there no post-hoc (nahang) procedure provided in Article X, the VVD members ask.
Waarom is er in Artikel X geen nahangprocedure voorzien, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Views Article X as an unconstitutional encroachment on the legislature, bypassing cabinet decision, Raad van State advice and parliament, with no clear time limits.
Has serious doubts that Article X respects constitutional principles and proportionality, especially ministerial power to deviate from existing rules without parliamentary involvement.
These members point out that after-the-fact consultation on rules already in force does not meet the demands of parliamentary primacy.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat meepraten over wetgeving achteraf op regels die al in werking zijn getreden niet voldoen aan de eisen die dat primaat stelt.
Opposes switching off parliamentary control even in a chaotic no-deal Brexit and questions whether the bill is complete and legitimately delegates powers.
The SP members consider switching off parliamentary control no option, not even in the chaotic situation of a no-deal Brexit.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden het uitschakelen van de parlementaire controle geen optie, ook niet in de chaotische situatie van een Brexit zonder deal.
Sees Article X as an unacceptable transfer of power from the Staten-Generaal to the cabinet or individual ministers, undermining legislative primacy.
Article X aims to bring about an unacceptable transfer of power from the Staten-Generaal to the Council of Ministers or individual ministers.
Artikel X heeft als doel een onacceptabele machtsoverdracht van de Staten-Generaal naar de ministerraad of individuele vakministers te bewerkstelligen.
Asks why the government needs such far-reaching powers, under what conditions, and why parliament has little role as co-legislator under the temporary delegation basis.
Is the government willing to revise this approach and come with a new proposal that guarantees democratic control and the co-legislative role?
Is de regering bereid deze wijze te herzien en met een nieuw voorstel te komen waardoor de democratische controle en medewetgevende taak gewaarborgd is?
Questions the necessity of the far-reaching powers and the lack of parliamentary co-legislation under the temporary delegation basis.
Why does the government consider the far-reaching powers it grants itself through the Brexit omnibus bill necessary?
Waarom acht de regering de verstrekkende bevoegdheden die de regering zichzelf toekent, middels het wetsvoorstel Verzamelwet Brexit, noodzakelijk?
Finds the powers insufficiently justified, raises constitutional objections, and supports the suggested revision of Article VII; requests a constitutional section.
In the view of the 50PLUS faction, the supplementary report has not sufficiently addressed the Council of State's question
Naar het oordeel van de fractie van 50PLUS is in het nader rapport niet voldoende ingegaan op de vraag van de Raad van State
Accepts the need for the bill but considers the government's reasoning on ECHR and property protection too quick, and asks for a constitutional section.
The ChristenUnie members consider this reasoning by the government too quick and simplistic.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie achten deze redenering van de regering te kort door de bocht
Asks how parliament's constitutional control role is safeguarded when measures are taken by general administrative order or ministerial regulation.
In such cases, how is parliament's involvement safeguarded and shaped so that its constitutional oversight task can be fully carried out, these members ask?

Op welke wijze wordt in dergelijke gevallen de betrokkenheid van het parlement geborgd en vormgegeven, teneinde de constitutionele controletaak van het parlement optimaal te kunnen blijven uitvoeren, zo vragen deze leden?
Asks concrete questions about situations where existing law offers no solution and how the bill relates to the Commission's contingency plan.
The PVV members ask the government whether it can state exactly in which concrete situations existing law offers no way out.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering of zij exact kan aangeven in welke concrete situaties het bestaande recht geen uitkomst biedt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Dutch Brexit omnibus bill (Verzamelwet Brexit), criticising the lack of a systematic analysis of Brexit scenarios, the broad general delegation power in article X allowing ministerial regulations to deviate from statute, and retroactive effect for burdensome provisions, and advising against submission unless revised. The minister's reply accepts the need for the delegation power, amends article X to add parliamentary approval within eight weeks and limits ministerial regulations, adds explanation on the systematic analysis and retroactivity, and largely follows the advice while declining some specific measures as EU competence.
concerns: The Afdeling objects to a general power to deviate from statute by ministerial regulation, which it finds highly unusual and undesirable given legislative primacy; the government narrowed article X and added parliamentary approval.
The Afdeling asks that structural deviations and deviations by ministerial regulation be clearly limited and subject to Staten-Generaal approval within eight weeks; the government adopted this.

The Afdeling criticises retroactive effect for burdensome provisions such as article II without adequate justification; the government limited retroactivity to neutral or beneficial measures but did not drop it.
The Afdeling finds no systematic analysis of Brexit scenarios and policy lines and no coherent choice of measures across policy fields; the government added explanation but maintained its selection.
The Afdeling notes that abrupt changes to acquired rights may be questionable under the ECHR and Article 1 of the First Protocol; the government added explanation on the limited state responsibility.
The Afdeling makes a redactional comment on article X, paragraph 2, which the government adopted.

35093.s: The bill introduces a flat-rate subscription fee of €19 per month for most Wmo 2015 support services, replacing income- and cost-based contributions, with exceptions set by regulation. It also lets the minister set by general administrative order rules on how municipalities assess applications for individual support, and has the CAK collect the fees and provide data to the minister for monitoring.
35093.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to avoid stacking of care costs, reduce administrative complexity, and allow flexibility in exceptions and in responding to unintended effects.
q: By general administrative order, rules may be set on how the college assesses the decision to grant an individual support service.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld over de beoordeling van het college bij de beslissing tot het verstrekken van een maatwerkvoorziening
d: designation of general services and fee level by municipal ordinance
2.1.4 lid 4 onder b; 2.1.4a lid 5 onder b
categories of clients exempt from fee based on income
cases without fee for individual support and rules on income and assets for fees
rules on municipal assessment for granting individual support
data the CAK must provide to the minister and transmission method
p: Allows the executive by general administrative order to set rules governing how municipalities decide whether to grant individual support, which may restrict citizens' access to services.
Gives the minister access to client-level data, including health data, from the CAK to monitor effects of the fee regime.

parties: Asks whether the subscription rate can be raised by municipalities, how the rules are fixed, and what guidance clarifies eligible voorzieningen, linking to municipal discretion.
These members find it important that the law is clear and gives municipalities sufficient guidance in implementation.
Genoemde leden vinden het belangrijk dat de wet duidelijk is en gemeenten in de uitvoering voldoende handvatten biedt.
Supports the bill and monitoring, but raises the Raad van State view on the rate and asks that care need stay central in the research phase.
Does she share with these members the view that during the research phase the care or support need must be central?
Deelt zij met deze leden de opvatting dat in de onderzoeksfase de zorg of ondersteuningsvraag centraal dient te moeten staan?
Welcomes the reduction of cumulative costs and requests more information on CAK costs and a fuller reflection on financial sustainability.
These members would like more information on these implementation costs.
Graag ontvangen deze leden meer informatie over deze uitvoeringskosten.
Fears under-compensation of municipalities could erode Wmo services and asks whether full coverage of extra costs will be guaranteed.
They fear that municipalities will not be sufficiently compensated for the financial consequences of the subscription rate, which could ultimately lead to a thinning of services under the Wmo 2015.

Zij vrezen dat gemeenten niet voldoende worden gecompenseerd voor de financiële gevolgen van het abonnementstarief, wat uiteindelijk kan leiden tot verschraling van de voorzieningen binnen de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Questions under-compensation of municipalities, risk of reduced care for all users, and legal inequality from variable municipal application of the eigenkracht rules via AMvB.
Does this not threaten legal inequality?
Doubts the bill achieves accessibility, questions the flat rate ignoring income, demands guarantees that AMvB measures do not worsen client positions, and raises financing gaps.

These members join the Raad van State's view that a capped contribution regardless of income or assets is insufficiently substantiated and ask to abandon this arbitrarily chosen rate unless a sound justification is provided.

Genoemde leden voegen zich bij de mening van de Raad van State dat het instrument van een gemaximeerd bedrag als eigen bijdrage, ongeacht iemands inkomens- of vermogenspositie, onvoldoende is onderbouwd en vragen af te zien van dit willekeurig gekozen abonnementstarief als hier geen dragende motivering voor kan worden gegeven.
Supports reducing cumulative costs but asks whether municipalities will offer fewer maatwerk services and how appropriate support is safeguarded.
How is it monitored that support remains appropriate and continues to match the client's needs and specific circumstances, these members ask.
Hoe wordt bewaakt dat de ondersteuning passend blijft en aan blijft sluiten op de behoefte en specifieke kenmerken van de situatie van de cliënt, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks when the Chamber can expect results of the research on aligning contributions across regimes.
When can the Chamber expect the results of this research?
Wanneer kan de Kamer de resultaten van dit onderzoek verwachten?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advises against the bill introducing a fixed maximum co-payment (abonnementstarief) for Wmo 2015 support, unless the government gives a fuller justification and involves the Minister of Interior, since it removes income-based co-payment instruments and affects intergovernmental relations. The government's reply (nader rapport) defends the proposal, cites cumulation of care costs and administrative savings, promises a monitor and a possible general administrative order to adjust eligibility, but declines to explicitly involve the Minister of Interior.
concerns: The Council requires a convincing justification for capping co-payments at a fixed amount regardless of income or wealth, given their role in financial sustainability; the government adds cost-stacking and administrative arguments and a monitor but does not fully resolve the justification gap.

The Council asks that the explanatory memorandum explain how the proposal respects intergovernmental relations principles and involve the Minister of Interior; the government declines to explicitly name that involvement.
The Council's drafting remark is not adopted by the government.

35174.s: The bill removes the statutory exception that treated cohabiting second-degree relatives with a care need differently from other couples sharing a household, in the Participatiewet and three related benefit laws, following a Supreme Court ruling that the distinction is discriminatory. It adds transitional rules keeping the old exception for twelve months for applications filed before entry into force and applying old law to pending appeals.
35174.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the Supreme Court ruling of 8 December 2017 and the lack of justification for treating second-degree relatives differently from non-relatives.
q: This bill aims to remove the discriminatory distinction made in the Participatiewet by deleting the statutory exception.
Dit wetvoorstel heeft als doel het in de Participatiewet gemaakte discriminatoire onderscheid op te heffen, door de gemaakte wettelijke uitzondering te schrappen (artikel I van het wetsvoorstel).

parties: Asks what powers municipalities have under article 18(1) to adjust benefits in hardship cases and whether this could preserve the current situation.
What powers does the municipality have on the basis of this article?
Welke bevoegdheden heeft de gemeente op basis van dit artikel?
Supports removing the discriminatory exemption and asks the government to ensure municipalities use their discretion in hardship cases and inform affected people.
These members assume that municipal executives will properly use their explicit powers and responsibility to tailor benefits to the circumstances of affected persons in hardship cases.

Deze leden gaan er daarbij vanuit dat de colleges van de gemeenten hun expliciete bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid goed zullen gebruiken om in voorkomende schrijnende gevallen, de bijstand af te stemmen op de mogelijkheden, omstandigheden en middelen van de belanghebbenden.
Agrees the distinction is unjustified and asks how widely municipalities use their hardship discretion and how well they know of it, and requests quantitative insight into affected numbers and costs.
These members call on the government, in consultation with implementing parties, to still provide more quantitative insight into this, as well as the financial consequences.
Deze leden roepen de regering op om in samenspraak met partijen uit de uitvoeringspraktijk hierover alsnog nadere kwantitatieve inzichten te verschaffen
Disappointed; argues the Central Court of Appeal's broader exemption for mutual care dependence should be followed, and questions the Participation Act principle of counting partner means.
These members therefore believe the government should follow the line of the Central Council of Appeal.
Deze leden zijn dan ook van mening dat de regering de lijn van de Centrale Raad van Beroep zou moeten volgen.

Critical that care-dependent people lose benefits and possibly enter institutional care; asks about the affected woman's situation and the Council of State's warning about unresolved underlying problems.

Asks for the government's view on the Central Council and Supreme Court case and why the exemption is removed rather than widened, and whether affected cases will be hardship cases and how people are informed.
Does the government share the expectation that the cases affected by this amendment will by definition be hardship cases?
Deelt de regering de verwachting dat het bij de gevallen die geraakt worden door deze wetswijziging per definitie zal gaan om schrijnende situaties?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill removing the exception that treats cohabiting second-degree blood relatives with a care need as single persons for social assistance, noting possible adverse effects and transitional-law inequality. The government's nader rapport responds that colleges can use discretion in hardship cases and amends the transitional rules to cover all three groups uniformly.
concerns: The Afdeling notes that the bill may lead cohabiting relatives with care needs to forgo joint households and lose benefits, and asks the explanatory memorandum to address alternatives.

The Afdeling finds it unjustified that transitional rules depend on when the administrative body decides, and advises separate treatment of three groups, which the government adopted by tying eligibility to the application date.

35219.s: The bill amends the Youth Act to clarify the residence-based responsibility principle (woonplaatsbeginsel) for youth care, defining the responsible municipality in several scenarios. It adds transitional rules continuing care for a year after a change of residence and new payment, investigation and information duties for municipalities, with details to be set by ministerial regulation.
35219.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation by saying detailed rules on controls and deadlines are needed for practical implementation and that deadlines may be imposed later if necessary.
q: By ministerial regulation further rules will be set on the payment, investigation and information duty, including controls municipalities must carry out before paying youth care.
Bij regeling van Onze Ministers worden nadere regels gesteld over de betaal-, onderzoeks- en informatieplicht
d: payment, investigation and information duties of municipalities, including controls before payment
p: Municipalities must pay for youth care and answer provider queries within a reasonable term, with detailed controls to be set by ministerial regulation rather than in the statute.

parties: Asks how much the change will reduce disputes and administrative costs, and how quality and suitability of care will be safeguarded through national agreements.
However, the members are not entirely clear to what extent this amendment will actually lead to less discussion between municipalities and providers.
Het is de leden echter niet volledig duidelijk in hoeverre deze wetswijziging daadwerkelijk tot minder discussie tussen gemeenten en aanbieders zal leiden.
Believes the section on administrative burdens is presented too optimistically and asks additional questions about it.
These members have the impression that the section on administrative burdens is presented too rosily, and they therefore have a number of additional questions and remarks about it.
Deze leden hebben het idee, dat het dat het gedeelte over de administratieve lasten te rooskleurig wordt voorgesteld en zij hebben hier dan ook nog een aantal aanvullende vragen en opmerkingen over.
Asks how municipalities' non-compliance with agreements, unreliable central registers and disputes causing delays will be addressed, and whether providers depend on municipal goodwill.
Does the government share the observation that three quarters of municipalities do not adhere to the agreements made?
Deelt de regering de observatie dat driekwart van de gemeenten zich niet houden aan gemaakte afspraken?
Asks how the government will monitor the benefits and risks, how stakeholders were involved, and how municipalities can be held accountable for insufficient implementation of the Wet BRP.
In what way are municipalities held accountable when they insufficiently implement the Wet BRP?
Op welke wijze worden gemeenten verantwoordelijk gehouden wanneer zij de Wet BRP onvoldoende uitvoeren?
Asks whether the change will push municipalities toward cheaper, lighter youth care and how this risk is being mitigated, and about cross-regional contracting and education cost allocation.
In keeping with the logic of this bill, should this always be the partnership where the young person lived before their stay?
Zou conform de logica van dit wetsvoorstel dit altijd het samenwerkingsverband moeten zijn waar de jongere woonde voorafgaande aan zijn of haar verblijf?

Welcomes reduced bureaucracy but worries about municipal shifting of responsibility, lack of oversight of care in other municipalities, and municipalities restricting residential facilities for financial reasons.
The members think it is good that this bill brings improvements in this area.
De leden vinden het goed, dat dit wetsvoorstel hierin verbeteringen aanbrengt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises submitting the bill amending the Youth Act's residence principle (woonplaatsbeginsel), but notes the financial risk for youth care providers is reduced, not fully removed, and asks whether stronger payment obligations for municipalities were considered. The government's reply explains that a broader payment duty risks incorrect invoices and extra administrative burden, adds a reasonable-time requirement and a ministerial power to set deadlines, and amends the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The financial risk for youth care providers is reduced but not fully eliminated in cases of direct referral without municipal information, and the explanatory memorandum should be supplemented.
The Afdeling asks whether a stronger payment obligation for municipalities was considered, which the government addresses by explaining why a broader payment duty was not chosen.

35237.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality by an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 14 million for the Urgenda case, with the amendment taking effect from 1 July 2019. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and no explanatory memorandum excerpt was provided.

35246.s: The bill simplifies the rules for the Chambers of Commerce and Industry on Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius, including board size, elections, term and vacancy filling, and the Chambers' tasks and governance. It also introduces a budget and annual accounts regime with financial oversight, a ban on competing with market actors using public-task revenues, and shifts detailed rules on elections, fees and contributions to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
35246.j: The memorandum justifies delegating detailed election rules, fee structures and contribution systems to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations as technical and administrative in nature, and strengthens financial oversight for transparency of public-task Chambers.
q: Detailed rules on these elections are delegated to a general administrative order.
Gedetailleerde regels over deze verkiezingen worden gedelegeerd naar een algemene maatregel van bestuur
d: election procedure for Chamber board members
persons qualifying as business representatives for voting
additional rules on mid-term resignation and replacement of board members
composition and work of the election committee
Artikel I.O (art. 12, vierde en vijfde lid)
fees for integral costs of Chamber services and management costs
structure and explanation of budget and annual accounts, equity requirements, audit points
Chamber's ex officio registration of changes
contribution system by legal form and size
amounts for inspection and copies of the register
p: The Rijksvertegenwoordiger may act in place of a negligent Chamber board, draw its funds, direct its secretary and dismiss staff, extending central executive control over the Chambers.
Introduces a budget and annual accounts cycle with submission to the Bestuurscollege and the minister, adding transparency and financial oversight of the Chambers.
Prohibits Chambers from competing with market actors using revenues from public tasks, with reporting in the annual report.

parties: Asks who supervises whether board members hold conflicting functions and what happens if they do, and whether the ACM supervises the rule against competing with market parties.
Can the government explain how this is checked? Who supervises it?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe dit wordt gecontroleerd? Wie houdt hier toezicht op?
Asks why the government did not follow the Raad van State advice on requiring separate registration of income and costs, and whether market activities should be capped.
Can the government further explain why it does not follow this advice?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom zij dit advies niet opvolgt?
Asks about the purpose of the Chamber of Commerce instrument on the islands, its evaluation history, and the representativeness of consulted stakeholders.
These members ask the government to reflect on whether the stakeholders consulted are sufficiently representative of current and future entrepreneurs.
Deze leden vragen de regering te reflecteren of de gesproken belanghebbenden voldoende representatief zijn voor huidige en toekomstige ondernemers.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet op de Kamers van Koophandel en Nijverheid BES and the Handelsregisterwet 2009 BES, objecting to delegating core election rules to an AMvB and recommending a separate registration of costs and benefits. The government's reply accepted the objections by writing the core election elements into the bill and adding transparency reporting, but declined mandatory separate bookkeeping as disproportionate.
concerns: Core elements of the election regime for Chamber board members (voting rights, eligibility, term, succession) should remain in the law rather than being fully delegated to an AMvB.
A mandatory separate registration of costs and benefits should be considered to ensure adequate supervision of the ban on cross-subsidy.
The manner in which costs are charged through fees should be clarified; the bill now expressly provides for charging integral costs, though separate bookkeeping was not required.

35255.s: The bill amends the Dutch international tax assistance act and the General Tax Act to implement EU Directive 2018/822 on mandatory automatic exchange of information about reportable cross-border tax arrangements. It imposes reporting duties on intermediaries and, failing them, on relevant taxpayers, adds administrative fines, and sets a rule that reported arrangements are treated as unknown facts for assessment purposes.
35255.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to effectively combat aggressive tax planning and to make the directive's information exchange work, and it limits data requests to what serves those goals.
q: Data and information that do not serve compliance with the objectives of Directive (EU) 2018/822 (and Directive 2011/16/EU) are not requested.
Gegevens en inlichtingen die niet strekken tot de nakoming van (de doelen van) Richtlijn (EU) 2018/822 (en Richtlijn 2011/16/EU), worden niet gevraagd.
d: deadlines and manner of reporting arrangement information to the tax authority
p: New reporting obligations on intermediaries and taxpayers give the tax authority expanded information powers over cross-border arrangements.
Information received under the directive is deemed an unknown fact for reassessment, widening the tax inspector's ability to reassess beyond the usual limits.Ht

parties: Asks about undefined key terms, unclear legal scope for SMEs, retroactive effect, and administrative burden estimates.
The VVD members are not yet convinced of the deliberate omission of a definition of the terms 'arrangement' and 'reportable cross-border arrangement'.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn nog niet overtuigd van het bewust weglaten van een definiëring van de begrippen «constructie» en «meldingsplichtige grensoverschrijdende constructie».
Criticises deliberately vague terms, retroactivity, doubts the law will catch real fraud, and questions the basis for estimating the number of reports.
The CDA members, however, do not believe this law helps detect real fraud and tax evasion.
De leden van de CDA-fractie geloven echter niet dat onderhavige wet helpt bij het opsporen van echte fraude en belastingontduiking.
Asks how other member states implement the directive, when the law will be evaluated, data security of the central database, and the regulatory burden advice.
The D66 members ask when the government will evaluate this law.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen per wanneer de regering deze wet evalueert.

Argues the directive's gaps and the government's narrow reading of the main benefit test and reporting triggers could hollow out the reporting duty, and asks for delegated rules to be submitted to parliament.
Argues reporting only treats symptoms, asks why rulings permitting avoidance are retained, and questions the closed list of hallmarks and burden of proof placed on the tax authority.
They fear this places the burden of proof on the Tax Authority and that new arrangements will be devised to circumvent this reporting duty again.
Zij vrezen dat hiermee de bewijslast bij de Belastingdienst ligt en dat nieuwe constructies zullen worden bedacht waarmee opnieuw deze meldplicht kan worden omzeild.
Expresses interest in the bill without substantive points in the report text.
The PvdA members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill implementing DAC6 (mandatory reporting of potentially aggressive cross-border tax planning), raising concerns about the justification of the maximum fine of €830,000 given many open norms, the underestimated administrative burden, and the abolition of the 'new fact' requirement for reassessment based on DAC6 information. The government's reply accepts that the fine and open-norm context differ from DAC4 and explains proportionality and burden estimates, and largely accepts the reassessment point by adding a clarifying provision and supplementing the explanatory memorandum while keeping the rule.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for better justification of the height of the administrative fine, given many open norms and the possibility of very high cumulative fines; the government explained proportionality criteria and clarified the explanatory memorandum but kept the fine level.

The Afdeling questioned whether the penalty provision (incomplete or incorrect reporting) is sufficiently clear under the lex certa principle given the open norms; the government referred to the forthcoming guidance and the proportionality framework.

The Afdeling found the justification for abolishing the new-fact requirement for DAC6 information insufficient and said the measure was not clearly necessary under DAC6; the government agreed DAC6 does not strictly require it but kept it as consistent with the directive's intent and clarified the memorandum.

The Afdeling said the administrative burden increase was likely underestimated, given expected precautionary reporting and open norms; the government clarified the extra work involved and explained the estimation method.

35273.s: The bill amends the Kieswet and the Waterschapswet so that members of the Tweede Kamer, Eerste Kamer, provincial councils, water boards, municipal councils and the island council may be temporarily replaced for pregnancy, childbirth or illness throughout their full term. It removes the existing restriction that replacement requests made within sixteen weeks before the end of the term may be refused, and repeals the 2006 transitional replacement act.
35273.j: The memorandum justifies the change by implementing constitutional articles 57a, 129 and 132a on temporary replacement and by stating that the water board rules remain consistent with article 133 of the Constitution, without delegating new powers.
q: This removes the restriction that a request for temporary release due to pregnancy, childbirth or illness need not be granted if it is made within sixteen weeks before the end of the term.

Daarmee vervalt de beperking dat aan een verzoek tot tijdelijk ontslag wegens zwangerschap en bevalling of ziekte niet wordt voldaan, indien het tijdstip waarop het verzoek wordt gedaan ligt binnen een periode van zestien weken voor het einde van de zittingsduur

parties: Asks the government to justify why it did not adopt the Kiesraad's advice on withdrawing pending leave requests when membership has already ended, and how the ex nunc principle and article 4.5 Awb apply.
The government does not adopt the Kiesraad's advice. The VVD members ask the government to justify this further.
De regering neemt het advies van de Kiesraad niet over. De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering dit nader te motiveren.
Welcomes the bill and encourages the government to bring it into force well before the next regular Tweede Kamer election.
The D66 members agree and encourage the government to bring this bill into force well before the next regular Tweede Kamer election.
De leden van de D66-fractie sluiten zich daar bij aan en moedigen de regering aan om dit wetsvoorstel ruim voor eerst volgende reguliere Tweede Kamer verkiezing in werking te laten treden.
Welcomes the bill and asks the government to explain why swearing-in on the day after dismissal at national level differs from same-meeting swearing-in at local level.
The GroenLinks members would like the government to explain this difference between the timing of swearing-in at national and local level.
Graag ontvangen de leden van de fractie van GroenLinks een toelichting van de regering op dit verschil tussen het moment van beëdigen op nationaal en decentraal niveau.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Kieswet and Waterschapswet to adjust temporary replacement of council and water board members during pregnancy, childbirth or illness, and found no remarks. The Minister's reply states the proposal gives no occasion for substantive remarks and asks that the bill be sent to the Tweede Kamer.

35282.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act (WHW) and the Vocational Education Act (WEB) to make teaching in a language other than Dutch subject to accreditation body approval and stricter criteria, introduces a ministerial consent requirement for capacity limits (numerus fixus) on English-taught tracks, and raises the minimum institutional tuition for non-EEA students while enabling administrative fees for diploma evaluation and language tests. It also adds an Dutch-language proficiency promotion duty and delegates detailed rules to amvb and ministerial regulations.
35282.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying detailed criteria cannot all be foreseen in advance and that case-specific judgment is needed, and it justifies the numerus fixus consent by the need to protect access to education.
q: It is impractical to regulate all situations in detail in advance.
Het is daarom ondoenlijk om op voorhand om alle situaties gedetailleerd te regelen.
d: rules on how institutions promote Dutch expression skills
designating programmes exempt from Dutch-skills rules
cases where accreditation body assesses new programme and procedure
cases and types of conditions for approval of foreign-language teaching
content of institutional language policy and cases of 'specific nature' justifying other language
other enrolment fees (eigen bijdragen) for diploma evaluation and language tests
capacity-limit consent grounds, procedure and selection rules
minimum and maximum institutional tuition amounts
replaces amvb with ministerial regulation for a tuition-related rule
specific nature of vocational education justifying other language
p: Minister must grant consent for capacity limits on programmes and English-taught tracks, with discretion over whether a capacity shortage exists and conditions attached to consent.

Accreditation body judges whether foreign-language teaching is 'in the student's interest', a broad discretionary test replacing the earlier 'necessity' criterion, with the NVAO approval as a check.}}],

parties: Asks whether a numerus fixus is justified by capacity and whether the Minister's prior consent procedure is workable, and raises the possible deterrent effect of Dutch-language requirements on international students.

Questions the government's choice of regulatory form, the replacement of 'noodzaak' by 'meerwaarde', and whether the NVAO and inspectorate have a sufficiently strong role in supervising language choices.
These members ask on the basis of which considerations the government chose the proposed form of regulation.
De leden van deze fractie vragen op grond van welke afwegingen de regering voor de voorgestelde vorm van regulering gekozen heeft.
Broadly positive about tailored measures for the international dimension and asks mainly clarifying questions on terminology and the NVAO's assessment of language choice.
The members of this faction are therefore in principle positive about the tailored approach that this act makes possible.
De leden van deze fractie staan daarom in beginsel positief tegenover het maatwerk dat deze wet mogelijk maakt.

Worries about the workload burden of the Dutch-language obligation without extra funding, the risk of a two-tier system between tracks under a numerus fixus, and whether student councils are properly informed and represented.
These members ask whether the government believes education institutions should fund this obligation without extra resources.
De leden vragen of de regering van mening is dat onderwijsinstellingen deze plicht zonder extra middelen moeten bekostigen.
Argues the numerus fixus and English-language tracks risk segregation and quality differences, and questions the choice of prior rather than ex post ministerial review.
These members wonder why prior review was chosen.
Deze leden vragen zich af waarom is gekozen voor toetsing vooraf.
Asks the government to justify the need for ministerial consent for numeri fixi and who bears consequences if an institution's request is blocked.
Can the government further substantiate the necessity of its intention?
Kan de regering de noodzaak van haar voornemen nader onderbouwen?
Asks why prior ministerial consent was chosen over ex post review, how institutions' effort obligation is measured, and whether the Minister should have a proactive role in numeri fixi.
Can the government explain why it chose a prior consent requirement rather than ex post review, as advocated in the field?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom zij heeft gekozen voor een toestemmingsvereiste vooraf en niet voor toetsing achteraf, zoals vanuit het veld werd bepleit?

Argues the measures are both insufficient to relieve pressure and unnecessarily intrusive on institutional autonomy, questioning ministerial control over numeri fixi for non-EEA students and the inspectorate's role.
These members ask why, for non-EEA students, the competent authority should not have the freedom to decide itself, within international law, how many students are admitted.

Eveneens vragen zij waarom ten aanzien van de groep niet-EER-studenten het bevoegd gezag niet bij uitstek vrijheid zou moeten hebben om binnen de grenzen van het internationaal recht zelf te bepalen hoeveel studenten worden toegelaten.
Asks the government to justify the raised threshold for English-taught programmes and the exemption possibilities for groups of programmes, which it views as undesirable.
These members therefore consider it necessary that programmes delivering more than half of the programme in another language must run a separate foreign-language track.
Zij vinden het dan ook noodzakelijk dat opleidingen die meer dan de helft van de opleiding in een andere taal verzorgen een anderstalig traject moeten doorlopen.
Questions extending the capacity fixus from two to three years and asks for scientific evidence that a numerus fixus on the English track will not create a two-tier quality gap.
The aforementioned members ask the Minister to substantiate scientifically that such a measure will not lead to a two-tier system or a quality difference.
De voornoemde leden vragen de Minister om wetenschappelijk te onderbouwen dat door een dergelijke maatregel géén tweedeling zal plaatsvinden en er geen kwaliteitsverschil zal ontstaan.

Criticises the broadened room for foreign languages in the amendment as a weakening of the bill, questions the subordination of programme quality to economic interests, and asks whether the government has an active responsibility to guarantee adequate supply.
The members ask for further justification of why it is desirable to deliberately subordinate programme quality to, among other things, the economy.
De leden vragen nader te onderbouwen waarom het wenselijk is dat de kwaliteit van de opleiding welbewust ondergeschikt zou moeten worden gemaakt aan onder meer de economie.

Asks for an overview of all possible steering instruments with their legal implications and for clarity on EU-law limits, and questions the government's view that a maximum number of non-EEA students cannot be set.
These members doubt the government's view on this.
Deze leden betwijfelen de opvatting van de regering hierover.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill modernising language policy and access in higher and secondary vocational education, including a ministerial consent requirement for numerus fixus, and a cap on institutional tuition for EEA students.
