The advisory division asked for a clearer problem analysis, reflection on internationalisation, better enforceability of the 'added value' criterion, and justification of the tuition cap; the minister's reply accepted several points (e.g. a broader duty for all students, numerus fixus limited to Dutch-taught tracks, tuition for non-EEA students) while defending the consent requirement and the cap on EEA tuition.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the need for the ministerial consent requirement for numerus fixus, noting the problem analysis is missing; the minister maintained the necessity, citing lack of safeguards, but clarified and justified the measure further.
The Afdeling doubted enforceability of the inspectorate's supervision of the inspanningsverplichting and the revocation power; the government rewrote the provision and clarified the scope.

The Afdeling found the 'meerwaarde' criterion vague and hard to enforce and asked for concrete criteria; the government added a delegation to set criteria by regulation and clarified the NVAO and inspectorate roles.

The Afdeling found no demonstrated need for capping EEA tuition, since most institutions already charge cost-covering fees; the government kept the cap and justified it on the gradations of public responsibility.
The Afdeling asked whether requiring institutions to offer a Dutch-language equivalent track is proportionate; the government dropped that possibility to protect institutional autonomy.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on how often the maximum tuition tariff is set; the government specified periodic setting by general administrative order, planned at about three years.

The Afdeling asked that the bill be reconsidered in light of the pending Van Rijn commission report and other studies; the government incorporated some findings but argued not all studies could be integrated.

35336.s: The bill amends the Dutch secondary vocational education law (WVO), the Education and Vocational Training Act (WEB), the Expertise Centres Act and the Compulsory Education Act to make structural integrated pathways (doorlopende leerroutes) from prevocational secondary education (vmbo) to secondary vocational education (mbo) possible, including an integrated vmbo-basic vocational route without vmbo exams. It sets out the required school-institution cooperation agreements, shared teams, shared funding transfers and enrolment rules, and allows deviation from standard instruction-time rules when quality is demonstrably sufficient.
35336.j: The memorandum justifies the new arrangements by the positive results of years of pathway experiments and the need for regional flexibility in vocational education.
q: This bill provides the possibility for vmbo schools and mbo institutions to offer integrated vmbo-mbo pathways at levels 2, 3 and 4 from 2020-2021, which they can shape regionally.

Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de mogelijkheid voor vmbo-scholen en mbo-instellingen om vanaf 2020–2021 doorlopende leerroutes vmbo-mbo op niveau 2, 3 en 4 aan te bieden, die zij regionaal kunnen vormgeven.
d: integrated vmbo-mbo pathway arrangements and conditions

parties: Supports the goals but asks how best practices will be spread, how financial arrangements are managed, and how the bill is feasible across all regions.
These members do, however, have some questions about the feasibility and implementation of this law.
Deze leden hebben echter wel enkele vragen bij de uitvoerbaarheid en implementatie van deze wet.
Asks why the rules are fixed in law before the 2021 evaluation, what room remains to amend the law after that evaluation, and how the Raad van State's criticism is addressed.
Asks how the government will monitor regional supply without a separate licence, and whether the bill threatens broad regional secondary schools.
How will the government keep track of regional provision, since no separate licence is required?
Hoe gaat de regering zicht houden op het regionale aanbod, aangezien er geen afzonderlijke licentie nodig is?

Worries that choices are made very early at around age 14 and that the bill may narrow options, including the removal of the practical exam for technology pupils, and asks for guarantees of pupils' freedom to develop.
Does the government think it desirable for young people to have to make a fairly definitive choice at such a young age?
Vindt de regering het wenselijk dat jongeren al op zo'n jonge leeftijd een vrij definitieve keuze moeten maken?
Fears premature study choices at age 14 and that student participation rights (medezeggenschap) are insufficiently protected.
The SP members fear that participation rights are not sufficiently secured by this legislative amendment.
De leden van de SP-fractie vrezen dat de medezeggenschap niet voldoende is geborgd met deze wetswijziging.

Not yet convinced of the bill's necessity, questions teacher qualifications and whether the works council rules are properly arranged, and asks the government to respond to the AOb's early-choice objection.
These members ask the government to specify to what extent the education sector feels a need for this bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nader te specificeren in hoeverre men in het onderwijsveld behoefte voelt aan dit wetsvoorstel
Asks whether the routes could be misused for improper gain, how much funding may be transferred to schools, and why the flexible hours option is limited to these routes.
The SGP members ask the government whether it has satisfied itself to what extent the proposed routes could be exploited for improper reasons by pupils and schools alike.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering of deze zich ervan heeft vergewist in hoeverre de voorgestelde leerroutes zowel door leerlingen als door scholen om oneigenlijke redenen kunnen worden benut

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised the government to postpone submitting the bill on permanent vmbo-mbo continuous learning routes until the experiments are evaluated, or to justify the timing; it also asked for a discussion of the bill's relation to other education legislation. The government's reply (nader rapport) disputes the reading of the monitoring results, argues the timing is justified by ten years of experience and field support, and expands the explanatory memorandum on the bill's relation to other measures, while largely maintaining the bill.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the experiments had demonstrated success and urged waiting for the final evaluation or a firmer justification for submitting the bill now; the government expanded its justification but maintained the timing based on ten years of experience and field consultation.
The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to address the bill's relation to other education measures and their overlapping goals; the government added a section on this relation.

35345.s: The bill abolishes the municipality of Haaren and transfers its territory to Boxtel, Oisterwijk, Vught and Tilburg, effective on a date set by royal decree. It also removes Haaren from several statutes and designates Oisterwijk to handle transitional matters under the general municipal reorganisation act.
35345.j: The explanatory memorandum gives no justification for the royal decree on the entry-into-force date beyond the municipalities' own initiative for this reorganisation variant.
q: Article 8: This law enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Artikel 8 Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: setting the date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Notes that splitting a municipality is not a regular merger and that municipalities rarely dissolve themselves, without raising a check concern.
They do note that splitting a municipality is not a 'regular' merger and that it is uncommon for a municipality to decide to dissolve itself.
Zij merken wel op dat de splitsing van een gemeente geen «reguliere» herindeling is en het niet vaak voorkomt dat een gemeente besluit zichzelf op te heffen.
Asks why the advice and provincial view were filed only with the Central Information Point rather than attached to the explanatory memorandum, and questions the level of public support per village.
What is the reason for this? Why were these documents not attached as annexes to the explanatory memorandum, so that they can also be consulted via www.officielebekendmakingen.nl?
Wat is de reden hiervoor? Waarom zijn deze stukken niet als bijlagen bij de memorie van toelichting gevoegd, zodat ze ook te raadplegen zijn via www.officielebekendmakingen.nl ?

Supports reorganisation where finances or capacity are weak, stresses popular support, and asks whether administrative resilience against undermining crime is secured across two safety regions and two police teams.
Naturally, support among the population is important in this regard.
Vanzelfsprekend is daarbij draagvlak onder de bevolking van belang.
Asks how smaller municipalities will be able to absorb additional tasks and how the national government and province will support them.
Can the government indicate how this is secured and how the national government and the province support a smaller municipality in this?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe dit geborgd wordt en hoe het rijk en de provincie een kleinere gemeente daarbij ondersteunen?
Hopes the proposal benefits residents and communities and has no further questions at this stage.
They hope that this proposal will benefit the residents of Haaren, but also the communities in the municipalities of Boxel, Oisterwijk, Tilburg and Vught.
Zij hopen dat genoemd voorstel de inwoners van Haaren, maar ook de gemeenschappen in gemeenten Boxel, Oisterwijk, Tilburg en Vught ten goede zal komen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill to split the municipality of Haaren, raising no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport simply forwards the bill, since the advice gave no occasion for substantive comments.

35354.s: The bill simplifies the funding of personnel and operating costs for secondary schools by replacing many parameters with a flat amount per school site and a per-pupil amount, and it repeals the separate personnel/operating grant structure. It also aligns the funding of secondary and vocational education in the Caribbean Netherlands with this model and adds transitional rules and an evaluation duty.
35354.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for a simpler, more transparent and predictable funding model with fewer parameters and lower administrative burden, while the detailed rules are left to lower regulation.
q: The simplified model helps, for example, works councils to better discuss with the school board the use of funds and the considerations involved.
Het vereenvoudigde model draagt er aan bij dat bijvoorbeeld medezeggenschapsraden beter kunnen meepraten met het schoolbestuur over de besteding van de middelen en de afwegingen hierin.
d: rules on implementing school funding for personnel and operations
conditions for per-site funding and distinctions by site type
annual funding amounts and wage/price adjustment rules
rules on pupil and site counting date
additional funding for exceptional developments, funding ceilings and allocation
additional funding for exceptional circumstances with conditions attached
transitional funding wage and price adjustment rules
funding amounts for Caribbean schools and additional funding conditions
additional funding for exceptional developments and ceilings
additional funding for exceptional circumstances with conditions
annual vocational education funding amounts per learning path
p: The Minister sets the funding level himself, judged by an open standard of reasonable needs of a school in normal circumstances, with no parliamentary approval of amounts.
The Minister may grant additional funding and set ceilings and allocation rules by ministerial regulation without statutory criteria beyond general descriptions of circumstances.
Transitional rules let the Minister set the transition path, with a time-limited compensation for negative redistribution effects.
For Caribbean Netherlands schools the Minister fixes funding amounts by an open reasonable-needs standard without a statutory amount.
Municipal reporting on school funding is reorganised, removing the separate personnel and operating reporting categories that previously gave transparency.

parties: Asks for concrete examples of how the current model makes financial considerations drive school course offerings and of small adjustments with large financial effects.
Can the government give a number of concrete examples that show this?
Kan de regering een aantal concrete voorbeelden geven waaruit dit blijkt?
Supports the goal of simplification but worries about effects on broad school communities and starting schools in shrinking regions, and asks detailed questions on redistribution effects.
These members are still concerned about the effects of this simplification of funding, particularly for broad school communities and starting schools.
Deze leden maken zich nog wel zorgen over de gevolgen van deze vereenvoudiging van de bekostiging voor met name brede schoolgemeenschappen en startende scholen.

Questions the policy objective behind simplification, possible perverse incentives, lack of transparency about the calculation model, and risks to equal opportunity and socialisation functions of schools.
These members also ask how transparency will be strengthened, since the government offers no transparency about the calculation model.
Ook vragen deze leden op welke wijze de transparantie wordt versterkt, aangezien de regering geen transparantie biedt over het rekenmodel.
Worries that reducing parameters to four could create perverse incentives favouring categorical schools and increase segregation, and asks how broad school communities' value is protected.
a concern is that reducing the number of parameters in the funding model to four could create a perverse incentive that mainly stimulates the formation of categorical schools.

een punt van zorg is dat van de reductie van het aantal parameters in het bekostigingsmodel tot vier, wel eens een perverse prikkel zou kunnen uitgaan die vooral de vorming van categorale scholen stimuleert.
Welcomes a simple, predictable funding system and government responsiveness, but asks whether broad school communities and isolated denominational schools are adequately protected.
From the perspective of mutual encounter and promoting transfer between sectors, broad school communities play an important role.
Vanuit het oogpunt van onderlinge ontmoeting en bevorderen van doorstroom tussen de verschillende sectoren vervullen brede scholengemeenschappen een belangrijke rol.

Wants clarity on specific problems in the current funding, classification of issues, reasons for dropping the per-school-type staff parameter, and notes drafting inconsistencies between bill and explanatory memorandum.
These members ask for more explanation and classification of the types of problems that would arise.
Deze leden vragen om meer duiding en classificatie van de soorten problemen die zich zouden voordoen.
Welcomes the new system but is concerned about negative redistribution effects for broad school communities and the unclear support measure for schools in sparsely populated areas.
Due to the bill, broad school communities will lose more.
Door het wetsvoorstel zullen brede scholengemeenschappen er meer op achteruit gaan.
Asks why funding is cost-following rather than based on substantive wishes, expected effects on school size, and the status of harmonising funding for green education.
Why has the government chosen to make funding cost-following rather than basing it on substantive wishes?
Waarom heeft de regering de keuze gemaakt om de bekostiging kostenvolgend te maken in plaats van deze te baseren op inhoudelijke wensen?
Thanks the government for its detailed answers and has no further questions.
The members of the VVD group thank the government for the extensive answers to the questions in the memorandum in response to the report and therefore have no further questions on this.
De leden van de VVD-fractie danken de regering voor de uitvoerige beantwoording van de vragen in de nota naar aanleiding van het verslag en hebben hierover dan ook geen nadere vragen.
Asks whether Zeeland schools are disproportionately hit by cumulative effects of the simplified funding, and whether compensation variables can be added.

Can the government confirm that Zeeland schools are relatively hard hit as a result of a cumulation of effects, namely the simplification of funding, the decline in pupil numbers and redistribution from special needs education?

Kan de regering bevestigen dat de Zeeuwse scholen als gevolg van een openstapeling van effecten, te weten de vereenvoudiging van de bekostiging, de leerlingendaling en verevening vanuit passend onderwijs, relatief zwaar getroffen worden.
Questions the government's assumption of no behavioural effects, expects fewer broad school communities, and asks why unclear freedom of spending persists under lump-sum funding.
These members ask the government how it is that there is still uncertainty about freedom of spending in education?
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe het komt dat er nog steeds onduidelijkheid over de vrijheid van besteding bestaat in het onderwijs?

Asks whether isolated schools can be assured of a right to additional funding and how the government accounts for the direction of education, and asks about the financial implications of future problems.
They ask this against the background of concerns among schools that additional funding could be seen as a favour that could be withdrawn in the future.
Zij vragen dit tegen de achtergrond van zorgen bij scholen dat aanvullende bekostiging als een gunst gezien zou kunnen worden die op termijn zou kunnen worden ingetrokken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill simplifying the funding bases for personnel and operating costs of secondary schools, raising no remarks and advising submission to the House of Representatives. The text contains no separate government reply to any concerns, as the advice itself raised none.

35372.s: The bill makes the professional competence and refresher certificates on driving licences of drivers born before 1 July 1955 invalid by law when they have not obtained the basic qualification or completed refresher training, aligning Dutch law with EU Directive 2003/59/EC. It also sets the end date of such invalidated certificates for licences issued afterwards to the date the law takes effect, with entry into force by royal decree.
35372.j: The memorandum justifies the automatic invalidation by the conflict with the EU directive and finds subsidies and cost coverage alternatives ineffective.
q: This means that drivers born before 1 July 1955 who have not completed refresher training or obtained the basic qualification, where they should have, lose their authority to carry out road transport.

Dit betekent dat bestuurders geboren vóór 1 juli 1955 die geen nascholing hebben gevolgd of de basiskwalificatie niet hebben behaald, indien ze die wel hadden moeten behalen, hun bevoegdheid om vervoer over de weg te verrichten verliezen.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree
p: Artikel I (new article 124a, fourth paragraph, Wegenverkeerswet 1994)

Certificates of drivers born before 1 July 1955 who lack the required qualification or refresher training become invalid automatically by operation of law, without an individual administrative decision.

parties: Asks how to minimise harm to older drivers, what happens if the bill is not passed, how costs and inconvenience are limited, and when the bill takes effect.
The VVD members ask how the government will ensure that as little harm as possible is caused to older drivers by this legislative change.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de regering ervoor gaat zorgen dat er zo min mogelijk leed wordt veroorzaakt bij oudere chauffeurs door deze wetswijziging.
Objects to the government executing EU rules without question and asks about the broader financial and social consequences for affected drivers and employers.
These members express their dissatisfaction with the way the government slavishly implements these EU dogmas.
Deze leden uiten hun onvrede over de manier waarop de regering deze EU-dogma’s slaafs uitvoert.
Asks about hardship cases, residual insurance and pensions for affected drivers, communication, CBR feasibility and waiting times, and whether compensation is warranted.
These members have several questions, particularly on preventing hardship cases and on the feasibility for the Central Bureau for Driving Licences (CBR).
Deze leden hebben enkele vragen, met name op het gebied van het voorkomen van schrijnende gevallen en de uitvoerbaarheid voor het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR).
Accepts the bill as necessary and proportionate, regrets the need for it, and raises concerns about CBR backlogs and possible implementation problems.
The GroenLinks members can agree with the bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie kunnen zich vinden in het wetsvoorstel.
Asks why the government did not opt for merely invalidating code 95 while keeping existing licences, and what the implementation burden for municipalities is.
These members wonder why the government did not choose to arrange matters so that merely invalidating code 95 while keeping the existing licence would suffice.
Deze leden vragen zich af waarom de regering er niet voor heeft gekozen het zo te regelen dat kan worden volstaan met een ongeldigverklaring van alleen code 95 met behoud van het bestaande rijbewijs.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill invalidating the code 95 vocational competence certificates does not compensate affected drivers for the cost of replacing their licences, which stem from an incorrect implementation of the EU directive, and advised considering compensation. The minister's reply declined to introduce compensation, citing that drivers benefited from the code 95, the modest cost of around 40 euro, low administrative costs relative to payouts, and advance notice of the change.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the government to consider compensating drivers for licence replacement fees they incurred because of the faulty implementation of the directive, and the government declined compensation.
The bill implements the earlier Directive 2003/59/EG incorrectly, creating the need for the corrective invalidation of code 95 certificates.

35390.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code of the BES islands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) to add jurisdiction over offences endangering aircraft safety or order on board, where the flight's last departure or next scheduled landing point is in those islands and the aircraft lands there with the suspect aboard. It implements the 2014 Montreal Protocol amending the Tokyo Convention and enters into force by royal decree.
35390.j: The memorandum justifies the entry-into-force delegation as a customary provision and notes that implementing rules for European Netherlands will follow via a general administrative order amendment.
q: Article II. This concerns a customary entry-into-force provision.
Artikel II Dit betreft een gebruikelijke inwerkingtredingsbepaling.

parties: Asks on what timeline the Besluit internationale verplichtingen extraterritoriale rechtsmacht will be amended for the European Netherlands.
They note that for the European part of the Netherlands a change is coming to the Decree on international obligations regarding extraterritorial jurisdiction.
Zij lezen dat er voor het Europese deel van Nederland een wijziging komt van het Besluit internationale verplichtingen extraterritoriale rechtsmacht.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Criminal Code of the BES islands to implement the 2014 Montreal Protocol on offences aboard aircraft, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply notes that a translation error in the original Tractatenblad publication was corrected and references to the new edition have been added to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35408.s: The bill extends tenancy protection under Book 7 of the Civil Code to tenants of mooring places (ligplaatsen) for residential houseboats, applying rules on termination, dissolution by the court, inheritance and substitution of tenants. It also shifts the ministerial responsibility references to the Minister of Interior Affairs and sets a two-year transitional period for existing leases.
35408.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the wish to give houseboat mooring tenants protection similar to residential tenants, without delegating new powers to the executive.
q: It is proposed to make these provisions also apply to tenants of mooring places.
Voorgesteld wordt deze bepalingen ook te laten gelden voor huurders van ligplaatsen.

parties: Asks why mooring-place tenants get no rent-price protection and where tenants can complain, noting municipalities' dual role as supervisor of landlords and landlord themselves.
These members also ask the government to further explain how the primacy of public law has been strengthened since the report 'Vaste grond onder de voeten' was published.
Deze leden vragen de regering ook om nader toe te lichten hoe het primaat van het publiekrecht is versterkt sinds het uitkomen van het rapport «Vaste grond onder de voeten».
Asks about the legal ambiguity of the term 'ligplaats' and whether the use of the houseboat matters for the protection.
These members point out that this will lead to confusion.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat dat tot verwarring zal leiden.
Asks how tenants are protected when a contract cannot be terminated before a judge rules, how many such cases exist, and what protection exists against an owner denying access to the shore.
These members ask how many such cases have come before the judge in recent years and what share of rulings were in favour of the mooring-place tenant.
Deze leden vragen hoeveel van dergelijke gevallen de afgelopen jaren voor de rechter zijn gekomen en welk aandeel van de uitspraken in het voordeel van de huurder van de ligplaats uit is gevallen?
Welcomes the improved tenancy protection and asks why the bill took long and whether the 2013 research is still current.
These members are pleased that tenancy protection for this category of tenants is being improved, implementing a wish of the House of Representatives contained in a motion.
Deze leden zijn blij dat de huurbescherming voor deze categorie huurders wordt verbeterd en dat hiermee een wens van de Tweede Kamer vervat in een motie wordt uitgevoerd.
Criticises the absence of rent-price protection for mooring-place tenants, calling it legal inequality, and asks for current figures.
The SP members believe that all tenants deserve equal rights.
De leden van de SP-fractie vinden dat alle huurders gelijke rechten verdienen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill extending tenancy protection under Book 7 of the Civil Code to berth tenants of houseboats, but asks for clarification of the word 'bestemd' in the definition of 'ligplaats'. The government's reply confirms that 'bestemd' is meant in a private-law sense, adds clarifying text to the explanatory memorandum, and makes two textual corrections and some editorial improvements.
concerns: The definition of 'ligplaats' uses the word 'bestemd', which could be read in a public-law sense; the explanatory memorandum should clarify it is meant privately.

35417.s: The bill proposes repealing the two additional articles (additionele artikelen I and II) of the Dutch Constitution, which have already been fully implemented because their transitional periods have ended. The explanatory memorandum notes that the relevant constitutional provisions (57a, 129(3) and 54(2)) entered into force in 2006 and 2008 respectively, so the additional articles can be removed.
35417.j: The memorandum justifies repeal on the ground that the transitional provisions have been fully executed and are therefore obsolete.
q: Additional article I of the Constitution has thereby been implemented and can lapse.
Additioneel artikel I van de Grondwet is daarmee uitgewerkt en kan vervallen.

parties: Asks the government for a timeline for removing additional articles IX and XIX and whether a simple national law is needed for article XIX, without raising checks on executive power.
Can the government explain how long it is expected to still be necessary to maintain article IX, given that the Extraordinary Criminal Law Decree concerns acts committed before 15 May 1945?

Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe lang het naar verwachting nog nodig zal zijn artikel IX te handhaven, gelet op het feit dat het Besluit Buitengewoon Strafrecht ziet op feiten die vóór 15 mei 1945 zijn begaan?
Asks whether implemented additional articles should be removed faster to keep the Constitution up to date, a general question about constitutional housekeeping.
Would it therefore not be more logical in the future, to keep the Constitution as current as possible, to have these kinds of additional articles removed more quickly?
Zou het daarom in de toekomst niet logischer zijn, om met het oog op het zo actueel mogelijk houden van de Grondwet, dit soort additionele artikelen sneller te doen laten vervallen?
Has no comments on the proposal to remove the implemented additional articles.
and have no comments on the proposal.
en hebben geen opmerkingen bij het voorstel.
Asks generally why additional constitutional articles are not given temporary effect automatically, without raising a specific check on the executive.
Why is it actually chosen not to give additional articles to the Constitution a temporary effect?
Waarom wordt er eigenlijk voor gekozen om additionele artikelen bij de Grondwet geen tijdelijke werking te geven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no substantive remarks on a bill declaring grounds exist to consider amending the Constitution by removing the additional articles that have been implemented. It advised submitting the proposal to the Tweede Kamer, and the government's reply is not included in the text beyond the transmittal letter.

35426.s: The bill replaces the Infrastructure Fund Act with a Mobility Fund Act, widening the fund's purpose to cover efficiency measures, research, pilot projects and experiments in addition to infrastructure spending. It also sets subsidy rules, with parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang) only for subsidy schemes with an annual ceiling above 10 million euro, and provides for a review within five years.
35426.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded fund purposes by the need for long-term, multi-year investments and the uncertain effects of pilots that must be studied before scaling up.
q: To be able to examine effectiveness, funding of pilot projects and experiments is made possible.
Om de effectiviteit te kunnen onderzoeken wordt bekostiging van proefprojecten en experimenten mogelijk gemaakt.
d: subsidy schemes funded from the Mobility Fund
subsidy schemes funded from the Mobility Fund
p: Subsidy schemes above 10 million euro a year must be pre-submitted to the House of Representatives, while smaller schemes need no parliamentary involvement, reducing parliament's ex ante role for smaller subsidies.
Broad categories of spending, including efficiency measures and experiments, may be financed from the fund as defined by the minister.

parties: Asks how modal balance and budget schotten are guaranteed and how the Chamber's budget authority and information position are affected.
What does the transformation of the Infrastructuurfonds into the Mobiliteitsfonds mean for the information position, budget right and authorisation of budgets by the House of Representatives?
Wat betekent de omvorming van het Infrastructuurfonds in het Mobiliteitsfonds voor de informatiepositie, het budgetrecht en de autorisatie van budgetten door/van de Tweede Kamer?
Worries the fund allows easier shifting of money, undermining sector certainty, and asks for a sound assessment framework and justification for haste.
These members ask whether the government shares the concern that with the new Mobiliteitsfonds money can more easily be shifted around.
Deze leden vragen of de regering de zorgen deelt dat er met het nieuwe Mobiliteitsfonds gemakkelijker geschoven kan gaan worden met geld.
Asks why broadened scope would not be covered by standard budget frameworks and how to prevent costs unrelated to efficiency; asks about Raad van State concerns.
Can the government further explain why the regular budget frameworks would not suffice for the expenditure categories suggested for addition to the fund?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom voor de reguliere begrotingskaders voor de voor toevoeging aan het fonds gesuggereerde uitgavencategorieën niet zouden volstaan?
Supports integral approach but asks for transparency, clear control of flexible budgets on article 20 and binding climate and sustainability conditions in investment decisions.
Supports modernisation but wants climate and liveability as binding conditions, questions whether the NMCA remains suitable, and asks for clearer decision hierarchy.
How will the new law ensure that a climate-neutral solution to an accessibility problem is preferred over a climate-damaging one?
Hoe zorgt de nieuwe wet er straks voor dat een klimaat neutrale oplossing van een bereikbaarheidsvraagstuk de voorkeur krijgt boven een klimaatschadelijke oplossing?
Supports the bill but asks for concrete examples of excluded measures to sharpen scope, and questions public funding of pipelines serving few firms.
Asks how integral trade-offs are organised and whether NMCA and other appraisal instruments will be revised for new fund objectives.
Which adjustments to the NMCA are foreseen in view of the new objectives of the Mobiliteitsfonds?
Welke aanpassingen van de NMCA zijn voorzien met het oog op de nieuwe doelstellingen van het Mobiliteitsfonds?
Criticises the motivation as pre-dating climate and corona crises, questions experiments under the Raad van State critique, and raises data privacy and ICT cost-control concerns.
Temporary deviations from the law simply to try something out or to ease transition between regimes are not experiments.; the Raad van State quoted in the report.
Tijdelijke afwijkingen van de wet om zomaar iets uit te proberen of om de overgang van het ene stelsel naar het andere stelsel soepeler te laten verlopen, zijn geen experimenten.
Supports a Mobiliteitsfonds but wants a careful assessment framework and clarity on maintenance versus renovation and reporting in the MIRT overview.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises that the proposed Mobiliteitsfonds bill broadens the scope of the former Infrastructure Fund to non-infrastructure measures, which the explanatory memorandum does not justify sufficiently, and recommends further motivation. In its reply, the government defends the broadening on grounds of transparency, integrated mobility policy and technology, and denies that the purpose is unclear.
concerns: The Afdeling finds insufficient justification for placing non-infrastructure measures in a budget fund, since the rationale for a budget fund applies much less to these items; the government counters that bundling related measures and avoiding a five-year budget cutoff justify it.

The Afdeling considers the broad purpose description makes it unclear for which goals multi-year funds are set aside and which expenditures may be charged to the fund; the government rejects this, pointing to specification in the budget and MIRT.

The Afdeling notes that the regular budget framework, including multi-year reserves and end-of-year margin rules, may suffice and that fund financing is not necessary for integrated mobility policy; the government responds that these tools do not offer the same long-term certainty.

35435.s: The bill requires large enterprises to undergo an energy audit at least every four years and report it to the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, implementing EU Directive 2012/27/EU. It also shifts supervision and enforcement, including the power to impose penalty orders, from local competent authorities to the Minister, which is carried out by RVO.nl.
35435.j: The memorandum justifies the shift of enforcement to the Minister by citing an evaluation showing heavy coordination burdens, the wish for efficiency, a single point of contact, and simpler reporting to the European Commission.
q: Centrally assigning the review and enforcement process with a single point of contact for businesses reduces the regulatory burden on the one hand.
Het centraal beleggen van het toetsings- en handhavingsproces met één aanspreekpunt voor bedrijven verlaagt aan de ene kant de regeldruk.
d: Artikel I, B, Artikel 18, derde lid
rules on how audits are carried out, report requirements and how reports are sent
Artikel I, B, Artikel 18, vierde lid
alternative compliance via energy or environmental management systems or quality marks
Artikel I, B, Artikel 18, vijfde lid
designation of administrative bodies that receive audit reports
p: Supervision and enforcement of the audit duty move from local competent authorities to the Minister, who may impose penalty orders, centralising power over enterprises' compliance.

parties: The VVD has no questions or comments on the bill.
The members of the VVD group have no questions and/or comments on the present bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben geen vragen en/of opmerkingen over het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks why the Council of State's advice on an exemption for companies not yet large in 2016 was not adopted, and how penalty payments will be applied during the corona crisis.

The CDA members note that the Council of State's advisory division's advice to make an exception to the audit submission deadline for companies that were not yet large enterprises on 31 December 2016 was not incorporated by the government.

De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen dat het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (Afdeling advisering) om een uitzondering te maken bij de termijn voor het inzenden van een energie-audit voor ondernemingen die op 31 december 2016 nog geen grote onderneming waren door de regering niet is verwerkt.
Asks for results of previous audits, the number of firms that failed to comply and the sanctions for non-compliance, and how audit results were followed up.
Are there sanctions for companies that also do not meet the postponed deadline?
Zijn er sancties voor bedrijven die zich ook niet aan de verlegde deadline houden?
Regrets that audits are not followed by mandatory energy-saving measures and asks about enforcement, capacity of RVO and consequences of missed deadlines.
With insight alone we will not bring down energy demand; mandatory measures that are also enforced should follow.
Met alleen inzicht brengen we de energievraag niet omlaag, daar dienen verplichtende maatregelen op te volgen die vervolgens ook worden gehandhaafd.
Has no further questions on the proposed amendment.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet implementatie EU-richtlijnen energie-efficiëntie to create a legal basis for energy audits, raising no substantive objections and only two drafting remarks. The minister's nader rapport reports that one drafting remark was not adopted because excluding non-large companies did not fit current practice, while the second was incorporated by aligning the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling advised excluding enterprises not yet large on 31 December 2016 from the proposed second paragraph of article 18; the government did not adopt this.

The Afdeling advised replacing date references in the proposed first paragraph of article 18a with 1 July 2019; the government reworded the provision and aligned the explanatory memorandum accordingly.

35450-V.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by a first supplementary budget, raising commitments and expenditures for several policy articles and the operating apparatus. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 1 May 2020, with no delegation, oversight or review provisions.
q: that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2020
dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2020

35453.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 to tighten the new-services procedure, modernise appointment procedures and governance of public broadcasters, and clarify the position of De Ster, along with technical changes to the tasks of the Commissariaat voor de Media. Article I of the amended bill removes the incompatibility provisions that were added by the Aartsen and Van der Molen amendment.
35453.j: The memorandum justifies removing the incompatibility provisions by citing their expected limited effectiveness and partial conflict with the Constitution and the ECHR, as advised by the Council of State.
q: the European Convention for the Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms
het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Mediawet 2008 (new-services procedure, appointment procedures for supervisory boards, governance, and technical improvements). The Afdeling raised no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so no government reply was needed.

35462.s: The bill amends the Mining Act to regulate removal and reuse of offshore and onshore mining structures, pipelines and cables, extend financial security requirements for decommissioning, and make the investment deduction for offshore mining generic at 40%. It also expands ministerial powers to grant reuse exemptions, set security rules by ministerial regulation, and monitor ownership changes.
35462.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the declining investment in offshore oil and gas and the need to secure decommissioning funds, and says the minister must use the security powers when there is reasonable doubt about a company's capacity.
q: In cases where the Minister has reasonable doubt about a mining company's financial capacity to meet its decommissioning obligation, he will be able and obliged to use the power under articles 47 and 48 to require financial security.

In gevallen waarin de Minister gerede twijfel heeft over de financiële capaciteit van een mijnbouwonderneming om aan zijn verwijderingsverplichting te voldoen, zal hij gebruik kunnen en moeten maken van de bevoegdheid die hem op grond van de artikelen 47 en 48 toekomt
d: temporary exemption from removal obligation for reuse of structures
rules on removal, abandonment, reuse of mining structures and temporary inactivity exemptions
content of financial security and monitoring agreements
p: The minister gains discretion to approve removal plans with conditions and to set termination periods, and may later amend or withdraw approval.
The minister may require financial security from licence holders and cable or pipeline operators, extended to onshore facilities, at amounts and terms he deems sufficient.
Ownership-change transactions that may harm security can be annulled by a court following a notice obligation.

parties: Asks for an overview of lower-level regulation (AMvB, ministerial regulations, policy rules) and whether it carries pre- or post-legislative review provisions.
The VVD members would like an overview of possible lower-level regulations included in the proposed amendment, such as AMvBs, ministerial regulations and policy rules.

De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag een overzicht ontvangen van (mogelijk) lagere regelgeving die is opgenomen in de voorliggende wetswijziging, bijvoorbeeld algemene maatregelen van bestuur (amvb), ministeriële regelingen, beleidsregels etc.
Asks how financial risks for the state and companies are distributed, who bears decommissioning costs if a company fails, and whether the state would have to pay more.
These members ask who will bear the costs if the company goes bankrupt.
Deze leden vragen wie er opdraait voor de kosten als het bedrijf failliet gaat.
Questions the basis for the 40% deduction and asks for analysis showing it is necessary, arguing the gas sector should not receive more funding than strictly needed.
The GroenLinks members ask the government to present an analysis showing the basis for raising the deduction to 40% and demonstrating that such a significant increase is actually necessary.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen de regering een analyse te presenteren, waaruit blijkt waar deze verhoging tot 40% op is gebaseerd en waaruit blijkt dat een dergelijke significante verhoging daadwerkelijk noodzakelijk is.
Opposes the higher investment deduction, asks whether public money will be spent on decommissioning and reuse, and questions liability and compensation for nearby residents.
They will therefore not repeat that they are generally opposed to investments in exploring and extracting natural gas at new locations.
Zij zullen dan ook niet herhalen dat zij over het algemeen tegen investeringen in het opsporen en winnen van aardgas op nieuwe locaties zijn.
Considers the higher deduction undesirable as it would expand onshore gas extraction, creating social unrest, and asks whether the bill will be amended to apply only offshore.
These members consider this development undesirable because it would in effect expand gas extraction through economic stimulation.
Deze leden achten deze ontwikkeling onwenselijk omdat hiermee in feite via economische stimulering de gaswinning zal worden uitgebreid.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Mining Act on removal and reuse of mining works and an investment deduction for offshore mining, raising points on the conversion mechanism, financial security, the scope of the deduction, and property rights. The Minister's reply states that the conversion provision was dropped, financial security was clarified with a delegation basis, the deduction was made generic with explanation, and the property concern was addressed by limiting the EBN rule.
concerns: The conversion of exemptions into Waterwet/Wabo/Omgevingswet permits was unclear in timing and added value, and the provision was dropped in favour of a consent-based procedure.

The investment deduction was made generic, and the Commission's selectivity concern was addressed, but the Afdeling's doubts about profitable fields and the energy transition rationale were only partly answered.
Financial security was made more predictable through a delegation basis for an AMvB on calculating the amount, with explanation added to the memorie.
Retroactive transfer of gas ownership under concessions could infringe property rights; the provision was limited to cases where EBN has a right to sales proceeds.
Cross-references, article 44 notifications and the wording of article 97e were corrected for consistency.

35470-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement (slotwet) for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council, adjusting appropriations and realised figures. It grants no new rule-making or decision powers to the executive and contains no delegation of legislative authority.
q: So it is that, with the joint consultation of the States General, We have resolved and decided as follows: Article 1 The budget statement of the other High Councils of State, Governors' Cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) for the year 2019 is amended as shown in the annexed statement.

Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad (IIB) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35471.s: The bill establishes a statutory framework for ambulance services in the Netherlands, designating a single Regionale Ambulancevoorziening per region with exclusive rights and obligations to provide ambulance care. It sets quality, governance, transparency and supervision requirements, with ministerial and NZa/IGJ enforcement powers including administrative directions, forced administrators and withdrawal of designation.
35471.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying detailed and change-prone rules belong in ministerial regulation for flexibility, and that the legislature cannot foresee quality development.
q: Under government legislative policy, delegation to a minister is limited to administrative rules, elaboration of details and rules that often need amendment.
Volgens het wetgevingsbeleid van de regering wordt delegatie aan een Minister beperkt tot administratieve voorschriften, uitwerking van details en voorschriften die dikwijls wijziging behoeven.
d: categories of ambulance professionals and qualification requirements
requirements for Regionale Ambulancevoorzieningen, may differ per region
categories of hospital data received by RAV and retention period
training or expertise requirements for medical officers
further requirements on data provision to the minister
rules on profit distribution by RAV and subcontractors
exemption from provisions of the act for designated ambulance care
powers and remuneration of a bewindvoerder set by the minister
p: The minister may issue binding written directions to an RAV and appoint a bewindvoerder over it, with a 7-day order renewable without limit while danger persists.
The minister may amend or withdraw the designation of an RAV on broad grounds including the interest of the minister's assessment, after only advisory consultation.
The minister designates the single legal person that holds exclusive ambulance care rights per region.
Changes of control, mergers or legal form of an RAV require prior ministerial consent.
The minister may impose penalty payments, administrative enforcement and administrative fines on RAVs.

parties: Asks whether non-urgent planned ambulance care can be classed as a non-economic service given the Council of State's doubts, and how the minister's intervention powers would operate.
These members read that guaranteeing continuity of ambulance care as a crucial link in the acute care chain requires strong public safeguards.
Genoemde leden lezen dat het waarborgen van de continuïteit van de cruciale schakel die de ambulancezorg is in de keten van acute zorg, sterke publieke waarborgen vergt.

Questions the persisting public-private mix, asks for quality guarantees and staffing safeguards now that providers receive a monopoly position, and requests an annual quality check rather than five-yearly visitation.
In the context of the changing care landscape there should be at least an annual quality check.
In het kader van het veranderende zorglandschap zou er minimaal een jaarlijkse kwaliteitscontrole moeten plaatsvinden.
Asks whether the Landsadvocaat was consulted on the uncertain NEDAB qualification, whether a foreign provider lawsuit is likely, and why no sub-norm per municipality was set.
These members also ask whether the government can estimate whether a lawsuit by a (foreign) provider could be launched if this bill is adopted.

Deze leden vragen ook of de regering een inschatting kan maken of het de verwachting is dat er een rechtszaak door een (buitenlandse) aanbieder gestart zou kunnen worden als dit wetsvoorstel wordt aangenomen.

Presses the government on the risk that the bill fails EU-law review as a non-economic service, the reasoning for rejecting concession and public models, and the likelihood of an infringement procedure.

To their concern, however, these members read in the Council of State's advice that in light of case law it is very uncertain that ambulance care, as designed in this proposal, can indeed be classed as an NEDAB.

Tot hun zorg lezen de genoemde leden in het advies van de Raad van State echter dat het gelet op de rechtspraak voor de Raad zeer onzeker is dat de ambulancezorg, zoals vormgegeven met dit voorstel, inderdaad is aan te merken als NEDAB.

Supports the NEDAB aim but questions implementation, asks why insurers still fund the service if the Council of State expects the bill to fail EU review, and asks whether care offices could coordinate instead.
As far as the Council of State is concerned, this law will not pass the EU test and ambulance care will not be classified as an NEDAB because of the hybrid character of its activities.
Wat de Raad van State betreft zal deze wet de EU-toets niet doorstaan en zal de ambulancezorg zal niet worden aangemerkt als NEDAB vanwege het «hybride» karakter aan activiteiten.

Favours a strictly non-market public service without profit distribution, asks about staffing shortages, the 15-minute norm failures in Brabant, and whether the minister will impose quality checks and an evaluation clause.
They are of the view that ambulance care should be a public provision without profit motive.
Zij zijn van mening dat de ambulancezorg een publieke voorziening zonder winstoogmerk zou moeten zijn.

Questions the replacement of the ambulance nurse with the 'ambulancezorgprofessional' title, the bill's effect on response times, and which further quality norms will be set in the ministerial regulation.
The PvdA members wish to express their concern about the disappearance of the central position of the ambulance nurse in ambulance care.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen hun zorgen uiten met betrekking tot het verdwijnen van centrale positie van de ambulanceverpleegkundige in de ambulancezorg.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against submitting the bill on ambulance care organisation (RAVs designated indefinitely) unless revised, citing serious doubts that ambulance care is a non-economic service of general interest under EU free movement rules, and objecting to a government commissioner with veto power and other design choices. The government's nader rapport accepts dropping the commissioner and several other points, while defending the NEDAB classification and the indefinite designation.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that ambulance care qualifies as a non-economic service of general interest under EU free movement rules given its hybrid financing; the government disagrees in part but adds clarifications on budget financing and the public character of tariffs.

The Afdeling advises considering alternatives such as concessions or a fully public service, which the government rejects on continuity and stability grounds, adding justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling objects to the government-appointed commissioner with veto power over RAV decisions, citing interference with local governance and external supervisors; the government drops the commissioner.
The Afdeling asks how restrictions on profit distribution would account for the financial risks RAVs bear; the government adds explanation in the memorandum.

The Afdeling asks that exceptions from the Act be set out in the statute itself and that the ministerial power to request further data be narrowed; the government revises the bill and explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling finds subdelegation of rules on health data disclosure by ministerial regulation undesirable and advises an AMvB instead; the government adopts this change.
The Afdeling offers redactional corrections, including the IGJ/Minister wording, which the government adopts.

35480.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Municipal Fund (Gemeentefonds) through an incidental supplementary budget to fund municipal measures related to the coronavirus crisis, raising the commitment amount to €26.523.201.000 and setting new integration and decentralisation grant commitments. It takes effect from 1 June 2020, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: the need has become apparent to amend the Municipal Fund for the year 2020
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van het Gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2020

35516.s: The bill allows landlords of freely rented (liberalised) dwellings to agree temporary rent reductions or freezes at the tenant's request and then to recover the lost increases later, by amending Book 7 of the Civil Code and the Rent Price Act. It also extends a 2014 housing-market measure deadline by one year and includes transitional provisions tied to a pending private member's bill.
35516.j: The memorandum justifies the change by saying landlords are currently unwilling to grant temporary rent reductions because rent rules only allow permanent reductions, so the new permission is needed to make such reductions possible.
q: Landlords are currently less or not inclined to grant a temporary rent reduction because the rent price rules only provide for a permanent rent reduction.
Verhuurders zijn nu minder of niet genegen om een tijdelijke huurkorting te geven doordat de huurprijsregelgeving alleen maar in een permanente huurkorting voorziet.

parties: Asks how the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties will verify whether temporary rent reductions are legitimate and prevent misuse for housing allowance.
The VVD members would like to see specified, also through examples, in which cases there is part of rent policy and in which cases a financial contribution.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zouden graag gespecifieerd zien, ook aan de hand van voorbeelden, in welke gevallen er sprake is van onderdeel van het huurbeleid en in welke gevallen er sprake is van een financiële bijdrage.
Asks which groups (students, starters, carers) can use the temporary reduction and how they will be reached.
The CDA members ask the government whether the possibility of a temporary rent reduction also applies to specific groups such as students, starters and/or informal carers?

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering of de mogelijkheid tot tijdelijke huurkorting, zoals geregeld in onderhavige wetswijziging, ook geldt voor specifieke groepen als studenten, starters en/of mantelzorgers?
Asks how tenants will be informed of the option and of consequences for housing allowance, and what happens if they fail to report changes.
These members ask how tenants will be informed of the possibility.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze huurders van de mogelijkheid op de hoogte worden gesteld.
Says the target group is too narrow, excluding tenants in the liberalised sector and non-corporation social tenants, and asks how the one-off reduction avoids a large rent rise the following year.
These members consider this too limited a target group.
Deze leden vinden dit een te beperkte doelgroep.

Asks why no enforceable right to a temporary reduction exists, what happens if a landlord refuses, and whether the Huurcommissie can handle such cases; also questions the size of any catch-up rent increase.
The SP members ask why no enforceable right is created for the rent reduction, while this does happen for the rent reduction under the one-off rent reduction act.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom er geen afdwingbaar recht wordt gemaakt voor de huurkorting, maar dat dit wel gebeurt bij de huurverlaging via de wet «eenmalige huurverlaging».
Worries tenants can be refused a rent reduction and asks on what grounds, and why the right is not enforceable, arguing tenants should be entitled to reductions when income falls.
The PvdA members are concerned about the possibility of being refused when applying for a rent reduction.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie maken zich zorgen over de mogelijkheid om afgewezen te worden bij een aanvraag tot huurverlaging.
Asks about the coherence with the bill on rent increases for single-person households and how tenants can be guided on tax obligations and avoid homelessness.
The ChristenUnie members ask about the coherence of this bill and the act amending rent increase possibilities and income limits under the Housing Act.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen naar de samenhang van dit wetsvoorstel en de Wet wijziging huurverhogingsmogelijkheden en inkomensgrenzen Woningwet.
Asks whether temporariness works as a solution for older people wanting to move, and what role landlords play in agreeing structural solutions.
Is temporariness of the act really a solution if the rent is an important obstacle to moving?
Is tijdelijkheid van de wet wel een oplossing, als de huurprijs een belangrijke belemmering is om te verhuizen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill differentiating the social rental income limit by household size, changing income-dependent rent increases, and expanding free allocation space, raising remarks on market effectiveness, coherence of measures, and the state aid/DAEB framework with the European Commission. The government's nader rapport adopted most points by adding explanation and revising the explanatory memorandum, while not formally notifying the Commission, and split the bill to a separate temporary rent discount law.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clearer explanation of the expected effectiveness of the measures to stimulate movement out of social rental housing, given limited alternatives in the private market.

The Afdeling noted coherence problems between the differentiated income limits, the structural increase in free allocation space, and recent middle-segment measures, which the government addressed only partly.

The Afdeling advised verifying with the European Commission that the changed DAEB income limit and free allocation space remain within the 2009 state aid decision and not to enter into force before agreement; the government argued formal notification was unnecessary and sought informal guidance.

35543.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by fifth supplementary budget changes, mainly to fund extra costs of public broadcasting programming and youth unemployment support linked to COVID-19. The amendment is set in thousands of euros and takes effect retroactively from 31 August 2020 or the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2020

35570-IIA.s: This bill adopts the 2021 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Staten-Generaal, setting its expenditure and revenue in thousands of euros, and takes effect from 1 January of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum describes the four policy articles covering the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer, members' allowances and interparliamentary activities.
q: The budget statement for the year 2021 is hereby adopted.
De begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for all ministries and funds, finding no remarks on the proposals except one non-blanco advice on the Ministry of Finance budget. The Minister of Finance replied in a nader rapport, addressing the single remark in an annex and noting some budget amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling raised one remark on the Ministry of Finance budget, which the government addresses in an annex not included in the text.

35606.s: The bill restructures vocational education governance: it replaces the agricultural training centre (aoc) and vakinstelling with a new 'beroepscollege' type, lets aoc's become vertical school communities, and makes the legal entity rather than the management the addressee for funding and supervision. It also eases institutional and governance mergers, adds reallocation of funds within one board, and introduces a legal basis for SBB-approved leerbedrijf recognition.
35606.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for uniform, practical implementation of consolidation and funding rules and for SBB operations, with ministerial approval as a check.
q: A beroepscollege has primarily a sectoral and often more national function, focusing on a specific industry or group of industries.
Een beroepscollege heeft primair een sectorale en vaak meer landelijke functie, en richt zich op een specifieke bedrijfstak of een groep van bedrijfstakken.
d: SBB statutes and internal governance rules
recognition conditions for training companies set by SBB regulation
further rules on fusion, splitting and conversion procedures
rules on use of state funding for private activities in education
rules on investing, borrowing and financial products by governing body
rules for forming, changing or ending a vertical school community
p: Ministerial approval and reporting shift some governance and transfer decisions toward central control, with limited waivers at ministerial discretion.
The Minister may issue binding directions to governing bodies for mismanagement, with the criteria for wanbeheer partly open-ended and subject only to an inspection report and four-week hearing.
The Minister may refuse fusion approval where it significantly impedes provider diversity, guided by an advisory committee and policy rules.

parties: Asks whether vertical school communities reduce student choice and how institutions keep their identity, and how 'educational factories' are prevented.
How do institutions ensure they keep their own identity when they merge into a larger organisation?
Hoe zorgen instellingen ervoor hun eigen identiteit te behouden, als zij opgaan in een grotere organisatie?
Asks why havo and vwo schools are excluded from vertical school communities and what the regional and funding consequences are.
They therefore still have question marks about excluding vo schools that also offer havo and vwo from cooperating with mbo institutions.
Daarom hebben zij wel nog hun vraagtekens over het uitsluiten van vo-scholen die ook havo en vwo aanbieden om samen te werken met mbo-instellingen.
Raises concern that parents' role is weaker under the Web/Wor participation regime and asks how this will be addressed beyond information campaigns.
What will the government do to remove these concerns, beyond active information provision, these members ask.
Wat gaat de regering doen om deze zorgen weg te nemen, naast actieve voorlichting, zo vragen deze leden.
Argues that the medezeggenschap position of parents, students and teachers is crucial and asks why a stronger participation model was not chosen.
These members consider the participation position of pupils, students, parents and teachers crucial for safeguarding education quality.
Voornoemde leden vinden de medezeggenschapspositie van scholieren, studenten, ouders en docenten cruciaal voor het borgen van de kwaliteit van onderwijs.
Doubts the bill's approach, questions the omission of staff rights, the choice against independent regulation scenarios, and the primacy of public education under Article 23.
On what grounds does the government adopt in this bill a starting point entirely opposite to Article 23 of the Constitution?
Op grond van welke overwegingen kiest de regering bij dit wetsvoorstel nu een uitgangspunt van volledig het tegenovergestelde van het uitgangspunt van artikel 23 van de Grondwet
Supports the proposal but asks how a public vmbo offer and mixing of students from all social backgrounds will be guaranteed.
How does this bill ensure that pupils and students from all layers of society continue to meet each other, these members ask.
Hoe zorgt dit wetsvoorstel ervoor dat leerlingen en studenten uit alle lagen van de samenleving elkaar blijven ontmoeten, zo vragen deze leden.
Questions the ministerial instruction power's four-week consultation procedure for urgent cases, the scope of conditions, and the statutes-approval competence of the supervisory board.
To what extent is the bill a reason to examine whether the instruction procedure is adequate to effectively address all situations named in the article, these members ask.
In hoeverre is het wetsvoorstel aanleiding om te bezien of de procedure voor de aanwijzing adequaat is om effectief te voorzien in alle in het artikel genoemde situaties, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 23 September 2020, on a bill harmonising governance of vocational education by converting agricultural training centres into vertical school communities; its main remark was that the retroactive effect clause was too broad and should be limited. The minister's nader rapport of 13 October 2020 states that the retroactivity provision was removed from the bill, along with several redactional and technical changes.
concerns: The retroactive effect clause in article XIII was too broad, not limited to the parts needed for funding under the WVO model, and was affecting a burdensome arrangement; the Afdeling advised narrowing it.
Several redactional improvements were proposed, which the government incorporated, including adding a citation title and aligning cross-references.

35633.s: The bill amends the Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij to end fur animal farming earlier by shortening the transition period to the day after the amending act enters into force. It adds an article under which the Minister may grant, on application, compensation to fur farmers for damage exceeding the normal social risk caused by the early end.
35633.j: The memorandum justifies the compensation power as required by article 14 of the Constitution and article 1 of Protocol 1 ECHR, with the details to be fixed in a policy rule.
q: Under the proposed article 8, the Minister, under the conditions stated there, grants on application a compensation to fur farmers for damage caused by the entry into force of this bill.

Op grond van het voorgestelde artikel 8 kent de Minister, onder de daar genoemde voorwaarden, op aanvraag een vergoeding toe aan pelsdierhouders voor schade die wordt veroorzaakt door inwerkingtreding van dit wetsvoorstel.
d: compensation for damage to fur farmers caused by early termination
p: The Minister is given a compensation power to grant or refuse payment on application, although the memorandum states this is a gebonden bevoegdheid with the details to be set in a policy rule.

parties: Asks for data on farms, mink numbers, compensation calculation and the basis for the NVWA's advice on timing.
These members still have a number of questions about the proposed bill.
Deze leden hebben nog een aantal vragen over het voorliggend wetsvoorstel.
Supports rapid closure of mink farming to prevent reservoir formation, but questions the ethical justification in the explanatory memorandum and the compensation amounts.

And because SARS-CoV-2 is a disease transmissible from animal to human and to prevent future reservoir formation at mink farms, these members support the accelerated ending of mink farming in the Netherlands.

En omdat SARS-CoV-2 een ziekte is die van dier op mens overdraagbaar is en om toekomstige reservoirvorming bij nertsenbedrijven te voorkomen, steunen deze leden het versneld beëindigen van de nertsenhouderij in Nederland.
Supports early closure on animal welfare and public health grounds; asks about subsidy scheme timing and the NVWA's concerns and reported welfare abuses on farms.
These members believe it is a good development that mink farming is closed early, in the interest of animal welfare but also public health.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het een goede ontwikkeling is dat de nertsenhouderij vroegtijdig wordt gesloten, in het belang van dierenwelzijn, maar ook in het belang van de volksgezondheid.
Welcomes the quick bill and removal of the nitrogen credit scheme, but questions the basis for the size of compensation and the risk of farms relocating abroad.
These members hear many voices in society that the compensation for mink farmers is out of proportion with the compensation other sectors receive.
Deze leden horen veel geluiden in de samenleving dat de nadeelcompensatie voor nertsenhouders niet in verhouding staat tot de compensatie die andere sectoren krijgen.
Regrets the delay in legislation, accepts that farmers may litigate and that courts upheld the ban, but considers the proposed compensation too generous.
Asks whether the bill could trigger lawsuits that delay ruming, whether the compensation policy rule is agreed with the sector, and whether the NVWA can enforce the law.
Is the government aware of signals that the present amendment could also lead to a lawsuit?
Kent de regering de signalen dat de nu voorliggende wetswijziging eveneens zou kunnen leiden tot een rechtszaak?

Welcomes the end of the sector but criticises the government's slow reaction against the precautionary principle recommended by the Van Dijk committee and asks for a ban on exporting inventory and a European ban; also questions why the scheme is set by policy rule rather than a general administrative order giving Parliament more say.
They are of the opinion that the House should have more say over a scheme of this size.
Zij zijn van mening dat de Kamer meer te zeggen dient te hebben over een regeling van deze omvang.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supported the early end of fur farming for public health reasons but advised against the compensation provision (it should be binding, not discretionary) and against the nitrogen netting scheme (it preserves nitrogen capacity rather than reducing it and treats mink farmers differently), recommending deleting that scheme. The government's reply adopted the binding compensation rule, clarified the timetable for its elaboration, and removed the nitrogen-capacity provision, while leaving open future restrictions.
concerns: The discretionary compensation power was held to pre-judge the individual assessment; the government changed it to a binding entitlement.
Uncertainty for farmers about how and when the compensation rule would be elaborated; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The nitrogen netting scheme undermines the reduction of nitrogen deposition needed for Natura 2000 and is not justified; the provision was deleted.
Unequal treatment of mink farmers compared with other livestock farmers on the 30% nitrogen deduction was unexplained; the government dropped the provision and left open future restrictions instead.

35642.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/633 on unfair trading practices in the agricultural and food supply chain by prohibiting listed practices such as late payment, unilateral contract changes and retaliation against suppliers. It assigns enforcement to the Autoriteit Consument en Markt, allows an optional dispute committee whose rulings become binding unless challenged in court within three months, and sets maximum fines.
35642.j: The memorandum justifies the enforcement powers and the committee by the EU directive's requirements and by the power imbalance between producers and buyers that deters suppliers from going to court.
q: Article 6: The minister may designate a committee tasked with settling disputes between buyers and suppliers over the application of articles 2 to 4.
Onze Minister kan een commissie aanwijzen die belast is met het beslechten van geschillen tussen afnemers en leveranciers inzake de toepassing van de artikelen 2 tot en met 4.
p: The minister may designate a committee whose binding rulings bind the parties unless a party refers the dispute to the civil court within three months.
The Autoriteit Consument en Markt may impose administrative fines, penalty payments and independent orders on violators, subject to general administrative law appeal.

parties: Asks why stricter national rules were not adopted, how the dispute committee and ACM enforcement work, and whether the bill is sufficient to correct cost-revenue imbalances.
Why was it chosen not to introduce stricter rules?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen geen strengere regels in te voeren?
Asks whether stricter national rules were considered, how the dispute committee will be set up, and whether 'force majeure' can justify unilateral order cancellation.
Has the government considered introducing stricter rules in the Netherlands?
Heeft de regering overwogen om strengere regels in Nederland te gaan stellen?
Asks why the directive was transposed one-to-one, how ACM complaints and reporting to parliament work, and how other member states implemented the rules.
What is the reason the government chose to transpose the directive one-to-one?
Wat is de reden dat de regering heeft gekozen om de richtlijn een op een over te nemen?
Argues the bill leaves opportunities unused, urging a general ban on unfair practices and a broader list such as sales below production cost, and more public transparency of ACM complaint handling.
Is the government willing to introduce a general ban on unfair trading practices? If not, why not?
Is de regering bereid een algemeen verbod op oneerlijke handelspraktijken in te voeren? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Asks how a dominant buyer can be prevented from forcing suppliers to accept terms, whether the 'agreed in advance' exception undermines protection, and how ACM complaints can stay anonymous.
How can it be prevented that the relative power position of a (large) buyer leads to suppliers effectively being forced to accept the stated conditions?
Hoe kan worden voorkomen dat de relatieve machtspositie van een (grote) afnemer er niet toe gaat leiden dat leveranciers feitelijk gedwongen worden in te stemmen met de gestelde voorwaarden?
Asks how farmers will be encouraged and informed to use the low-threshold dispute resolution and whether producers from developing countries can access it.
These members ask how the government will encourage farmers to also use this low-threshold dispute resolution.
Deze leden vragen hoe de regering gaat stimuleren dat boeren ook gebruik gaan maken van deze laagdrempelige geschillenbeslechting

Asks whether delisting threats and costs imposed for certification such as PlanetProof should be covered, whether complaints can be anonymous, and whether cooperative advance-payment practices remain possible.
Will the government consider how this bill can prevent suppliers, due to economic dependence, feeling forced to incur costs for certification such as PlanetProof without reasonable compensation?

Wil de regering bezien hoe via het voorliggende wetsvoorstel voorkomen kan worden dat vanwege de economische afhankelijkheid leveranciers zich gedwongen voelen om zonder redelijke vergoeding kosten te maken voor keurmerken als PlanetProof

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on the Dutch bill implementing EU Directive 2019/633 on unfair trading practices in the agricultural and food supply chain, raising concerns about turnover thresholds timing, the alternative dispute resolution commission (binding decisions, short appeal period, procedural burden on buyers), and the justification of the fine ceiling.
