The minister's reply largely adopted these points: it clarified the timing of threshold testing with the Commission, lengthened the appeal period to three months, explained the burden of proof and the fine ceiling, and made a drafting correction.
concerns: Unclear whether turnover thresholds apply at contract conclusion or at the time of the trading practice, which matters for multi-year contracts; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

Buyers' access to court is affected by the mandatory dispute commission and the six-week appeal period, which was too short; the period was extended to three months and the procedural position was clarified, though the choice for a state-designated commission over sector-led dispute resolution was defended.
The fine ceiling of EUR 900,000 or 10% of turnover lacked reasoned justification; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with reasons for deterrence and comparability with other regimes.
A transposition table reference regarding Article 8(1) of the Directive needed to be added.

35650-IIB.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2020 departmental budget for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, with net expenditure changes across articles such as the Council of State and the Ombudsman. The changes reflect Covid-19 related costs for home working, shifts in the timing of spending on the Lange Voorhout building, and a reallocation of housing costs linked to the Binnenhof renovation.
q: As a result of the Covid-19 measures, the Council of State also had to introduce home working.
Ten gevolge van de Covid-19 maatregelen is ook bij de Raad van State de noodzaak ontstaan om te gaan thuiswerken.

35705.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) through an incidental supplementary budget related to Winair, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 January 2021. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were provided.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35723.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding a third incidental supplementary budget to expand the economic support and recovery package. It also sets the effective date of the amendment, with retroactive effect to 3 February 2021.
35723.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by the need for final payments on the TOGS scheme and higher expected costs of the TVL support during the lockdown.
q: To cover final payments for the TOGS scheme in connection with objections and appeals, the budget for 2021 is increased by €1.6 million.
Ten behoeve van laatste betalingen voor de regeling TOGS in verband met bezwaar en beroep wordt het budget in 2021 verhoogd met € 1,6 mln.

35732.s: The bill inserts into the Public Health Act a power for the minister, by ministerial regulation, to restrict staying in the open air, covering the COVID-19 evening curfew after the Wbbbg basis was challenged in court. It also gives the existing national curfew regulation a statutory footing and provides criminal enforcement and an order-under-penalty mechanism.
35732.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to contain the virus variants, citing OMT advice, and argues that the curfew is a proportionate, legitimate and necessary restriction.
q: As under the Wbbbg, it becomes possible to restrict staying in the open air by ministerial regulation.
Net als onder de Wbbbg wordt het mogelijk om bij ministeriële regeling het vertoeven in de openlucht te beperken.
d: ARTIKEL I, B (art. 58j, eerste lid, onder f Wpg)
restricting staying in the open air (curfew)
p: ARTIKEL I, B (art. 58j, eerste lid, onder f Wpg)

Adds a power for ministers to restrict staying in the open air by ministerial regulation, limiting citizens' freedom of movement, subject only to subsequent laying before Parliament and a purpose limit to infectious disease control.
Extends exemption and enforcement powers and order-under-penalty to the new open-air restriction, enlarging administrative reach over citizens.
Deems the existing national curfew regulation adopted under the new statutory power, removing its previous legal basis problems without a fresh decision-making process.

parties: Asks about the status of the Voortduringswet and whether the curfew's proportionality versus legal basis is a separate question from the court ruling.
Can the government confirm that the summary judge suspended the temporary curfew on a procedural ground (an alleged lack of urgency) rather than on a proportionality test?

Kan de regering bevestigen dat de voorzieningenrechter in het vonnis de tijdelijke avondklok buiten werking stelde op grond van een procedureel argument (een vermeend gebrekkig spoedeisend karakter) en niet op basis van een proportionaliteitstoets?
Wants the curfew's time limit set explicitly in the statute rather than left to lower regulation, and asks about penalties.
Would it not be fitting and required, also from the perspective of restricting civil rights, to explicitly state in the law that a time limit must be set for the duration of the curfew?

Zou het niet passend en geboden zijn, ook uit een optiek van de beperking van burgerrechten, om expliciet in de wet ... op te nemen dat een tijdslimiet bepaald moet worden ten aanzien van de duur van de avondklok?
Regrets the legal uncertainty, questions the effect of the curfew separately from the one-visitor rule, and asks about consequences for fines and the pending appeal.
Can the government further explain how the OMT arrived at this calculation?
Kan de regering nader toelichten hoe het OMT tot deze berekening is gekomen?
Questions the evidence base, proportionality and legal form of the curfew, and asks for better measurement instruments and criteria for ending the measure.
Does the government see an opportunity to provide measurement instruments to generate current and complete information so it can make sound statements about the effectiveness of the measures taken?

Ziet de regering kans te voorzien in meetinstrumenten om in de nabije toekomst actuele en volledige informatie te genereren om deugdelijke uitspraken te kunnen doen over de effectiviteit van de genomen maatregelen

Objects to the shortened consultation period, questions the Eerste Kamer's role in extensions via ministerial regulation, and asks why mayors may grant exemptions without consulting the health council.
Does this concretely mean that the House of Representatives does have decisive say over a possible extension of the curfew, but the Senate has nothing more to say about a possible extension?

Betekent dit dan ook concreet dat de Tweede Kamer wél beslissende zeggenschap heeft bij een eventuele verlening van de avondklok, maar dat de Eerste Kamer niets meer te zeggen heeft over een mogelijke verlenging van de maatregel?
Asks why the Twm route was not chosen and whether a less intrusive advisory form of the curfew was considered, given proportionality and subsidiarity concerns raised by the court.
Does the government not consider there to be a chance that a subsequent judge will again find the curfew in conflict with requirements of subsidiarity and proportionality?
Acht de regering dan niet de kans aanwezig dat een volgende rechter wederom de avondklok strijdig gaat vinden met eisen van subsidiariteit en proportionaliteit?
Asks how the statutory tests in Wpg article 58b (necessity, rights minimisation, proportionality) were met and what happens to fines if the legal basis proves wrong.

The members asking here inquire about the consequences for fines already issued if the legal basis on which the measure rests turns out not to be correct in the view of the Court of Appeal in The Hague.

De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen naar het gevolg voor reeds uitgeschreven boetes wanneer de rechtsgrond waar de maatregel op gebaseerd is, niet juist blijkt te zijn naar het oordeel van het gerechtshof Den Haag.
Strongly criticises the government's use of the Wbbbg, the absence of prior formal legislation for restricting fundamental rights, and the lack of timely Eerste Kamer approval of the Voortduringswet.
This still has not happened today, 17 February 2021.
Dit is ook nu, op 17 februari 2021, nog altijd niet gebeurd.
Argues an extensive state power to restrict liberty should not be enacted via an urgent law outside the Article 103 emergency regime, and questions the 10% effect estimate and proportionality.
Is it logical to regulate a low-threshold curfew in an urgent law, while the Wbbbg and Article 103 of the Constitution reserve that instrument for exceptional, urgent situations?
Is het logisch om een laagdrempelige avondklok te regelen in een spoedwet, terwijl de Wbbbg en artikel 103 van de Grondwet dat middel reserveren voor uitzonderlijke, spoedeisende situaties?
Asks why the bill was initially not framed as an amendment to the Wpg and whether the curfew would be lifted immediately if the necessity disappears.
Why was it initially not chosen to do this in the present situation as well?
Waarom is er in onderhavige situatie aanvankelijk niet voor gekozen dit ook te doen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Temporary Act restricting presence in the open air (avondklok) to curb COVID-19, criticising the choice of a separate law instead of amending the Twm and the thin proportionality justification. The government's reply accepted the advice to amend the Wpg/Twm route and to strengthen the proportionality reasoning in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling advised justifying in the explanatory memorandum why the measure was not included in the Twm as a separate law, or else recasting it as an amendment to the Twm; the government followed this by recasting it as an amendment to the Wpg.

The Afdeling found the proportionality assessment merely referred to earlier OMT advice and lacked a self-standing, current weighing of public health against fundamental freedoms; the government followed this and supplemented the explanatory memorandum.

35804.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management by adding 370,000 thousand euros to article 16 (public transport and rail) for the availability allowance for the public transport sector in Q4 2021. It sets budget amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 January 2021.
q: Changes to the fourth supplementary budget concerning the availability allowance for public transport, Q4 2021
Mutaties vierde incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake Beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV Q4 2021

35830-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement (Slotwet) for the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, setting realised spending and receipts against the original and supplementary budgets. It also fixes that amounts are in thousands of euros and that the law takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December 2020.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the other High Councils of State, Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) for 2020 (closing budget act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad (IIB) voor het jaar 2020 (Slotwet)

35831.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2021 amendment to the ESM Treaty, expanding the ESM's role in designing and monitoring financial assistance programmes and introducing a common backstop for the Single Resolution Fund. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
35831.j: The memorandum justifies the enlarged ESM role as improving the effectiveness of assistance programmes while avoiding overlap with the Commission's tasks.
d: ESM Treaty amendment incl. annexes III and IV adjustable by Board of Governors
p: The Board of Governors may amend the criteria for loan approval and disbursement in annex IV, with such changes taking effect after national procedures; the memorandum notes that Dutch parliamentary approval applies to such changes under Article 91 of the Constitution.

parties: Asks how parliament will be given consultation opportunities before ESM decisions on the backstop, and what effect a parliamentary reservation has on ESM decision-making.
How is it ensured that the House is offered opportunities to consult with the cabinet?
Hoe wordt geborgd dat de Kamer overlegmogelijkheden met het kabinet worden geboden?
Asks what ESM's own responsibility for debt sustainability analysis means, the value of preventive credit lines unused so far, and the size of the additional interest margin.
The PVV members want to know what this responsibility precisely entails and what consequences it may have for ESM members.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten wat deze verantwoordelijkheid precies inhoudt en wat voor gevolgen dit kan hebben voor de ESM-leden.

Supports the amendments for strengthening monetary stability, but asks about discretionary room left to the Commission and Council and whether checks and balances remain in balance with the ESM's larger role.
ask the government to explain this discretionary room and in particular the process by which it is used.
vragen de regering deze discretionaire ruimte toe te lichten en met name het proces hoe daar gebruik van wordt gemaakt.
Questions whether taxpayers will bear the costs of failing banks, whether the new arrangements make support programmes faster, and what sovereignty powers are transferred.
ask the government how it can be prevented that the taxpayer is saddled with the costs of failing banks.
vragen de regering hoe voorkomen kan worden dat de belastingbetaler met de kosten van falende banken wordt opgezadeld.

Finds the explanation of the common backstop clear but asks for further reflection on risks to Dutch taxpayers in a major crisis; asks why ex-post rather than ex-ante information applies to ESM payouts.
ask the government for further reflection on the risks to the costs ultimately borne by the Dutch taxpayer.
vragen de regering om een nadere reflectie op de risico's voor de kosten van uiteindelijk de Nederlandse belastingbetaler

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill approving the amendment to the ESM Treaty and advised submitting it to parliament, with only drafting remarks. The government's reply explains why the treaty does not extend to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba and clarifies the explanatory memorandum, adopting the drafting changes.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should state the reasons why the treaty does not apply to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, and this has been added.

The general part of the explanatory memorandum should describe the content of the memorandum of cooperation between the European Commission and the ESM and the joint working document on debt sustainability, and this has been added.

35930.s: The bill inserts new delegation provisions (art. 63a AWR and art. 69a Invorderingswet 1990) allowing the minister, by general administrative order (amvb), to designate groups of cases in which unlawful acts or omissions by the tax inspector or collector caused overwhelming unfairness and to grant compensation to affected parties. It also allows rules on exchanging data between public bodies and administrative obligors to support such compensation, with a four-week pre-submission period after the draft is laid before parliament.
35930.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegation by the need to remedy hardship quickly, the variety of circumstances, and the difficulty of specifying cases in statute, while promising Raad van State advice and parliamentary voorhang.
q: Because the circumstances that can lead to an "unfairness of overriding nature" may vary widely, it is more logical to choose a general delegation provision rather than a specific regulation.

Omdat de omstandigheden die kunnen leiden tot een «onbillijkheid van overwegende aard» zeer uiteen kunnen lopen, ligt het bovendien meer voor de hand om te kiezen voor een algemene delegatiebepaling dan voor een specifieke regeling.
d: designating case groups and compensation rules for unfair tax-administration outcomes
rules for exchanging data and information with public bodies and administrative obligors
designating case groups and compensation rules for unfair collection outcomes
rules for exchanging data and information with public bodies and administrative obligors
p: The minister receives broad power to define compensable case groups and compensation terms by amvb, with only a four-week voorhang period and little room for parliamentary amendment.
The same broad amvb power is created for collection outcomes, again with only a voorhang procedure.

parties: Asks how parliament and the Council of State are involved in elaborating the delegated provisions and wants an explanation of parliament's budget authority per situation.
The VVD members ask how the House and the Council of State will be involved in the elaboration and implementation of the bill's provisions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe Kamer en Raad van State worden betrokken bij de invulling en uitwerking van de bepalingen uit het wetsvoorstel.
Asks the government to clarify parliament's precise powers to check a possible AMvB and whether the delegation would be used beyond the childcare benefits case.
The D66 members ask the government to explain the precise power of the House to scrutinise a possible AMvB.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering om de precieze bevoegdheid van de Kamer in het controleren van een mogelijke AMvB toe te lichten.

Accepts controlled delegation with a pre-consultation procedure but worries parliament will be insufficiently involved and given too little time, and asks about its powers to amend or reject the AMvB.
On this, the CDA members do have some concern that the House will be insufficiently involved or will have too little time to think along about a proposal.
Ten aanzien daarvan hebben de leden van de CDA-fractie wel enige zorgen dat de Kamer onvoldoende wordt betrokken of te kort de tijd heeft mee te denken over een voorstel.
Questions why the delegation is needed and whether the government still applies a human measure, and asks for more generous, transparent legal instruments for victims.
These members ask the government why it cannot correct hardship cases without a delegation provision.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom ze niet zonder delegatiebepaling schrijnende gevallen kan rechtzetten.
Notes the broad delegation reduces parliament's ability to scrutinise in detail and asks how parliament will be kept informed and whether explicit consent will be sought.
This inevitably means that parliament's scrutinising task can be carried out in less detail.
Dit heeft onherroepelijk tot gevolg dat de controlerende taak van het parlement minder gedetailleerd uitgevoerd kan worden.
Supports the aim but worries about privacy and data exchange under the delegation, the vague term 'overduidelijk onredelijk', and the absence of an evaluation provision.
It must be prevented that this data collection and exchange conflicts with principles of privacy and data protection.
Voorkomen dient immers te worden dat deze gegevensverzameling en -uitwisseling op gespannen voet komt te staan met principes rondom privacy en gegevensbescherming.
Understands the broad phrasing but asks for more explicit conditions to frame the tegemoetkoming, and asks how citizens' position is strengthened when they cannot themselves claim compensation.
Which explicit conditions have been considered to better frame the possibility of a compensation?
Welke expliciete voorwaarden zijn overwogen om de mogelijkheid tot een tegemoetkoming beter in te kaderen?
Asks whether the Council of State's criticism has been fully addressed and whether renewed advice was considered.
The GroenLinks members ask whether the Council of State's criticism has been fully removed after the government's changes.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen of de kritiek van de Raad van State volledig is weggenomen na de wijzigingen van de regering.

Questions the open norm 'overduidelijk onredelijk' and why compensation is not provided through damages where wrongful acts occurred, and asks for a legal analysis of treating the state's own law violations.
Why is it not chosen to also be able to pay damages in case of wrongful acts?
Waarom wordt er niet voor gekozen om ook een schadevergoeding uit te kunnen keren ingeval er sprake is van onrechtmatig handelen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill Overige fiscale maatregelen 2022, raising concerns about the eigenwoningregeling complexity, monthly childcare data delivery, the CFC offset order, and new delegation provisions for compensating hardship cases, and advised removing the latter (arts. VIII and IX) and submitting them separately. The government's nader rapport accepts removing those provisions and placing them in a separate bill, while defending their placement in the AWR and IW 1990 and clarifying the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling views the new compensation scheme for hardship cases caused by inspector or receiver misconduct as a third category beyond damages and nadeelcompensatie, requiring thorough justification, and advised a general scheme if any; the government disagreed on generality but moved the provisions to a separate bill.

The delegation provisions are insufficiently defined, lack a supporting motivation, and need clearer delimitation of 'onbillijkheden van overwegende aard' and their relation to the hardship clause in article 63 AWR.

The explanatory memorandum's standalone readability is poor, as it refers to a separate letter instead of stating the considerations itself, and the eigenwoningregeling complexity analysis is missing.
The complexity of the eigenwoningregeling raises doubts about whether citizens can reasonably manage it without expert help, and the explanatory memorandum lacks analysis of this.

The monthly childcare data provision lacks a clear legal basis for the obligation to record paid hours and unclear parental awareness and verification, and the explanatory memorandum should address this.
The CFC offset-order provision lacks an explanation of the underlying problem and why legislation is needed, and the explanatory memorandum should be supplemented.

35975-J.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) for 2021 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across articles on flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, experimentation and water quality. It also makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2021, retroactively to the day after publication, and is issued in the name of the King with the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have approved and decided ... The budget statement of the Delta Fund (J) for the year 2021 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds (J) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

36038.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management by adding an incidental supplementary grant of €26 million (in thousands of euros: 26,050) to the fireworks sector, effective from 1 March 2022. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and contains no safeguards or oversight changes beyond the usual budget procedure.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2022

36065.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by an incidental supplementary budget of EUR 679 million for a one-off energy allowance for low-income households. It raises the commitment amount for general and additional grants under the Financial Relations Act to EUR 31.353 billion and sets entry into force retroactively to 15 March 2022.
q: Amendment of the 2022 budget of the municipal fund (incidental supplementary budget on the one-off energy allowance for low incomes)
Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds (B) voor het jaar 2022 (incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake eenmalige energietoeslag lage inkomens)

36083.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security, a second supplementary budget for the reception of Ukrainian displaced persons, adding about 1.57 billion euro in commitments and 952.6 million euro in expenditure, mainly under migration. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 30 March 2022 with retroactive effect where publication is later.

36092.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund by adding about 458 million euros in obligations and 8.8 million euros in expenditure and receipts, as a first supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 May 2022, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2022

36120-III.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2022 budget appropriation statutes for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Oversight Committee on Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD), mainly adding funds for the CTIVD and the TIB linked to a temporary law on investigating foreign offensive cyber programmes. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and does not alter the powers of the executive or oversight bodies beyond funding them.
36120-III.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase for the CTIVD and TIB by the need to keep them able to fulfil their statutory oversight tasks under the amended supervision regime.
q: To continue to meet their statutory tasks structurally, the capacity to carry out staff tasks must be expanded.
Om structureel aan hun wettelijke taken te kunnen blijven voldoen, dient de capaciteit voor het kunnen uitvoeren van de staf-taken te worden uitgebreid.

36137.s: The bill amends the temporary toll law for the Blankenburgverbinding and ViA15 to align it with the EETS directive implementation, letting the Minister register passages with technical devices, allowing toll payment via service providers under private-law contracts, and moving revenue to the Mobiliteitsfonds. It also adds data-processing rules, exemptions, and a temporary test-road regime that expires two years after entry into force.
36137.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to implement the EETS directive and ensure proper operation of the toll, citing a privacy impact assessment and reserving detailed rules for general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
q: The bill contains various legal bases for data processing for the above processing purposes.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat verschillende grondslagen voor gegevensverwerking voor bovengenoemde verwerkingsdoelen.
d: rules on use and disclosure of technical registration devices and processing of data
rules on test environment and designation of test road section
conditions, restrictions and requirements attached to exemptions
payment term for toll owed to the Minister
payment term for service provider to pay the Minister
personal data to be processed for toll collection and enforcement
personal data processed by the supervisor
designation of supervisors and their enforcement powers
p: Allows the Minister to register vehicle plates, locations and images by location-bound technical devices and to compare them automatically with other data, with rules deferred to a general administrative order and signposting required on site.
Excludes administrative appeal to the administrative court for payment obligations to service providers and disapplies parts of the General Administrative Law Act, shifting disputes to civil courts.
Lets the Minister impose provisional measures such as moving vehicles against unpaid fines and removes the earlier payment-arrangement option, while keeping objection and appeal against the fine.
Expands the Minister's authority to process and link personal data for enforcement and to retain data for defined periods.

parties: Asks the government to respond to the Adviescollege ICT-toetsing finding that the toll system is probably not ready and that effective chain steering is lacking.
These members want to know the government's response to this finding and how the project can still achieve its objectives.
Deze leden willen weten wat de reactie van de regering is op deze constatering en hoe het project de doelstellingen wél kan gaan halen.
Questions the need for two parallel payment systems, the cost overruns and possible socialisation of costs, and the overlap with the truck levy law.
Does this not create an unnecessarily complex system and additional costs?
Zorgt dit niet voor een onnodig complex systeem en aanvullende kosten?
Questions whether paying a public road toll through a private EETS provider amounts to privatisation of tax collection and asks about alternatives.
These members do wonder to what extent paying for use of a public road or tunnel via a private EETS provider is a form of privatising tax collection.
deze leden vragen zich wel af in hoeverre het betalen voor het gebruik van ene publieke weg of tunnel via een particuliere EETS-aanbieder niet een vorm van privatisering van belastinginning is.
Asks who is ultimately liable to pay the toll, and raises the social impact on residents and whether tolling should be postponed.
It is unclear who is ultimately obliged to pay the toll.
Het is onduidelijk wie nu uiteindelijk verplicht is tot het betalen van de tolheffing.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill amending the temporary toll law for the Blankenburgverbinding and ViA15 to implement the EETS directive, raising a major concern that it is unclear on the statutory level who must pay the toll to the Minister, citing Article 104 of the Constitution and legal certainty. The government's reply accepts the advice, designating the vehicle holder as the party liable to pay the toll directly in the law and adding a testing-environment power.
concerns: Toll payer should be specified in the statute rather than delegated, under Article 104 of the Constitution, though the government disputes that delegation is wholly barred for retributions.
Statute should clearly state who is obliged to pay the toll, so citizens know whether the scheme applies to them.

36155.s: The bill amends the Dutch road freight act, the passenger transport act 2000 and the economic offences act to implement EU Regulation 2020/1055 on road haulage access rules. It lowers the licensing threshold for vehicles above 2.5 tonnes, tightens good-repute and rehabilitation rules for transport managers, and extends cabotage and enforcement provisions.
36155.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary to implement binding EU regulation and to close gaps in enforcement of good repute and cabotage rules.
q: in implementation of Regulation (EU) 2020/1055
Verordening (EU) 2020/1055 ... ter uitvoering van Verordening (EU) 2020/1055
d: applying EU cabotage rules to foreign carriers in combined transport
classification of serious infringements of EU rules for good-repute
p: Creates a prohibition on carriers, consignors and forwarders who knew or should have known of unlawful cabotage or unlicensed haulage.
Lets the NIWO declare a transport manager unfit and fixes a two-year disqualification period.

parties: Asks how enforcement of the proposed cabotage restrictions will work and whether there is sufficient enforcement capacity.
These members want to know what enforcement will look like now that restrictions on cabotage are proposed.
Deze leden willen weten hoe de handhaving eruit gaat zien, nu er restricties worden voorgesteld aan cabotage.
Asks what the consequences of exceeding the implementation deadline are for enforceability and what lessons the government draws.
They ask the government about the possible consequences of exceeding the implementation deadline.
Zij vragen de regering naar de mogelijke gevolgen van de overschrijding van de implementatietermijn.
Asks for reliable data on whether foreign-licensed drivers violate rules more often and how shippers and subcontractors will be held liable and enforced against.
The PVV members ask the government whether it can substantiate with reliable and current figures whether drivers with a foreign licence break the rules more often than Dutch drivers.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen aan de regering of zij middels betrouwbare en actuele cijfers kan onderbouwen of het aantal chauffeurs met een buitenlands rijbewijs vaker de regels overtreedt dan Nederlandse chauffeurs.
They have no further questions on this for the time being.
Zij hebben hierover voor dit moment geen nadere vragen.
Asks whether the number of vehicles between 2.5 and 3.5 tonnes is indeed nil, so the exemption option for experienced entrepreneurs is not used.
These members ask whether the government is indeed certain that the number of vehicles with a maximum mass above 2.5 tonnes but not above 3.5 tonnes is nil.
Deze leden vragen of de regering inderdaad zeker is dat het aantal voertuigen met een maximummassa van meer dan 2,5 ton maar niet meer dan 3,5 ton nihil is.
Asks for clarification on the meaning of a durable presence requirement, mutual recognition of exams, and the impact of serious infringements on the Netherlands.
The BBB member wants to know what is meant by the phrase that road transport undertakings must be permanently established in a Member State.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie wil weten wat wordt bedoeld met de zinsnede dat wegvervoersondernemingen duurzaam aanwezig dienen te zijn in een lidstaat.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a bill implementing EU Regulation 2020/1055 on road transport, raising concerns about the rehabilitation options for transport managers, the timely and careful implementation (missing internet consultation, incomplete transposition table, lapsed implementation deadline). The minister's reply largely accepted the points, clarifying the rehabilitation rules as minimum harmonisation, supplementing the explanatory memorandum and transposition table, and amending the vehicle threshold in article 2.1(3) Wet wegvervoer goederen.
concerns: The Afdeling found the transposition table incomplete and lacking explanation of member state options and non-transposed provisions; the memorandum was revised accordingly.

The Afdeling asked for consideration of the consequences of the lapsed implementation deadline and for timely consultation; the government added a passage on the consequences but did not hold an internet consultation, citing the short deadline.

The Afdeling doubted the government's reading of article 14(1) of the professional competence regulation as leaving member states a choice of rehabilitation route; the government maintained minimum harmonisation allows stricter national rules.

The vehicle threshold in article 2.1(3) Wet wegvervoer goederen was amended to also cover vehicles above 2,5 tonnes permissible maximum mass, preventing a looser licensing threshold than the regulation allows.

36164.s: The bill replaces the separate recognition schemes under the Road Traffic Act 1994 with a single basic recognition (basiserkenning) plus specific recognitions for defined handlings, with the RDW administering and supervising them. It also strengthens enforcement by adding administrative fines, administrative coercion and penalty powers for the RDW, and makes related technical amendments.
36164.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to lower regulation as necessary for flexibility, faster response to societal developments, and risk-based supervision by the RDW.
q: By including vehicles in the business inventory, vehicle obligations (taxes and APK) can be discontinued.
Door opname van voertuigen in de bedrijfsvoorraad kunnen de voertuigverplichtingen (belastingen en APK) worden stopgezet.
d: specific recognitions for defined vehicle-registration, plate, inspection and installation handlings
approval and periodic testing requirements for equipment and certified means
which handlings may only be performed by competent natural persons and their requirements
RDW grants competence to natural persons by decision
exemptions from the trade register requirement
ARTIKEL I, C (artikel 4aub, lid 4 and artikel 4auc, lid 2)
equivalence of foreign certificates and events triggering new certificate of conduct
data registration obligations for plate manufacturers
rules for destruction of returned number plates
number of vehicles sampled in periodic inspection checks
amount of administrative fines for breaches of recognition conditions
conditions for retaining specific recognitions enforceable by administrative coercion
p: Allows new categories of recognised handlings to be introduced by general administrative order, without new statutory amendment, once the framework is in place.
RDW may suspend or withdraw basic recognition and set waiting periods up to 30 months, including integrity-based grounds with advisory input from the integrity bureau.
Introduces RDW power to impose administrative fines on recognition holders, with fine maxima tied to criminal categories and a 50% escalation for repeat offences.
ARTIKEL I, BB (artikel 169a, lid 2) and ARTIKEL I, D/EE
Extends RDW administrative coercion powers to enforce recognition conditions and competence requirements.
ARTIKEL I, W, Y (artikel 99 lid 3, artikel 106 lid 3)
Allows approval decisions on modifications and damaged vehicles to rest on certifications by private recognised firms rather than RDW inspection.
ARTIKEL I, I (artikel 50) and ARTIKEL I, S/T (artikelen 83-89)
Removes several statutory inspection and oversight provisions, shifting frequency and detail of checks to ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks how often malicious businesses have abused recognitions, why specific recognitions are deferred to lower regulation, and how the RDW's bibob-investigation capacity will cope.
These members want to know how often this occurs under the current system.
Deze leden willen weten hoe vaak dit onder het huidig stelsel voorkomt.
Supports the proposal and has no questions.
They are positive about the proposal and have no questions.
Zij staan positief tegenover het voorstel en hebben geen vragen.
Questions whether predictable MOT sampling lets businesses anticipate inspections and why the statutory 3% sampling requirement must be departed from for risk-based supervision.
These members wonder why a fixed pattern has been used for the sampling to date and why an unpredictable selection procedure was not chosen.
Deze leden vragen zich af waarom voor de steekproeven tot op heden een vast stramien is gehanteerd en waarom er niet is gekozen voor een onvoorspelbare selectieprocedure?
Questions the legal basis on which the RDW could withdraw a basic recognition based merely on doubts after another authority, such as a mayor, closes a business address.
What is the RDW's legal basis for withdrawing the basic recognition on the basis of doubts?
Welke grondslag heeft de RDW om op basis van twijfels de basiserkenning in te trekken?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft amendment to the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 on modernising the recognition system is too broad, in particular the open delegation of specific recognitions to lower regulation, the sanction and fine design, the subdelegation to a ministerial regulation for APK inspection sampling, and the missing EU-law analysis. The government's reply accepted all four points and amended the bill by narrowing the delegation, separating fine powers and categories, setting the sample size by ministerial regulation, and adding EU-law discussion.
concerns: The open delegation for specific recognitions covering all RDW tasks was too broad and needed to be limited with main lines set in the statute.
Fine provisions referring to delegated norms not yet set violate the lex certa principle and were removed from the statutory fine basis.
The fine maximum categories were insufficiently motivated and were differentiated and justified in the amended bill.
Subdelegation of the APK re-inspection sample size to a ministerial regulation was undesirable and was changed to ministerial regulation-level setting.
The explanatory memorandum lacked an analysis of the relationship with EU law, including the Notification and Services Directives, which was added.

36182.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by adding a fifth supplementary budget of 200,040 thousand euros for financial support to Ukraine via the IMF. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 September 2022, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), all for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB), alle voor het jaar 2022

36191.s: The bill establishes a permanent Adviescollege ICT-toetsing that advises the government and parliament on the risks and success prospects of central-government ICT projects and information systems, and promotes knowledge transfer. It sets out the college's composition, duties, reporting obligations, and the duty of ministers to request advice before major ICT projects and to justify deviations from advice to parliament.
36191.j: The memorandum justifies the college's structure by reference to the importance of ICT for policy execution and aligns it with the general Kaderwet adviescolleges rules, without a substantive justification for the non-application of the consensus requirement beyond the judiciary's status as outside the executive.
q: The requirement of agreement with the Council of Ministers does not apply under the fourth paragraph to ICT projects of the Council for the Judiciary, because the Council for the Judiciary is a body of the judicial organisation and as such is not part of the executive branch.

Het vereiste van overeenstemming met de ministerraad geldt ingevolge het vierde lid niet voor de ICT-projecten van de Raad voor de rechtspraak, omdat de Raad voor de rechtspraak een orgaan van de rechterlijk organisatie is en als zodanig geen deel uitmaakt van de uitvoerende macht.
d: provision of the college's administrative secretariat
entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: Ministers may depart from the college's advice after ministerial-council agreement, with only a reasoned notice to parliament, and the consensus requirement does not apply to the judiciary's ICT projects.

parties: Asks what kind of advisory body the Adviescollege is, since it falls outside Article 79 of the Constitution and the Kaderwet adviescolleges, and supports its independence to give independent advice.
These members consider it important that this college can give independent advice on ICT matters and therefore also support the independent positioning of the ICT review advisory college.

Deze leden achten het van belang dat dit college onafhankelijk advies kan geven over ICT-aangelegenheden en zijn daarom ook voorstander van de onafhankelijke positionering van het adviescollege ICT-toetsing.

Supports the body being as independent as possible but asks why this organisational form was chosen, what alternatives were considered, and what the effects are of placing it outside ministerial responsibility; also asks whether the college can advise on its own initiative and on digital components of legislation.
These members ask what the consequences will be of placing such an essential part of regular business operations outside ministerial responsibility, and request an explanation.
Deze leden vragen wat de gevolgen zullen zijn van het buiten de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid zetten van zo'n essentieel onderdeel van de reguliere bedrijfsvoering, graag een toelichting.

Values the college's work and asks whether its advice should always be followed and whether implementation can be made verifiable short of a hard legal obligation; also asks about future-proofing, an earlier evaluation, and reappointment limits.
As a rule, the advice and recommendations of the Adviescollege should always be followed, insofar as this is not already happening.
In de regel zouden de adviezen en aanbevelingen van het Adviescollege altijd opgevolgd moeten worden, voor zover dat niet al gebeurt.

Supports the permanent status but notes that only about one third of notified projects received advice in 2021 and asks why not all requests are advised on, and raises concerns about capacity and strategic autonomy in ICT procurement.
These members note that therefore advice is not issued on two-thirds of the requests.
Deze leden constateren dat dus over tweederde van de aanvragen geen advies wordt uitgebracht.

Supports the college's independence but asks how sufficient oversight of ICT project execution is guaranteed, what the role of the Minister of the Interior is, whether the college has adequate resources and capacity, and why the appointment term deviates.

In this context, these members ask how it is guaranteed that, especially given the advisory task of the Adviescollege, sufficient oversight of the implementation of ICT projects remains, and how this oversight is practically and theoretically arranged.

Deze leden vragen in dat kader hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat, zeker gezien de adviestaak van het Adviescollege, er wel voldoende toezicht blijft op de uitvoering van ICT-projecten en hoe dit toezicht nu praktisch en in theorie geregeld is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in May 2022 that a law establishing the Adviescollege ICT-toetsing is unnecessary and that independent positioning outside the ministry is questionable, and that the bill should be reconsidered or revised to avoid unnecessary juridification and duplication of the Kaderwet adviescolleges. The government's reply of September 2022 keeps the independent position, removes several juridical obligations and adjusts references to the Kaderwet, but does not drop the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that the stated goals do not require a law and advises reconsidering the bill; the government rejects this, saying only a permanent Instellingsbesluit would not achieve all goals.
The Afdeling prefers positioning the college within the ministry under full ministerial responsibility; the government keeps the college at arm's length to ensure independence.
Obligatory consultation, copy obligations and the two-week response period that risk juridifying relations are largely dropped, leaving only the copy of advice sent to parliament.

Provisions copied from the Kaderwet adviescolleges are replaced by direct references, and deviations such as reappointment, appointment by royal decree and the employment contract clarification are adjusted or justified.

36218.s: The bill amends the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte so that the annual maximum rent increase for liberalised rental contracts is set by the lower of an inflation-based formula or a wage-based formula, each plus one percentage point, applying from 1 January 2023. The explanatory memorandum says the maximum rent increase would otherwise be high, and it provides for a mandatory evaluation before the cap lapses in May 2024.
36218.j: The memorandum justifies the cap as protecting tenants against high rent increases and states that the cap is evaluated in the last quarter of 2023.
q: Because the cap in principle lapses on 1 May 2024, a mandatory evaluation is foreseen in the last quarter of 2023.
Omdat de maximering in beginsel op 1 mei 2024 vervalt is voorzien in een verplichte evaluatie in het laatste kwartaal van 2023.
d: Artikel I (art. 10, lid 3, Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte)
setting the maximum percentage rent increase for liberalised rental contracts

parties: Asks for projections of wage development, rent-return calculations, the advice of the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk, and whether an evaluation clause will be added.
Is the government willing to evaluate this bill in a few years to examine whether a proper balance of interests between tenant and landlord has been struck?
Is de regering bereid om dit wetsvoorstel over een aantal jaar te evalueren om te onderzoeken of er inderdaad een goede belangenafweging is gemaakt tussen de huurder en de verhuurder?
Supports better protection of tenants but asks the government to answer the Raad van State's advice on the effects of the cap on landlords and to justify the +1% figure.
The CDA members note in the Council of State's advice that the Division advises mapping the consequences of the cap for landlords.
De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen in het Advies van de Raad van State dat de Afdeling adviseert in kaart te brengen welke gevolgen de maximering heeft voor verhuurders.
Argues the +1% margin still allows excessive rent increases, risking affordability and payment problems, and raises human-rights (right to adequate housing) concerns requiring monitoring.
Does the government agree that, from a human-rights perspective, it is obliged to make this transparent and to monitor it?
Deelt de regering de mening dat de regering mensenrechtelijk gezien verplicht is om dit inzichtelijk te maken en te monitoren?

Doubts the bill protects tenants enough, since rent-to-income ratios would still rise and landlords kept large past gains; asks how tenants will be informed and how landlords are prevented from applying the old rules.
How does the maximum rent increase relate to the goal of making rents more affordable?
Hoe verhoudt de maximale huurprijsstijging zich tot het doel om huren betaalbaarder te maken?

Argues the bill places the burden of high inflation entirely on landlords, questions whether the balance of interests is fair, and asks the government to respond to the Raad van State's points on necessity and proportionality.
These members point to the Council of State's remarks on necessity and proportionality.
Deze leden wijzen op de opmerkingen die de Raad van State maakt over de noodzaak en proportionaliteit.

Asks how quickly and automatically the government can depart from the system if wage growth falls below inflation, and what financial effects a fixed maximum percentage or income-based increase would have.
This member would like to know how quickly it is possible to depart from the system.
Dit lid zou graag willen weten hoe snel er kan worden afgeweken van de systematiek.

Says the bill is a step in the right direction but insufficient: the housing-point indexation is still tied to inflation, the cap leaves too little room for tenants, and the government should consider limiting point-price indexation and lowering rent increases below wage growth.
This member points out that the bill as currently drafted lacks sufficient measures to achieve the government's ambitions.
Dit lid wijst erop dat de inhoud van de wet in haar huidige opmaak over onvoldoende maatregelen beschikt om de ambities van de regering na te komen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on 17 August 2022 against the bill abolishing the rental-housing levy and altering the rent-increase cap, raising concerns about the replacement investment arrangements, the insufficient safeguards and ministerial delegation for the liberalised rent cap, and the combining of unrelated measures, and advised splitting the bill. The minister's reply of 4 October 2022 reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented, the rent cap was restated in the Uitvoeringswet itself, and the bill was split into two separate bills.
concerns: Delegating the setting of the maximum rent increase to a ministerial regulation is unjustified given the legislature's primacy, so the cap is now fixed in the Uitvoeringswet itself.

The rent-increase cap lacks safeguards showing it is necessary and proportionate and a balanced weighing of tenant and landlord interests; the reply adds explanation but the cap remains a formula change.
The cap restricts landlords' property rights under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR and requires a reasonable balance, which the reply addresses only by clarifying the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for a justification that the levy abolition and replacement investment arrangements achieve the aims, given the Balkenende IV precedent, which the reply addresses by supplementing the memorandum.
Combining two unrelated measures in one bill that may attract separate debate warrants splitting it, and the bill has been split into two.

36245.s: The bill moves the funding and allocation of work facilities for visually impaired people in the Participatiewet target group from municipalities to the UWV, and removes visual impairment from the municipal rules on work facilities. It adds a new Article 10h granting UWV the task and power to grant and fund work facilities, with a general administrative order to set details and a ministerial regulation on compensation.
36245.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to keep flexibility in implementation and allow lower rules for practical matters, while anchoring rights at statute level.
q: Because the rights are laid down at statute level, the rights of visually impaired persons are clear and durable, while flexibility in implementation is preserved by regulating this by or pursuant to a general administrative order.

Doordat de rechten zijn vastgelegd op wetsniveau zijn de rechten van visueel beperkten duidelijk en bestendig, maar blijft de flexibiliteit in de uitvoering behouden door dit bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur te regelen.
d: Artikel I D (10g, vierde lid); Artikel I E (10h, vierde lid)
scope, content and conditions of work facilities entitlement
p: Artikel I E (10h, tweede lid en zesde lid)
UWV is given discretion to refuse work facilities in listed cases, including where the person may claim support under other statutes, and to set further rules by policy rules.
Artikel I E (10h, vierde lid, toelichting)
The explanatory memorandum says a discretionary power for UWV to provide tailored support will be set at general administrative order level, which parliament would not itself enact.

parties: Asks how individualised tailoring is guaranteed when UWV centralises delivery and why the split between technical aids and jobcoaching departs from the advisory report.
Can the government explain how it will ensure that personalised tailoring is preserved when delivery is centralised at the UWV?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe ervoor gezorgd gaat worden dat bij het centraliseren van de uitvoering door het UWV het gepersonaliseerde maatwerk gewaarborgd blijft?
Asks how low-threshold accessibility and one-counter integrity will be secured given that jobcoaching remains at municipalities, and whether other services could be transferred.
How does the government intend to secure the integrity of service delivery and prevent people with a visual impairment having to go to two places for adequate support?
Hoe wil de regering de integraliteit van de dienstverlening borgen en voorkomen dat mensen met een visuele beperking op twee plekken terecht moeten voor goede ondersteuning, zo vragen zij.
Supports the goal but questions the UWV discretionary power set by general administrative order, its equality implications for WIA and Wajong groups, and the absence of an evaluation clause.

Asks whether transferring only this group to UWV is justified, whether applications become more complex, why other groups are not included, and how monitoring will inform the Chamber and involve experts by experience.
How will the Chamber be informed about this monitoring? Is the government willing to involve experience experts and organisations representing people with a visual impairment in the monitoring?
Hoe wordt de Kamer over deze monitoring geïnformeerd? Is de regering bereid om ervaringsdeskundigen en organisaties die mensen met een visuele beperking representeren te betrekken bij de monitoring?
Asks how the split between municipal jobcoaching and UWV fits the one-government principle and avoids added burden, and how evaluation and monitoring will be shaped.
How does the government prevent an increased burden for this group, who will have to turn to several bodies for support?
Hoe voorkomt de regering lastenverzwaring voor deze doelgroep die straks bij meerdere instanties terecht moet voor ondersteuning?
Shares the PvdA concerns about fragmentation and asks about evaluation and monitoring design and whether other groups should be transferred.
The PvdA and GroenLinks members also ask how evaluation and monitoring of this amendment will be shaped.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie en GroenLinks-fractie vragen zich eveneens af op welke manier evaluatie en monitoring van deze wijziging wordt vormgegeven.

Asks how separating work and living-domain applications fits the one-counter principle and the additional regulatory burden compared with auditory impairment, and what the expected effect of UWV's crowded change agenda will be.
How does the government view this in relation to the interpreting provisions and the higher regulatory burden for visually impaired people compared with auditorily impaired people that this entails?
Hoe beziet de regering dit in verhouding met de tolkvoorzieningen en de hogere regeldruk voor visueel beperkten ten opzichte van auditief beperkten die dit met zich meebrengt?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Participatiewet for work provisions for visually impaired persons and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport adds only a textual correction in chapter 4 of the explanatory memorandum, noting that advice had been requested on a possible service point for working with visual impairment.

36263.s: The bill creates a temporary (four-year) legal framework letting the AIVD and MIVD investigate states with offensive cyber programmes, relaxing some Wiv 2017 safeguards on hacking, bulk interception and metadata analysis. It shifts binding ex ante review of several powers from the TIB to binding ex durante review by the CTIVD oversight department, and adds a right of appeal to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
36263.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for effective cyber investigations and the operational difficulties of current rules, while stating that safeguards remain at a comparable level through shifted oversight.
q: without adequate use of these powers it is difficult, and sometimes impossible, for both services to carry out such investigations effectively
zonder een adequate inzet van deze bevoegdheden is het voor beide diensten moeilijk, en soms onmogelijk, om dergelijk onderzoek op effectieve wijze uit te voeren
p: Authorisation to reconnoitre automated systems moves from the Minister to the head of the service, with only a notification to the CTIVD afterwards instead of prior review by the TIB.
The obligation to describe technical risks in hacking requests is removed and the power to enter further connected systems is added, with oversight shifted to ex durante review.
Authorises bulk interception of all telecommunications to identify data streams, with a one-year authorisation period and six-month retention, and excludes the usual Article 26 safeguard in part.
Metadata analysis of interception results is exempted from prior review by the TIB.
Expands the power to add new numbers, technical identifiers and providers to existing interception authorisations, notified after the fact to the CTIVD.
Gives the CTIVD oversight department binding powers to halt powers and order deletion of data, strengthening a check on the executive.
Gives the Minister a right of appeal to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division against binding oversight rulings, with interim relief possible.

parties: Supports the bill as necessary to counter rising state cyber threats and asks no check-related questions in this opening passage.
They are of the view that the present bill enables our intelligence and security services to better protect national security against the growing threat of cyberattacks.

Zij zijn van mening dat voorliggend wetsvoorstel onze inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten beter in staat stelt om de nationale veiligheid te beschermen tegen de toenemende dreiging van cyberaanvallen.
Asks whether the bill's aim of greater speed while keeping oversight unchanged is realistic and why urgency warrants a temporary law rather than waiting for full revision.
These members ask the government to elaborate on the urgency of the present bill.
Zij vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de spoedeisendheid van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Supports adequate powers against offensive cyber programmes but asks about monitoring timing, the pending amendment note, and whether the bill covers threats beyond the four named states.
These members recognise that it is of great importance that the AIVD and MIVD are equipped with adequate powers to investigate states with an offensive cyber programme.
Deze leden onderkennen dat het van groot belang is dat de AIVD en de MIVD met adequate bevoegdheden zijn toegerust om onderzoek te doen naar landen met een offensief cyberprogramma.
Criticises the incomplete submission, withheld information, lobbying of selected factions, the labelling as urgent, and the risk of mass surveillance and reduced ex ante oversight.
These members attach great importance to all parliamentarians having an equal information position from the government, especially on legislation.
Deze leden hechten er zeer aan dat alle volksvertegenwoordigers een gelijke informatiepositie krijgen van de regering, zeker op het vlak van wetgeving.

Accepts stronger powers in principle but insists on balance with rule-of-law protections, questions how the TIB and the scope of the temporary law are applied, and points to European case law favouring judicial review.

That does not, however, detract from the need to maintain a balance, if these legal powers are strengthened, between being able to act against those threats and protecting the democratic constitutional state.

Dat neemt echter niet weg, zo menen zij, dat er bij eventuele versterking van die wettelijke mogelijkheden een balans moet worden behouden tussen enerzijds het kunnen optreden tegen die bedreigingen en anderzijds de bescherming van de democratische rechtstaat.
Stresses that powers must be targeted to avoid collecting citizens' data unnecessarily and asks how the targeting criterion and oversight by the TIB and CTIVD will work.
These members attach strong importance to this principle and are of the view that, even under an amended law, the special powers of the services must be deployed as specifically as possible.
Deze leden hechten sterk aan dit uitgangspunt en zijn van mening dat ook bij een gewijzigde wet de bijzondere bevoegdheden die de diensten hebben zo gericht mogelijk moeten worden ingezet.
Objects to the bill, questions the removal of ex ante TIB review of technical risks, and asks for a halt in favour of a full Wiv 2017 revision with an impact analysis.
As far as they are concerned, we should not proceed with this kind of temporary legislation, with many unclarities, but should instead pursue a revision of the Wiv 2017.
Wat hen betreft gaan we niet aan de slag met dit soort tijdelijke wetgeving, met erg veel onduidelijkheden, maar zetten we in op een herziening van de Wiv 2017.
Asks questions specifically about the appeal route to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State under article 13.
The questions of these members focus on article 13, which regulates the possibility of appeal to the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
De vragen van deze leden spitsen zich toe op artikel 13 waarin de beroepsmogelijkheid bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State wordt geregeld.
Asks why dispute resolution and oversight changes are included in a temporary bill rather than the broader revision, and about the workability of two parallel oversight regimes.
They wonder why, in that light, subjects such as dispute resolution have also been included, whereas such themes may fit better in the follow-up process.
Zij vragen zich af waarom in dat licht ook onderwerpen als geschillenbeslechting zijn opgenomen, terwijl zulke thema's wellicht beter passen in het vervolgtraject.
Asks why a temporary law with a four-year horizon is chosen when the threat is not temporary, and how the Wiv 2017 revision will be ensured within that period.
After all, the explanatory memorandum does not show that the threat is temporary in nature, so they ask the government why it nevertheless opted for a temporary law.
Uit de memorie blijkt immers niet dat de dreiging van tijdelijke aard is, dus vragen zij de regering waarom dan toch voor een tijdelijke wet is gekozen.

Asks why the temporary regime is needed, questions the heavy administrative burden on services, and asks whether the two oversight bodies could be merged and whether civil society criticism was considered.
This also brings risks with it.
Dit brengt ook risico's met zich mee.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a government amendment extending the temporary intelligence-powers bill to all AIVD and MIVD investigations, removing the relevance-assessment duty for bulk datasets and allowing annual retention extensions, and warned it lacks sufficient justification and safeguards, advising reconsideration before submission. The minister's reply largely accepts the requests for stated criteria and a time-limited exception mechanism (artikel 14b and 14ba), but rejects a statutory maximum number of extensions and a general end-term, and retains the proposal with the sunset clause after four years.
concerns: The Council found the extension of bulk-dataset retention to all investigations insufficiently justified given the privacy intrusion, and the minister added a fuller explanation in the amended text.

Retention of bulk datasets mostly concerning uninvolved persons requires solid safeguards under Article 10 Constitution and Article 8 ECHR; the minister introduced statutory criteria and a restricted exception procedure.
The Council advised a statutory maximum number of extensions and a general end-term for retention, which the government declined, preferring case-by-case annual extensions subject to CTIVD oversight.
The Council asked for a separate and coherent justification for applying the extension now rather than awaiting the Wiv 2017 revision; the minister supplied a more detailed explanation.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft temporary law for AIVD and MIVD investigations into states with offensive cyber programmes, finding the operational need justified but requiring stronger safeguards on exploratory cable tapping, data retention, bulk datasets, technical risks of hacking, and the new Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak appeal procedure. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, adding a notice of amendment on bulk datasets, shortening retention for cable exploration data to six months, requiring disclosure of foreseeable technical risks, and rejecting an evaluation clause in favour of monitoring.
concerns: Exploratory cable interception must not allow sharing of collected data with foreign services and needs a shortest possible retention period, which the government adopted with a six-month maximum.
Bulk dataset retention extension needs objective criteria and a maximum number of extensions; government removed the provision from this bill and said points will go into a notice of amendment.
Doubt whether the proposed measures will actually achieve the aimed-for operational speed and agility, given increased complexity of the oversight system.
The new appeal procedure before the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak should be used only exceptionally, and public disclosure of rulings under Article 121 Constitution needs a clear position.
Foreseeable technical risks of hacking, including use of unknown vulnerabilities, should be described in the authorisation request; government clarified this in the explanatory memorandum.
Advice to include an evaluation clause in the bill was not followed; government opted for monitoring and an implementation test instead.
Article-by-article explanation was incomplete and was expanded; redactional points were adopted.

36281.s: The bill temporarily lowers rents to a maximum of EUR 575.03 per month for tenants of housing associations (toegelaten instellingen) whose 2021 household income was at most 120% of the minimum income threshold, with a tenant-request route and a deadline of 31 May 2023 for associations to propose reductions. It amends Article 54a of the Housing Act and sets the effective date at 1 March 2023 with indexation from 2024.
36281.j: The memorandum justifies the scheme as avoiding indirect discrimination with unregulated private landlords and explains the Huurcommissie's role in reviewing disputes, without a separate justification for the delegation.
q: In case of a dispute between tenant and housing association over the rent reduction, the tenant may request a ruling from the Huurcommissie, and the party that disagrees with that ruling may then request a judgment from the court.

Bij een geschil tussen huurder en woningcorporatie over de huurverlaging kan de huurder een uitspraak van de Huurcommissie vragen en de partij die niet instemt met de uitspraak van de huurcommissie kan daarna een uitspraak van de rechter vragen.
d: Artikel I C 2 (art. 54a lid 3, vierde zin)
income verification rules for tenant requests

parties: No further questions or remarks on the bill.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the amendment to the Housing Act (rent reduction 2023 for tenants with lower incomes) and have no further questions or comments on it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de Wijziging van de Woningwet (huurverlaging 2023 voor huurders met lager inkomen) en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen en/of opmerkingen.
Supports the rent reduction but regrets that only corporation tenants qualify, notes the Council of State's unequal-treatment objection, and asks whether a wealth limit should apply.
These members regret that only tenants of housing corporations qualify for the rent reduction and wonder whether there are no other options to help tenants in the private rental sector?

Zij betreuren dat alleen huurders van woningcorporaties voor de huurverlaging in aanmerking komen en zij vragen zich af of er geen andere mogelijkheden zijn om huurders in de particuliere huursector tegemoet te komen?
Finds the exclusion of private-landlord tenants hard to defend under equal treatment and asks how the government will reach those tenants and the target rent quota.
Questions unequal treatment, the omission of the right to adequate housing and property-right justification, and the exclusion of tenants of commercial landlords.
Why has the bill not been tested against the right to adequate housing as laid down in international and European treaties and ratified by the government?
Waarom is er niet getoetst aan het recht op behoorlijke huisvesting, zoals dit in internationale en Europese verdragen is vastgelegd en door de regering is geratificeerd?
Supports the bill but asks why it excludes private-sector tenants, why the 120% cut-off is hard, and how tenants applying in 2024 will be properly informed.
These members note that for 2024 tenants are themselves responsible for applying for the rent reduction to which they are entitled.
Deze leden constateren dat huurders voor het jaar 2024 zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het aanvragen van de huurverlaging waarop ze recht hebben.
Welcomes the step but finds the justification for excluding around 100,000 low-income tenants in social housing from private landlords insufficiently convincing and asks for quantified effects.
These members find the arguments the government gives in the explanatory memorandum for this insufficiently convincing.
Deze leden vinden de argumenten die de regering in de memorie van toelichting hiervoor geeft onvoldoende overtuigend.
Asks about financial effects on corporations, alternatives such as higher rent allowance, the tight implementation timeline, and the Tax Authority's feasibility assessment.
Asks about the distribution of rent reductions across income groups, the choice of 2021 income data and the application deadline, and risks of high rent-allowance repayments.
How are tenants made aware of this? How are high reclaims prevented?
Hoe worden huurders hierop gewezen? Hoe worden hoge terugvorderingen voorkomen?
Asks how long the verification procedure for tenant-initiated reductions takes and whether it could be sped up without losing care.
If this takes a year or longer, is there not a risk that the rent reduction will not arrive in time, with all the risks that entails?
Indien dit een jaar of langer duurt, bestaat er dan geen risico dat de huurverlaging voor huurders niet op tijd komt, met alle risico's van dien?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on 2 November 2022 that the bill lowering rents in 2023 for low-income tenants of housing corporations (rent above €562.65) be reconsidered, citing unclear targeting, unjustified unequal treatment versus private landlords' tenants, unexplained choice over rent allowance, EU free movement concerns, and implementation risks. The minister's reply of 14 December 2022 responds to each point, largely defending the design and indicating the bill was amended and the amended text sent to parliament.
concerns: Unequal treatment between tenants of housing corporations and private landlords requires objective justification, which the explanatory memorandum lacked; the minister expanded the justification but maintained the distinction on property-right grounds.

Unclear why the existing rent allowance instrument was not used instead; the minister argues rent allowance is less targeted and more costly and that the chosen measure is funded by the abolished landlord levy.

The Services Directive and free movement of services and capital require further reasoning; the minister argues the measure has no cross-border character and the Directive does not apply to these corporations.

Insufficient analysis of financial effects on individual housing corporations and risk of unverifiable income data; the minister added a Tax Authority implementability test and clarified the reference income thresholds and 'reasonable doubt' standard.
Insufficient up-to-date analysis of target group's rent burden given recent inflation and other government measures; the minister responded with additional explanation of the policy rationale.

36308.s: The bill amends the Dutch Inland Shipping Act (Binnenvaartwet) to implement EU Directive 2017/2397 on recognition of professional qualifications in inland navigation, replacing the skipper and crew certificate system with competence-based Union qualification certificates. It also lets the Minister classify waterways as maritime or as having specific risks, adds possibilities to suspend certificates and impose restrictions, and extends the Minister's powers to set rules on crew qualification and recognition.
36308.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to further specify the directive's competence requirements, certificate models and safety rules, and notes the directive's own implementing acts.
q: To further elaborate what the directive contains, the European Commission is given power in several parts to adopt delegated or implementing acts.

Ter verdere uitwerking van hetgeen in de richtlijn is opgenomen wordt op verschillende onderdelen aan de Europese Commissie de bevoegdheid toegekend gedelegeerde of uitvoeringshandelingen op te.stellen.
d: Artikel I, B, onderdeel 3 (artikel 2, lid 2 en 3)
classification of inland waterway sections as maritime or as waters with specific risks
types of crew certificates and requirements for issuing them
invalidating or restricting certificates on specified grounds
Artikel I, M (artikel 30, lid 3) and Artikel I, Q
further rules on suspension of qualification certificates
p: The Minister may classify a waterway as having specific risks when needed for safety, based on listed circumstances.
The Minister may invalidate or restrict certificates, partly or wholly, where the Minister judges the holder lacks required knowledge or fitness.
Artikel I, M (artikel 30, lid 1, onderdeel e)
Certificates can be invalidated where in the Minister's own judgment the holder lacks the required knowledge or competence.

parties: Asks how enforcement of qualifications will work, why the ATR advice was not followed, and how the unfinished CBR consultation affects ILT enforceability.
These members want to know what the impact of this amendment is on the enforceability of the professional qualifications.
Ook willen deze leden weten wat de impact van deze wetswijziging is op de handhaafbaarheid van de beroepskwalificaties.
Supports harmonisation of professional qualifications in the EU and has no questions.
They support the aim of harmonising professional qualifications in the European Union (EU).
Zij ondersteunen de inzet om beroepskwalificaties te harmoniseren in de Europese Unie (EU).
Asks how the directive is implemented in other member states and how a level playing field will be ensured.
How will it be ensured that there is a level playing field with other member states?
Hoe gaat ervoor gezorgd worden dat er een gelijk speelveld is met andere lidstaten?
Asks the government to commit that the CBR will carry out the task of issuing qualification certificates delegated by the ILT.
Can the government commit that this task will be carried out by the CBR?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat deze opdracht wordt uitgevoerd door het CBR?
Worries that the ILT lacks capacity and budget for additional enforcement tasks and demands extra funding and guarantees that existing tasks are not displaced.
These members expect the government to substantially expand the ILT's resources and to commit that new or additional tasks will not come at the expense of existing tasks.
Deze leden verwachten van de regering een forse uitbreiding van de middelen van de ILT en de toezegging dat nieuwe of extra taken niet afgaan van eerdere en bestaande taken.
Asks which stakeholders were consulted and how concerns about workability raised by the ATR and practice are addressed.
