Can the government indicate more concretely which points and concerns have been raised and how they will be dealt with?
Kan de regering meer concreet aangeven welke aandachtspunten en zorgen op tafel zijn gelegd en hoe hiermee zal worden omgegaan?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill implementing EU Directive 2017/2397 on recognition of professional qualifications in inland navigation, raising remarks on the certification and recognition procedures for training (urging better justification for assigning tasks to the ILT rather than the CBR) and on retroactive effect of parts of the law. The minister's reply accepted the points: the bill was corrected so that the CBR retains most training tasks, and retroactive effect was removed.
concerns: Advised the explanatory memorandum to justify why certification and recognition of training tasks are assigned to the ILT rather than the CBR, which has relevant experience.
Objected to the retroactive effect of parts of the bill, advising specification of when retroactivity is necessary, especially for burdensome rules.

36350-V.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2023.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36362.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to implement EU Directive 2022/542 on the margin scheme for used goods, works of art, collectors' items and antiques, and the place-of-supply rules for virtually supplied services. It also allows dealers to claim deferred input VAT in early 2025 and sets entry into force on 1 January 2025.
36362.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to align Dutch VAT law with the EU directive, and it does not justify any delegation or new executive power.
q: This article does not apply to granting access to events where attendance is virtual.
Dit artikel is niet van toepassing op het verlenen van toegang tot de evenementen indien de aanwezigheid virtueel is.

parties: Asks whether the measures burden entrepreneurs and why the measure is budget-neutral, and asks how the increased enforcement complexity for virtual services will be mitigated.
The members of the VVD faction ask whether the proposed measures lead to an increased burden for entrepreneurs.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de voorgestelde maatregelen leiden tot een lastenverzwaring voor ondernemers.

Supports preventing VAT cumulation but questions fiscal neutrality of differing VAT treatment for art sales, the strategy on reduced rates, the effects on the art sector, and place-of-supply tax avoidance risks.
These members ask the government to reflect on how such a difference in VAT treatment relates to fiscal neutrality.
Deze leden vragen de regering om erop te reflecteren hoe een dergelijk verschil in btw-behandeling zich verhoudt tot fiscale neutraliteit.
Has noted the proposed amendment with no further questions at this stage.
The members of the SP faction have taken note with interest of the proposed amendment to the law and have no further questions on this at this time.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van de voorgestelde wijziging van de wet en hebben hier op dit moment geen verdere vragen over.
Questions the purpose of removing the margin scheme and the increase from 9% to 21% for the cultural sector, and asks about the Tax Authority's enforcement complexity.
As far as the BBB faction member is concerned, the government keeps VAT rates in the cultural sector low precisely to stimulate the sector.
Wat het lid van de BBB-fractie betreft houdt de regering de btw-percentages in de cultuursector juist laag om de sector op deze manier te stimuleren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Dutch VAT Act on the special scheme for antiques, art and collectibles and on place-of-supply rules for certain virtual services, and raised no remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) reports only five clarifying textual adjustments to the explanatory memorandum and no substantive changes.

36380.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/882 on accessibility requirements for products and services by amending the Warenwet, the Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte, the Telecommunicatiewet, the Burgerlijk Wetboek, the Wft, and the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming. It sets accessibility obligations for market operators and service providers, mostly to be detailed in AMvBs and ministerial regulations, with supervision by designated authorities (RDI, ILT, AFM, CvdM, ACM, Inspectie JenV).
36380.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed, technical accessibility rules and by the directive's requirement to implement uniformly across sectors, with consultation of stakeholders planned.
q: The bill and the implementing regulations to be adopted impose implementation burdens on market operators.
Het wetsvoorstel en de ter uitvoering daarvan op te stellen uitvoeringsregelgeving brengt uitvoeringslasten met zich voor marktdeelnemers.
d: prohibition of non-accessible products and requirements for market operators
rules implementing binding EU decisions on products
accessibility rules for designated service providers
rules implementing Commission implementing acts; postponed effect of directive amendments by ministerial decision
accessibility requirements and criteria for fundamental change or disproportionate burden for electronic communications services
obligations for service providers and conformity assessment procedures
accessibility of banking services, internal procedures and information provision
transitional periods for existing services and contracts
p: Broad executive power by AMvB to ban non-accessible products and set detailed market operator obligations, including conditions where accessibility rules may be limited.
Artikel II, B (Wgbh/cz art. 5c) and Artikel II, B (art. 5d)
Executive may by AMvB define service provider obligations and, via ministerial decision, postpone the legal effect of amendments to the directive.</description_en>
Transitional exemptions allow continued use of non-accessible products and services until 2030 under fixed deadlines.

parties: Asks about the feasibility of equivalent accessibility in rural areas and about instructions for low-literate users; mostly information questions.
It is good to read that market participants can use these exceptions at their own judgement.
Het is goed om te lezen dat marktdeelnemers naar eigen oordeel gebruik kunnen maken van deze uitzonderingen.
Asks for clarity on supervision, supervisors' expertise, a central coordinating supervisor and graded sanctions for non-compliance.
Can the government provide clarity on this?
Kan de regering hier duidelijkheid over verschaffen?
Asks who checks compliance, how importers and distributors verify conformity, and whether the Regulatory Burden Advisory Board was consulted.
Questions the self-assessment of exemptions, how supervision of documented assessments works in practice, and whether national regulation should be imposed rather than left to supervisors.
Why is this left to their own assessment?
Waarom wordt dit overgelaten aan de eigen beoordeling?
Fears market parties will misuse self-assessed exemptions and asks whether the bill could deviate by leaving assessment to supervisors.
These members fear that some market participants will misuse these exception grounds.
Genoemde leden vrezen dat een deel van de marktdeelnemers deze uitzonderingsgronden zal misbruiken.
Stresses weak implementation and supervision, vague norms, the lack of an evaluation provision and the difficulty consumers face in finding supervisors.
For this reason, various advisers point to the implementation aspect and supervision of compliance.
Verschillende adviseurs benoemen om die reden het uitvoeringsaspect en het toezicht op de naleving.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill implementing EU Directive 2019/882 on accessibility requirements for products and services, criticising the missing response to the supervisors' feasibility tests and the unclear involvement of stakeholders in developing guidance for micro-enterprises. The government's reply added a follow-up working group of supervisors and described stakeholder consultation, and it amended the Warenwet so that fine amounts are no longer set by general administrative order.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacked a substantive response to the feasibility and enforceability tests of the designated supervisors, which the government subsequently added.
Supervision should be coordinated and made uniform across the different supervisors, and the government set up a working group to do so.

The explanatory memorandum did not clarify how relevant stakeholders and representatives of persons with disabilities would be involved in developing guidance for micro-enterprises, and it was supplemented.

The delegation basis for setting Warenwet administrative fine amounts by general administrative order was removed and replaced by a statutory maximum linked to the fifth category of the Criminal Code.

36407.s: The bill amends the Dutch Environmental Management Act (Wet milieubeheer) and the Economic Offences Act to implement EU directive 2023/959 and 2023/958 and regulation 2023/957, extending the EU emissions trading system to maritime transport, non-CO2 aviation effects, CORSIA compliance, and a new ETS for fuels used in buildings, road transport and other sectors. It gives the emissions authority (NEa) new licensing, monitoring and enforcement powers and empowers ministerial regulations and EU-level implementing acts to fill in detail.
36407.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for timely, uniform EU-harmonised implementation and the highly detailed nature of the EU rules.
q: These rules are extensive and detailed, which is necessary to achieve a harmonised European implementation.
Deze regels zijn omvangrijk en gedetailleerd, wat noodzakelijk is om een geharmoniseerde Europese uitvoering te realiseren.
d: rules implementing EU auction regulation for emission allowances
free allocation percentages for products under carbon border mechanism
rules on permanent chemical binding of greenhouse gases
use of ICAO-accepted units for CORSIA compliance
reporting of planned changes and monitoring plan approval for fuel suppliers
content and application procedure for fuel-supplier permits
identifying and documenting fuel volumes to avoid double counting
manner of reporting pass-through of allowance costs to end users
tax authority and gas network operator must supply data to emissions authority on request
p: Artikel I, onderdeel AB (art. 18.6a) and AC (art. 18.16a)
Expands the emissions authority's power to impose administrative fines and penalty orders on operators for violations of many provisions, including fuel-supplier and shipping obligations.
Adds administrative enforcement by order under bestuursdwang for failure to cooperate with supervisors.

parties: Asks whether the Netherlands Emissions Authority (NEa) has enough knowledge and expertise to assess energy-saving measures and shipping emissions, and how it cooperates with the ILT.
The VVD members note that the Netherlands Emissions Authority (NEa) raises concerns about its knowledge and expertise capacity to itself assess energy-saving measures.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat de Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit (NEa) kanttekeningen maakt bij de kennis- en expertisecapaciteit om zelf energiebesparingsmaatregelen te beoordelen.
Asks about consequences of late implementation and asks for annual reductions in free allowances to be expressed in percentages.
The D66 members ask what the consequences are of not implementing this legal amendment on time.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen wat de gevolgen zijn van het niet tijdig implementeren van deze wetswijziging.

Welcomes the ETS measures but insists on close monitoring of household energy costs and asks when national measures to limit price rises would be triggered, plus whether a new impact assessment is planned.
They also ask the government to explain what happens if energy prices are too high both in 2026 and in 2027.
Deze leden vragen de regering ook om uit te leggen wat er gebeurt als de energieprijzen zowel in 2026 als in 2027 te hoog zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no comments on the draft bill implementing EU ETS amendments (directives 2023/958 and 2023/959, regulation 2023/957) and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's reply explains minor changes made in response, such as moving a provision for shipping, clarifying aviation 'stop the clock' rules, and adding regulatory authority for permit content.

36425.s: The bill abolishes the separate corporate tax liability of Dutch open limited partnerships (open commanditaire vennootschap) and of partnerships with shares, and codifies a foreign-entity classification regime for income, corporate, dividend and withholding taxes. It sets up transitional relief (deemed disposal, share mergers, deferred payment over ten years) and adds delegation clauses so that lower regulation can set comparability criteria for foreign legal forms.
36425.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to set detailed comparability rules for a wide range of foreign legal forms that cannot be fixed in the statute itself.
q: In lower regulation (in an general administrative order, AMvB) frameworks are given for assessing when a foreign entity has a legal form comparable in nature and structure to a Dutch-law entity.

In lagere regelgeving (in een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB)) worden kaders gegeven voor de beoordeling wanneer een buitenlands lichaam een rechtsvorm heeft die naar aard en inrichting vergelijkbaar is met die van een naar Nederlands recht opgericht of aangegaan lichaam.
d: comparability of foreign legal forms for income tax
comparability of foreign entities for transparency treatment
comparability of foreign legal forms for corporate tax
comparability of foreign legal forms for dividend tax
comparability of foreign legal forms for withholding tax
minister may grant exemption from profit inclusion on joint request, under conditions set by the minister
p: The minister may, on joint request and under self-set conditions, allow the tax inspector to disregard the profit arising from the deemed disposal, a discretionary exemption from statutory tax treatment.
I.A (art. 1.11, derde lid) and parallel delegations

Criteria for deciding whether foreign entities are comparable to Dutch legal forms are left to general administrative orders rather than the statute.','severity':'minor','towards':'executive','description_en':'Criteria for deciding whether foreign entities are comparable to Dutch legal forms are left to general administrative orders rather than the statute.'}],

parties: Asks for insight into the underlying problem, the choice of methods, budgetary effects of abolishing the open CV, and transitional rules.
These members are curious in how many cases hybrid mismatches are involved.
Zo zijn deze leden benieuwd in hoeveel gevallen het gaat om hybride mismatches.
Supports any step that prevents or makes tax avoidance harder; has no additional questions.
encourage every step that prevents or makes tax avoidance more difficult.
moedigen elke stap die belastingontwijking voorkomt of moeilijker maakt aan.
Sees the benefit of aligning classification policy with foreign legal forms; no additional questions.
These members see the value in aligning the qualification policy with (foreign) legal forms.
Deze leden zien het nut in van het in lijn brengen van het kwalificatiebeleid met (buitenlandse) rechtsvormen.
Asks whether the symmetric method could make Dutch firms less attractive to foreign partners and why the wording is considered superfluous.
Is it possible that this scenario makes it less attractive for foreign companies and/or employees to do business with Dutch enterprises?
Is het mogelijk dat dit scenario het voor buitenlandse bedrijven en/of werknemers minder aantrekkelijk maakt om met Nederlandse ondernemingen in zee te gaan?

Asks for clarity on the forthcoming general administrative order defining comparable legal forms, a list of qualified foreign partnerships, and the proportionality of costs versus the small expected yield; also asks for monitoring and periodic reporting to the Chamber.
These members ask whether the government is willing to reconsider monitoring regarding the budgetary yield of the proposal.</evidence_en>
Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is om dit te heroverwegen ten aanzien van de budgettaire opbrengst van het voorstel.
Welcomes tackling the cause of hybrid mismatches and finds the methods suitable, but asks why the costs are high and how the Tax Administration will find capacity.
These members see the methods the government proposes as suitable, because they create more clarity and align with the treatment of entities abroad.
Deze leden zien de methoden die de regering hiervoor aandraagt als passend, omdat die zorgen voor meer eenduidigheid en aansluiten bij de behandeling van lichamen in het buitenland.
Asks whether the transitional period should be extended given Chamber of Commerce processing times and whether the 83 FTE can realistically be recruited.
Given that processing registrations at the Chamber of Commerce takes some time, one may ask whether the transitional period should not be extended.

Gezien het feit dat met de verwerking van inschrijvingen bij de Kamer van Koophandel enige tijd gemoeid is, kan worden afgevraagd of de termijn voor het overgangsrecht niet verlengd zou moeten worden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet fiscaal kwalificatiebeleid rechtsvormen, codifying tax qualification policy for foreign legal forms and abolishing the open commanditaire vennootschap's separate tax liability, and made no remarks. The government's nader rapport thanks the Afdeling and reports only minor editorial and technical changes plus a supplement to the consultation section.

36443.s: The bill strengthens the position of pupils with extra support needs and their parents in Dutch special and inclusive education by moving the school support profile into the school guide, making parent and youth support points mandatory for each partnership, and giving pupils a right to express their opinion before the development perspective is set or amended. It also amends the primary, secondary, expertise-centre and co-determination laws accordingly, with the detailed rules on the development perspective left in part to an algemene maatregel van bestuur.
36443.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the aim of making inclusive education more accessible and easier for parents and pupils, and does not present new executive powers as a justification.
q: the competent authority sets or amends the development perspective only after giving the pupil the opportunity to freely express his opinion in a manner the pupil determines

het bevoegd gezag stelt het ontwikkelingsperspectief vast of stelt het bij nadat het bevoegd gezag de leerling in de gelegenheid heeft gesteld op een door de leerling te bepalen wijze vrijelijk zijn mening hierover naar voren te brengen
d: ARTIKEL II, E (artikel 40a, lid 9 Wet primair onderwijs)
p: ARTIKEL I, F; ARTIKEL II, H; ARTIKEL IV, J
Pupils with extra support needs are given a right to express their opinion before the school sets or amends the development perspective, which strengthens citizens' position against the school board.

parties: Asks whether the hearing right limited to the development perspective creates inequality, how compliance will be inspected, and whether it should cover all pupils and all decisions.
Why is this hearing right limited to only the development perspective?
Waarom wordt dit hoorrecht beperkt tot alleen het ontwikkelingsperspectief?
Asks what other instruments besides statute will change school culture, and how often support is actually adjusted after pupils are heard.
These members ask whether the government, besides statutory anchoring, uses other instruments to influence this culture.
Deze leden vragen of de regering, naast vastlegging in een wet, nog andere instrumenten aangrijpt om deze cultuur te beïnvloeden.
Doubts that a statutory hearing right is necessary and worries about the professionalism of teachers and added workload.
These members ask the government whether we are not doing professionals an injustice with this.
Deze leden vragen de regering of we hiermee de professionals niet tekort doen.
Supports the hearing right but asks why it is limited to the development perspective, risks legal inequality, and how the relation to child-autonomy legislation and parental consent works.
Why the hearing right was chosen to apply only to the development perspective is insufficiently clear from the government's proposal.
Waarom er gekozen is om het hoorrecht uitsluitend van toepassing te maken op het ontwikkelingsperspectief, blijkt onvoldoende duidelijk uit het voorstel van de regering.
Asks whether the hearing right leads to better outcomes, what risks exist, how a broader implementation would look, and how pupils with multiple disabilities can express their view.
These members ask whether the hearing right can lead to better educational results and whether the government has examples of such cases.
Deze leden vragen of het hoorrecht voor deze leerlingen kan leiden tot betere onderwijsresultaten en of de regering voorbeelden heeft van dergelijke gevallen.
Asks whether parents are really heard and whether their interests are weighed, and how the hearing right ensures children are understood, not just heard.
to what extent parents/guardians are actually heard regarding their child's support needs.
in hoeverre ouder(s)/verzorger(s) nu echt worden gehoord als het gaat over de ondersteuningsbehoefte van hun kind(eren).
Notes the hearing right does not oblige action and asks how support needs will not be ignored, how young children and those with communication difficulties will be heard.
Asks about age limits, situations where hearing a child is not in its interest, consistency with the cabinet's earlier reluctance, and whether the bill's criterion of handling capacity is sufficient.
These members ask whether the government has considered an age limit.
Deze leden vragen allereerst of de regering een leeftijdsgrens heeft overwogen.

Supports statutory anchoring of the hearing right for all children and asks why stronger instruments were chosen over softer ones, and how feedback to pupils and inclusion of pupils in poverty will be ensured.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill strengthening the position of pupils and parents in special-needs education, but raises remarks on guaranteeing support for the pupil hearing right, on the scope of co-determination over the support offer, on processing of personal data, and on the parent and youth support points, advising adaptation of the bill and explanatory memorandum. The minister's reply accepts most remarks by adding a statutory support obligation, clarifying the scope of the hearing, tightening data-processing rules, and removing the proposed parliamentary co-determination reference, while declining to legislate further on the hearing right and on co-determination in general.
concerns: The Afdeling asks how passende ondersteuning for pupils exercising the hearing right is guaranteed without a statutory obligation; the government added an explicit legal duty.
The Afdeling asks whether further legislation is planned to realise the child's hearing right beyond the development perspective; the government relies on handreikingen for now and will monitor.
The Afdeling finds it unusual that the Tweede Kamer is invited to regulate co-determination by amendment while the government has taken no position; the reference was removed.
The Afdeling asks how the Inspectie can establish that parent and youth support points fulfil their statutory task, especially without protocols; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The Afdeling advises additional specific safeguards for processing special personal data, such as access limits and retention periods; the government adds no new retention rules but supplements the explanation.
The Afdeling notes the bill suggests health data may be processed by support points without consent; the text was aligned with the explanation requiring explicit consent.
The Afdeling asks why support point staff must process personal data for signalling and informing the samenwerkingsverband; the provision was amended as unnecessary.
A technical error in the schoolgids amendment in the Wet op de expertisecentra and a missing cross-reference were corrected.

36461.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden so that new cooperation arrangements may be set by general administrative order (amvb) only in urgent cases, as a temporary measure, and must be followed by a bill submitted to parliament. It also deletes the mandatory post-publication parliamentary objection procedure (nahang) for such amvb.
36461.j: The memorandum justifies temporary delegation by the need for speed and flexibility in urgent situations where a formal law cannot be awaited, following the Raad van State's advice.
q: That possibility is in this bill limited to urgent situations and may only be used temporarily, to bridge the time needed to bring about a statutory amendment.

Die mogelijkheid wordt in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel beperkt tot spoedsituaties en kan alleen tijdelijk worden gebruikt, ter overbrugging van de tijd die nodig is om een wetswijziging tot stand te brengen
d: new cooperation arrangements for data processing, when a law cannot await
p: Allows the executive to temporarily regulate new data-processing cooperation arrangements by amvb in urgent cases, with an obligation to submit a bill and withdraw the amvb if parliament rejects it.
Removes the four-week nahang procedure by which either chamber could demand that an amvb be replaced by a law, relying instead on parliament's later vote on the follow-up bill.

parties: Questions whether a fixed moment should be set for submitting a replacement bill to parliament, given concerns that an AMvB is an inadequate basis for sharing sensitive personal data.
These members ask whether it is not desirable to fix the moment by which a corresponding bill must be submitted to the House.
Deze leden vragen of het niet wenselijk is om het moment vast te pinnen waarop een daartoe strekkend wetsvoorstel bij de Kamer moet worden ingediend.
Stresses the need for speed and flexibility and asks whether the proposal endangers the intended flexibility for partners fighting organised crime.
Is the speed and flexibility that was intended not endangered too much by the bill?
Komt de snelheid en flexibiliteit die was beoogd niet te veel in gevaar door het wetsvoorstel?
Questions the open definition of emergency, the lack of a time limit for replacement legislation, supervision of emergency declarations, and the risk of profiling from linked networks.
Why is no time limit attached to this?
Waarom wordt hier geen tijdslimiet aan verbonden?
Notes that parliamentary involvement is better guaranteed and asks how often emergency temporary AMvBs are expected.
How often does the government expect there to be an emergency situation requiring a temporary AMvB for a new partnership?
Hoe vaak verwacht de regering dat er sprake zal zijn van een spoedsituatie waarbij een tijdelijke AMvB wordt ontworpen voor een nieuw samenwerkingsverband?
Critical of the data-sharing scheme; the Dutch Data Protection Authority wants prior judicial approval of data exchange, and the SP doubts sufficient safeguards exist for privacy.
According to the regulator these adjustments are still not sufficient, because data exchange between specific government bodies and possible private parties should first be approved by a judge.

Volgens de toezichthouder zijn deze aanpassingen nog niet voldoende, want eerst zou gegevensuitwisseling tussen specifieke overheidsinstanties en eventuele private partijen goedgekeurd moeten worden door een rechter.
Finds dropping the nahang procedure understandable but stresses parliamentary involvement is essential; asks how long the government can designate new partnerships without parliament.
Nevertheless, the importance of parliamentary involvement in the context of this law is essential.
Toch is het belang van parlementaire betrokkenheid in het kader van deze wet essentieel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises dropping the four-week post-adoption parliamentary review (nahangprocedure) for temporary emergency AMvBs designating new data-cooperation partnerships under the WGS, because it can delay urgent situations and adds little given the duty to submit a bill promptly. The minister's reply accepts the advice and removes the nahangprocedure from the draft article 3.3.
concerns: The nahangprocedure can cause undesirable delay in urgent situations and its added value for parliamentary involvement is small, so it should be dropped for temporary AMvBs.
Parliamentary involvement remains ensured because a bill must follow promptly and the AMvB is withdrawn if parliament rejects it, so the review procedure is redundant.

36470-IIA.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget of the States General (IIA), raising expenditure and commitments by EUR 151 thousand, mainly for the First Chamber (EUR 30 thousand) and the Second Chamber (EUR 121 thousand). It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2023

36506.s: The bill extends the Wet inkomensvoorziening oudere werklozen (IOW) by four years, moving the access cutoff from 1 January 2024 to 2028 and the statutory expiry from 2034 to 2038, plus two cross-reference adjustments. It aims to keep income security for older unemployed people during this extended period.
36506.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by the long-term approach of the Seniorenkansenvisie and the need to keep dampening income loss for this group, while acknowledging a possible negative effect on re-employment chances.
q: With this horizon in mind, the government considers it appropriate to continue dampening the income drop for this group for another four years.
De regering vindt het met deze horizon voor ogen passend om voor nog eens vier jaren de terugval in inkomen voor deze groep te blijven dempen

parties: Asks for quantified justification of the age threshold, the effects of the Seniorenkansenvisie, and what consequences follow if those measures fail to deliver.
They ask whether the government can substantiate when the actions from the Seniorenkansenvisie will take effect and how large those effects will be.
Zij vragen of de regering kan onderbouwen op welk moment de acties uit de Seniorenkansenvisie effect zullen hebben en hoe groot deze effecten zijn.

Objects that the government implements the law in practice before parliamentary approval, stressing the need for careful legislation and asking about risks to benefit recipients if the bill is not adopted.
However noble they find this aim, they consider it highly undesirable that the government puts a law into practice in advance of its consideration by both chambers.
Hoezeer deze leden dit een nobel doel vinden, het blijft zeer onwenselijk dat de regering vooruitlopend op behandeling in beide Kamers alvast een wet in praktijk brengt.
Strongly supports the four-year extension to prevent financial hardship for workers over sixty who cannot find work, while asking about effects on re-employment.
These members wholeheartedly support the government's proposal to extend the temporary IOW by another four years.
Deze leden ondersteunen van harte het voorstel van de regering om de tijdelijke IOW met nog eens vier jaar te verlengen.
Asks which sectors succeed in keeping older workers employed and how employers are involved in development plans for 55-plussers.
To what extent is there coordination with the employer when drawing up a development plan and creating a sustainable employment relationship?
In hoeverre is er sprake van afstemming met de werkgever bij het opstellen van een ontwikkelplan en het creëren van een duurzame arbeidsrelatie?

Doubts the necessity of a third extension of a temporary scheme, asks for thorough justification and clarity on when the scheme would no longer be needed, and questions the omission of an asset exemption and a cost-sharing norm.
The D66 members note that this is already the third extension of a temporary scheme.
Het valt de leden van de D66-fractie op dat dit reeds de derde verlenging van een tijdelijke regeling is.

Asks for the impact on re-employment chances, whether the SEO evaluation is still current, and for annual monitoring reports to be sent to parliament; raises a Raad van State point on the risk of restricting older workers.
The CDA members ask whether the monitor can be sent to the House annually.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de monitor jaarlijks naar de Kamer gestuurd kan worden.
Questions why the scheme is not made structural, asks what guarantees the Seniorenkansenvisie offers, and argues that a structural scheme is more logical.
Does the government agree with these members that it is more logical to make the IOW structural now?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat het logischer is om de IOW nu structureel te maken?
Asks under which conditions the government would consider extension no longer necessary and what measures exploit the current tight labour market for older jobseekers.
Under which circumstances and at what point does the government consider extension of the IOW no longer necessary?
Onder welke omstandigheden en op welk moment acht de regering verlenging van de IOW niet langer noodzakelijk?

Criticises the timing of submission relative to the retroactive start date, questions the implications for parliament's budgetary and legislative role, and asks for measurable goals before ending the scheme.
The bill was submitted to the House of Representatives for consideration on 16 February 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 16 februari 2024 aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer voor behandeling.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a fourth-round extension of the Wet inkomensvoorziening oudere werklozen by four years, asking the explanatory memorandum to address the risk that retired workers crowd out the slightly younger age group under unequal labour-law rules. The minister replied that current evidence shows no significant crowding out, so no measures to rebalance labour-law rules are planned, and added the reasoning to the memorandum along with a technical correction.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to justify the continued need for the IOW given rising labour participation of pensioners and the risk of crowding out 60-to-AOW-age workers.
A redactional error in article I, part C of the bill was corrected.

36515.s: The bill approves the 2023 Brussels protocol amending the 1994 Eurovignette treaty on road charges for heavy goods vehicles, extending its scope and adding CO2 emission classes. It also amends the Dutch heavy motor vehicle tax act to implement the protocol's tariff structure, effective 1 January 2025.
q: The government considers that the Protocol contains two provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, which directly grant rights or impose obligations on legal subjects.

Het Protocol bevat naar het oordeel van de regering twee eenieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet, die aan rechtssubjecten rechtstreeks rechten toekennen of plichten opleggen.

parties: Asks how the derogation of 1.9% relates to a budgetary gain of about two million euros, how the CO2 classes affect global emissions and relate to Euro norms, and how the levy is enforced internationally.
Worries that the Tax Authority and Dienst Wegverkeer cannot verify CO2 classification of foreign vehicles and that fraud resistance declines, asking for safeguards and level-playing-field guarantees.
How is it guaranteed that all contracting parties adhere to the classification?
Hoe wordt er gewaarborgd dat alle verdragsluitende partijen zich houden aan de classificatie?
Questions the added value of amending the law for a short period before the planned Dutch truck levy starts in 2026, and whether data sharing with treaty partners was considered.
Can the government indicate what the added value of this law amendment is in this short time frame?
Kan de regering aangeven wat de meerwaarde is van deze wetswijziging in het kader van dit korte tijdsbestek?
Asks for precise vehicle numbers in CO2 classes and whether the rise in charges across subgroups is proportionate given market sustainability developments.
Is the increase in charges for the subgroups proportionate according to the government, given developments in sustainability on the market?
Is de oploop in beprijzing voor de subgroepen proportioneel volgens de regering, gezien de ontwikkelingen qua duurzaamheid op de markt?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division, in its opinion of 31 January 2024, raised no substantive remarks on the bill approving and implementing the 2023 Brussels protocol amending the 1994 treaty on road charges for heavy goods vehicles, and advised submitting it to the House. The government's reply of 1 March 2024 notes only redactional changes to the explanatory memorandum, clarifies the transition from Eurovignette to the truck charge, and corrects the number of vehicle groups and the implementation deadline.

36550-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the other High Councils of State, the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council, raising appropriations by about EUR 12.3 million with effect from 1 June 2024. The amendment is largely technical, reallocating funds within the Raad van State for ICT and applying wage and price adjustments.
36550-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reallocations for digitalisation within the Raad van State and wage and price adjustments, not by any delegation of power.
q: This is the result of the digitalisation implemented within the Raad van State.
Dit is het gevolg van de doorgevoerde digitalisering binnen de Raad van State.

36551.s: The bill extends the Netherlands' equal treatment laws (general equal treatment act, gender, disability, age, part-time and fixed-term work rules) to the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) and creates an independent anti-discrimination assistance facility there, with the College voor de rechten van de mens empowered to rule on complaints. It also extends employer dismissal protections and enables the Minister to set detailed rules on the facility's operation and data processing by general administrative order.
36551.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to a general administrative order by stating it will be used only if the protocol proves insufficient and that data rules are needed for legal clarity for citizens.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further requirements may be set on the organisation of the facility and the execution of the tasks referred to in the second paragraph.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen nadere eisen worden gesteld aan de inrichting van de voorziening en de uitvoering van de taken, genoemd in het tweede lid.
d: further requirements on facility organisation and task execution
rules on processing, sharing, retention and security of personal data by the facility
p: Creates an independent anti-discrimination assistance facility for citizens, with the Minister retaining power to set further operational requirements by decree if the protocol proves insufficient.

parties: Asks how the anti-discrimination laws will work in practice, whether sector plans will follow, and who will monitor and steer progress, including the role of the National Coordinator against Discrimination.
They assume this legislation will provide a tool to combat discrimination in practice.
Naar zij aannemen gaat deze wetgeving een handvat bieden om in de praktijk discriminatie tegen te gaan.
Supports the bill but raises concerns about the missing baseline measurement, unassessed costs, and whether the CvdRM should have more binding rulings.

They still have some critical questions, particularly about the still-missing promised baseline measurement and the insufficiently mapped consequences of making the Equal Treatment Act on grounds of disability or chronic illness applicable.

Zij hebben nog wel enkele kritische vragen, met name over het nog ontbreken van de toegezegde nulmeting en de nog onvoldoende in kaart gebrachte gevolgen van het geldig verklaren van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte.

Asks how tailored implementation (maatwerk) can be guaranteed, the status of ratifying the UN disability convention, and the regulatory burden of integrally adopting Dutch laws, citing the Council of State.
Can the government further explain why this option was chosen instead of drafting separate laws for the islands?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom voor deze optie is gekozen in plaats van het opstellen van aparte wetten voor de eilanden?

Asks why government conduct itself is excluded from scope despite possible discriminatory risk profiles, and how residents can be protected against state discrimination; also asks about annual monitoring.
Does the government share the view that the government can also (consciously or unconsciously) be guilty of discrimination?
Deelt de regering de mening dat de overheid zich ook (al dan niet onbewust) schuldig kan maken aan discriminatie
Positive about the bill but worried about unclear costs of accessibility adaptations and whether an impact analysis is needed to ensure costs are correctly estimated.
These members are positive about this law but still have a number of questions.
Deze leden zijn positief gestemd over deze wet maar hebben nog een aantal vragen.

Opposes uncritical application of equal-treatment law to the public bodies, seeking a balance with other fundamental rights such as freedom of religion and expression and local cultural norms, and asks why the government did not reserve tailored room.
From that latter interest they are not enthusiastic about applying equal-treatment legislation unabridged to the public bodies.
Vanuit dat laatste belang zijn zij niet enthousiast over het onverkort toepassen van de gelijke behandelingswetgeving op de openbare lichamen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised revising the explanatory memorandum of the bill extending Dutch anti-discrimination laws to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, covering impact assessment, EU law application, the scope of undue burden in light of local circumstances, and a timeline for ratifying the UN disability convention. The government's reply accepted most remarks, committed to impact research, clarified EU law application and undue burden, and outlined steps toward ratification while making minor drafting changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller account of the status of equal treatment in other areas and the expected impact of extending the laws; the government announced an ongoing baseline measurement and impact assessment to be shared with parliament.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the scope and consequences of voluntarily applying EU equal treatment directives and whether courts must follow CJEU interpretation; the government explained the approach and committed to adding it to chapter 3.

The Afdeling asked for an explanation of how local circumstances figure in the undue-burden test under the disability equal treatment law and whether financial schemes exist to offset burdens; the government stated the test is open and broad and committed to amending chapter 4.

The Afdeling asked for concrete steps and a timeline for ratifying the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities for the Caribbean Netherlands; the government said a plan of action is being prepared with departments and public bodies.
Minor clarifications were made to the bill's structure and to the scope of the power to set rules on processing and security of personal data.

36560-IIA.s: This is a Dutch slotwet that amends the 2023 budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (House of Representatives and Senate) to record realised expenditure and revenue against the amended budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2023

36600-X.s: This bill fixes the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Defence (about EUR 13.3 billion in obligations and EUR 12.2 billion in expenditure) and the 2025 budget of the Paresto agency (EUR 106 million). It does not itself create or delegate any new powers; the memorandum describes Defence tasks including Royal Marechaussee border and police duties in the Caribbean and NATO readiness commitments.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket advisory opinion on the 2025 Defence budget bill, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply notes this and corrects a technical error in the commitments total, reducing it from €13,346,423 to €13,346,313 without changing the overall expenditure or revenue totals.

36605.s: This fiscal omnibus bill (Fiscale verzamelwet 2025) amends several tax laws, including income tax, wage tax, transfer tax, excise, turnover tax, the general tax law and the child-linked budget, with changes effective 1 January 2025. Most provisions are technical or relief measures, with a few new ministerial delegation powers (e.g. adjusting S&O wage-tax thresholds and the interest percentage by ministerial regulation or AMvB).
36605.j: The memorandum justifies the S&O threshold delegation by the need for flexible, timely alignment with the budget without requiring a law amendment each time.
q: To give the Minister of Economic Affairs more room on this point, it is proposed that from 1 January 2025 the threshold between the first and second tier, besides the percentages, can also be adjusted by ministerial regulation.

Om de Minister van EZ op dit punt meer armslag te bieden, wordt voorgesteld om met ingang van 1 januari 2025 naast de percentages ook de grens tussen de eerste en tweede schijf ... te kunnen aanpassen bij ministeriële regeling.
d: adjust S&O wage-tax rates and tier threshold
interest percentage for charged and reimbursed tax interest
p: Extends the period in which the inspector may fine a third party from five to twelve years in specified cases, lengthening limitation protection for affected persons.

parties: Asks how parliamentary rights are safeguarded now that bracket limits in the WBSO can be changed by ministerial regulation, and how much these brackets have changed.
The SGP members ask how the rights of the House are safeguarded now that the bracket limits in the WBSO can also be amended by ministerial regulation?

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen hoe de rechten van de Kamer worden geborgd, nu ook de schijfgrenzen in de Wet Bevordering Speur- en Ontwikkelingswerk (WBSO) bij ministeriële regeling kunnen worden aangepast?
Questions whether a delegation provision for reduced payroll withholding is appropriate, given the principle that taxes may only be levied by statute.
The NSC members assume that taxes may only be levied on the basis of a statute.
De leden van de NSC-fractie gaan ervan uit dat belastingen slechts kunnen worden geheven op basis van een wet.
Criticises the government for ignoring the Council of State's advice to remove the 27-year relative rule from an omnibus bill, arguing fundamental-rights measures need careful treatment.
These members agree with the Council of State that a fiscal omnibus bill is difficult to reconcile with substantive policy measures, especially where they concern fundamental rights.
Deze leden zijn het met de Raad van State eens dat een fiscale verzamelwet zich moeilijk laat verenigen met beleidsinhoudelijke maatregelen, zeker als deze betrekking hebben op grondrechten.
Asks whether anti-abuse rules or the fraus legis principle already apply, and whether the six-month key-agreement period enables tax avoidance.
These members suspect that most key agreements take place only a few weeks before legal transfer.
Deze leden vermoeden dat de meeste sleutelovereenkomsten slechts enkele weken voor juridische overdracht plaatsvinden.
Asks what the government did with each critical point of the Council of State's advice on the relative rule.
Can the government indicate what exactly has been done with this advice, per criticism point of the Council of State?
Kan de regering aangeven wat er precies, per kritiekpunt van de Raad van State, met dit advies gedaan is?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a nota van wijziging to the Fiscale verzamelwet 2025 and found no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën accepted the advice and forwarded the amendment accordingly, so no substantive government reply on objections is needed.

The Raad van State advised on a multi-measure fiscal omnibus bill, recommending removal of two measures: a new statutory information duty for tax inspectors to gather evidence for administrative fines (raising nemo tenetur and fishing-expedition concerns) and abolition of the 27-year age limit for first-degree relatives as toeslagpartners (raising equality and discrimination concerns). The government's reply accepts the advice by withdrawing the information-duty measure and the age-limit abolition is retained with justification and removal of the carry-over provision.
concerns: The information duty for administrative fines raises nemo tenetur and Article 6 ECHR concerns regarding fishing expeditions, sanctions, and legal certainty; the government withdrew the measure from the bill.

Abolishing the 27-year age limit for first-degree relatives as toeslagpartners lacks justification for the unequal treatment compared with other cohabiting persons, raising discrimination concerns; the government argues the difference is justified and expanded the explanation.

Measures involving fundamental rights and substantive policy are unsuitable for an omnibus tax bill requiring careful parliamentary treatment; the government withdrew the information-duty measure from the omnibus.
The carry-over effect of the age-limit change on income tax partner rules raises complexity and inconsistency; the government removed the carry-over provision in the Awir.
Minor redactional changes were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36613-IIB.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 budget for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, adjusting spending and commitments for each institution. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: The 2024 budget statement for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat, Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs en de Kiesraad voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36641.s: The bill amends the Dutch Electoral Act so that remainder seats are no longer allocated to lists whose vote count is below the electoral quotient, and removes the rule that no list may receive more than one remainder seat in one round. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
36641.j: The memorandum justifies the threshold by pointing to fragmentation in local and water board councils and the need for effective control by factions, without framing any new executive power.
q: For that reason the threshold is applied that each party must have obtained at least the electoral quotient to qualify for a remainder seat.
Om die reden wordt de grens gehanteerd dat iedere partij tenminste de kiesdeler moet hebben behaald om in aanmerking te komen voor een restzetel.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether the bill substantially solves coalition formation problems and what the consequences are for one-person factions.
The PVV members state that the government does not sharply describe the causes of the problems the bill partly aims to solve.
De leden van de PVV-fractie stellen dat de regering niet scherp omschrijft welke oorzaken ten grondslag liggen aan de geschetste problemen die dit wetsvoorstel (ten dele) wil oplossen.
Sees benefits in reducing fragmentation but worries about effects on representativeness of decentralised councils with a high threshold.
However, these members have questions about the effects of this bill on the representativeness of the councils concerned.
Wel hebben deze leden vragen bij de gevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel voor de representativiteit van de desbetreffende volksvertegenwoordigingen.
Supports the bill to strengthen decentralised governance, accepting the higher threshold, and asks about the Caribbean public bodies' objections.
These members realise this will lead to a higher electoral threshold, but adjusting the remainder seat allocation is important for strengthening decentralised public administration.

Deze leden beseffen dat dat zal leiden tot een hogere kiesdrempel, maar het aanpassen van de restzetelverdeling is belangrijk vanuit het oogpunt van het versterken van het openbaar bestuur op decentraal niveau.
Supports the aim of reducing fragmentation but shares concerns that the effective threshold strains proportional representation in small municipalities, questioning the uniformity rationale.
An effective electoral threshold of eleven or twenty percent puts considerable pressure on the principle of proportional representation.
Een kiesdrempel van de facto elf of twintig procent legt een behoorlijke druk op het principe van evenredige vertegenwoordiging.
Asks for data on how many of the 89 parties are national or local, the basis for the government's claims, and how the bill addresses councillor workload and oversight capacity.
Worries the measure's effect on representativeness of decentralised bodies is substantial, especially in small councils, and doubts it achieves its aim.
Especially in smaller municipalities (few council seats) the threshold to win a seat will be very high.
Vooral in de kleinere gemeenten (gemeenten met weinig raadszetels) zal de drempel om een zetel te halen erg hoog liggen.

Finds the necessity insufficiently shown, criticises the government's reliance on uniformity over representativeness, and asks why the Otjes findings and the pending study on council size were not awaited.
These members find the necessity of the bill insufficiently clear on the basis of the explanatory memorandum.
Deze leden vinden de noodzaak van het wetsvoorstel op basis van de toelichting onvoldoende duidelijk.
Sees the bill as a threat to representative democracy, questions proportionality and subsidiarity, and asks for empirical justification and consultation with the VNG-related bodies.
These members see this proposal as a threat to representative democracy in the Netherlands.
Deze leden zien dit voorstel als bedreiging voor de representatieve democratie in Nederland.
Accepts the goal of greater council capacity but insists uniformity must not override careful justification; asks about differentiation for small councils and the Eerste Kamer link.
They note that the government considers uniformity decisive, but these members stress at the same time that uniformity must never outweigh careful justification and implementation.

Zij merken op dat het belang van uniformiteit voor de regering doorslaggevend is, maar deze leden benadrukken tegelijkertijd dat uniformiteit nooit boven zorgvuldige onderbouwing en uitvoering mag komen te staan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft amendment to the Kieswet tightening the criminal offence of recruiting proxy votes and introducing a minimum threshold (the full quota) for receiving a remainder seat in decentralised councils. The government's nader rapport split the bill, referred the proxy-recruitment part to the Tweede Kamer separately, and largely defended the threshold while adding justification and an explanation of the remaining points.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness and enforceability of the proxy-recruitment offence in the private sphere and urges a non-criminal approach such as voter information.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address the effects of the quota threshold on representativeness and its very different impact compared with the Tweede Kamer threshold.

The Afdeling asks the government to justify the threshold choice in light of alternatives and to show whether fragmentation is equally present in other decentralised bodies, which the government answered only partly.
The Afdeling asks whether recruiting several persons with one act yields several offences, and whether the government intends that outcome.

36704.s: The bill (Asielnoodmaatregelenwet) amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 to shorten asylum residence permits to a maximum of three years, abolish permanent (onbepaalde tijd) asylum permits, abolish the voornemenprocedure, restrict family reunification to spouses and minor children, and expand grounds for declaring foreigners unwelcome (ongewenstverklaring) and for rejecting applications as manifestly unfounded. It also amends the Awb annex on direct appeal and adds transitional and coordination provisions with other bills.
36704.j: The memorandum justifies the measures as necessary to relieve the asylum chain and reduce inflow, and argues they remain compatible with fundamental rights and EU law, with individual proportionality review.
d: cases where residence permits are granted for less than three years and renewal rules
ARTIKEL I, N (art. 36 Vw) / art. 41 lid 4 Vw (ARTIKEL I, R)
time limits for written response to intended decision and application of procedural rules
ARTIKEL I, DD (art. 68 lid 1 Vw, ongewenstverklaring opheffing)
lifting or temporary lifting of unwelcome declaration
p: Grants the IND power to reject asylum applications as manifestly unfounded where applicants fail to respond, miss hearings, or disappear.
ARTIKEL I, B-D, Q, S-V (abolition of voornemenprocedure and permanent permits)
Abolishes the pre-decision notice procedure allowing foreigners to respond before a decision and removes permanent residence permits, shifting protection from the primary decision stage to appeal.
ARTIKEL I, Z-AA, CC, FF (ongewenstverklaring expansion, art. 67, 79)
Expands grounds for unwelcome declarations, makes direct appeal available without objection, and removes the statutory maximum detention period for certain asylum seekers.
Opens direct appeal to the courts for unwelcome declarations, skipping the administrative objection stage.
Restricts family reunification to a core family, with individual cases still assessed under Article 8 ECHR.

parties: Welcomes the measures to limit asylum inflow and says the party would have preferred immediate effect.
These members would of course have preferred the measures from the Asylum Emergency Measures Act to take effect immediately with the emergency law.
Deze leden hadden natuurlijk het liefst gezien dat de maatregelen uit de Asielnoodmaatregelenwet direct waren ingegaan met de noodwet.
Doubts effectiveness, warns that abolishing the voornemen procedure shifts weighing of facts to the courts, and questions compliance with refugee and naturalisation obligations.
Can the government, on the basis of research, still demonstrate the effectiveness of the measures in this bill?
Kan de regering op basis van onderzoeken alsnog de effectiviteit van de maatregelen in het onderhavig wetsvoorstel aantonen?
Asks how periodic review of asylum permits will work and whether the measures stay consistent with EU law and case law.
To what extent is it ensured that the expanded possibilities for declaring persons unwanted do not conflict with EU law and the case law of the Court of Justice of the EU?
In hoeverre wordt gewaarborgd dat de verruimde mogelijkheden tot ongewenstverklaring geen conflicten opleveren met het Unierecht en de jurisprudentie van het Hof van Justitie van de EU?
Supports tougher asylum policy but questions workability, legal certainty and the position of vulnerable groups facing long-term uncertainty.
Does the government consider there to be a risk that asylum status holders will remain for a long time in uncertainty about their future in the Netherlands?
Acht de regering het risico aanwezig dat asielstatushouders hierdoor langdurig in onzekerheid blijven over hun toekomst in Nederland?
Strongly objects to abolishing unlimited-duration permits, demands an evaluation clause after three years and parliamentary involvement in implementation tests.
They ask the government to include an evaluation provision to evaluate the law after three years both on effectiveness and on its effect on implementation.
Zij vragen de regering een evaluatiebepaling op te nemen om de wet na drie jaar te evalueren zowel op effectiviteit als op het effect op de uitvoering.
Requests transparency about what information the ministry gave coalition parties and the Council of Ministers at each decision point.
The CDA members attach importance to the Chamber being told separately at each of these moments what information was provided.
De leden van het CDA-fractie hechten eraan dat over al deze momenten apart aan de Kamer wordt aangegeven welke informatie daarbij is verstrekt.
Criticises the short consultation, questions the evidence for migration effects and the link of ongoing reviews to integration, and asks about conformity with the Return Directive.
Can the government provide a justification of the precise effect on migration of each measure taken in this proposal?
Kan de regering een onderbouwing geven van het precieze effect op de migratie per maatregel die wordt genomen in dit voorstel?
Objects to a rushed and confidential consultation that failed to weigh input from the bar association and judiciary, undermining due process.
Expresses serious concern about implementation problems, lack of evidence that measures reduce inflow, and worsened legal position of asylum seekers.
To what extent does the government justify the worsening of the legal position of foreigners within the asylum procedure compared with the current situation?
In hoeverre verantwoordt de regering de verslechtering van de rechtspositie van vreemdelingen binnen de asielprocedure ten opzichte van de huidige situatie?
Supports decisive asylum policy to curb inflow and remove pull factors compared with neighbouring countries.
The Netherlands has proven more attractive to asylum seekers than our neighbouring countries, and it is time to remove that incentive.
Nederland is voor asielzoekers aantrekkelijker gebleken dan ons omringende landen, en het is tijd die prikkel weg te nemen.
Questions whether the shorter permit duration adds anything given existing revocation powers and how IND capacity will cope.
How will the government ensure that the IND has the capacity available to process all these extension requests?
Hoe gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat de IND de capaciteit beschikbaar heeft om al deze verlengingsverzoeken te behandelen?
Concerned about advice pointing to unworkability and asks for per-measure justification backed by evidence.
Whether the government can provide, for each proposed measure, a justification backed by figures or (scientific) research.
Of de regering per voorgestelde maatregel een motivatie kan aandragen die onderbouwd is met cijfers of (wetenschappelijk) onderzoek.
Questions whether the government has substantiated that the measures cause no fundamental-rights violations and whether a proper balancing of interests was made.
Can the government still substantiate this claim?
Kan de regering deze stelling alsnog onderbouwen?
Asks the government to explain how a missing balancing of fundamental rights fits its own coalition commitment to safeguard fundamental rights, and requests the balancing be made and shared.
They also urgently request the government to nevertheless make and share this balancing of interests.
Ook verzoeken zij de regering met klem om deze belangenafweging desalniettemin te maken en te delen.
Notes receipt of the TCGCT advice and asks no questions.
There are no questions about this.

Argues the legislator itself must ensure the measures comply with fundamental rights rather than leaving this to implementation or judges, and questions discrimination in family reunification and the abolition of the objection phase.
Does the government agree that the legislator itself must ensure this measure complies with fundamental rights and that this cannot be left to implementation or the judge?

Deelt de regering de mening dat de wetgever er zelf voor dient te zorgen dat ook deze maatregel in overeenstemming is met de grondrechten en dit niet slechts aan de uitvoering of de rechter kan worden overgelaten?
Worries about missing justification of proportionality, possible discriminatory effects, legal certainty, and the higher workload for the judiciary from abolishing the objection phase.
To what extent has the government weighed the proposed measures against the interests of the foreigners whose fundamental rights are at stake?
In hoeverre heeft de regering de voorgestelde maatregelen afgewogen tegen de belangen van de vreemdelingen wiens grondrechten in het geding zijn?
Questions the lack of a balancing of interests, retroactive application to pending applications, and compliance with EU procedural requirements.
Can the government justify why this balancing of interests was not carried out?
Kan de regering motiveren waarom deze belangenafweging niet is gedaan?
Asks the government for its legal assessment of the TCGCT view on immediate effect versus legal certainty and equal treatment under the Family Reunification Directive.

The CDA asks the government how it legally assesses the TCGCT statement that it conflicts with legal certainty and equal treatment to attribute delay caused by a member state to a status holder's application.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering uiteen te zetten hoe zij het advies van de TCGCT juridisch beoordeeld waarin zij stelt: «Uit de interpretatie van de Gezinsherenigingsrichtlijn door het Hof van Justitie van de EU valt verder af te leiden dat het indruist tegen de beginselen van rechtszekerheid en gelijke behandeling wanneer tijdverloop dat door een lidstaat is veroorzaakt, bij de behandeling van een aanvraag wordt aangerekend aan een statushouder».

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against submitting the Asylum Emergency Measures Act in its current form, arguing the bill's effectiveness is not demonstrated, it may increase burdens on the IND and courts, risks conflict with the EU Asylum and Migration Pact, and was prepared hastily. The Minister's reply accepts some points (pact alignment, procedural safeguards, clarified justifications) but maintains most measures, arguing their combined effect will reduce inflow and immediate effect is needed.
concerns: The bill does not demonstrate that the measures will effectively reduce asylum inflow or streamline procedures, and may increase the burden on the asylum chain.
Implementation consequences for the IND, courts and reception were not properly assessed given the rushed consultation, and funding is insufficient.
The bill should be aligned with the EU Asylum and Migration Pact applying from June 2026 to avoid rapid re-amendment and legal uncertainty.
Immediate effect of the new rules in pending cases risks unequal treatment and conflicts with legal certainty; transitional law should be reconsidered.
Procedural delays and the narrowed family reunification scope could infringe the right to a fair trial, family life and non-discrimination in practice.
The expanded possibility of ongewenstverklaring may conflict with the Return Directive's objectives and lacks justification for proportionality.
Abolishing the voornemenprocedure weakens the right to be heard and the procedural filter, increasing appeals and complexity.

36713.s: The bill replaces the flat abonnementstarief for Wmo 2015 services with an income- and asset-dependent eigen bijdrage, letting municipalities charge contributions for general and individual support. It also sets out how contributions are determined, collected by the CAK, and processed under data-protection rules, with delegations to AMvB and ministerial regulation.
36713.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to keep Wmo services available and financially sustainable given ageing and rising demand, and to let municipalities ask contributions matched to ability to pay.
q: enable municipalities to charge clients a contribution for more services, dependent on their financial capacity
gemeenten in staat te stellen voor meer voorzieningen een eigen bijdrage van de cliënt te vragen die afhankelijk is van zijn financiële draagkracht
d: rules on contributions for general services with lasting support relationship
rules on calculation and exemptions of contributions for individual support
other cases where no contribution is due for individual support
data to be supplied to the minister and manner of supply
p: Municipal councils may impose income-dependent contributions for general services, with the level and exemptions set by ordinance, capped at cost price and financially appropriate for the target group.
Municipalities may charge income- and asset-dependent contributions for individual support, with detailed rules left to AMvB and ordinance.
Assigns setting and collection of contributions to the CAK, providers or joint-regulation bodies, with data sharing among them.}

parties: Worries that the contribution will increase poverty risk and burden vulnerable people with disabilities, and asks how the bill fits the UN disability convention's ban on disproportionate financial barriers.
They also have serious concerns about this proposal and its consequences for the target group, which often already consists of people in a vulnerable position.
Zij maken zich ook ernstige zorgen over het onderhavige voorstel en de gevolgen ervan voor de doelgroep, die vaak al bestaat uit mensen in een kwetsbare positie.
Asks whether the bill is effective for sustainability and requests a detailed breakdown of income effects and marginal pressure before judging it.
Questions whether widening municipal discretion over contributions creates postcode-based differences in access, and asks about the financial consequences for several household cases.
If the government's priority is to increase access to care, why was municipal policy freedom on this point instead increased?
Als de regering als speerpunt heeft de toegankelijkheid tot zorg te vergroten, waarom is er dan voor gekozen de beleidsruimte van gemeenten juist op dit punt te vergroten?
Asks how the bill ensures national uniformity and legal certainty and how municipalities keep room for tailored exceptions in hardship cases.
Questions the choice of the 135% income threshold and the 328 euro maximum, the cumulative burden with other charges, and risks of care avoidance.
This percentage appears to be an arbitrary choice.
Dit percentage lijkt een arbitraire keuze te zijn.
Opposes income-dependent contributions as a penalty for care needs, warns of two-tier care, care avoidance and conflict with the UN standstill principle.
This is not about organising solidarity with people who need care according to their means, but an income- and wealth-dependent penalty for a care need.
Het gaat hier namelijk niet om het organiseren van solidariteit met mensen die zorg nodig hebben naar draagkracht, maar om een inkomens- en vermogensafhankelijke boete voor een hulpvraag.
Supports the replacement in principle but questions the design, the 328 euro cap versus median rates, the risk of shifting to Wlz, and the discretion to waive contributions.
Municipalities retain some policy discretion over which clients will be charged the ivb.
Gemeenten behouden enige beleidsruimte wat betreft de vraag aan welke cliënten de ivb zal worden opgelegd.
Accepts the need for an alternative but insists contributions must not impair access for chronically ill people, and questions the reasons for the broad scope and the discretion of municipalities.
At the same time, these members consider it important that a personal contribution does not come at the expense of the accessibility of help and support, particularly for the chronically ill.
Tegelijk vinden deze leden het belangrijk dat een eigen bijdrage niet ten koste gaat van de toegankelijkheid van hulp en ondersteuning aan, met name, chronisch zieken.
Supports a fairer system and more municipal efficiency but has further questions.
These members acknowledge the desire to make the system fairer and to give municipalities room to work more efficiently.
Deze leden onderkennen de wens om het stelsel rechtvaardiger te maken en ruimte te bieden aan gemeenten om doelmatiger te werken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the government better justify the bill replacing the Wmo 2015 subscription tariff with an income- and wealth-dependent contribution as a durable solution, and reconsider the homeowner compensation for housing adaptations. The government's reply raised the maximum contribution, lowered the minimum, and dropped the homeowner compensation provision from the bill.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the bill's income-dependent contribution will sufficiently curb demand for Wmo services and asked for a fuller justification of the maximum amount and durability of the solution.
The Afdeling questions whether the contribution structure and maximum (EUR 298) are proportionate, noting it does not vary with hours of support and may keep high-income demand attractive.

The homeowner compensation for housing adaptations creates legal uncertainty for citizens and risks disputes, and the Afdeling asked for it to be justified or the bill reconsidered; the government dropped the provision.
The homeowner compensation scheme would be complex and hard to implement, and its effects are uncertain, so the government withdrew it.

36731.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2024/1069 against SLAPPs by adding article 224a to the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure, allowing courts to order claimants to post security for costs and damages in public-participation cases. It also extends the security rules to appeals and cassation and amends article 414 accordingly.
36731.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the Directive and as a means to protect press freedom and access to court without creating a separate statutory regime.
q: The court may order security if it considers it appropriate and there are elements indicating abuse of procedure within the meaning of the Directive.
De rechter kan verplichten tot het stellen van zekerheid als hij zulks passend acht en er elementen zijn die erop wijzen dat er sprake is van misbruik van procesrecht in de zin van de richtlijn
p: Gives courts discretion to order security for costs in SLAPP cases, protecting targets of abusive litigation against the claimant rather than shifting power to the executive.

parties: Asks why the directive's handholds for judges were not written into law and why no specific cost regime or expedited procedure for SLAPPs was chosen, given limited case law.
What stands in the way of nevertheless incorporating the mentioned handholds from the EU directive into the law?
Wat verzet zich ertegen om de genoemde handvatten uit de EU-richtlijn toch op te nemen in de wet?
Questions the necessity of the bill given no concrete Dutch SLAPP examples, and asks about the scope of the directive and the lack of an impact assessment.
If these examples cannot be given, what does that say about the necessity of the bill?
Als deze voorbeelden niet kunnen worden gegeven, wat zegt dat over de noodzaak van het wetsvoorstel?
Asks how the judge's test for manifestly unfounded claims and abuse of procedure will work in the Dutch context and how legal certainty about who counts as a SLAPP target can be improved.
Does the government see a chance to provide somewhat more clarification on this?
Ziet de regering kans om hier iets meer duiding bij te geven?

Asks why courts rarely award full costs in practice and why no separate statutory provision requiring full cost recovery in SLAPP cases was chosen, and questions whether a kort geding is better protection than an expedited main proceeding.
In light of the above, why was no separate statutory provision chosen requiring the judge in SLAPP cases to explicitly consider full cost recovery (unless equity opposes it)?

Waarom is, in licht van bovenstaande, niet gekozen voor een aparte wettelijke bepaling dat de rechter in SLAPP-zaken expliciet een volledige proceskostenvergoeding moet overwegen (tenzij de billijkheid zich daartegen verzet)?

Warns that the vague terms 'manifestly unfounded' and 'abuse of procedure' leave wide interpretive room, risking unequal and arbitrary judicial outcomes, and that genuinely wronged parties may be labelled abusers; also asks about court capacity and an evaluation clause.
This may lead to legal inequality and arbitrariness among judges, especially when political or sensitive societal issues are involved.
Dit kan leiden tot rechtsongelijkheid én willekeur bij rechters, zeker als er politieke of gevoelige maatschappelijke onderwerpen spelen.
Asks whether the government will commit to providing the same security-for-costs safeguard in domestic cases as in cross-border cases.
If these members have understood this correctly, they wish to ask whether the government can commit to a security-for-costs provision for domestic cases equal to that for cross-border cases.
