Indien deze leden dit juist hebben begrepen, willen zij vragen of de regering dan wel kan toezeggen dat er eenzelfde voorziening tot zekerheidstelling voor nationale gevallen als voor grensoverschrijdende gevallen gaat komen.

Raises the Raad voor de rechtspraak's concerns about the principle of audi alteram partem in early dismissal and asks why SLAPP rulings are not published and why the scope excludes purely national cases and Caribbean Netherlands.
Does the government understand these concerns? In what way have these concerns been addressed?
Begrijpt de regering deze zorgen? Op welke manier is er tegemoetgekomen aan deze zorgen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Dutch Civil Procedure Code to implement EU Directive 2024/1069 against strategic lawsuits against public participation (SLAPPs), and found no remarks. The government's nader rapport transmits the advice to the King and asks that the bill and explanatory memorandum be sent to the Tweede Kamer, without substantive reply to any points.

36800-V.s: This bill, the 2026 budget act for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, fixes the departmental budget at the amounts listed in the schedule, in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2026 and is accompanied by an explanatory memorandum on policy priorities such as sanctions enforcement and the international legal order.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget schedule belonging to this act for the year 2026 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport confirms this and makes only technical adjustments to EU contributions and the unallocated HGIS article, raising total expenditure and receipts.

36812.s: The bill (Belastingplan 2026) amends numerous tax laws for 2026 and later: it adjusts income tax brackets and allowances, car and bicycle benefits, the lucratief belang regime, inheritance rules for biological children, environmental taxes and motor vehicle taxes. It also includes a delegation to adjust the early-retirement (RVU) drempelvrijstelling via algemene maatregel van bestuur with voorhang.
36812.j: The memorandum justifies the RVU delegation by the need for speed in adjusting the exemption, while keeping parliamentary involvement through voorhang.
q: Although the subject matter justifies regulation by statute, amending the threshold exemption does not lend itself to that, given the speed required.
Hoewel de materie inhoudelijk regeling bij wet rechtvaardigt, leent de wijziging van de drempelvrijstelling zich daar niet voor, gezien de snelheid die daarbij geboden is.
d: adjusting or phasing out RVU threshold exemption
Artikel III lid 4 (artikel 32bc; Artikel IV B)
Minister sets rules and valuation for company cars
rules on genetic test proving biological parenthood
annual indexation of motor vehicle tax amounts
p: Allows the minister to amend RVU exemption rules by general administrative order, subject to a voorhang procedure and annual reporting.
Allows a ministerial regulation to amend tax laws to fix overlapping-law errors, without a parliamentary check.

parties: Questions why the government did not reverse the lowering of the general tax credit and whether the taakstelling on fiscal arrangements is genuinely filled, and asks for justification of the chosen offsets.
These members ask the government to explain why this has not succeeded and how this can be reconciled with the fact that many ineffective fiscal arrangements still exist.
Deze leden vragen de regering om toe te lichten hoe het komt dat dit niet is gelukt en hoe dit te rijmen is met het feit dat er nog steeds vele ondoelmatige fiscale regelingen zijn.

Asks the government to justify the carried-interest multiplier against international comparisons, administrative burden and the Belastingdienst's capacity, and questions retroactive application to existing structures.
Can the government indicate how the proposed multiplier compares with the tax burden on comparable income in countries such as Germany, France and the United Kingdom?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe de voorgestelde multiplier zich verhoudt tot de belastingdruk op vergelijkbare inkomsten in landen als Duitsland, Frankrijk en het Verenigd Koninkrijk?
Asks for an updated purchasing-power picture reflecting two adopted motions, and asks how the government will ensure enforceability of the fietsregeling and the carried-interest measure.
These members ask the government to confirm that a written agreement between employer and employee stating the bicycle may not be taken home is sufficient evidence to omit the bijtelling.

Deze leden vragen de regering te bevestigen dat een schriftelijke afspraak tussen werkgever en werknemer waarin wordt vastgelegd dat de fiets niet mee naar huis mag worden genomen voldoende bewijs vormt om de bijtelling achterwege te laten.

Criticises the use of the tabelcorrectiefactor as a vehicle for structural measures and questions the fairness of lowering the heffingsvrij vermogen, which shifts the burden of the box 3 repair onto a new group.
In their view this is not a suitable instrument to cover structural measures.
In hun ogen is dit geen passend instrument om structurele maatregelen mee te dekken.

Questions the unilateral change in the box 3 return on overige bezittingen, citing the Raad van State, asks for an external legal analysis on property rights and an impact analysis on the rental market.
These members ask whether an external legal analysis has been carried out on the legal tenability of this unilateral increase, as it may conflict with the undisturbed enjoyment of property.

Deze leden vragen of een externe juridische analyse is uitgevoerd ten aanzien van juridische houdbaarheid van deze voorgestelde eenzijdige verhoging, omdat dit mogelijk niet strookt met het ongestoord genot van eigendom.
Questions the non-indexation of tax parameters as a hidden tax increase that burdens lower incomes, and the unequal treatment of disability benefit recipients under the arbeidskorting.
These members also draw attention to the fact that the high arbeidskorting leads to large, unjust outcomes for people who are disabled.
Deze leden vragen ook aandacht voor het feit dat de hoge arbeidskorting tot grote, onrechtvaardige uitkomsten leidt voor mensen die arbeidsongeschikt zijn.
Questions the purpose and expected effectiveness of further raising the arbeidskorting and the first-bracket rate, and the widening single-earner/dual-earner tax gap.
Various studies have shown that the scope for effectiveness and efficiency gains from a further increase in tax credits on labour participation has been exhausted.
Diverse onderzoeken hebben laten zien dat de rek uit de doelmatigheid en doeltreffendheid van een verdere verhoging van belastingkortingen op de arbeidsparticipatie eruit is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Belastingplan 2026 package, raising concerns about amendment quality, unclear multiple policy goals, the energy tax credit increase, the new pseudo-eindheffing on company cars, the ungelijke breukdelen measure and related transitional rules. The government's nader rapport accepts a number of points (e.g. amending the transitional period and the scope of the breukdelen transitional rule, adding explanations) but keeps several measures, including the energy tax credit increase and the breukdelen measure in substance.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the breukdelen measure's transitional rules were unclear and too strict, and the government moved the cut-off date and loosened the rule for unrelated amendments.
The Afdeling questioned whether the broad breukdelen taxation is proportionate given its goal of combating tax constructions, and the government maintained it is justified.
The Afdeling questioned the effectiveness and efficiency of the increase in the energy tax credit for all households and advised reconsidering it; the government kept the measure.
The Afdeling asked for clearer goals, efficiency and evaluation in the explanatory memorandum for many measures, and the government adjusted the text in part.
The Afdeling flagged enforcement and implementation problems with the pseudo-eindheffing on company cars and asked for explanation; the government supplemented the memorandum but kept the measure.
The Afdeling urged government and parliament to improve the amendment process to avoid defective amendments requiring repair legislation.
The Afdeling asked for justification under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR for the breukdelen measure, and the government added this to the memorandum.

36820-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget of the other high state bodies, the governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council (suppletoire begroting September), raising total expenditure and reallocating funds among the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman and other bodies. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 16 September 2025.

36902.s: The bill obliges municipalities and public bodies to ensure a library service within reasonable distance for residents, strengthens the library framework (national digital infrastructure, provincial support institutions, school reading promotion), and amends the Copyright Act and Neighbouring Rights Act to impose a lending-right remuneration on schools and vocational institutions for book loans. Several executive decisions are left to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
36902.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative orders and ministerial regulations by the need for detailed rules on the multi-year plan content, the fair remuneration calculation and the designation procedure, which it says are better left to lower-level regulation.
q: Further rules on the content of the multi-year plan are laid down by general administrative order.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot de inhoud van het meerjarenplan.
d: content of municipal multi-year library plan
rules on subsidies and specific grants for school reading promotion
procedure for designating provincial support institution and subsidy
method for determining the fair remuneration for school lending
rules on costs and remuneration of foundation chair
rules on costs and remuneration of SOnT chair
Art. III (art. 15b Wet op de naburige rechten)
rules on costs and remuneration of foundation chair
p: Provincial support institutions are designated by the Minister and funded by subsidy, with the Minister setting designation procedures by ministerial regulation.
Libraries gain a duty to promote reading in schools, with Minister able to grant subsidies or specific grants for this purpose by ministerial regulation.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised that the bill amending the public library system law (mandatory at least one full library per municipality) and the Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Acts (lending remuneration for school libraries) may proceed without substantive remarks. The minister's reply states that only redactional and technical changes were made, with no substantive changes.

36911.s: The bill amends the Wet kinderopvang to extend childcare allowance (KOT) eligibility to parents who are PhD candidates or technology design trainees, to treat childcare on public holidays as agreed hours, and to remove a statutory clause on allowances of 33.3 percent or less. It sets the entry-into-force date by royal decree, with retroactive effect for some changes.
36911.j: The memorandum justifies the retroactive effect by avoiding repayment claims and notes that the Dienst Toeslagen can verify hours through invoices if needed.
q: To prevent this from leading to reclaims in practice, the government proposes giving retroactive effect to the part of the bill on the right to KOT for PhD candidates and technology design trainees, up to and including 1 January 2025.

Om te voorkomen dat dit in de praktijk tot terugvorderingen leidt, stelt de regering voor om aan het onderdeel van het wetsvoorstel dat gaat over het recht op KOT voor promovendi en technologisch ontwerpers in opleiding terugwerkende kracht te verlenen tot en met 1 januari 2025.
d: entry into force date and retroactive effect of parts of the act
height and calculation method of childcare allowance

parties: Supports the direction of the bill but asks how the transition to a new financing system will work and how the extension to broader groups and the technical correction will be applied uniformly across municipalities.
The D66 members see this bill as an improvement of the childcare system and support the direction it sets.
De leden van de D66-fractie zien met dit wetsvoorstel een verbetering van het systeem van de kinderopvang en onderschrijven de richting die hiermee ingezet wordt.
Has no questions on the bill.
These members have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben verder geen vragen.

Asks whether the eligibility conditions can be verified, questions the working requirement and its complexity, and queries the retroactive effect creating inequality between applicants and non-applicants.
These members do ask to what extent it can be checked whether this right actually exists under the proposed new rules.
Deze leden vragen wel in hoeverre te controleren valt of dit recht onder de voorgestelde nieuwe regels daadwerkelijk bestaat.
Supports exceptions for certain groups, including PhD candidates and designers without employment contracts, and asks whether the exception provisions are complete and justified.
That is why these members also favour giving PhD candidates without an employment contract and technological design trainees without an employment contract a right to childcare allowance.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Wet kinderopvang to improve several childcare allowance provisions be submitted to the Tweede Kamer without remarks. The minister's reply notes that the explanatory memorandum was clarified on retroactive effect for promovendi and technological designers in training and on entitlement to childcare allowance for mandatory parts of the Wet inburgering 2021.

36945-L.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2025 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds, the National Growth Fund, to reflect the final budget outcome. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides that the law takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
